Motivation: 山火季延长带来严重威胁，而美国有 2600 万人英语能力有限，超过 80% 的应急信息仅以英文发布，导致边缘化群体信息获取不平等。

Method: 系统整合 Watch Duty 的火场边界、疏散令和避难所数据；利用实时 GPS 与 NOAA 天气数据预测火险，用 XGBoost 动态调度风险评估更新；通过避让多边形的路径规划生成疏散路线，并配有情境感知的多语言智能体、个性化清单及自动语言切换界面。

Result: 系统能在用户接近火场时发送含疏散路线的警报，并动态生成、勾选个性化提醒项，界面依据用户最近使用的语言自动切换。

Conclusion: BEACON 通过多语言、个性化的综合疏散指引，有望改善应急场景下对边缘化社区的信息服务。

Abstract: Wildfire seasons have become 84 days longer in the current days than in the 1970s, causing enormous threats to one's financial status and short- and long-term health. During the fire, public agencies send out emergency messages to provide warnings and orders. Although 26 million people in the US have limited English proficiency, over 80% of those messages are only delivered in English, which can cause disproportionate information distribution and awareness. In order to better serve marginalized communities during emergencies, the authors developed BEACON, a service that provides comprehensive and personalized evacuation guidance, including navigation routes, personalized checklists, and a chatbot in the language that a user uses. Our current system ingests data including fire perimeter information, evacuation order status, and shelter information from Watch Duty. When a user is within a certain proximity from the fire, the system utilizes real-time GPS locations and nearby weather data from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) to predict fire danger levels. The assessment model refreshment are dynamically scheduled based on fire progress and trends using XGBoost. If the location has a likelihood of fire danger, the system sends alerts with evacuation routes outputted from a polygon-avoidant routing pipeline. The application provides a context-aware multilingual agent that users can communicate with and is tightly connected to other features of the application. In addition, based on data that the user entered, the system dynamically generates and checks off personalized reminder items to provide an organized evacuation plan. The system's user interface dynamically changes its language settings based on the language the user most recently used in either setting or chatbot conversation for all the application elements.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [140] [Stochastic Gradient Descent over P2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13343)
*Maria Oprea,Qin Li,Yunan Yang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文为概率测度（Wasserstein空间P2）上的随机优化建立了SGD的扩散近似，即用高斯噪声替代随机梯度，达到二阶弱精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SGD在欧氏空间的扩散近似是理解其动力学与长期行为的强大工具。本文探究这一近似原理能否推广到以Wasserstein空间P2上的泛函为目标函数的概率测度优化问题。但P2的非线性几何与无穷维特性阻碍了经典欧氏理论的直接延伸。

Method: 利用Lions微分将问题提升到线性Hilbert空间，从而获得高阶微分运算能力。构造一个高斯随机场近似，使其速度场的均值与协方差与原随机梯度相匹配；通过高阶Taylor展开实现矩匹配。

Result: 证明了该高斯近似以二阶弱精度刻画原始SGD的动力学。

Conclusion: 该结果为在概率测度上的随机优化中用解析可处理的高斯涨落替代样本驱动的随机性提供了严格的理论基础。

Abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) admits diffusion approximations that replace the complicated randomness of stochastic gradients by Gaussian noise, providing a powerful tool for understanding its dynamics and long-time behavior. We investigate whether an analogous approximation principle holds for optimization over probability measures, where the objective is a functional defined on the Wasserstein space P2. The nonlinear geometry and infinite-dimensional nature of P2 prevent a direct extension of the classical Euclidean theory. Using Lions differentiability, we lift the problem to a linear Hilbert space, where higher-order differential calculus becomes available. We then construct a Gaussian random-field approximation whose velocity field matches the mean and covariance of the original stochastic gradient. By exploiting this moment matching through higher-order Taylor expansions, we show that the Gaussian approximation captures the SGD dynamics with second-order weak accuracy. Our result provides a rigorous foundation for replacing sample-driven randomness by analytically tractable Gaussian fluctuations in stochastic optimization over probability measures.

</details>


### [141] [Beyond Point Forecasts: A Survey on Probabilistic Forecasting for Time Series and Spatiotemporal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13345)
*Donia Besher,Rajdeep Pathak,Madhurima Panja,Tanujit Chakraborty*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于概率预测的综述，提出以“不确定性引入位置与方式”为轴的统一分类法，并辅以跨范式实证研究，揭示没有单一范式在所有场景中占优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率预测对不确定性决策至关重要，但其方法在时间/时空预测、统计建模、机器学习与深度生成建模等方向日益碎片化，缺乏统一视角与选型指南。

Method: 按不确定性如何引入预测流程构建分类体系：模型无关方法（集成、无分布校准）与模型内在方法（贝叶斯建模、参数化预测分布、分布回归、现代生成模型），并考察时间序列基础模型；同时在单变量、多变量和时空任务上开展跨范式实证对比。

Result: 跨范式实验表明：没有任何单一不确定性量化范式在所有场景占优；校准、锐度、预测精度与计算效率会导致显著不同的模型偏好；高表达能力生成模型与零样本基础模型在精度-效率权衡上差异明显。

Conclusion: 综述提供统一概念框架与实用选型路线图，并指出未来挑战，包括演化依赖结构中的不确定性、物理信息预测分布、极端事件预测、计数/方向/连续时间序列建模及统一软件资源建设。

Abstract: Probabilistic forecasting is central to decision-making under uncertainty, yet its methodological landscape has become increasingly fragmented across temporal and spatiotemporal forecasting, statistical modeling, machine learning, and deep generative modeling. This survey develops a unified perspective by organizing probabilistic forecasting methods according to where and how uncertainty is introduced into the forecasting pipeline. Our taxonomy connects model-agnostic approaches including ensembles and distribution-free calibration, with model-intrinsic approaches spanning Bayesian modeling, parametric predictive distributions, distributional regression, and modern generative models, and further examines the emerging role of time series foundation models. Beyond methodological synthesis, we identify the assumptions, computational demands, and forms of uncertainty represented by different paradigms, and translate these distinctions into data-driven and domain-specific guidance for method selection. We complement the survey with a cross-paradigm empirical study on univariate, multivariate, and spatiotemporal forecasting tasks. The results reveal that no single uncertainty-quantification paradigm dominates across settings. Calibration, sharpness, predictive accuracy, and computational efficiency can lead to substantially different model preferences, while expressive generative models and zero-shot foundation models exhibit markedly different accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. Lastly, we identify unresolved challenges surrounding uncertainty in evolving dependency structures, physics-informed predictive distributions, forecasting extreme events, handling count-valued, directional, and continuous-time series, and the development of unified software resources. Our survey provides both a conceptual framework and a practical roadmap for probabilistic forecasting research.

</details>


### [142] [A pullback-corrected scalar auxiliary variable optimizer with momentum and adaptive mobility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13569)
*Jiahao Zhang,Shiheng Zhang,Guang Lin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文将PB-SAV方法的曲率修正引入带动量和自适应迁移率的优化器，通过单一隐式求解同时作用于梯度与动量，并给出精确修正能量律和局部稳定性条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学机器学习目标常为多项损失之和（残差、边界、初始、数据等）。PB-SAV方法用单标量跟踪移位目标，各分量梯度构成秩至多为分量数的半正定曲率修正，但如何将该修正融入带动量与自适应迁移率的优化器尚待研究。

Method: 在带动量和自适应迁移率的优化器中引入PB-SAV曲率修正，对梯度与存储动量在单一隐式求解中同时施加修正；采用Loewner序非增的迁移率，并分析动量附加于求解后的情形；推导局部稳定性充要条件（依赖Hessian减二倍修正）。

Result: 非增迁移率给出精确修正能量律，涵盖欧氏与AMSGrad型选择；求解后附加动量的恒等式含不定号交叉项。固定迁移率下给出驻点局部稳定的充要条件，并证明其对所有标量松弛序列具有局部几何收敛。隐式求解化为阶数为分量数的稠密系统。前向Burgers对比中，四分量较单分量在同学习率与动量设置下平均尾部目标降64.7%、最终解误差降50.2%。

Conclusion: 该工作将PB-SAV曲率修正无缝集成到带动量与自适应迁移率的优化框架，提供精确能量律、局部稳定性与收敛性保证，并在多分量科学机器学习任务上显著提升优化性能。

Abstract: Objectives in scientific machine learning are often prescribed as a sum of several terms, such as the residual, boundary, initial, and data losses of a physics-informed neural network. In the pullback-corrected scalar auxiliary variable (PB--SAV) method, one scalar tracks the shifted objective while the component gradients build a positive semidefinite curvature correction of rank at most the number of components. We carry that correction into an optimizer with momentum and an adaptive mobility, applying it to the gradient and the stored momentum in a single implicit solve. A mobility that is nonincreasing in the Loewner order yields an exact modified energy law, covering Euclidean and AMSGrad-type choices; the corresponding identity for momentum appended after the solve carries a cross term of indefinite sign. For a fixed mobility we give a necessary and sufficient condition for local stability at a stationary point, depending on the Hessian minus twice the correction, and show that it also gives local geometric convergence for every scalar relaxation sequence. The implicit solve reduces to a dense system whose order is the number of components. In the forward Burgers comparison, four components reduce the mean tail objective by 64.7% and the final solution error by 50.2% relative to one component at the same learning rate and momentum settings.

</details>


### [143] [Resolution-Independent Analysis of Encoder--Decoder Operator Learning via Limiting Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13798)
*Lei Shi,Jia-Qi Yang,Ding-Xuan Zhou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文研究编码-解码架构下算子学习的核方法理论：编码空间上的矩阵核诱导原函数空间上的算子值核，二者RKHS等距同构；随分辨率增大诱导核在算子范数下收敛到极限核，从而可在与编码分辨率无关的假设下给出SGD误差上界与下界，并扩展到NTK框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算子学习本质上定义在函数空间上，但训练数据只能以有限维表示形式获得（如离散采样、Fourier系数等）。编码-解码架构引入了编码分辨率这一人为因素，其如何影响学习误差、是否可被消除，缺乏理论刻画。

Method: 1) 将编码空间上的矩阵值核提升为原函数空间上的算子值核，证明相应RKHS等距同构；2) 分析分辨率增大时诱导核在算子范数意义下收敛到极限核，使正则性假设独立于编码分辨率；3) 对正则化SGD分别给出递减步长与固定步长下的上界，将编码误差、正则化项与优化项（t^{-θ}、T^{-θ'}）分离；4) 证明编码相关项的下界；5) 通过极限NTK将分析推广到编码-解码神经网络，引入有限宽度项与参数/样本复杂度保证。

Result: 得到递减与固定步长下SGD的误差上界，实现编码项、正则项与优化项的显式分离；证明编码诱导项在一般情况下不可避免（下界）；在编码误差代数衰减时给出含有限宽度项的误差界以及多项式参数与样本复杂度保证。框架涵盖径向核与点积核构造的矩阵核、宽编码-解码网络的NTK，以及基于Fourier、Legendre多项式、小波、PCA与逐点采样的编解码对。

Conclusion: 编码分辨率并非理论障碍：诱导核的极限收敛性使学习理论可在函数空间层面独立于离散化方式陈述，且误差中编码贡献可被显式刻画并具有本质下界；该框架统一了多种核与编解码表示，并为编码-解码神经网络提供了复杂度保证。

Abstract: Operator learning is formulated on function spaces, but training data are typically available only through finite-dimensional representations. In encoder--decoder architectures, a matrix-valued kernel on the encoded space induces an operator-valued kernel on the original function spaces, and the corresponding reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces are isometrically isomorphic. As the input and output resolutions increase, the induced kernels converge to a limiting kernel, in the sense of operator-norm convergence of their associated integral operators, allowing regularity assumptions to be stated independently of the encoding resolution. For regularized stochastic gradient descent, we establish upper bounds for decreasing and fixed step sizes, separating the encoding and regularization terms from optimization terms of order \(t^{-θ}\) and \(T^{-θ'}\), respectively, for any \(θ,θ'\in(0,1)\). We further prove lower bounds showing that these encoding-induced terms are generally unavoidable. The analysis is further extended to encoder--decoder neural networks through the limiting neural tangent kernel (NTK), yielding error bounds with an additional finite-width term and polynomial parameter and sample complexity guarantees when the encoding errors decay algebraically. The framework covers matrix-valued kernels constructed from radial and dot product kernels, NTKs arising from wide encoder--decoder neural networks, and encoder--decoder pairs based on Fourier, Legendre polynomial, wavelet, PCA, or pointwise sampling representations.

</details>


### [144] [Just add noise: Debiasing tree-based variable importance in mixed data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14083)
*Jiahe Li,Omar Melikechi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 基于树的变量重要性评分对分类预测变量存在系统性偏置，作者从理论上分析此偏置并提出对分类变量加少量噪声的简单修正方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机森林等基于树方法的变量重要性评分偏向连续预测变量、低估分类预测变量，这一偏置会影响特征选择结果的公平性与可靠性。

Method: 对偏置进行理论分析；提出简单修正：给每个分类预测变量加入少量噪声；并结合 integrated path stability selection 用于混合数据变量选择与错误发现控制。

Result: 在多种模拟数据集和真实数据集上验证了修正的有效性，并能实现混合数据的变量选择及错误发现控制。

Conclusion: 加噪声修正可有效缓解树模型对分类变量的重要性偏置，配合稳定性选择可得到带错误发现控制的变量选择结果。

Abstract: Variable importance scores from tree-based methods such as random forests favor continuous predictors over categorical ones. We present a theoretical analysis of this bias and propose a simple remedy: add a small amount of noise to each categorical predictor. The correction is demonstrated on a variety of simulated and real-world datasets and combined with integrated path stability selection to perform variable selection with false discovery control for mixed data.

</details>


### [145] [Exact Finite Attention Responses From RoPE Derivatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14127)
*Julie Huang,Maggie Chlon,Gregory Gutin,Leon Chlon*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出用于注意力干预的精确局部响应方法，通过RoPE导数推导有限位置位移并穿过softmax，实现对编辑候选的快速打分；在位置编辑和键值联合编辑上大幅降低误差，并附带KL证书与查询控制表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力干预（如位置、键、值编辑）通常需要昂贵的前向执行来评估效果，且现有基于位置雅可比或简单叠加归因的方法存在近似误差，尤其忽略键值同时编辑的交互项。

Method: 从RoPE导数 ∂_p z(p)=A z(p) 出发，其积分给出有限位置位移，并在不线性化旋转与归一化的情况下穿过softmax；用缓存基线和一次反向传播对候选编辑打分；对键值联合编辑用差商计算分离交互项 C_KV。

Result: 在768个留出提示集、92,160次位置编辑上达到95.36–96.52%符号准确率，答案边际MAE较位置雅可比降低73.6–82.5%，较零基线降低36.2–50.9%；在5,120次干预扫描中保留交互项使下游边际MAE降低九倍以上，较二次交互校正降低75.9–98.5%。

Conclusion: 该微积分框架为注意力编辑提供精确局部响应，支持快速候选排序与缓存决策；还给出局部近似误差的KL证书、精确查询条件梯度步表示及最小范数查询控制。

Abstract: We derive exact local responses for attention interventions, allowing candidate edits to be scored from a cached baseline and one backward pass. The starting point is the RoPE derivative $\partial_p z(p) = A z(p)$: its integral gives the finite positional displacement, which we carry through the softmax without linearising either rotation or normalisation. The resulting predictions achieve 95.36--96.52% sign accuracy across 92,160 executed positional edits on 768 held-out prompt sets, reducing answer-margin MAE by 73.6--82.5% against the positional Jacobian and by 36.2--50.9% against zero. For simultaneous key and value edits, the same divided-difference calculus isolates the interaction term $C_{KV} = \sum_j (p'_j - p_j)\,\varepsilon_j$, which is omitted by adding separate attributions. Retaining it reduces downstream margin MAE by more than a factor of nine in every setting of a 5,120-intervention sweep across two Qwen sizes, two tasks, and multiple layers; reductions against a quadratic interaction correction are 75.9--98.5%. Exactness concerns the edited attention write; downstream predictions contract that response with a baseline gradient and are evaluated by native execution. The calculus also yields a KL certificate for local approximation error, an exact query-conditioned gradient-step representation whose curvature identifies attention-preserving query directions, and minimum-norm query control. Sparse evaluation supports candidate ranking and cache decisions under explicit local distortion criteria.

</details>


### [146] [Multi-source conformal prediction: leveraging heterogeneity via localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14531)
*Rohan Hore,Anirban Chatterjee,Sayantan Choudhury*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出MS-RLCP方法，将随机局部化保形预测扩展到多源异构数据，通过数据自适应源选择实现有限样本覆盖保证，并在模拟与真实实验中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代预测任务常涉及多个异质数据源，且测试分布可能与任一单一源显著不同。异质性虽带来挑战，但不同源在特征空间不同区域各有优势，可提供互补信息，从而实现更优的覆盖与预测。

Method: 基于随机局部化保形预测（RLCP）的局部覆盖性质，提出多源随机局部化保形预测（MS-RLCP），通过数据自适应源选择将其扩展到多源场景。在源间与测试群体条件响应分布共享的假设下，采用可解释的"包络分布"刻画各源的聚合特征空间表示，建立有限样本覆盖界；并允许测试特征分布关于包络绝对连续，超越源分布混合的情形。在额外正则条件下证明渐近的测试条件覆盖。

Result: 理论上给出有限样本覆盖界及渐近测试条件覆盖；实验上，模拟与真实数据实验表明MS-RLCP在不同数据异质程度下均有效。

Conclusion: MS-RLCP通过数据自适应源选择有效利用多源异构数据的互补性，在不要求测试分布为源分布混合的宽松条件下提供覆盖保证，适用于各类异质水平的多源预测任务。

Abstract: Many modern prediction tasks involve data from multiple heterogeneous sources, while the test distribution may differ substantially from any individual source. Although heterogeneity poses challenges, it also offers an opportunity: different sources may provide complementary information, with some regions of the feature space better represented in one source than another. We propose Multi-Source Randomly Localized Conformal Prediction (MS-RLCP), which builds on the local coverage properties of randomly localized conformal prediction (RLCP) (Hore and Barber, 2025) and extends it to multiple sources through data-adaptive source selection. Under the widely adopted assumption of a shared response distribution conditional on the features across sources and the test population, we establish finite-sample coverage bounds using an interpretable notion of envelope distribution that captures their aggregate feature-space representation. Our analysis allows the test feature distribution to be absolutely continuous with respect to the envelope, extending beyond mixtures of source distributions. Under additional regularity conditions, we also establish asymptotic test-conditional coverage. Simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MS-RLCP across varying levels of data heterogeneity.

</details>


### [147] [Evaluation of optimisation and Bayesian inference methods for reaction rates in atmospheric chemical mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14569)
*Valery Ashu,Wenqing Peng,Zhi-Song Liu,Heikki Haario,Andreas Rupp,Taiwo Ashu,Petri Clusius,Lukas Pichelstorfer,Zihao Fu,Michael Boy*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文用已知真值的合成数据，在玩具自氧化机理上比较了ODE约束神经网络优化与MCMC两类速率系数反演方法，发现二者互补：低噪时NN高效、MCMC稳健于高噪并能量化不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显式大气化学机理中反应速率系数的约束是核心难题，尤其自氧化体系多路径仅能通过高分辨质谱间接观测，导致参数可比性（identifiability）与不确定性难以刻画。

Method: 构建玩具自氧化机理，用已知真值的合成数据检验两类方法：一是ODE约束的神经网络优化（点估计），二是MCMC（后验采样与不确定性量化）。分别用直接浓度观测与质谱观测，并在不同噪声水平下测试，加入后验预测验证。

Result: 无扰动与低噪下两法均收敛至真值，NN点估计更快；高噪（S/N≈1）下MCMC恢复速率系数明显更稳健。后验分析显示质谱聚合即使在低噪下也扩大可信区间，高噪质谱使许多单速率弱可辨识；但后验预测验证表明宽参数不确定性仍能准确重现可观测质谱。

Conclusion: 点估计与贝叶斯采样提供互补信息：神经网络优化适用于信息丰富的数据，而MCMC对诊断不确定性、非唯一性与可辨识性问题不可或缺，尤其在高噪或聚合反演问题中。

Abstract: Constraining reaction rate coefficients is a central challenge in the development of explicit atmospheric chemical mechanisms, particularly for autoxidation systems where many reaction pathways are only indirectly observed through high-resolution mass spectrometry. In this study, we evaluate rate-coefficient optimisation methods for a toy-case autoxidation mechanism using synthetic data with known ground truth. Two complementary approaches are compared: ODE-constrained neural-network optimisation, which provides efficient point estimates of uncertain rate coefficients, and the Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) approach, which samples the posterior distribution of rate coefficients and quantifies parameter uncertainty. The methods are tested using direct concentration observations and mass-spectral observations under different noise levels. For unperturbed and low-noise synthetic observations, both methods converged towards the known rate coefficients, with the neural-network optimiser providing faster point estimates. Under high-noise conditions (with the signal-to-noise ratio approximately S / N = 1), however, MCMC was substantially more robust in recovering the rate coefficients. The posterior analysis shows that mass-spectral aggregation broadens credible intervals even at low noise, and that high-noise mass spectra can leave many individual reaction rates weakly identifiable. Posterior predictive validation nevertheless shows how broad parameter uncertainty constrained by MCMC remains consistent with accurate reproduction of the observable mass spectrum. These results demonstrate that point-estimation and Bayesian sampling methods provide complementary information: neural-network optimisation is effective for informative data, whereas MCMC is essential for diagnosing uncertainty, non-uniqueness, and identifiability in noisy or aggregated inverse problems.

</details>


### [148] [PU classification under Non-SCAR: clustering-assisted logistic model with oversampling enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14675)
*Konrad Furmańczyk,Kacper Paczutkowski*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究在违反SCAR假设下的PU分类问题，将SMOTE技术整合到基于逻辑回归的聚类方法（含严格/非严格Lasso）中，以缓解类别不平衡，并在13个真实基准数据集和1个合成数据集上验证其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PU分类方法通常假设SCAR（selected completely at random）成立，但现实中该假设常被违反，同时类别不平衡问题会进一步影响分类性能，因此需要寻找在此情形下更稳健的方法。

Method: 采用基于逻辑回归的聚类方法及其严格与非严格Lasso扩展。先用SMOTE对训练集进行重平衡，再通过2-means聚类导出干净的标签；随后在清洗后的数据上训练逻辑回归，其中识别出的正例被附加额外真阳性，其余样本作为负例处理。与朴素方法和Spy-EM方法进行对比。

Result: 在13个真实基准数据集和1个合成数据集上的实验表明，当SCAR条件被违反时，引入SMOTE能提升分类性能，并且LassoJoint方法在该设定下表现出中等程度的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 将SMOTE与基于逻辑回归的聚类方法结合，可在SCAR假设被违反时改善PU分类性能，LassoJoint方法具有一定的稳健性。

Abstract: This study addresses the PU classification problem under violations of the SCAR assumption. We investigate logistic regression-based approaches, namely the cluster method and its extensions with strict and non-strict Lasso regularization. The primary contribution of this work is the integration of the SMOTE technique to alleviate class imbalance and systematically assess its impact on the performance of the considered algorithms. SMOTE is first applied to rebalance the training dataset. Next, cleaning labels are derived via 2-means clustering. Logistic regression is then trained on the cleaned data, where identified positive instances are augmented with additional true positives and the remaining observations are treated as negative. The experimental evaluation is conducted on 13 real benchmark datasets and one synthetic dataset. For comparison, we include the naive approach and the Spy-EM method. The results demonstrate that incorporating SMOTE improves classification performance when the SCAR condition is violated and indicate moderate robustness of the LassoJoint method in this setting.

</details>


### [149] [From matrix inversion to constraints: provably tighter confidence regions for importance weights in label shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14802)
*Mushan Li,Kihyun Han,Yanyuan Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出从"反演式推断"转向"直接矩阵约束"框架，用于标签漂移下域适应的重要性权重不确定性分析，得到更紧且具有精确有限样本有效性的置信区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标签漂移下的域适应中，重要性权重常因有限样本不确定性而失效；现有方法用区间线性系统的高斯消元分析不确定性，导致置信区域过于保守、下游应用低效。

Method: 提出直接矩阵约束框架替代反演式推断，定义联合置信区域，并通过线性规划提取边际区间，推导可证明更紧的权重边界；同时分析置信区域几何结构并给出直径界的理论结果。

Result: 在文本、图像、多模态基准（AGNews、MNIST、CIFAR-10、N24News）及真实自动驾驶数据集nuImages上，方法一致地产生比反演式方法更短的置信区间和更小的预测集。

Conclusion: 直接矩阵约束框架在保持精确有限样本有效性的同时，显著提升了重要性权重置信区域的紧致性，改善了域适应下游任务效率。

Abstract: Importance weights are essential in domain adaptation under label shift, yet their utility is often undermined by the finite sample uncertainty associated with their estimation. Existing methods typically analyze this uncertainty through Gaussian elimination on interval-valued linear systems, which leads to overly conservative confidence regions and inefficient downstream applications. We propose a paradigm shift from inversion-based inference to a direct matrix constraint framework. We use this framework to define a joint confidence region and extract marginal intervals via linear programming, deriving provably tighter bounds for importance weights while maintaining exact finite-sample validity. Furthermore, we analyze the confidence region's geometry and provide the theoretical results for its diameter bounds. Evaluated across text, image, multimodal benchmarks, including AGNews, MNIST, CIFAR-10, N24News, and a real-world autonomous driving dataset, nuImages, our approach consistently yields shorter confidence intervals and smaller prediction sets than inversion-based methods.

</details>


### [150] [A Functional SVD Framework for Regularized Multivariate Functional PCA with Dual Penalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14815)
*Yue Zhao,Hossein Haghbin,Rebecca Sanders,Mehdi Maadooliat*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出ReMFPCA框架，基于函数SVD同时正则化功能主成分及其得分，提升多变量函数数据分析的可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MFPCA方法基于协方差特征分解，仅对功能主成分进行惩罚，忽视了对主成分得分的正则化，导致难以过滤无关的个体特异性变异。

Method: 在Hilbert空间框架下引入广义函数SVD，对功能PCs和PC得分同时正则化，并在PC得分上加入稀疏惩罚；提出顺序与联合两种幂算法实现，以及基于迭代回归的交叉验证用于最优平滑参数选择。

Result: 大量仿真实验和真实数据应用表明，该框架在提取有信息且可解释的成分方面显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 对功能PCs和得分进行双重惩罚是超越现有协方差特征分解方法的重要进步，为多变量函数数据分析提供了方法论和实践价值。

Abstract: This paper introduces a novel framework for Regularized Multivariate Functional Principal Component Analysis (ReMFPCA) via Functional Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). The proposed method extends existing MFPCA approaches by incorporating a generalized functional SVD within a Hilbert space framework, enabling simultaneous regularization of both functional principal components (PCs) and their associated PC scores. A key innovation of this framework is the inclusion of a sparsity penalty on the PC scores, which enhances interpretability by filtering out irrelevant subject-specific variations. This dual-penalization strategy represents a significant advancement beyond existing covariance-based eigen decomposition methods, which penalize only the functional PCs. Two power algorithm implementations, sequential and joint, are proposed, together with a cross-validation approach based on iterative regression for optimal smoothing parameter selection. Comprehensive simulation studies and real data applications demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves the extraction of informative and interpretable components, offering methodological and practical benefits for analyzing multivariate functional data across diverse domains.

</details>


### [151] [Shapley Value Estimation for Multi-Site Data with Blockwise-Missing Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14902)
*Siqi Li,Wangxuan Fan,Yiming Li,Doudou Zhou,Molei Liu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出FUSHAP方法，利用部分观测的辅助站点降低单站点Shapley估计的方差，避免插补引入的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Shapley值的特征归因方法假设用于评估联盟博弈的观测在共同特征空间下完全观测，但多站点研究中不同机构按不同协议记录不同特征，导致系统性块状缺失，该假设常被违反。标准插补补救会引入系统性、依赖联盟的偏差。

Method: FUSHAP利用部分观测的辅助站点来降低初步单站点Shapley估计的方差，且不进行插补；并通过基于置换的筛选步骤检测并剔除与目标总体数据分布不兼容的站点。

Result: 合成实验中，FUSHAP的MSE比单站点估计低3–8倍，比插补基线低2–3倍，且不引入插补偏差；筛选程序在中等错位下有82%功效，强错位下达100%。在多站点空气质量和多中心临床数据上，FUSHAP相对单站点估计将MSE降低约3–7倍；临床应用中标准插补可能使MSE高于单站点基线。

Conclusion: FUSHAP为部分观测的多站点数据提供无插补的Shapley归因框架，显著降低方差并识别不兼容站点，优于插补基线。

Abstract: Shapley value (SV)-based methods are the prevailing framework for feature attribution in machine learning, yet existing population-level Shapley estimators generally assume that observations used to evaluate the coalitional game are fully observed under a common feature space. This assumption is routinely violated in multi-site studies across biomedicine, social science, and environmental monitoring, where institutions record different features under different protocols, producing systematic blockwise missingness across sources. We first show that the standard remedy of imputing missing features before computing Shapley values introduces systematic, coalition-dependent bias into the resulting attributions. We then propose \textbf{FUSHAP} (\textbf{Fu}sion \textbf{Sh}apley \textbf{A}ttribution from \textbf{P}artially-observed data), a method that leverages partially-observed auxiliary sites to reduce the variance of a preliminary single-site Shapley estimate without imputation. A permutation-based screening step detects and excludes sites whose data distributions are incompatible with the target population. In synthetic experiments, FUSHAP achieves $3$--$8\times$ lower MSE than the single-site estimator and $2$--$3\times$ lower MSE than imputation baselines without incurring imputation-induced bias, and the screening procedure identifies misaligned sites with $82\%$ power at moderate misalignment and $100\%$ for strong misalignment. On multi-site air quality and multi-center clinical data, FUSHAP reduces MSE by approximately $3$--$7\times$ relative to the single-site estimator; in the clinical application, standard imputation can increase MSE above the single-site baseline.

</details>


### [152] [Steady-State Convergence of Stochastic Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14922)
*Yixuan Zhang,Qiaomin Xie*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文为常步长收缩型随机逼近(SA)在Markovian乘性噪声下建立了统一的稳态收敛(SSC)理论，覆盖局部可微与不可微均值算子，并用多步普适性框架得到最优速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SSC理论要求i.i.d.或加性噪声、均值算子全局可微，且给出的速率次优；对Markovian乘性噪声及局部不可微情形缺乏统一理论。

Method: 提出多步普适性框架，将原始随机递推逐步归约为可处理的辅助动力学并保持其稳态极限；在不动点处做局部二次线性化进行分析。

Result: 在局部可微情形下得到缩放稳态的Gaussian逼近，Wasserstein-2距离达到最优速率O(√α)，并给出原始迭代的有限时间Gaussian逼近；在局部不可微情形建立一般SSC结果，其主导渐近偏差可达√α阶（光滑情形为α阶）。理论应用于Markovian线性SA与异步Q-learning，并提出无需知晓局部光滑性的Q-learning偏差缩减方案，经数值实验验证。

Conclusion: 该统一理论扩展了SSC的适用范围与速率最优性，揭示了不可微情形下偏差阶数的本质变化，并为Q-learning提供了实用偏差缩减方法。

Abstract: For constant-stepsize stochastic approximation (SA), the iterates converge in distribution to a stationary law that depends on the stepsize $α.$ Steady-state convergence (SSC) concerns the limit of the scaled stationary distribution as $α\downarrow 0.$ Existing SSC theory requires i.i.d. or additive noise and global differentiability of the mean operator, and yields suboptimal rates. We develop a unified SSC theory for constant-stepsize contractive SA driven by Markovian, multiplicative noise, covering both locally differentiable and locally nondifferentiable mean operators. A key methodological contribution is a multi-step universality framework that progressively reduces the original stochastic recursion to tractable auxiliary dynamics while preserving its steady-state limit. Under local quadratic linearization at the fixed point, we obtain a Gaussian approximation of the scaled steady state at the optimal rate $O(\sqrtα)$ in Wasserstein-2 distance, which further gives finite-time Gaussian approximations for the raw iterates. In the locally nondifferentiable regime, we establish a general SSC result and show that the leading-order asymptotic bias can be of order $\sqrtα$, in contrast to the $α$-order bias in the smooth regime. We apply the theory to Markovian linear SA and asynchronous Q-learning, neither of which is covered by prior results. We further propose a bias-reduction scheme for Q-learning that requires no knowledge of the local smoothness regime, validated by numerical experiments.

</details>


### [153] [Data Attribution at Scale via Influence Matrix Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15044)
*Yuxi Chen,Hamza Golubovic,Han Tong,Arian Maleki,Andrew Ilyas*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将预算受限的数据归因建模为从少量测量中估计大规模影响矩阵的问题，指出用于矩阵恢复的最佳测量与用于归因本身的测量不同，并提出 MAGE 与 SPELL 两种算法，在现有 metagradient 机制上无额外成本运行，实验证明优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据归因对数据估值、机器遗忘和可解释性很重要，但神经网络非凸性使可扩展方法难以预测删除训练数据的影响。MAGIC 等 metagradient 方法虽能精确计算影响，却需为每个预测单独训练一次，代价高昂，因此需要降低计算成本。

Method: 将预算受限归因转化为从少量测量中估计大型影响矩阵；分析发现最适合恢复该矩阵的测量不同于最适合归因的测量；据此提出分别面向重建的 MAGE 和面向归因的 SPELL，二者均基于现有 metagradient 机制，不增加额外成本。

Result: 实验表明，在不同训练规模和测量预算下，所提方法相较现有基线表现强劲。

Conclusion: 通过区分矩阵重建与归因目标，可在有限预算下高效进行数据归因，并兼容现有 metagradient 工具。

Abstract: Data attribution seeks to quantify how individual training examples shape a model's predictions and underpins problems including data valuation, machine unlearning, and model interpretability. Despite having a long line of work, computationally scalable methods often struggle to predict the effect of removing training data in neural networks due to their non-convex nature. To overcome this challenge, metagradient-based methods such as MAGIC (Ilyas and Engstrom, 2025) differentiate each prediction through the entire training run and compute its exact influence with respect to the training data, but require a separate run for every prediction. To reduce this cost, we cast budgeted attribution as estimating a large influence matrix from a small number of measurements. We show that the measurements most appropriate for recovering this matrix differ from those best suited for attribution itself. We then present two algorithms, MAGE and SPELL, suited for reconstruction and attribution respectively, that run on existing metagradient machinery at no extra cost. Empirical studies demonstrate strong performance over existing baselines across training scales and measurement budgets.

</details>


### [154] [Conformal Individual Treatment Effect Estimation under Networked Interference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15254)
*Matteo Zecchin,Osvaldo Simeone*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出干涉调整加权共形预测，在存在单元间干涉时仍能为反事实结果和个体处理效应提供有限样本边际覆盖保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共形反事实预测依赖无干涉假设。放松该假设后，单元的潜在结果会依赖其他单元的处理与协变量，导致倾向得分重加权无法恢复加权可交换性，现有方法可能失效。

Method: 构造目标干预下理想但不可观测的共形p值的可观测上界，以实现干涉调整加权共形预测；并在干涉导致的非一致性分数变化有界时，给出更紧的构造。

Result: 在直推式和归纳式两种设定下，所提预测集对反事实结果与个体处理效应均具有有限样本边际覆盖保证；数值实验显示本方法保持名义覆盖，而现有方法可能无法达到。

Conclusion: 该工作将共形反事实预测扩展到存在干涉的场景，提供有效覆盖保证，并验证了方法的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Conformal counterfactual prediction constructs prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees for counterfactual outcomes and individual treatment effects under the no-interference assumption. In this work, we relax this assumption by allowing each unit's potential outcomes to depend on other units' treatments and covariates. In this setting, propensity-score reweighting does not restore weighted exchangeability, and existing methods may fail to achieve valid coverage. To address this issue, we develop interference-adjusted weighted conformal prediction that accounts for interference by constructing an observable upper bound on the ideal and unobserved conformal $p$-value under the target intervention. The resulting prediction sets provide finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees for counterfactual outcomes and individual treatment effects in both transductive and inductive settings. We also derive a sharper construction when intervention-induced changes in nonconformity scores are bounded. Numerical experiments show that our methods preserve nominal coverage, whereas existing methods may not.

</details>


### [155] [ReLU Neural Network Approximation to Smooth Functional Operator: Dimensional Decay and Error Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15355)
*Shuhao Jiao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究无穷维可分希尔伯特空间上光滑标量泛函的深度ReLU网络一致逼近，给出非渐近上界与基于伪维数的下界，并在广义指数坐标衰减下得到几乎最优的逼近率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维/无穷维函数输入下的深度网络逼近理论尚不完善，现有工作缺乏通过坐标幅度与方向敏感性联合衰减来刻画逼近误差的分析框架。

Method: 构造性分析：结合坐标截断、各向异性划分、局部Taylor逼近与ReLU网络实现，允许保留坐标间无限制交互；并用伪维数下界进行匹配分析。

Result: 建立了泛函一致逼近误差的一般非渐近上界及最坏情况下的伪维数下界；在广义指数衰减 w_d s_d ≍ exp(-c d^ρ) 下，上下界在主阶匹配，得到关于网络预算对数为伸缩指数的几乎最优逼近率。

Conclusion: 首次通过坐标幅度与方向敏感性的联合维度衰减显式刻画无穷维泛函输入的神经网络逼近误差，为无穷维函数学习的网络逼近理论提供了新框架。

Abstract: We study the uniform approximation of smooth scalar-valued functionals on an infinite-dimensional separable Hilbert space by deep ReLU neural networks. Writing the functional input as $X(t)=\sum_{d\geq1}ξ_dν_d(t)$, we quantify the importance of coordinate $d$ through $w_ds_d$, where $s_d$ bounds the magnitude of the corresponding basis score and $w_d$ controls the directional Fréchet sensitivity of the target functional. Our constructive analysis combines coordinate truncation, anisotropic partitioning, local Taylor approximation, and ReLU network realization, while allowing unrestricted interactions among the retained coordinates. We establish a general nonasymptotic upper bound for the uniform approximation error and a complementary pseudo-dimension-based lower bound for the worst-case approximation error. Under generalized exponential coordinate decay $w_ds_d\asymp\exp(-cd^ρ)$, with $ρ>0$, the upper and lower bounds match at the leading order and thus yield the nearly optimal approximation rate, which is stretched-exponential in the logarithm of the network budget. This is the first work to characterize neural network approximation error for infinite-dimensional functional inputs explicitly through the joint dimensional decay of coordinate magnitudes and directional sensitivities.

</details>


### [156] [Graph Matching Relaxations and Amortization for Supervised Graph Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15437)
*Federico Méndez,Paul Krzakala,Gabriel Melo,Charlotte Laclau,Rémi Flamary,Florence d'Alché-Buc*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文研究端到端监督图预测(SGP)中的置换不变损失,提出用Gromov-Wasserstein目标并通过摊销图匹配来避免每样本内层优化,联合学习预测模块与匹配器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SGP需要置换不变损失来比较任意节点排序的预测图与目标图,但这通常涉及代价高昂的图匹配问题,逐样本求解内层优化计算开销大。

Method: 首先从理论和实验上比较三种最优传输松弛,论证GW目标最适合SGP;然后摊销图匹配问题,对每个训练样本使用基于可微Sinkhorn算法的参数化匹配器在经验节点分布上提供传输方案,预测模块与匹配器联合学习。

Result: 在难度递增的玩具和真实SGP问题上展示了方法的效率,并引入了一个新的质谱到骨架(Mass-spectra to Scaffold)任务。

Conclusion: GW目标适合SGP,摊销图匹配可有效避免逐样本内层优化,联合学习方法在多个SGP任务上高效且有效。

Abstract: End-to-end Supervised Graph Prediction (SGP) requires a permutation-invariant loss to compare predicted and target graphs with arbitrary node orderings. Such losses typically involve a costly graph-matching problem. We first study three Optimal Transport relaxations of this problem and show, theoretically and empirically, that the Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) objective is the most suitable for SGP. Then, to avoid solving the resulting inner optimization for every training example, we propose to amortize the graph matching (node alignment) problem. For each training sample, the loss function leverages a transport plan provided by a parametric matcher based on the differentiable Sinkhorn algorithm applied on empirical node distributions. The graph prediction module and the matcher are jointly learned. We showcase the efficiency of this approach on toy and real world SGP problems of increasing complexity including a novel Mass-spectra to Scaffold task that we introduce.

</details>


### [157] [Predictive Likelihood Ratios for Language Model Watermark Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15657)
*Li Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文在大语言模型水印检测中构建预测似然比检验，通过对概率赤字与残尾分布的不确定性进行先验平均，实现跨备择设定的稳健检测，并证明在条件枢轴零假设下检验鞅性质保证Type I错误控制与可选停止有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 键控水印检测依赖观测token与密钥重构伪随机变量之间的依赖关系。既有框架（Li et al. 2025）需要设定单一信号强度，难以在多种备择设定下保持稳健检测功效，因此需要无需调参的稳健检验。

Method: 构造对不确定概率赤字与残尾分布平均的预测似然比；用混合先验结合尾形状与有效宽度，并引入分层扩展允许文档内赤字/宽度变化。在精确条件枢轴零假设下，规范化预测备择给出既是贝叶斯因子又是检验鞅的统计量；Gumbel边际似然用固定求积计算。

Result: 在尾形状与尾宽度备择及三个时间尺度上，union-tail混合的最大观测Type II错误遗憾为0.0080，而equal-tail混合为0.0962。在两个开源模型的温度匹配输出上，该方法在全部八个非饱和模型-温度单元中AUC均优于equal-tail基线，但领先参考分数通常AUC更高。补充实验显示在独立类零替换下保持功效，分层依赖建模带来的变化较小。

Conclusion: 证据支持在所评估备择下的稳健性，而非均匀功效保证或对任意文本编辑的抵抗能力；对条件零假设的违反及插值实现不享有随时保证。

Abstract: Keyed watermark detection tests dependence between observed tokens and pseudorandom variables reconstructed from a secret key. Building on the pivotal framework of Li et al. (2025), we construct predictive likelihood ratios that average over uncertain probability deficits and residual-tail distributions. The aim is robust detection power across alternative specifications without requiring a single signal-strength tuning. A mixture prior combines tail shape and effective width; hierarchical extensions allow within-document variation in deficit or width. The test maximizes prior-averaged power at a fixed size, but is not generally uniformly most powerful or minimax. Under the exact conditional pivot null, normalized predictive alternatives selected before each observation yield a Bayes factor that is also a test martingale: Type I error control is unaffected by alternative misspecification and remains valid under optional stopping. This guarantee does not cover violations of the conditional null, and the interpolated implementation has no certified anytime guarantee. Gumbel marginal likelihoods are evaluated by fixed quadrature. Across the evaluated tail-shape and tail-width alternatives and three horizons, the union-tail mixture has maximum observed Type II error regret .0080, compared with .0962 for the equal-tail mixture, relative to the best tested rule. On temperature-matched outputs from two open models, it improves AUC over the equal-tail baseline in all eight non-saturated model-temperature cells, although the leading reference score generally has higher AUC. Supplementary experiments show retained power under independent null-like replacement and smaller changes from hierarchical dependence modeling. The evidence supports robustness across the evaluated alternatives, not uniform power guarantees or resistance to arbitrary text edits.

</details>


### [158] [Learning under Target Shift: Optimal Density Ratio Estimation and Importance-Weighted Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15785)
*Ren-Rui Liu,Zheng-Chu Guo*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究连续输出下目标偏移（target shift）的密度比估计与重要性加权回归，提出RKHS中的谱正则化方法，并建立有限样本理论与最优收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标偏移下条件分布不变但输出边缘分布变化，离散输出已有大量研究，但连续输出情形理解不足：重要性权重由未知密度比函数决定，现有估计方法缺乏显式有限样本收敛率。

Method: 在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中提出谱正则化方法，利用标注训练样本与无标注测试输入估计连续密度比；在源条件（regularity参数ι>0）下进行理论分析，并将估计的密度比用于重要性加权回归以刻画误差传播。

Result: 建立高概率有限样本保证，估计量达到与容量无关的极小极大最优RKHS范数率O(n_η^{-ι/(2ι+2)})；当密度比估计样本充足时，回归估计量达到标准核回归的极小极大最优率。

Conclusion: 该工作为连续密度比估计与目标偏移下的重要性加权学习建立了有限样本理论。

Abstract: We study density ratio estimation and importance-weighted regression under target shift with continuous outputs. Under target shift, the conditional distribution of the inputs given the outputs remains invariant across the training and test distributions, while the output marginal distribution may change. Although this problem has been extensively studied for discrete outputs, the continuous setting is substantially less understood: the importance weights are determined by an unknown density ratio function, for which existing estimation methods lack explicit finite-sample convergence rates. We propose a spectral regularization method in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) for estimating the continuous density ratio from labeled training samples and unlabeled test inputs. Under a source condition with regularity parameter $ι>0$, we establish high-probability finite-sample guarantees and show that the estimator achieves the capacity-independent minimax-optimal RKHS-norm rate $O(n_η^{-ι/(2ι+2)})$. We then incorporate the estimated density ratio into importance-weighted regression and characterize the propagation of density-ratio estimation error to the final predictor. When sufficiently many samples are available for density ratio estimation, the resulting regression estimator attains the minimax-optimal rates of standard kernel regression. These results establish a finite-sample theory for continuous density ratio estimation and importance-weighted learning under target shift.

</details>


### [159] [Quenched Ensemble Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15894)
*David Yallup*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出Quenched Ensemble Sampling，将nested sampling的硬能量约束推广为能量边界上的一族排斥势，使其可用梯度核在相变处高维采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理系统能量函数采样在相变处最困难，密度态突变导致许多采样算法停滞；nested sampling对相变鲁棒，但高维下硬约束采样困难，限制其应用。

Method: 将硬能量约束推广为能量边界处的排斥势族，保持能量单调下降的quenched路径，同时使约束目标可用可扩展的基于梯度的采样核。

Result: 在合成相变模型上跨过一阶相变估计边际似然并采样后验，而tempering等常用方法失败；用于贝叶斯神经网络边际似然估计以比较网络架构；在高维连续格点场论中跨一阶相变并估计配分函数。

Conclusion: QES保留了nested sampling对相变的鲁棒性，同时通过软约束实现高维可扩展采样，可用于边际似然、模型比较与配分函数估计。

Abstract: Some of the sharpest challenges in sampling from the energy functions of physical systems arise at phase transitions, where the density of states changes abruptly and many sampling algorithms stall. Nested sampling is a particle method that traverses the density of states under a hard energy constraint and is known to be robust to such transitions, but its application in high dimension is limited by the difficulty of sampling under that constraint. In this work we introduce Quenched Ensemble Sampling, which generalises the hard constraint to a family of repulsive potentials at the energy boundary. This preserves the quenched path of monotonically decreasing energy while making the constrained target amenable to scalable gradient-based kernels. We demonstrate on synthetic models of phase transitions that our method estimates the marginal likelihood and draws posterior samples across a first-order transition where popular alternatives such as tempering fail. We apply the procedure to marginal likelihood estimation in Bayesian neural networks, enabling model comparison between network architectures. Finally, in a high-dimensional continuous lattice field theory, we show that this method traverses a first-order transition and estimates the partition function.

</details>


<div id='econ.EM'></div>

# econ.EM [[Back]](#toc)

### [160] [Homophily and transitivity in dynamic network formation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14049)
*Kevin Dano,Bryan S. Graham,Yassine Sbai Sassi*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究动态网络形成模型中，如何在存在基于不可观测属性的同质性匹配时，识别出对传递性连接的偏好，并构造估计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会与经济网络中，个体常共享共同联系人。对此有两种竞争性解释：一是对传递性连接存在结构性偏好（共享联系人提高连接回报）；二是基于不可观测属性的同质性匹配。需要区分这两种机制。

Method: 构建简单动态网络形成模型：个体随时间形成、维持、解除连接以最大化效用；连接回报可因共享联系人而提高；引入配对特定效用分量以允许对时不变属性的任意同质性。推导在存在不可观测同质性匹配下检测传递性偏好的识别条件，不限制初始网络与配对特定效用分量的联合分布（两者均为高维冗余参数）。识别结果具有构造性，据此提出类比估计量，并刻画其有限网络与单一大规模网络性质。

Result: 得到可检测传递性偏好存在的识别条件；提出类比估计量并刻画其有限网络和单一大规模网络下的性质；通过例子展示单一（大）网络设定中信息积累的微妙性。

Conclusion: 在不可观测同质性匹配下仍可识别传递性偏好，且识别方法具有构造性并可用于估计，但单一网络下信息积累较为微妙。

Abstract: In social and economic networks linked agents often share connections in common. There are two competing explanations for this phenomenon. First, agents may have a structural taste for transitive links - the returns to linking may be higher if two agents share a common connection. Second, agents may assortatively match on unobserved attributes, a process called homophily. We study parameter identifiability in a simple model of dynamic network formation with both effects. Agents form, maintain, and dissolve links over time to maximize utility. The return to linking may be higher if agents share connections in common. A pair-specific utility component allows for arbitrary homophily on time-invariant agent attributes. We derive conditions under which it is possible to detect the presence of a taste for transitivity in the presence of assortative matching on unobservables. We leave the joint distribution of the initial network and the pair-specific utility component, both high dimensional nuisance parameters, unrestricted. Our identification result is constructive, suggesting an analog estimator, whose finite and (single) large network properties we characterize. We show, via examples, the delicacy of information accumulation in the single (large) network setting.

</details>


### [161] [What Variation Identifies Payoffs in a Dynamic Game?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14069)
*Haojie Liu,Zihan Lin*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 动态博弈中识别收益依赖竞争对手特征的问题：区分"转移技术"与"对手策略混合"两条渠道，给出秩识别的环境数量条件，并分析私有冲击导致的病态识别与推测集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态博弈中观察到的选择混合了当期利润与延续价值。当收益还依赖对手特征时，比较算子会同时对对手的均衡策略求平均，导致延续技术变化与对手策略变化不可互相替代，需要明确各自的识别来源与代价。

Method: 1) 形式化区分两类变异：改变原始转移（改写延续技术）与在固定转移律下改变对手马尔可夫策略（改写对手相关收益的混合）。2) 对 rank 为 K 的对手特征收益，推导位置意义上的秩识别所需政策环境数为 Ephi=ceil((MK-1)/(M-1))，饱和时需第二个核。3) 证明任意小政策差异即可恢复秩。4) 分析独立私有冲击：迫使混合对手行动可分解，联合依赖 d 个对手的收益仅在 η^d 阶可见；给出最小被识别奇异值上界 κη^Φ及 Oracle-GLS 方差消失条件 nη^{2Φ}→∞。5) 使用含第一阶段误差的 Anderson–Rubin 集构造稳健推断。

Result: 独立私有冲击下，要么秩失败，要么最小被识别奇异值至多 κη^Φ，且与堆叠核数量无关；Oracle-GLS 方差仅在 nη^{2Φ} 发散时消失。带第一阶段设计矩阵误差的 Anderson–Rubin 集无需风险消失条件即可覆盖。美国航空业进入数据中，即便在秩可识别方向，最有利的对手依赖对比仍比观察行为宽数倍。

Conclusion: 对手依赖收益的识别受限于政策环境数量与私有冲击导致的信息衰减，秩可识别并不等于实用精度；经验应用中对手依赖对比的识别区间过宽，需借助稳健推断方法并谨慎解释此类估计。

Abstract: Observed choice in a dynamic game mixes current profit with continuation value. A rival adds a second problem: the same comparison averages over the rival's equilibrium policy. Changing the primitive transition rewrites continuation technology; changing the rival's Markov policy, holding that law fixed, rewrites the mixture over rival-contingent payoffs. The two are not substitutes. For a rival-feature payoff of rank $K$, rank identification up to location requires $\Ephi=\lceil(MK-1)/(M-1)\rceil$ policy environments, and a second kernel when payoffs are saturated. Rank can still be restored by arbitrarily small policy differences. Independent private shocks force mixed rival actions to factor, so a payoff that depends jointly on $d$ rivals is visible only at order $η^{d}$ near a common interior baseline. Either rank fails or the smallest identified singular value is at most $κη^{\dPhi}$, independently of how many kernels are stacked. Oracle-GLS variance in that direction vanishes only if $nη^{2\dPhi}$ diverges. An Anderson--Rubin set that carries first-stage error in the design matrix covers without a vanishing-risk condition. On U.S.\ airline entry, even among rank-identified directions, the most favorable rival-dependent contrast is several times wider than observed behavior.

</details>


### [162] [Identification and Inference in proxy-SVARs with non-Gaussian shocks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14398)
*Paritosh Shankarrao Junare*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 提出一种融合外部工具变量与非高斯性的GMM混合识别框架，实现结构VAR的点识别，且在弱工具与近外生性下仍保持稳健一致的推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构VAR的两类主流识别方法各有短板：外部工具（proxy）有经济含义但常为弱工具；冲击非高斯性可提供统计识别但缺乏经济解释。需要一种能兼顾两者优势、且在工具弱或近外生性下仍稳健的方法。

Method: 在统一的广义矩方法（GMM）框架下，将proxy排他性约束与结构冲击的高阶矩条件叠加。高阶矩在合适秩条件下为识别提供“锚”，使目标冲击被点识别，非目标冲击可识别至符号与排序。

Result: 在局部近零工具相关性下，动态因果效应估计量仍一致，标准渐近推断有效；Anderson-Rubin置信集显著窄于纯工具版本。混合估计量比单独使用任一识别来源更有效。在proxy近外生性偏离下给出渐近偏差界，非高斯性越强偏差越小。过度识别结构提供两个正交的设定检验（proxy外生性、高阶矩有效性），并推导极限分布与bootstrap临界值。蒙特卡洛与两个应用（石油新闻冲击、欧元区货币政策冲击）验证框架潜力。

Conclusion: 融合外部工具与冲击非高斯性的混合GMM框架同时实现经济可解释的识别与统计稳健性，在弱工具和近外生性情形下优于单一识别来源，并提供可操作的检验与推断工具。

Abstract: Two frequent approaches for identifying structural VARs are external instruments, which carry economic content but are often weak, and non-Gaussianity of the shocks which provides statistical identification but carries no economic meaning. We combine the two strategies in a single generalized method of moments framework that stacks proxy exclusion restrictions with higher-order moment conditions of the structural shocks. This hybrid approach point-identifies the target shocks while also identifying the non-target shocks up to sign and ordering. Under suitable rank conditions, the higher-order moments anchor the identification uniformly over the instrument strength. Consequently, under local-to-zero proxy relevance, estimators of the dynamic causal effects remain consistent, and standard asymptotic inference remains valid. Moreover, the Anderson-Rubin confidence sets are substantially narrower than their instrument-only counterparts. The hybrid estimator is also more efficient than either source of identification used in isolation: at any fixed proxy relevance, even a weak instrument increases efficiency of the estimator through its covariance with the non-Gaussian moment block. Under local deviations from proxy exogeneity, we provide asymptotic bias bounds and show that stronger non-Gaussianity of the shocks compresses the bias. Finally, the over-identified structure yields two mutually orthogonal specification tests, for proxy exogeneity and validity of higher-order moment conditions. We derive their limiting distributions and provide a bootstrap procedure for finite-sample critical values. Monte Carlo simulations and two applications with identification of oil news-shock and a Euro-area MP shock demonstrate the potential of our framework.

</details>


### [163] [Eigenvalue-Decomposition Cost Denoising as an Alternative to Predict-then-Optimize for Shortest-Path Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15111)
*Henry Aldridge-Krawciw,Irene Aldridge*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 论文提出用PCA特征值分解对噪声成本向量去噪后再做Dijkstra优化，应对SPO+在模型误设下的性能退化，并在5×5网格最短路基准上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Predict-then-optimize方法（如SPO+）依赖预测模型设定正确：当真实成本过程非线性而预测器为线性时，误设越大性能越差，尤其在能观测同一成本过程多次噪声实现的场景下亟需替代方案。

Method: 将观测到的成本向量视为噪声信号，直接用训练成本协方差矩阵的特征值分解（等价PCA）去噪：保留top-k特征向量构成子空间，把新的噪声成本观测投影到该子空间，再用Dijkstra算法求解；在Elmachtoub与Grigas(2022)的5×5网格最短路基准上实例化。

Result: k的选择至关重要：仅保留k=2会丢弃真实信号，甚至不如朴素噪声成本基线；当k=5（匹配真实潜在特征维度）时，特征值去噪Dijkstra在所有误设水平下均表现最佳，高误设时大幅超越SPO+。

Conclusion: 在决策者可观测同一成本过程多次噪声实现的常见设定下，直接对成本向量做PCA去噪无需预测模型即可有效规避误设问题，且取正确的k（等于潜在维度）是性能关键。

Abstract: Predict-then-optimize methods such as Smart "Predict, then Optimize" (SPO+) of Elmachtoub and Grigas (2022) learn a mapping from contextual features to unknown edge costs and then solve the induced combinatorial problem on the predicted costs. This approach is powerful but relies on the predictive model being well specified: when the true cost-generating process is nonlinear in the features and the predictor is linear, SPO+'s performance degrades as the misspecification grows. We propose and evaluate a structurally different remedy for a specific but common setting: when the decision-maker observes many noisy realizations of the same underlying cost process, the realized cost vectors themselves can be treated as a noisy signal and denoised directly, via eigenvalue decomposition (equivalently, Principal Component Analysis) of their covariance matrix, before ever invoking a predictive model. We instantiate this idea on the $5\times5$ grid shortest-path benchmark introduced by Elmachtoub and Grigas (2022), retaining only the top-$k$ eigenvectors of the training cost covariance matrix and projecting new noisy cost observations onto that subspace prior to solving with Dijkstra's (1959) algorithm. We find that the choice of $k$ is decisive: keeping only $k{=}2$ eigenvectors discards real signal and underperforms even the naive noisy-cost baseline, while setting $k{=}5$ to match the true latent feature dimension makes eigenvalue-denoised Dijkstra the best-performing method at every misspecification level tested, outperforming SPO+ by a wide margin under high misspecification.

</details>


### [164] [Conditional-Moment Estimation and Inference in the BLP Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15736)
*Hua Jin,Rui Sun,Tian Xie*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: BLP随机系数需求模型常用GMM估计，但其无条件矩限制与识别所依赖的条件矩限制不等价，可能导致标准GMM无法识别参数。本文构造反例并提出基于条件矩的两步估计量，证明其渐近正态性与半参数有效性，模拟显示其优于标准GMM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BLP(1995)模型的识别本质上依赖条件矩限制，而实践中普遍使用的GMM基于固定工具变量的无条件矩限制。二者并不等价，无条件限制可能容许额外的参数值，从而存在识别缺口，导致标准GMM（即使使用最优工具）也可能无法识别模型。作者希望直接基于识别性限制来构造估计方法。

Method: 借鉴Ai and Chen (2003)，提出两步估计量：第一步非参数估计相关条件期望（给出核方法与级数方法两种实现），第二步通过条件方差加权的最小距离准则选择结构参数。标准GMM被证明是该准则在线性投影到有限个工具变量上的特例。

Result: 建立了估计量的根号T渐近正态性；核与级数两种第一阶段实现共享相同的极限分布，并达到半参数效率界。模拟证据展示了识别缺口的后果，并表明所提估计量在有限样本下优于标准GMM。

Conclusion: 标准GMM的无条件矩方法在BLP模型识别上存在缺口，而直接基于条件矩限制的两步估计量可实现半参数有效估计，并在有限样本中表现更优，为随机系数需求模型的估计提供了更可靠的替代方案。

Abstract: The random-coefficient demand model of Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes (1995) is commonly estimated by the generalized method of moments (GMM), using an unconditional moment restriction with a fixed set of instruments. Identification of the model, however, rests on a conditional moment restriction. The two are not equivalent: the unconditional restriction may admit additional parameter values. We construct a counterexample in which the model is identified by the conditional restriction yet standard GMM is not, even with the optimal instrument. Building directly on the identifying restriction, we propose a two-step estimator, following Ai and Chen (2003), that first estimates the relevant conditional expectations nonparametrically and then selects the structural parameters by a conditional-variance-weighted minimum-distance criterion; standard GMM is recovered as the special case of a linear projection onto finitely many instruments. We establish root-T asymptotic normality for the proposed estimator, and we develop the theory for both kernel and series implementations of the first stage. The two implementations share a common limiting distribution, attaining the semiparametric efficiency bound. Simulation evidence illustrates the consequences of the identification gap and demonstrates that the proposed estimator outperforms standard GMM in finite samples.

</details>

### [165] [Towards foundation models for insurance risk modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14576)
*Christopher Blier-Wong*

Main category: q-fin.RM

TL;DR: 本文综述语言、视觉、地理空间、时间序列、表格和科学基础模型在保险精算中的应用，提出将模型输出接入精算计算并评估其贡献、稳定性与合规性的流程，同时讨论数据延迟、稀有巨灾、迁移失效、隐私与模型依赖等挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保险已收集的理赔叙述、图像和传感器数据含风险信息，但现有精算模型难以利用这些高维数据；基础模型可经大规模预训练后适配具体任务，把这些数据转为变量或数值表示，从而帮助保险公司更充分利用已有信息并降低每个应用的开发经验需求。

Method: 综述语言、视觉、地理空间、时间序列、表格和科学模型，梳理其在保险中的现有应用与潜在用途；将科学模型用于未来天气气候情景，把局地灾害与资产损害、维修成本和保险覆盖挂钩以估计损失；提出连接模型输出与精算计算并评估预测贡献、稳定性和信息使用合规性的流程。

Result: 展示了基础模型可提升保险数据利用（如语言模型从理赔记录识别伤情恶化，使准备金模型在付款反映前察觉成本上升）；同时指出评估困难源于最终理赔成本长时间滞后、大额损失稀有、异地学到的模式难以迁移到目标组合。

Conclusion: 基础模型为保险精算提供新机会，但需谨慎评估和治理；更丰富数据可能暴露隐私、支持更细风险分类并改变保险可及性，跨保险商复用同一模型还会造成对共享预测和供应商的依赖。

Abstract: Claim narratives, images and sensor data contain information about insured risks that is difficult to use through existing actuarial models. Foundation models learn patterns from large datasets before being adapted to particular tasks. By turning these high-dimensional sources into variables or numerical representations, they could help insurers use more of the information they already collect, potentially reducing the experience needed to develop each application. For example, a language model could identify a worsening injury in a new claim note, allowing a reserving model to recognise the change in expected cost before the payments reveal the deterioration. In this paper, we review language, vision, geospatial, time series, tabular and scientific models, explaining existing insurance applications and potential future uses. Scientific models extend this approach to future weather and climate conditions: their simulations can inform loss estimates once local hazards are linked to asset damage, repair costs and insurance coverage. We propose a process to connect these model outputs to actuarial calculations and to assess their predictive contribution, stability and compliance with rules on information use. Evaluating these applications is difficult when final claim costs become known only after long delays, large losses are rare or patterns learned elsewhere fail to transfer to the target portfolio. Richer data can reveal private information and support finer risk classification, which can change access to insurance. Reusing the same models across insurers also creates dependence on shared predictions and providers.

</details>


### [166] [Quantifying the 2027 Solvency II Risk Margin Reform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15741)
*Said Khalil,Fatima Zahrae Chaayra*

Main category: q-fin.RM

TL;DR: 本文为2027年Solvency II风险边际(Risk Margin)改革(资本成本率6%→4.75%并引入资本要求的时间衰减)构建解析与数值框架，用归一化贴现资本分布精确表示新旧风险边际之比，给出普适与期限特定边界、随机占优刻画及协方差分解，并列示数值结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2027年Solvency II改革最终校准的监管影响需要理论刻画：资本成本率下调与未来SCR的时间依赖衰减如何共同改变风险边际，以及资本时间结构、利率敏感性等驱动因素尚缺乏可操作的分析工具。

Method: 将贴现的预计资本要求归一化为运行期上的概率分布，得到新旧风险边际比率的精确表示；推导普适及期限特定边界，用随机占优刻画资本时点后移效应，并说明平均运行期不能决定改革效果；在给定平均运行期与期限下给出条件边界；对成比例最优估计投影作精确协方差分解；建立简约随机模型量化资本持续性不确定性的凸性效应，并用公开运行期轮廓重构风险边际计算及受控长期限、利率、持续性数值实验。

Result: 给定预计SCR路径时，机械性下调幅度在20.83%至60.42%之间；成比例最优估计投影下协方差分解识别偏离比例性的影响；固定SCR路径时新公式的直接利率半弹性低于旧校准；随机扩展量化了持续性不确定的凸性效应。

Conclusion: 改革效果由未来资本的时间结构支配，而非仅由平均运行期决定；本文提供的工具可用于评估预计资本轮廓、风险边际简化方法及直接折现率敏感性。

Abstract: The 2027 Solvency II reform recalibrates the Risk Margin by reducing the prescribed cost-of-capital rate from 6% to 4.75% and introducing a time-dependent attenuation of future Solvency Capital Requirements. This paper develops an analytical and numerical framework for characterizing the effect of the final regulatory calibration. By normalizing discounted projected capital requirements into a probability distribution over run-off time, we obtain an exact representation of the ratio between the revised and previous Risk Margins. The framework yields sharp universal and horizon-specific bounds, characterizes the effect of later capital timing through stochastic dominance, and shows that mean run-off time alone does not determine the reform effect when temporal dispersion varies. Additional bounds are derived conditional on mean run-off time and horizon. Conditional on a given projected SCR path, the mechanical reduction lies between 20.83% and 60.42%. For proportional Best Estimate projections, an exact covariance decomposition identifies how departures from proportionality affect the relative reform ratio. Holding the projected SCR path fixed, the revised formula has a lower direct interest-rate semi-elasticity than the previous calibration. A reduced-form stochastic extension further quantifies convexity effects arising from uncertainty in capital persistence. Numerical applications reconstruct Risk Margin calculations from published actuarial run-off profiles and complement them with controlled long-horizon, interest-rate, and persistence experiments. The results show that the reform effect is governed by the temporal structure of future capital and provide tractable tools for assessing projected capital profiles, Risk Margin simplifications, and direct discount-rate sensitivity.

</details>

### [167] [Special Markowitz: Thermodynamic Formalism for the Joint Regularisation of Returns and Covariance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14029)
*David Reinhardt*

Main category: q-fin.PM

TL;DR: 提出Special Markowitz正则化框架，通过谱可靠性势Φ_k对收益与协方差进行联合正则化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Markowitz组合优化中，收益与协方差的估计误差会破坏最优解。需要一种能同时、联合地正则化两者，并根据各谱方向估计质量进行差异处理的方法。

Method: 相对于参考态(mu_ref, Sigma_ref)正则化收益与协方差。对白化相对算子的每个特征方向定义谱可靠性势Φ_k，由估计质量导出Gibbs权重exp(-Φ_k)，同时控制收益信号与协方差偏差的保留比例：可靠模式(低Φ_k)保留，不可靠模式(高Φ_k)向参考态松弛。对数势坐标满足乘法合成律，Stein损失被刻画为与耦合相容的唯一自由能密度。

Result: 得到对数势坐标的乘法合成律；证明Stein损失在自然类中是唯一与耦合相容的自由能密度；SM压力泛函在各模式间可加。

Conclusion: Special Markowitz以谱可靠性势和可加压力泛函(其定义性质)统一了收益与协方差的联合正则化，为估计质量驱动的组合优化提供了理论框架。

Abstract: Special Markowitz (SM) regularises returns and covariance jointly, relative to a reference state (mu_ref, Sigma_ref). Each eigendirection of the whitened relative operator carries a spectral reliability potential Phi_k, derived from its estimation quality. Its Gibbs weight exp(-Phi_k) governs both the fraction of the return signal and the fraction of the covariance deviation that survive regularisation. Reliable modes (low Phi_k) are preserved; unreliable modes (high Phi_k) relax to the reference. The logarithmic potential coordinate is characterised by a multiplicative composition law; the Stein loss is characterised as the unique free-energy density (within a natural class) compatible with the resulting coupling. The SM pressure functional is additive across modes - the defining property of Special Markowitz.

</details>

### [168] [Diffusion models for dynamic volatility surface generation and data-driven hedging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13402)
*Yinbin Han,Jack Yuxiang Zhang,Manuel Torres,Fernando Acero,Renyuan Xu*

Main category: q-fin.CP

TL;DR: 本文提出基于扩散模型的动态隐含波动率曲面生成框架（AD-Seq-Vol及AD-Seq-Vol-FT），并通过数据驱动对冲验证其经济价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态隐含波动率曲面的生成需同时捕捉横截面与时序依赖、保持无套利一致性，并具备实际经济用途（如对冲），现有方法难以兼顾。

Method: 构建两个扩散模型：AD-Seq-Vol联合学习标的收益的条件演化与高维隐含波动率曲面，通过顺序更新市场历史生成多期情景；AD-Seq-Vol-FT进一步通过后训练惩罚引入静态无套利约束。基于2000–2023年SPX期权数据，并将生成的情景嵌入优化对冲框架。

Result: 模型能生成连贯的曲面轨迹并捕捉横截面与时序依赖；AD-Seq-Vol的静态套利违规比训练数据和GAN基准更少更轻，AD-Seq-Vol-FT几乎消除违规。对冲实验中，跟踪误差接近零、尾部风险显著降低，COVID-19期间表现尤为稳定。

Conclusion: 自适应序列扩散模型是一类有前景的市场一致且具经济价值的金融情景生成器。

Abstract: We develop a diffusion-model framework for dynamic implied-volatility surface generation and evaluate its economic usefulness through data-driven hedging. The framework consists of two models. AD-Seq-Vol jointly learns the conditional evolution of the underlying asset return and the high-dimensional implied-volatility surface, generating adapted multi-period scenarios by sequentially updating the realized market history. AD-Seq-Vol-FT further incorporates option-market structure through post-training penalties for violations of static no-arbitrage conditions. Using daily SPX option data from 2000 to 2023, we show that the proposed models generate coherent surface trajectories while capturing both cross-sectional and temporal dependence. AD-Seq-Vol produces fewer and less severe static-arbitrage violations than the training data and the GAN-based benchmark, while AD-Seq-Vol-FT reduces these violations to nearly zero. We then integrate the generated conditional scenarios into an optimization-based hedging framework. Compared to a range of classical and data-driven benchmarks, the diffusion-based hedges maintain tracking errors near zero, substantially reduce tail risk, and exhibit particularly stable performance during the COVID-19 market disruption. These results establish Adaptive Sequential Diffusion Models as a promising class of market-consistent and economically useful financial scenario generators. Our code is available at: https://github.com/yinbinhan/volatility-surface-simulation.

</details>


### [169] [Same Book, Different Fills: Partial Identification of FIFO Execution from Aggregate Order Books](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13597)
*Riya Danait,Yuliana Zamora,Ioana Boier*

Main category: q-fin.CP

TL;DR: 仅凭L2聚合数据回测被动成交会依赖不可观测的撤单分配规则；作者将其建模为条件部分识别问题，并在三种撤单规则下比较被动执行结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: L2价格档位数据只有聚合流动性，缺少价格-时间优先所需的排队顺序，因此被动执行回测即使固定价格、数量与成交，也会依赖未观测的撤单分配假设。

Method: 将订单级历史恢复视为条件部分识别问题；在固定聚合路径、对账后的市场移除、潜在订单划分和新增订单的前提下，构建保持路径的编译器，仅改变撤单在队列前端、按量加权随机、后端之间的分配；证明单个成交价时段内虚拟标记订单的前-后成交顺序；用2025年东京证交所7个月、两只股票（1301.T、7911.T）的十档L2快照与L1成交，各构造1,080个五分钟匹配样本。

Result: 主动基准在FIFO实现间不变，但被动执行对撤单规则敏感。1301.T中前端撤单相比后端撤单使临到期完成率提高8.01个百分点，实施差额降低1.010 bps；7911.T对应为7.39个百分点和0.384 bps。

Conclusion: 观察上等价的聚合订单簿路径可能对应经济上不同的被动执行结果；基于聚合数据的执行策略应报告FIFO敏感性分析，而非基于不可观测排队假设的单点估计。

Abstract: Price-level limit order book (L2) data reveal aggregate liquidity but not the ordered queue required by price--time priority. Passive-execution backtests can therefore depend on an unobserved cancellation-allocation rule even when observed prices, quantities, and trades are held fixed. We frame recovery of market-by-order histories from aggregate snapshots as a conditional partial identification problem: multiple histories can reproduce the same aggregate path. Holding that path, reconciled market removals, latent order partitions, and additions fixed, our path-preserving compiler varies only cancellation allocation among front, quantity-weighted-random, and back rules. Within this compiler class, we establish front--back fill ordering for a virtual tagged order during one touch-price spell. We study seven months of synchronized 2025 Tokyo Stock Exchange data for two instruments with different trading activity: RIC 1301.T and RIC 7911.T. Ten-level L2 snapshots provide book states, while L1 trades permit inference of market removals and resting side through reconciliation. Each instrument contributes 1,080 matched five-minute episodes over the same 18 held-out trading days. The aggressive benchmark is invariant across FIFO realizations, but passive execution is sensitive to the cancellation rule. For 1301.T, front rather than back cancellation raises preterminal completion by 8.01 percentage points and reduces implementation shortfall by 1.010 bps. For 7911.T, the corresponding differences are 7.39 percentage points and 0.384 bps. Thus, observationally equivalent aggregate-book paths can imply economically different passive-execution outcomes. Execution policies evaluated from aggregate data should be accompanied by FIFO sensitivity analysis rather than reported as single-point estimates based on an unobservable queue assumption.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [170] [ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13356)
*Jiyan He,Guang Liang,Hao Liu,Haoxiang Guan,Jinbo Sun,Junyi Guo,Wenjun Feng,Yantai Xie,Yifei Shen,Bin Shao,Chuyang Wei,Kai Chen,Kexin Zhou,Minghang Zhu,Shuxin Zheng,Tie-Yan Liu,Taine Zhao,Wenhui Zhu,Xueyin Xu,Xiaoqing Zhang,Yatao Li,Yuxuan Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ZGCM-1 是一个完全开源的 7B 稠密基础模型，通过数据、系统和算法的高效设计，结合内部思考与外部工具使用，在 256K 上下文下实现强竞争力，并以约 4.2 倍效率提升预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑模型无法被动记忆开放网络内容，需通过"内部思考+外部工具使用"突破参数量限制。

Method: 架构与系统协同设计（交织门控滑窗与全注意力、稳定的 FP8 Muon 优化器）；渐进式课程与 MDP 中期训练（16K→64K→256K 上下文扩展，将交互轨迹重构为马尔可夫决策过程）；AI 原生研发流程（智能体集群自主管理集群、数据与评估）。

Result: 在通用基准上与 7B 模型族竞争力强；在数学推理和智能体搜索任务上可媲美 Qwen3-235B-A22B、GLM-5.1 等大数量级前沿模型；16K 预训练时间到损失效率提升约 4.2 倍；提炼出八条可操作经验。

Conclusion: 开源模型权重（预训练/中期/后训练）、中间检查点、训练代码、分阶段数据与配方及 W&B 日志，促进社区研究。

Abstract: In this work, we present ZGCM-1, a fully open 7B dense foundation model trained from scratch with extreme data, system, and algorithmic efficiency. ZGCM-1 is founded on a core premise: compact models cannot passively memorize the open web, but can overcome parametric capacity limits by coupling deliberate internal thinking with active external tool use. To support this paradigm across a 256K context, we develop an end-to-end, high-efficiency open training recipe: Architecture & System Co-design: interleaved gated sliding-window and full attention, and a stable FP8 Muon optimizer; Progressive Curriculum & MDP Mid-Training: context scaling across 16K, 64K, and 256K, and the reformulation of interaction traces into Markov Decision Processes. Furthermore, we establish an AI-native R&D workflow where agent swarms autonomously manage cluster operations, data curation, and rapid diagnostic evaluation. Extensive evaluations show that ZGCM-1-7B is competitive across 7B model family on general benchmarks. On several challenging mathematical reasoning and agentic search suites, it remains competitive with frontier models orders of magnitude larger, such as Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.1. We also show that our pre-training design offers a ~4.2x efficiency improvement in 16K pre-training time-to-loss. Across the full development lifecycle, we distill eight actionable empirical findings-spanning architectural scaling, SFT quality pruning, long-context generalization, and agentic co-training dynamics. To facilitate community research, we open-source model weights from the pre-training, mid-training, and post-training stages, intermediate checkpoints, training code, per-stage data and data recipes, and W&B logs.

</details>


### [171] [Converge Then Diversify: Decoupling Convergence and Diversity in Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13396)
*Chao Jiang,Yueling Huang,Miqing Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"先收敛后多样化"(CTD)两阶段方法，将多目标贝叶斯优化中的收敛与多样性解耦，在极紧预算下显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MOBO方法同时追求收敛与多样性，需要精细设计，且在预算极紧时难以同时逼近整个Pareto前沿。

Method: 将搜索分为两阶段：第一阶段专注收敛，快速逼近Pareto前沿上的单一点；第二阶段专注多样性，将解分散到整个前沿。并基于常用采集函数给出两种简单实现。

Result: 在全部446组成对比较中，CTD在72.9%的情况下统计显著优于SOTA，21.1%持平，仅6.1%更差；在极紧评估预算或高维问题上优势尤为明显。

Conclusion: 将收敛与多样性解耦的两阶段策略是应对紧张预算MOBO问题的有效方案。

Abstract: Multi-objective Bayesian optimisation (MOBO) is a sample-efficient approach for optimising expensive black-box functions with multiple objectives. In MOBO, the goal is to adequately approximate the Pareto front; that is, to obtain a high-quality solution set with 1) good convergence (closeness to the Pareto front) and 2) good diversity (spread across the Pareto front). Existing MOBO methods typically aim to accomplish these two tasks simultaneously, i.e., driving the search towards the Pareto front while maintaining a diverse set of nondominated solutions, such that the solutions, ideally, can gradually approach the entire front. When sufficient search budgets are available, this approach is effective. However, considering both convergence and diversity throughout the search is not easy and requires careful design. Under very tight budgets, there may not be enough solutions generated to be able to simultaneously approach the entire Pareto front. To address this issue, this paper proposes a \textit{converge-then-diversify} (CTD) approach that decouples convergence and diversity into two stages. In the first stage, CTD focuses on convergence, aiming to quickly drive the search toward a single point on the Pareto front. In the second stage, CTD focuses on diversity, aiming to spread solutions across the front. We present two simple instantiations of CTD by using widely adopted acquisition functions in the area. Experimental results show that, across all 446 pairwise comparisons, CTD statistically outperforms state-of-the-art methods in 72.9\% of the cases, performs equivalently in 21.1\%, and is statistically worse in only 6.1\%, with the advantage being particularly evident in settings with very tight evaluation budgets or in high-dimensional problems.

</details>


### [172] [Generalized Agent Iteration: One Formal Framework for Iterative Policy Improvement and Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13406)
*Hongyao Tang,Yi Ma,Pengyi Li,Yifu Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出通用智能体迭代(GAI)框架，用统一形式化描述迭代策略改进与递归自我改进(RSI)，并通过两个关键"旋钮"区分二者并定位现有系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RSI在不同尺度被广泛主张，但缺乏统一的形式化框架来描述这些新兴实例；经典对应物迭代策略改进由GPI刻画，但GPI要求更新原理与评估基准位于智能体之外，无法涵盖RSI。

Method: 提出GAI框架，将智能体定义为系统内可修改组件的配置，将学习过程建模为"智能体评估—智能体改进"的循环。用两个关键旋钮区分实例：(1)改进机制是否属于智能体本身；(2)其衡量标准是否基于智能体外部。

Result: 第一个旋钮划定GPI与RSI的边界，第二个旋钮决定系统极性（锚定、目标漂移或完全自指）。作者用这两个坐标将现有系统置于同一坐标系中，并逐条陈述RSI的缺陷。

Conclusion: 本文是探索RSI形式化刻画的第一步，该刻画建立在经典理论之上，使现有系统可比，并为分析与设计新系统提供有原则的基础。

Abstract: When we speak of recursive self-improvement (RSI), are we speaking of a phenomenon, a mechanism, or a prospect? Towards autonomous and evolving intelligence, RSI is being claimed at many scales, while no single framework that formally describes these emerging instances exists. Its counterpart in the classical realm, iterative policy improvement, is characterized by generalized policy iteration (GPI), a framework of broad applicability with well-understood theoretical properties, but only where the update principle and the evaluation base lie outside the agent. In this paper, we propose Generalized Agent Iteration (GAI), a formal framework that describes iterative policy improvement and RSI as two cases of a single learning paradigm. GAI defines the agent as a configuration of modifiable components within a system and models the learning process as a cycle of agent evaluation and agent improvement. Two pivotal dials then distinguish the instances: whether the improving mechanism is part of the agent and whether the standard it is measured against is grounded outside it. The former dial delineates the boundary between GPI and RSI, and the latter determines a system's polarity as anchored, goal drift, or fully self-referential. Moreover, we use these coordinates to place existing systems on the same two axes and make the defects of recursive self-improvement statable one condition at a time. We see this paper as a first step toward exploring a formal characterization of RSI that rests on the classical account, makes existing systems comparable, and provides a principled basis for analyzing and designing new ones.

</details>


### [173] [How User-AI Mistreatment Occurs and Matters in Conversational Systems?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13579)
*Fanqi Zeng,Sadid A. Hasan,Chaocheng He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 审计777K LMSYS-Chat-1M对话，用词典与审核检测器区分"用户对模型的敌意"与"有害内容索取"，发现二者弱重叠。针对助手的骚扰率约0.90%，用户敌意跨模型相差13倍（主要由吸引的用户群驱动），助手道歉与下一轮敌意正相关，但整体更爱道歉的模型收到更少敌意，且敌意呈时间演化结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全研究多关注模型生成的危害，而忽视用户对模型施加的敌意、胁迫与对抗压力；理解这类行为对解读模型行为、对齐漂移和部署风险至关重要。

Method: 对777K条英文LMSYS-Chat-1M对话进行审计，采用两个独立检测器：(1) 八类针对模型的敌意词典；(2) 数据集自带的审核信号。对比二者覆盖现象及重合度，并做精确度校正；进一步分析跨模型差异、对话内道歉与后续敌意的关联（控制拒绝、越狱等因素）、跨模型相关性与时间结构。

Result: 两检测器捕获不同且弱重叠的现象：词典识别辱骂、威胁、越狱胁迫，审核标记则以诱导有害内容为主。二者合计覆盖约5%用户轮次；校正精确度后针对助手的虐待率为0.90%（仅代表竞技场式评测流量，非部署基线）。用户敌意跨模型相差13倍，主要由模型吸引的用户群决定而非模型行为；首轮敌意比回复后敌意更普遍，去重后极端差异仍超15倍。助手道歉与下一轮敌意更高几率相关（在非拒绝前轮、无越狱对话中仍成立，23个模型中20个为正）；但跨模型看，更爱道歉的模型总体收到更少敌意。敌意还有时间结构：胁迫性开场集中首轮，情感性敌意随会话累积。

Conclusion: 用户对模型的敌意可被系统检测，且与有害内容索取是不同现象；其变化主要由用户群构成驱动，并与道歉存在双向/张力关系，且具时间演化特征。作者公开词典、检测器交叉验证流程及所有派生表格。

Abstract: Safety research often focuses on model-generated harms, but users may also direct hostility, coercion, and adversarial pressure at models. Understanding how and when that occurs is essential for accurately interpreting model behaviour, alignment drift, and real-world deployment risks. In this paper, we audit 777K English LMSYS-Chat-1M conversations with two independent detectors: an eight-category lexicon for hostility directed at the model, and the dataset's moderation signal; and show that they capture different, weakly overlapping phenomena. The lexicon identifies insults, threats, and jailbreak coercion aimed at the assistant, while moderation flags are dominated by toxic-content solicitation rather than hostility at the model. Together, they mark about 5% of user turns; adjusting the narrower lexicon-harassment union for measured precision puts mistreatment aimed at the assistant at 0.90%. These absolute rates describe arena-style evaluation traffic and should not be read as deployment-wide base rates. We find that user hostility varies 13-fold across models, driven largely by who each model attracts rather than by model behaviour: first-turn hostility spreads far wider than post-response hostility, and more than fifteenfold separates the extremes even after deduplicating opening prompts. Within conversations, assistant apologies are consistently associated with higher odds of next-turn hostility under both detectors; the effect survives restricting to non-refused prior turns and to jailbreak-free conversations, and is positive in 20 of 23 models. Yet across models, more apologetic models receive less hostility overall. Finally, hostility also shows temporal structure, with coercive openings front-loading the first turn while affective hostility accumulates over a session. We release the lexicon, the detector cross-validation pipeline, and all derived tables.

</details>


### [174] [Vibe Patenting: Evaluating LLM Judges for Professional Patent-Drafting Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13422)
*Toshiaki Koike-Akino,Vlad Blaykhman,Ye Wang,Jing Liu,Gene V. Vinokur*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过端到端专利撰写测试平台 Vibe Patenting 研究 LLM 评审在复杂专业工作中的可靠性，发现评审引导的迭代修改能持续提升质量并缩小模型差距，但评审与专业律师评估存在系统性偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 评审被广泛用于评估和改进 AI 生成内容，但其在复杂专业工作中的可靠性仍不清楚，需要实证检验。

Method: 构建 Vibe Patenting 端到端专利撰写测试平台，用独立调用的 LLM 评审对生成专利草稿打分并提供结构化反馈，支持多轮迭代修改；测试多种发明与撰写智能体配置，并与专业专利律师的独立评估进行验证对比。

Result: 评审引导的修改持续提升评审质量，无引导修改趋于饱和；迭代反馈使低推理智能体接近高推理智能体的表现；更强模型和更多推理通常提升质量，领域特定工作流带来额外增益；与律师评估存在有意义但强依赖指标的共识及系统性校准差异。

Conclusion: LLM 评审既是复杂专业工作流中有用的评估者与优化信号，也存在明显局限，需谨慎对待其可靠性。

Abstract: LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate and improve AI-generated outputs, yet their reliability for complex professional work remains unclear. We study this problem through Vibe Patenting, an end-to-end patent-drafting testbed for AI-agent evaluation. A separately-invoked LLM judge evaluates generated patent drafts and provides structured feedback for iterative revision. Across multiple inventions and drafting-agent configurations, judge-guided revision consistently improves judge-assessed quality, while unguided revision tends to saturate. Notably, iterative judge feedback enables a low-reasoning agent to approach the performance of a substantially more expensive high-reasoning agent. Stronger models and increased reasoning generally improve judge-assessed drafting quality, while domain-specific agentic workflows provide further gains. We validate the judge against independent evaluation by a professional patent attorney and find meaningful but strongly metric-dependent agreement and systematic calibration differences. These results highlight both the utility and limitations of LLM judges as evaluators and optimization signals for complex professional workflows.

</details>


### [175] [Toward Self-Adaptive Physical AI: Can LLM Agents Manage Long-Horizon Physical Tasks?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13436)
*Varun Kaushik,Yayun Tan,Xiaofan Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探索构建可零样本管理长期物理任务、无需人工干预即可自适应环境变化的物理AI智能体，采用集成规划、工具调用、观测与验证的多智能体框架，并在农业任务上验证其有效性与自适应能力。


<details>
