The framework incorporates small volatility-of-volatility, fast mean-reverting, and short-maturity asymptotics.

</details>


<div id='math.OC'></div>

# math.OC [[Back]](#toc)

### [318] [Formation control from the generic combinatorial viewpoint: edge dynamics and directed sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13423)
*Louis Theran,Daniel Zelazo,Sean Dewar,Bernd Schulze*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出距离型编队控制的几何框架，将稳定性问题降到边空间，用线性边算子的谱性质刻画局部指数稳定性，并给出方向/目标几何相关的充要条件及SDP综合方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 距离型编队控制中，智能体间距的演化与实现它的节点运动耦合在一起，稳定性分析复杂。作者希望将两者分离，把稳定性问题简化到边空间，并用谱性质给出统一判据。

Method: 建立几何框架，分离边距离演化与其在节点运动中的实现，将稳定性归约到边空间；证明边动力学局部指数收敛可推出编队局部指数收敛；引入边算子的弱容许、容许、强容许等谱性质层级；针对有向感知，给出任意目标点局部稳定性的充要谱条件与二次充分判据；对无环方向给出容许性的精确组合刻画，并用二次判据构造综合稳定边增益的半定规划。

Result: 边动力学的局部指数收敛等价于编队的局部指数收敛；稳定性可由线性边算子的谱性质认证；有向感知下获得局部稳定的充要谱条件与二次充分证书；稳定性同时依赖图的方向与目标几何；持久性既非局部收敛的必要条件也非充分条件；每个一般刚性图都存在容许方向；无环方向的容许性有精确组合刻画；可用SDP综合稳定边增益。

Conclusion: 该几何框架将距离型编队控制稳定性分析统一到边空间，给出谱判据和组合/优化工具，澄清了持久性与收敛性的关系，并为有向感知下的增益设计提供可计算途径。

Abstract: We develop a geometric framework for distance-based formation control that separates the evolution of inter-agent distances from its realization by compatible node motions, reducing the stability problem to the edge space. We show that local exponential convergence of the edge dynamics implies local exponential convergence of the formation, and that stability is certified by spectral properties of a linear edge operator. We introduce a hierarchy of generic spectral properties --- weak admissibility, admissibility, and strong admissibility --- that provide necessary conditions for local exponential stability. Specializing to directed sensing, we obtain a necessary and sufficient spectral condition for local stability at an arbitrary target, together with a quadratic sufficient certificate. These conditions reveal that stability depends jointly on the graph orientation and target geometry, and show that persistence is neither necessary nor sufficient for local convergence. We show that every generically rigid graph admits an admissible orientation and, for acyclic orientations, we give an exact combinatorial characterization of admissibility. Finally, the quadratic certificate leads to a semidefinite program for synthesizing stabilizing edge gains.

</details>


### [319] [Data-Driven Flutter Suppression via HODMD, DMDcand Constrained MPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13459)
*Carlos Mendez*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出可解释的数据到控制框架，结合HODMD、DMDc和MPC实现含执行器约束的颤振抑制，从早期测量数据构建低阶模型并完成约束控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 颤振抑制需要从含噪测量中准确辨识气动弹性模态并实现满足执行器约束的控制，标准DMD辨识精度不足，需发展可解释的数据驱动建模与控制一体化方法。

Method: 以带后缘襟翼和有理非定常气动的俯仰-沉浮典型剖面为对象；用HODMD从四个结构通道辨识主导频率与增长率；由HODMD子空间构建五状态实降阶模型，并用DMDc从小幅PRBS记录估计襟翼输入矩阵；最后设计约束MPC。

Result: 2% RMS噪声下近临界增长率误差1.8e-3 s^-1，优于标准DMD；chirp输入归一化误差2.4e-3；约束MPC使后临界对象在8度初始扰动、1度襟翼限制下稳定，而饱和LQR达到有效性极限；SU2、OpenFOAM和FSI辅助研究验证了频率恢复、执行器力矩权限和闭环可行性。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了从早期测量到约束气动弹性控制的可复现路径，但辅助CFD研究不构成CFD级MPC验证。

Abstract: This work presents an interpretable data-to-control framework for actuator-constrained flutter suppression by combining higher-order dynamic mode decomposition (HODMD), dynamic mode decomposition with control (DMDc), and model predictive control (MPC). The primary case is a pitch-plunge typical section with a trailing-edge flap and rational unsteady aerodynamics. HODMD identifies the dominant frequency and growth rate in subcritical, near-critical, and post-critical regimes from four measured structural channels. With 2% RMS sensor noise, the near-critical growth-rate error is 1.8 x 10^-3 s^-1, substantially lower than with standard DMD without delay embedding. A five-state real reduced-order model is formed from the HODMD subspace, and its flap-input matrix is estimated from a small-amplitude PRBS record using DMDc. For an independent chirp input, the normalized error over all channels is 2.4 x 10^-3. The constrained MPC stabilizes the true post-critical plant for an initial pitch perturbation of 8 degrees with a flap limit of 1 degree, whereas saturated LQR designed from the same model reaches the prescribed validity limit. Three supporting studies assess transferability. SU2 simulations show HODMD frequency recovery consistent with the available spectral resolution; OpenFOAM dynamic-mesh calculations show nearly linear articulated-flap moment authority from 2 to 8 degrees with frequency-dependent gain; and a two-way SU2 Python-FSI case demonstrates bounded disturbance rejection using a proportional-derivative baseline. These studies support modal identification, actuator authority, and closed-loop feasibility, but are not presented as CFD-level MPC validation. The framework provides a reproducible route from early-time measurements to constrained aeroelastic control.

</details>


### [320] [Matching Higher-Order Oracle Complexity for Smooth Monotone Variational Inequalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13462)
*Haihan Zhang,Wendao Wu,Chenheng Zhang,Cong Fang,Haoxuan Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文为光滑单调变分不等式建立近最优高阶 oracle 复杂度界，上界改进为 Õ_p(Q^{2/(3p-1)})，并证明匹配下界，从而确定最坏情形复杂度为 Θ̃_p((L_pD^p/ε)^{2/(3p-1)})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原有 Chen 等人的高阶 oracle 上界为 Õ_p(Q^{1/p})，但该上界并非最优，本文旨在缩小光滑单调变分不等式高阶 oracle 复杂度的上下界差距。

Method: 针对直径≤D 的紧凸集 X 上单调 F，且 Lip(D^{p-1}F)≤L_p，每次查询返回完整 jet (F,DF,…,D^{p-1}F)；提出维度无关的确定性算法，返回显式的切 residual 证书，达到 Õ_p(Q^{2/(3p-1)}) 上界。

Result: 将上界从 Õ_p(Q^{1/p}) 改进到 Õ_p(Q^{2/(3p-1)})；对任意自适应确定性算法及每实例成功率≥2/3 的随机算法，证明匹配下界 Ω_p(Q^{2/(3p-1)})；在无 span 或 tensor-update 限制下，得到最坏情形复杂度 Θ̃_p((L_pD^p/ε)^{2/(3p-1)})；同类方法用于光滑凸-凹极小极大问题，将固定几何精度指数从 4/(3p+1) 改进到 2/(3p-1)，与已知下界指数匹配。

Conclusion: 光滑单调变分不等式的高阶 oracle 最坏情形复杂度被确定为 Θ̃_p((L_pD^p/ε)^{2/(3p-1)})，同时改进了光滑凸-凹极小极大问题的精度指数，达到与下界匹配的近最优结果。

Abstract: We establish near-optimal higher-order oracle bounds for smooth monotone variational inequalities. For fixed $p\ge2$, let $F$ be monotone on a known compact convex set $X$ of diameter at most $D$, with $\operatorname{Lip}(D^{p-1}F)\le L_p$. Each feasible query returns the complete jet $(F,DF,\ldots,D^{p-1}F)$, and the goal is to find $x$ with tangent residual $\operatorname{dist}(0,F(x)+N_X(x))\le\varepsilon$. Writing $Q=L_pD^p/\varepsilon$, we improve the $\widetilde O_p(Q^{1/p})$ upper bound of Chen et al. to $\widetilde O_p(Q^{2/(3p-1)})$ via a dimension-independent deterministic algorithm that returns an explicit tangent-residual certificate. We prove a matching $Ω_p(Q^{2/(3p-1)})$ lower bound for arbitrary adaptive deterministic algorithms and randomized algorithms with per-instance success probability at least $2/3$, without span or tensor-update restrictions. Hence the high-dimensional worst-case oracle complexity is $\widetildeΘ_p((L_pD^p/\varepsilon)^{2/(3p-1)})$. The same method applies to smooth convex--concave minimax problems, improving the fixed-geometry accuracy exponent from $4/(3p+1)$ to $2/(3p-1)$ and matching the known lower-bound exponent.

</details>


### [321] [Inverse Learning of the Altruism and Cost Level in Mixed-Individual Mean Field Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13469)
*Haoyang Cao,Gökçe Dayanıklı,Xiaofei Shi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文为混合个体平均场博弈(MFG)提出逆学习框架，从噪声观测中恢复不可观测的利他程度与劳动成本等私人结构参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解个体与群体对激励的响应对于有效政策设计至关重要。在连续时间随机大群体框架下，MFG刻画非合作主体，MFC刻画完全合作(完全利他)基准，混合个体MFG通过利他参数在两者间插值。但监管者面临的挑战是利他水平和劳动成本等私人结构参数通常不可观测。

Method: 针对混合个体MFG构建逆学习框架，从含噪观测中反演(潜)利他水平和劳动成本水平。

Result: 实验证明该方法在恢复潜参数上具有可行性与准确性。

Conclusion: 逆MFG方法有望揭示大群体中的潜在偏好结构，对激励设计、经验行为建模和数据驱动政策分析具有重要意义。

Abstract: Understanding how humans respond to incentives, both at the individual and collective levels, is crucial to the design of effective policies. Within the continuous-time stochastic framework for large interacting populations, mean field games (MFGs) model populations of non-cooperative agents, whereas mean field control (MFC) describes the fully cooperative benchmark, interpreted in our setting as fully altruistic behavior. Mixed-individual MFGs interpolate between these two extremes through a parameter governing the degree of altruism. A central challenge for regulators and policymakers, however, is that intrinsic altruism levels and other private structural parameters, such as individual labor costs, are typically unobservable. To address this challenge, we develop an inverse learning framework for mixed-individual MFGs. Our approach enables the recovery of (latent) altruism and labor cost levels from noisy observations, with experiments demonstrating the feasibility and accuracy of our method. These findings underscore the promise of inverse MFG methodologies for uncovering latent preference structures in large populations, with important implications for incentive design, empirical behavioral modeling, and data-driven policy analysis.

</details>


### [322] [Fast Relax-and-Round Unit Commitment with Topological Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13480)
*Evan J. R. Brody,Charles Foltz,Eve Tsybina,Slaven Peles,Shaked Regev*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出对松弛-舍入机组组合(RRUC)的扩展方法，可在满足跨时段与空间MVA约束下，更快地对大规模电网进行机组组合，并验证其良好的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 美国知识经济发展导致数据中心负荷激增，促使数据中心自带发电机组，同时公用事业转向次输配电级发电资产；负荷增长与电网条件趋紧使得在电网约束下需对大量局部发电机组进行机组组合，而传统方法难以应对大规模问题。

Method: 提出RRUC(Relax-and-Round Unit Commitment)的扩展方法，能够在考虑跨时段约束和空间MVA约束的前提下，对更大规模问题进行机组组合，且速度优于传统方法。

Result: 在100至20,000节点的合成阻塞测试系统上验证，RRUC求解成本低且与问题规模无关，运行时间随节点数呈亚二次增长；100节点系统不到1秒，20,000节点系统约7分钟；而领先的先进求解器15分钟内无法为100节点系统找到可行解。

Conclusion: RRUC扩展方法在大规模电网机组组合问题上具有显著的速度和可扩展性优势，适合应对数据中心负荷增长带来的发电调度挑战。

Abstract: Recent developments in the US knowledge economy have created a significant growth in datacenter loads, with two major consequences for power generation. First, to compensate for growth in load, datacenters are encouraged to bring their own generating units. Second, in search of the remaining pools of dispatchable generation, utilities are increasingly turning to subtransmission and distribution level generating assets. Coupled with increasing loads and the resulting tighter grid conditions, both trends are likely to create a need to commit a large number of localized generating units under grid constraints. We propose an extension of Relax-and- Round Unit Commitment (RRUC) that is capable of committing generating units for larger problems faster than conventional methods, while staying within intertemporal and spatial MVA constraints. We demonstrate the performance of RRUC using synthetic congestible test systems ranging from 100 to 20,000 buses. RRUC consistently finds low cost solutions, independent of the problem size, and its run time increases sub-quadratically in the number of buses. RRUC can solve the 100 bus system in less than a second and the 20,000 bus system 7 minutes. In contrast, a leading state of the art solver cannot find a feasible solution to the 100 bus system in 15 minutes.

</details>


### [323] [Strategic Index Reconstitution: Differential Games, Closed-Loop Equilibria and Mean-Field Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15901)
*Lukas-Benedikt Fiechtner,Jose Blanchet*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文在连续时间多资产博弈中研究指数重构前后的策略性交易，建立子博弈完美纳什均衡并导出可计算的政策，分析异质信念与竞争/冲击衰减对价格与执行成本的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指数重构引发可预期的交易需求，机会主义交易者会提前布局并在公告与执行阶段获利，但缺乏刻画瞬态跨资产冲击、异质信念与指数跟踪者执行计划下多方博弈均衡的统一框架。

Method: 构建连续时间、多资产的策略交易博弈，包含瞬态跨资产价格冲击和对未来指数成分的异质信念；设定公告前布局、公告后调整、随指数化者执行计划交易的时序。在无价格操纵条件下，通过仿射反馈政策刻画子博弈完美纳什均衡，政策由非标准矩阵Riccati方程和线性常微分方程求解，规模不随交易者数量增长；并在平均场缩放极限下构造平均场均衡。

Result: 在有限期限上存在子博弈完美纳什均衡；聚合库存与价格冲击仅通过总体平均信念依赖信念，个体库存位置受信念差异影响；平均场均衡具有定量收敛与近似纳什界。数值示例显示竞争与冲击衰减决定预期性交易带来的不利价格位移与指数化者执行成本节省之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 该框架揭示了指数重构中策略性交易的均衡机制与信念聚合效应，并提供了在交易者众多时可扩展的均衡刻画和近似保证，对理解指数化执行成本与市场冲击有政策与实践意义。

Abstract: We study strategic trading around index reconstitution in a continuous-time, multiasset game with transient cross-asset price impact and heterogeneous beliefs about future index membership. Opportunistic traders position before a public announcement, adjust to the revealed composition, and trade around an indexer following a prescribed execution schedule. Under a no-price-manipulation condition, we construct a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium on every finite horizon. The affine feedback policies are computed from a non-standard matrix Riccati equation and linear ordinary differential equations whose number and dimensions do not grow with the number of traders. Aggregate inventories and price impact depend on beliefs only through the population-average belief, while differences in beliefs affect individual inventory positions. Under mean-field scaling, we construct a mean-field equilibrium and obtain quantitative convergence and approximate-Nash bounds. Numerical illustrations show how competition and impact decay determine the balance between adverse price displacement from anticipatory trading and savings in the indexer's execution costs when opportunists trade against its orders during implementation.

</details>


### [324] [A family of spectral conjugate gradient algorithms derived by least-squares approximations based on a modified quasi--Newton update with application to a revised robust binary classification model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13526)
*Saman Babaie-Kafaki,Maryam Khoshsimaye-Bargard,Ahmad Mousavi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种谱三项修正的Hestenes-Stiefel共轭梯度算法，保持抗干扰性的同时确保充分下降性，并给出无凸性假设下的收敛性证明与数值/应用验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Hestenes-Stiefel共轭梯度法具有抗干扰特性，但缺乏充分下降性质的保证，作者希望在保留该优势的同时弥补这一缺陷。

Method: 构造谱三项修正格式，从中导出修正割线方程得到无记忆BFGS更新公式；通过最小二乘意义下将搜索方向导向给定BFGS方向来确定谱参数，给出算法框架及理论分析。

Result: 在CUTEr无约束优化测试集上与三种共轭梯度算法对比（Dolan-More度量），并在基于重缩放损失的约化二次曲面SVM鲁棒二分类任务中评估精度与训练时间。

Conclusion: 所提算法在理论上无需凸性假设即具下降性与收敛性，实验和实际应用中展现出优于对比方法的实用优势。

Abstract: We develop a spectral three-term modification of the classic Hestenes--Stiefel conjugate gradient algorithm, preserving its anti-jamming characteristic and, simultaneously, taking care of the sufficient descent property. We discuss how a modified secant equation can be extracted from our modification scheme, yielding a memoryless BFGS updating formula. Then, the spectral parameter of our method is obtained by steering its direction toward the given BFGS direction within a least-squares context. Using our technical improvements, we outline the general framework of our algorithm and discuss its theoretical features, including the descent and convergence properties, without the convexity assumption. We put our algorithm to the test in comparison with the three other conjugate gradient algorithms on a set of CUTEr unconstrained optimization test models, comparing the outputs using the Dolan--More measure. Next, we provide a concise evaluation of the results, highlighting the practical advantages of our algorithm. As a real-world case study, we introduce a reduced quadratic surface SVM with the rescaled loss for robust binary classification and apply the proposed algorithm to assess its accuracy and training time against several other SVMs.

</details>


### [325] [Assortment Control Unlocks the Value of Dynamic Pricing in Mixed Last-Mile Delivery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13539)
*Ze Zhou,Balázs Kulcsár*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究混合配送选项（送货上门+自提柜）的动态报价与定价问题，提出基于ADP的状态价值锚定定价方法SVAP-ADP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商增长使末端配送需同时兼顾客户选择与运营效率，需动态联合决策配送选项的报价与定价。

Method: 将DOPMDO建模为有限期MDP；提出SVAP-ADP，在聚合状态表示上学习连续价值近似，用接受与拒绝的价值差估计选项级机会成本，并嵌入围绕标定"fine-static"基准的锚定信赖域定价问题。

Result: 在真实西雅图实例上，平均单集利润较当前实践提升7.0%（95% CI: 6.7–7.2%），主要来自降低末端履约成本，同时保持稳定的上门—自提柜—放弃组合比例。品类控制实验显示，动态定价在菜单含运营价值高的自提柜选项时最有效。

Conclusion: 预期性定价与品类控制具有互补性：定价引导客户选择低成本选项，而菜单决定了高价值合并机会是否存在。

Abstract: The growth of e-commerce has intensified the need for last-mile delivery systems that can jointly manage customer choice and operational efficiency. We study the Dynamic Offering and Pricing of Mixed Delivery Options problem, in which a logistics service provider dynamically selects and prices attended home-delivery time slots and out-of-home pickup options for sequentially arriving customers. Each decision affects immediate revenue, customer acceptance, and the route-dependent fulfillment cost realized at the end of the booking horizon. We formulate DOPMDO as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and propose State-Value Anchored Pricing via Approximate Dynamic Programming. The method learns a continuation-value approximation on an aggregate state representation of the mixed-delivery system and uses accepted-versus-rejected value differences to estimate option-level opportunity costs. These opportunity costs are embedded in an anchored trust-region pricing problem around a calibrated fine-static benchmark. Computational experiments on the real-world Seattle instance show that SVAP--ADP increases mean episode profit by 7.0\% relative to current practice (95\% CI: 6.7--7.2\%), primarily by reducing terminal fulfillment cost while maintaining a stable home--locker--opt-out mix. Assortment-control experiments show that dynamic pricing is most effective when the menu exposes operationally valuable locker alternatives, with richer candidate pools delivering substantially larger gains than restricted nearest-locker menus. These results indicate that anticipatory pricing and assortment control are complementary: pricing steers customers toward lower-cost options, but the menu determines whether high-value consolidation opportunities are available in the first place.

</details>


### [326] [The Generalized Excursion Coupling as the Limit of Concave Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13587)
*Yash Kanoria*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文将 Juillet 关于凹代价最优传输选择的工作从一维推广到 $\mathbb{R}^n$，证明一类严格凹扰动下的最优映射收敛到由极大射线上的"excursion coupling"诱导的内在极限映射 $t_\#$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧氏距离代价的 Monge-Kantorovich 问题是退化的，存在无穷多最优方案，需通过扰动代价（凸或凹）选取唯一方案。凸侧已有理解，但凹侧此前只在一维（实数轴）上由 Juillet 研究，并仅对幂代价证明了 excursion coupling 的收敛；本文旨在将其拓展到 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 并验证 Juillet 的猜想。

Method: 考虑相互奇异、总质量相等且一阶矩有限的正 Borel 测度 $\mu,\nu$，并假设 $\mu$ 关于 Lebesgue 测度绝对连续。对距离施加一类广泛的递增严格凹扰动（具有良定义的一阶剖面），考察对应最优映射；沿传输的极大射线作分解（disintegration），在每条射线上应用一维 excursion coupling 构造内在极限映射 $t_\#$。此外对幂代价 $\|x-y\|^{1-\varepsilon}$ 在有限 $\|x\|\ln(1+\|x\|)$ 矩条件下进行分析。

Result: 对于具有良定义一阶剖面的广泛递增严格凹扰动族，相应最优映射在 $\mu$-测度意义下收敛到同一个内在极限 $t_\#$，且该极限与扰动族及其剖面无关。对幂代价 $\|x-y\|^{1-\varepsilon}$ 在有限 $\|x\|\ln(1+\|x\|)$ 矩条件下也得到同样极限。

Conclusion: 本文将凹代价最优传输的唯一选择从一维推广到 $\mathbb{R}^n$，证明极限映射 $t_\#$ 由极大射线上的 excursion coupling 内在刻画，与扰动无关，从而证明了 Juillet 的猜想。

Abstract: The Monge-Kantorovich problem with the Euclidean distance cost is degenerate, typically admitting infinitely many optimal plans. A unique optimal plan is selected by perturbing the distance to a strictly convex or increasing strictly concave cost and passing to the limit: the convex side gives the plan induced by the map which is monotone on each transport ray, while the concave side was understood only on the real line, where Juillet proved that power-cost optimizers converge to the so-called excursion coupling, which is induced by a map when the source is atomless. This paper extends the concave selection to $\mathbb{R}^n$ for mutually singular finite positive Borel measures $μ$ and $ν$ with equal total mass and finite first moments, assuming that $μ$ is absolutely continuous with respect to the Lebesgue measure: for a broad class of increasing strictly concave perturbations of the distance with a well-defined first-order profile, the corresponding optimal maps converge in $μ$-measure to the same intrinsic limit $t_\#$, independent of the perturbation family and its profile. The map $t_\#$ is obtained by disintegrating the transport along its maximal rays and applying the one-dimensional excursion coupling on each ray. The same limit is established for the power costs $\|x-y\|^{1-\varepsilon}$ under a finite $\|x\|\ln(1+\|x\|)$ moment condition, establishing a conjecture of Juillet.

</details>


### [327] [Nonsmooth Optimization via Orthogonalized Momentum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13677)
*Lexiao Lai,Tianyi Lin,Jiayu Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究正交化动量（如Muon）在非光滑优化中的失效机制，并提出自适应动量方法MAGD恢复收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实问题常含矩阵参数，传统优化器将其视为向量忽略几何结构。Muon等方法通过正交化动量矩阵利用输入输出几何，但其经验成功引出理论问题：正交化动量能否在非光滑优化中仍然有效？

Method: 1) 在广义导数框架下（兼容反向传播）研究局部Lipschitz函数；2) 识别固定动量因子下Muon的失效条件；3) 证明当动量因子自适应趋于1且步长消失时可恢复收敛；4) 提出MAGD，将正交化动量与梯度按其相对进展加权结合。

Result: 1) 对任意固定β∈[0,1)，Muon从几乎所有初始点都无法逼近凸Lipschitz目标的全局最优解（即使迭代有界）；该例子扩展了Parshakova等仅覆盖β∈[0,1/2)的结果。2) 在非凸非光滑、有界及正则条件下，自适应动量使Muon恢复渐近收敛。3) MAGD在非凸下保持渐近收敛，凸下达到O(min{m,n}ε^{-2})速率，匹配最优维度依赖下界。4) 合成问题、图像分类和LLM预训练实验表明MAGD是Muon的简单实用替代。

Conclusion: 失效根源在固定动量而非正交化。自适应动量结合正交化可恢复非光滑优化的可靠性，MAGD兼具理论保证与实用性。

Abstract: Modern real application problems involve matrix-valued parameters, yet conventional optimizers treat them as vectors, thereby motivating matrix-aware methods that exploit input-output geometry, such as Muon which orthogonalizes the momentum matrices before parameter updates. Its empirical success raises a conceptual question: can orthogonalized momentum remain effective beyond smooth optimization? This paper studies this question for locally Lipschitz functions using a generalized derivative framework compatible with backpropagation. Our first contribution is to identify a key limitation: for every fixed momentum factor $β\in[0,1)$, Muon can fail to approach the global optimal solution of a convex Lipschitz objective from almost every initialization, when step sizes adapt to the full gradient history. The failure can occur even along bounded iterates. Our example is inspired by the one of Parshakova et al. which only covers $β\in[0,\frac{1}{2})$. Then, we show that the obstruction lies in fixed momentum rather than orthogonalization. Indeed, when the momentum factor is adaptive and approaches 1 together with a vanishing step size, Muon recovers asymptotic convergence for nonconvex nonsmooth optimization under the boundedness and regularity conditions. Moreover, we propose MAGD, which combines orthogonalized momentum with gradient, weighted based on their relative progress. MAGD retains asymptotic convergence in nonconvex settings and achieves an $O(\min\{m,n\}ε^{-2})$ rate in convex settings. A lower bound shows the optimal dimension dependence. Experiments on synthetic problems, image classification, and LLM pretraining show MAGD is a simple and practical alternative to Muon. Together, our results characterize when orthogonalized momentum fails without smoothness and how it can be made reliable and we hope that the analysis may be useful more broadly.

</details>


### [328] [Preconditioned Three-Term Conjugate Gradient Framework for Nonconvex Finite Minimax Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13754)
*Wenzhe Zhao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出双曲优超预条件三项非线性共轭梯度框架，用于非凸有限minimax优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对非凸有限minimax优化，需要兼顾曲率吸收、预条件与线搜索度量的高效梯度方法。

Method: 由双曲光滑模型的全局二次优超导出解析对称正定度量，同时用作曲率吸收器、预条件子和线搜索能量度量；固定位移s_{k-1}并采用可变曲率响应b_k，引入增强三项方向及在保持基线最坏情形度量-能量常数前提下的最大自适应参数μ_k^\star。

Result: 获得Dai-Liao型共轭关系、增强充分下降性、平滑参数一致的Armijo下界、固定平滑的全局一阶收敛性与复杂度，以及连续化下的Clarke驻点聚点。

Conclusion: 该框架为非凸minimax优化提供了具有理论保证的预条件共轭梯度方法。

Abstract: This paper develops a hyperbolic-majorization preconditioned three-term nonlinear conjugate-gradient framework for nonconvex finite minimax optimization. An analytic symmetric positive definite metric is derived from a global quadratic majorization of the hyperbolic smoothing model and is used simultaneously as a curvature absorber, a preconditioner, and the line-search energy metric. With the displacement \(s_{k-1}\) fixed and a variable curvature response \(b_k\), an enhanced three-term direction is introduced together with an adaptive parameter \(μ_k^\star\) that is maximal under the requirement that the baseline worst-case metric-energy constant be preserved. The resulting framework yields a Dai--Liao-type conjugacy relation, enhanced sufficient descent, a smoothing-parameter-uniform Armijo lower bound, fixed-smoothing global first-order convergence and complexity, and Clarke-stationary accumulation points under continuation.

</details>


### [329] [Row-Polar LP-Newton for Linear Programming with Corral Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13755)
*Yanfei Li,Yuki Matsuno,Jianming Shi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出Polar LP-Newton (P-LPN)及其改进版Corral-repair P-LPN (CR-P-LPN)，利用行列极壳与Wolfe矩阵校正实现线性规划求解，并验证其相对HiGHS的加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LP-Newton通过一系列最近点问题求解LP。然而每个外层迭代重启Wolfe方法会丢弃其终端corral，尽管壳未改变且下一目标位于同一射线上，造成计算浪费。

Method: 给定不等式形式LP的内点可行解，构造由原点和归一化约束行形成的紧壳。P-LPN沿目标射线到行极壳边界，恢复原始-对偶最优解或证明无界性的衰退方向。CR-P-LPN则修复终端corral用以启动下一次投影，并在全壳上验证以保持P-LPN的投影、外层目标及LP结论。

Result: 对有理行极数据，证明外层迭代界为维度二次、二进制输入长度线性（不含内层Wolfe工作量）。Julia与MATLAB实验：180个单LP测试中P-LPN中位时间为CR-P-LPN的1.62与1.55倍；3个5000–100000行问题几何均值因子为2.03与1.46。19个应用LP端到端测试中，CR-P-LPN在18个上中位总时间低于更快的冷HiGHS模式，HiGHS/CR-P-LPN时间比几何均值为4.93与3.06。终端corral复用是有效组件，候选优先排序无一致增益。修复并非总有益：Klee-Minty测试上更慢，保留Netlib模型上作者实现的单纯形更快。

Conclusion: 终端corral复用可显著加速LP求解，CR-P-LPN在大规模应用LP上优于HiGHS，但增益依赖于问题结构，并非普遍适用。

Abstract: LP-Newton solves a linear program through a sequence of nearest-point problems. Given an interior feasible point for an inequality-form LP, we construct the compact hull formed by the origin and its normalized constraint rows. Polar LP-Newton (P-LPN) follows the objective ray to the boundary of this row-polar hull, where it recovers a primal-dual optimum or a recession direction proving unboundedness. For rational row-polar data, we prove an outer-iteration bound quadratic in dimension and linear in binary input length, excluding inner Wolfe work.
  Restarting Wolfe at every outer iteration discards its terminal corral even though the hull is unchanged and the next target lies on the same ray. Corral-repair P-LPN (CR-P-LPN) instead repairs that corral and uses it to start the next projection. Verification over the full hull preserves P-LPN's projections, outer targets, and LP conclusion in exact arithmetic.
  Experiments in Julia and MATLAB show where repair helps. After common initialization, median P-LPN times across 180 single-LP tests are 1.62 times the corresponding CR-P-LPN times in Julia and 1.55 times in MATLAB. On three problems with 5,000 to 100,000 rows, the corresponding geometric-mean factors are 2.03 and 1.46. A separate end-to-end study includes initialization on 19 application-derived LPs. CR-P-LPN has lower median total time than the faster cold HiGHS mode, either dual simplex or the interior-point method with crossover, on 18 of the 19 workloads in each language. The geometric means of the ratios of HiGHS time to CR-P-LPN time are 4.93 and 3.06. Component comparisons identify terminal-corral reuse as the useful component, whereas candidate-first ordering alone shows no consistent gain. Repair is not always beneficial: it is slower on Klee-Minty tests, and an author-implemented simplex is faster on the retained Netlib models.

</details>


### [330] [On the Equivalence of Stochastic Control and Path Space Formulations for Schrödinger Bridges over Compact Connected Lie Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13758)
*Hamza Mahmood,Georgiy A. Bondar,Abhishek Halder,Adeel Akhtar*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该论文证明了紧连通李群上运动学方程Schrödinger桥问题（SBP）的随机最优控制表述与路径空间表述等价，并给出解析、概率和计算三方面的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为紧连通李群上运动学方程的SBP建立随机最优控制与路径空间相对熵最小化之间的等价性，从而统一不同视角并拓展求解手段。

Method: 利用水平提升和随机反发展等几何概念，推导Girsanov型测度变换，证明期望控制能量等于受控路径律相对于参考Wiener测度的相对熵。

Result: SBP等价于给定端点边缘约束下的路径空间相对熵最小化；据此可证SB的存在唯一性、可作最可能偏差的概率解释，并可用静态Sinkhorn迭代直接求解，在环面T²上数值验证。

Conclusion: 该等价性为SBP提供了统一框架，兼具理论价值与计算可行性，代码已公开。

Abstract: We establish the equivalence between the stochastic optimal control and path space formulations of the Schrödinger bridge problem (SBP) for the kinematic equation on a compact connected Lie group. Using the geometric concepts of horizontal lift and stochastic anti-development, we derive a Girsanov-type change-of-measure result, and show that the expected control energy equals the relative entropy of the controlled path law with respect to the reference Wiener measure. Thus, the SBP is equivalently a path space relative entropy minimization problem subject to prescribed endpoint marginals.Our result has three useful implications. From an analytic viewpoint, the shown equivalence helps prove the existence and uniqueness of the SB. From a probabilistic viewpoint, it helps interpret the SB as the most probable deviation of the uncontrolled stochastic dynamics consistent with the endpoint constraints. From a computational viewpoint, it allows using static Sinkhorn recursions to directly solve the relative entropy minimization problem and compute the optimal path measure. We illustrate the equivalence numerically on the torus $\mathbb{T}^2$. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/gradslab/LargeDeviationSBP

</details>


### [331] [Last-Iterate Performance of Gradient Descent and Relaxed Proximal Point via $s$-Composability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13765)
*Salah Chikhi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: s-可组合性的联合势函数可同时作为最后一迭代尖锐性能的证书，由此求解常数步长与silver步长的最优worst-case保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: s-可组合性原本用于组合优化步长schedule并保持尖锐保证；本文探索同一联合势函数的第二用途——直接作为最后一迭代尖锐性能的证书，从而解决若干悬而未决的常数与唯一性问题。

Method: 基于联合势函数构造非负光滑-凸插值证书，对常数步长与silver schedule分别分析；通过Moreau包络将常数步长问题转化为松弛邻近点的残差最小化问题，并对任意正s-可组合schedule求精确最后一迭代邻近目标间隙常数。

Result: 证明常数步长情形下Grimmer等(2025)提出的s-可组合性公开问题（任意有限水平）；识别出最小化worst-case最终梯度范数的唯一最优常数步长，验证Taylor等(2017)猜想3的步长、值与唯一性；证明该常数也是松弛邻近点唯一最优松弛常数；给出任意s-可组合schedule的精确worst-case最后一迭代目标间隙常数及匹配的一维例子；对silver schedule得到其精确最后一迭代目标间隙常数，解决Wang等(2025)的公开问题。

Conclusion: 联合势函数可统一用于步长组合与最后一迭代性能证明，为常数与silver步长给出尖锐、唯一的worst-case保证，回答了多个公开问题。

Abstract: The notion of s-composability was introduced to compose optimized stepsize schedules while preserving sharp guarantees. We show that the same joint potential has a second use: it can serve directly as a certificate of sharp last-iterate performance. We develop this viewpoint for constant and silver schedules. For the constant schedule, we prove the s-composability statement posed as an open question by Grimmer et al. (2025), at every finite horizon, through an explicit nonnegative smooth-convex interpolation certificate. The result identifies the unique constant stepsize minimizing the worst-case final gradient norm of smooth convex gradient descent under an initial-distance bound, thereby proving the optimal stepsize, value, and uniqueness predicted by Conjecture 3 of Taylor et al. (2017) without resolving its full worst-case curve. Through the Moreau envelope, the same constant is also the unique constant relaxation minimizing the worst-case final residual of relaxed proximal point. More generally, for every positive s-composable schedule, we determine the exact worst-case final proximal objective-gap constant and give a matching one-dimensional example. Applying this result to the already s-composable original silver schedule yields its exact last-iterate objective-gap constant, closing a question left open by Wang et al. (2025).

</details>


### [332] [Interior-point proximal methods for nonsmooth optimization in Hilbert spaces with cone-ordered constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13813)
*Behzad Azmi,Alberto De Marchi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究带锥约束的非光滑非凸优化的非精确内点法，基于障碍正则化子问题并用近端梯度法非精确求解，给出收敛性与复杂度分析，并应用于椭圆最优控制和字典学习问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对带锥不等式约束的非光滑非凸优化问题（涵盖有限维分量约束与无限维PDE约束优化），需要一套统一且具有复杂度保证的非精确内点方法。

Method: 采用对数型和幂型障碍的正则化子问题，用近端梯度法非精确求解；推导可微性与曲率估计，在标准约束规范下建立KKT型最优性条件，并分析原变量与障碍诱导乘子满足近似KKT条件。

Result: 证明算法收敛到稳定点，给出达到近似稳定所需的近端梯度迭代总次数上界；因障碍曲率增长，总复杂度由最后的外层迭代主导。凸情形下整序列弱收敛到全局解，二次增长条件下强收敛。应用于带状态约束的半线性椭圆最优控制与带非线性侧约束的稀疏字典学习，数值实验验证理论。

Conclusion: 该框架统一处理有限维与无限维锥约束非光滑非凸优化，提供收敛与复杂度保证，并在凸情形给出更强结果，理论与实验相符。

Abstract: We study an inexact interior-point method for nonsmooth, nonconvex optimization problems with conic inequality constraints. The objective function is given by the sum of a smooth, possibly nonconvex term and a convex, possibly nonsmooth term with a computable proximal mapping. The constraints are formulated by means of an order cone in a Banach lattice. This setting covers finite-dimensional nonsmooth nonlinear problems with componentwise constraints as well as infinite-dimensional PDE-constrained optimization problems with pointwise state constraints. The method is based on barrier-regularized subproblems, which are solved inexactly by a proximal-gradient method. We consider logarithmic and power-type barriers and derive the differentiability and curvature estimates needed for the convergence and complexity analysis. Under standard constraint qualifications, we establish KKT-type optimality conditions for the original problem and show that the primal iterates and barrier-induced multipliers satisfy approximate KKT conditions. For the interior-point scheme, we prove convergence to stationary points and derive bounds on the total number of proximal-gradient iterations needed to reach approximate stationarity. In particular, we show that the total complexity is dominated by the final outer iterations because of the growth of the barrier curvature. In the convex setting, we obtain stronger convergence results: the full sequence converges weakly to a global solution and strongly under a quadratic growth condition. We apply the abstract results to state-constrained semilinear elliptic optimal control problems, for which all assumptions are verified, and to finite-dimensional sparse dictionary-learning problems with nonlinear side constraints. Numerical experiments support the theoretical findings.

</details>


### [333] [Generation of Custom Solvers in Rust for Convex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13875)
*Hao Zhu,Joschka Boedecker*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: cvxgenrust 是一个开源工具，可将 CVXPY 中建模的参数化凸优化问题族代码生成专用 Rust 求解器，支持半定规划和指数锥等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CVXPY 直接求解参数化问题族时运行时开销较大；现有代码生成工具（如 CVXPYgen）对 Rust/Clarabel 及更广锥类支持有限，缺少高效的原生 Rust 求解器生成方案。

Method: 该工具对问题族进行规范化，提取仿射映射转换为 Clarabel 锥规划数据，生成专用 Rust crate，运行时更新参数并原生调用 Clarabel；生成的求解器可暴露给 Python 并注册为自定义 CVXPY 求解器。支持范围涵盖至半定规划和指数锥问题。

Result: 数值实验显示，相比直接使用 CVXPY 求解，运行时间降低；在共享问题类上性能与 CVXPYgen 相当。

Conclusion: cvxgenrust 为参数化凸优化问题提供了一种高效的开源代码生成方案，兼顾广度（至 SDP 和指数锥）与性能，并可与 Python 生态集成。

Abstract: We introduce cvxgenrust, an open-source tool for generating custom Rust code that solves families of parameterized convex optimization problems modeled in CVXPY. cvxgenrust canonicalizes a problem family, extracts affine maps to Clarabel cone-program data, and generates a specialized Rust crate that updates parameters and calls Clarabel natively at runtime. The generated solver can also be exposed to Python and registered as a custom CVXPY solver. Our code generator supports a wide range of convex optimization problems up to semidefinite programs and exponential-cone problems. Numerical experiments show reduced runtime relative to direct CVXPY solves and performance comparable to CVXPYgen on shared problem classes.

</details>


### [334] [CyclOT: Learning Quadratic Optimal Transport Maps via Synchronized Forward-Backward Interpolants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13892)
*Shizhou Xu,Jiachen Liu,Shih-Hsin Wang,Stefan Broecker,Yuhao Huang,Bao Wang,Thomas Strohmer*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种双向神经网络框架，无需配对样本或凸势参数化，即可从非配对样本中恢复前向与反向二次最优传输映射，并从理论（种群恢复定理）与实验（多数据集）两方面验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从非配对样本中恢复高维最优传输映射是有挑战的问题。现有方法通常需要预计算样本配对或显式凸势参数化，限制其灵活性；论文旨在消除这些约束，同时保证前向与反向映射的恢复。

Method: 构建双向神经框架：学习的前向与反向映射诱导前向和反向位移插值；训练目标融合双向二次作用量、判别器受限的Jensen-Shannon端点目标以及双边循环一致性。无需预计算配对，也无需显式凸势参数化。

Result: 在紧凸集上绝对连续测度、生成器逼近、判别器丰富性及极小值可达到等条件下，证明种群恢复定理：当判别器水平足够大、退火作用量权重足够小时，任意全局极小值与前向/反向Brenier二次映射间的L²误差之和低于任意给定精度。循环损失上界为λW₂²(μ₀,μ₁)。补充结果刻画近似可逆性，并表明端点Jensen-Shannon散度与循环一致性分别控制缺失目标质量与多对一映射坍缩。实验覆盖Swiss roll、MNIST、CelebA、单细胞扰动数据与胸部X光图像，评估端点保真度、传输成本、逆一致性及插值几何。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了从非配对样本恢复双向二次最优传输映射的理论保证与实用框架，兼具种群恢复定理、循环损失界及坍缩控制的分析，并在多个高维数据集上验证了方法的有效性与几何性质。

Abstract: We study the recovery of forward and reverse quadratic optimal-transport maps from unpaired samples in high dimensions. We introduce a bidirectional neural framework in which the learned maps induce forward and backward displacement interpolants, while the training objective combines bidirectional quadratic action, discriminator-restricted Jensen-Shannon endpoint objectives, and two-sided cycle consistency. The construction requires neither precomputed sample pairings nor an explicit convex-potential parameterization. For absolutely continuous probability measures supported on a compact convex set, and under the stated generator-approximation, discriminator-richness, and minimizer-attainment conditions, we prove a population recovery theorem: for every prescribed accuracy, the sum of the corresponding \(L^2\) errors between any global minimizer and the forward and reverse quadratic Brenier maps is below that accuracy, provided the discriminator level is sufficiently large and the annealing action weight becomes sufficiently small. Moreover, the cycle loss is bounded above by \(λW_2^2(μ_0,μ_1)\). Complementary results quantify approximate invertibility and show that exact endpoint Jensen-Shannon divergence and cycle consistency control missing target mass and many-to-one map collapse, respectively. Experiments on Swiss roll, MNIST, CelebA, single-cell perturbation data, and chest X-ray images evaluate endpoint fidelity, transport cost, inverse consistency, and the geometry of the induced interpolations.

</details>


### [335] [Equilibrium bias and convergence in augmented primal--dual dynamics with sampled constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13925)
*Kang Liu,Mengxiao Chen,Siqi Xiong,Yi Xia*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究样本估计约束下增广原始-对偶动力学的稳定性与收敛性，揭示偏差问题并提出递归估计方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际中约束值常需从样本估计，无偏观测会导致增广乘子信号有偏，从而移动均值动力学的平衡点甚至破坏KKT条件，需研究其稳定性并加以纠正。

Method: 对分量不等式给出保持KKT平衡的充要条件；采用递归方式先估计约束值再构造增广乘子信号；对光滑凸锥问题做联合能量分析，在全局正则性与有界条件二阶矩假设下分析收敛。

Result: 构造了局部指数稳定但违反互补性的凸反例；证明原始、对偶与估计状态有界、估计误差消失、原始-对偶迭代几乎必然收敛到单一KKT点，允许非唯一解与乘子且每次迭代样本数固定。

Conclusion: 数值实验验证了预测的平衡偏差，并考察了非唯一KKT点及非线性约束下的收敛行为。

Abstract: This work studies the stability and convergence of augmented primal-dual dynamics when constraint values are estimated from samples. Unbiased constraint observations can produce a biased augmented multiplier signal, shifting the equilibria of the mean dynamics. For componentwise inequalities, we give a necessary and sufficient condition for preserving the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) equilibria and construct a convex example with a locally exponentially stable equilibrium that violates complementarity. To address this bias, constraint values are estimated recursively before forming the augmented multiplier signal. For smooth convex conic problems, a joint energy analysis establishes boundedness of the primal, dual, and estimation states, vanishing estimation error, and almost sure convergence of the primal-dual iterates to a single KKT point under global regularity and bounded conditional second moments. The result allows nonunique solutions and multipliers while keeping the number of samples per iteration fixed. Numerical studies illustrate the predicted equilibrium bias and examine convergence with nonunique KKT points and nonlinear constraints.

</details>


### [336] [Autonomous Flows: Exact Finite Interpolation and Uniform Approximation Obstructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14002)
*Qiaomu Liu,Qi Lü,Enrique Zuazua*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 在维数≥2时，一类局部Lipschitz向量场能在任意给定正时刻实现任意有限点对点映射，并应用于浅层ReLU网络实现精确有限插值；同时证明连续自治半流无法交换并压缩两个不相交球。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨自治动力系统（连续时间、无时间依赖系数）能否精确实现任意有限输入-目标插值，并区分「有限点精确插值」与「邻域一致逼近」这两种能力。

Method: 构造一个光滑自治参考流与有限多个局部修正场；利用一致稳定性与Brouwer度，在满足线性、生成全局流、一致逼近紧支光滑向量场条件的类内得到精确端点。仅用向量场的一致逼近，不控制其导数。应用于浅层ReLU向量场时给出精确有限插值及宽度与归一化系数强度界。

Result: 该类局部Lipschitz向量场可在任意规定正时刻实现任意有限对应（输入、目标可重叠）；浅层ReLU向量场无需时间依赖系数或额外状态变量即可实现精确有限插值，并有宽度与系数强度界。反面结果：任何连续自治半流都不能交换并压缩两个不相交球，其时间映射因而无法在紧集上一致逼近所有连续映射。

Conclusion: 精确的有限点插值与邻域的一致控制是本质不同的能力；自治半流在有限点上可精确插值，但不能一致逼近所有连续映射。

Abstract: In dimension at least two, a class of locally Lipschitz vector fields realizes every finite correspondence between distinct inputs and distinct targets at any prescribed positive time, provided that it is linear, its members generate global flows, and it approximates every smooth vector field of bounded support uniformly on bounded sets. The input and target sets may overlap. The proof constructs a smooth autonomous reference flow and finitely many localized correction fields, then uses uniform stability and Brouwer degree to obtain exact endpoints within the approximating class. The argument uses only uniform approximation of the vector fields; it does not require control of their derivatives. Applied to shallow ReLU vector fields, the result gives exact finite interpolation without time-dependent coefficients or additional state variables, together with bounds on width and normalized coefficient strength. In contrast, no continuous autonomous semiflow can exchange and compress two disjoint balls. Its time maps therefore fail to approximate all continuous maps uniformly on compact sets. The results distinguish exact interpolation at finitely many points from uniform control of neighborhoods.

</details>


### [337] [Distributed Convex Second-Order Optimization for AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Systems within PROcess Orchestration Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14004)
*Xinliang Dai,Yuning Jiang,Junyi Zhai,Jianlei Liu,Thorsten Schlachter,Colin N. Jones,Xiao-Ping Zhang,Veit Hagenmeyer*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出凸ALADIN变体实现分布式非线性凸优化的局部二次收敛，并应用于含复杂AC/DC互联与下垂控制VSC的AC/DC混合配电网OPF，通过POF协同仿真平台实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AC/DC配电网运行模型常过度简化AC/DC互联与VSC特性；现有分布式算法依赖梯度法，仅具线性收敛率，难以高效扩展至大规模系统。

Method: 提出利用凸子问题二阶导数的凸ALADIN变体，应用于可分离AC/DC OPF模型，显式纳入复杂AC/DC互联与多下垂控制VSC，同时保持计算可追踪性；并用PROcess Orchestration Framework协同仿真平台实现分布式凸二阶优化，通过图形界面自动化工作流设计、模型集成与分布式执行。

Result: 数值结果验证了所提模型的有效性。

Conclusion: 该凸ALADIN变体为分布式非线性凸优化提供局部二次收敛，且结合协同仿真平台可免除手工编码，为AC/DC混合配电网OPF提供高效可行方案。

Abstract: Existing operation formulations for AC/DC distribution grid often oversimplify the interplay of AC/DC interconnections and VSC characteristics. Moreover, current distributed algorithms depend on gradient-based methods, which achieve only linear convergence rates and struggle to scale efficiently for large systems. This paper proposes a convex ALADIN variant that exploits second-order derivatives of convex subproblems, achieving locally quadratic convergence for distributed nonlinear but convex optimization problems. Then, this convex ALADIN is applied to a separable AC/DC OPF model for AC/DC hybrid distribution grid, explicitly incorporating complicated AC/DC interconnections and multiple droop-controlled VSCs while retaining computational traceability. To bridge theory with practice, we implement the distributed convex second-order optimization framework using the PROcess Orchestration Framework, a co-simulation platform that automates workflow design, model integration, and distributed execution via a user-friendly graphical interface, eliminating manual coding. Numerical results illustrate effectiveness of the proposed model.

</details>


### [338] [Riemannian ascent--descent for nonconvex nonconcave minimax landscapes: convergence to basin saddle points and applications to distributionally robust optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14141)
*Rishabh Dixit,Pranav Upadrashta,Alex Cloninger*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究乘积空间（欧氏×黎曼流形）上的分布鲁棒优化（DRO）极小极大问题，提出"盆鞍点"概念与Riemannian梯度上升-多步下降收敛框架，并在高斯测度DRO上给出显式收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该类DRO的极小极大地形一般非凸非凹，缺乏全局收敛的一阶方法；需针对局部结构建立可保证收敛的理论与算法。

Method: 定义局部Nash均衡"盆鞍点"（局部极小临界集连通分量δ邻域×测度流形测地球）；在局部Łojasiewicz型增长条件（指数β∈(1,2]）下建立Riemannian梯度上升+多步下降的抽象收敛框架；对高斯测度DRO（Bures-Wasserstein协方差流形）松弛为惩罚DRO，导出Lagrangian的非渐近Hessian估计，证明最大化子的存在与局部唯一性及交替Riemannian梯度法收敛。

Result: 在临界集Lipschitz正则下，β=2得线性收敛，β∈(1,2)得多项式收敛，且显式依赖流形截面曲率；高斯DRO中所有常数以数据维度、损失矩与参考协方差显式给出。

Conclusion: 为流形上的非凸非凹DRO提供局部收敛理论及可实例化算法，收敛率与常数均具显式依赖。

Abstract: We study a class of distributionally robust optimization (DRO) problems for the statistical risk problem, formulated as minimax problems over the product of a Euclidean space and a Riemannian manifold. Because the resulting minimax landscape is nonconvex nonconcave in general, no globally convergent first order method is known to be available. We instead introduce the notion of a \emph{basin saddle point}, a Nash equilibrium defined locally on the Cartesian product of a $δ$ basin around a connected component of the local minima critical set and a geodesic ball on the measure manifold. We develop an abstract convergence framework for a Riemannian gradient ascent multistep descent iteration to a basin saddle point under a local Łojasiewicz type growth condition, with exponent $β\in (1,2]$, in the $δ$ basin around connected components of the local minima critical sets. Under Lipschitz regularity of critical sets we establish linear convergence for $β= 2$ and polynomial convergence for $β\in (1,2)$ to a basin saddle point, with explicit dependence on the sectional curvature of the manifold. We then instantiate this framework for the statistical risk DRO problem over Gaussian measures, where the ambiguity set is naturally modeled as the product of Euclidean space and the Bures Wasserstein manifold of covariance matrices, which we relax to a penalized DRO formulation. We derive nonasymptotic Hessian estimates for the resulting Lagrangian, establish existence and local uniqueness of its maximizer, and prove that an alternating Riemannian gradient scheme converges to a basin saddle point of the penalized DRO problem, recovering the linear and polynomial rates of the abstract theory with all constants explicit in terms of data dimension, loss moments, and the reference covariance.

</details>


### [339] [The Global Topology of Orthogonally Decomposable Tensor Landscapes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14186)
*Chunyin Siu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究正正交可分解张量对应的球面齐次函数的临界点全局结构，用持续性同调及随机系数下的极限定理刻画自旋玻璃式能量景观的典型拓扑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最佳秩一逼近与均值场自旋玻璃的目标函数是球面上的齐次形式，其临界点虽已被广泛研究，但这些临界点构成的整体景观的全局组织方式仍缺乏理解。

Method: 针对正正交可分解张量，确定子水平集与超水平集过滤的持续性同调，对所有同调维数 q、环境维数 D 和张量阶 k 给出闭式表达，并通过环境维数的递推实现；进一步取随机系数，导出第 0 维与第 D-2 维持续性图的强大数定律。

Result: 得到了任意 q、D、k 下持续性同调的闭式解与递推公式；在随机系数下证明持续性图在维数 0 和 D-2 处满足强大数定律，精确刻画了自旋玻璃式能量景观的典型全局拓扑；并用数值计算与模拟加以验证。

Conclusion: 该工作为这类张量能量景观的全局拓扑提供了精确理论描述，将持续性同调分析与随机矩阵/自旋玻璃理论联系起来。

Abstract: The homogeneous form associated with a symmetric tensor, restricted to the sphere, is the objective of the best rank-one approximation problem and, with random coefficients, the energy of a mean-field spin glass. Its critical points have been studied extensively, but the global organization of the landscape they form is far less understood. We study this global structure for positive orthogonally decomposable tensors. We determine the persistent homology of the sublevel and superlevel filtrations in closed form, for every homological dimension $q$, every ambient dimension $D$ and every tensor order $k$, via a recurrence in the ambient dimension. Taking the coefficients to be random, we further prove laws of large numbers for the resulting persistence diagrams at dimension $0$ and $D-2$, giving an exact description of the typical global topology of a spin-glass-like energy landscape. We illustrate our results with numerical computations and simulations.

</details>


### [340] [Resilient Extremum Seeking Control for Cyber-Physical Systems Under Denial-of-Service Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14192)
*Filipe da Silva Bastos Teixeira,Pedro Henrique Silva Coutinho,Tiago Roux Oliveira,Miroslav Krstic*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种抗DoS攻击的离散时间极值搜索控制(ESC)架构，通过DoS期间保持最近成功传输的信号实现弹性优化，并给出确定性与概率性DoS下的收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ESC依赖刻意注入的激励信号提取优化信息，使其网络化实现尤其易受DoS攻击。需要一种在DoS攻击下仍能保持稳定优化的弹性架构。

Method: 采用"保持最近成功传输信号"（hold-based）机制应对DoS区间，得到平均误差动态：成功通信时为指数收缩模态，受攻击时为中性模态。分别针对确定性DoS（攻击时长平均上界）和概率性DoS（随机平均法）进行收敛性分析。同时分析零输入策略失效机制。

Result: 确定性DoS下实现实用指数收敛，收敛率显式依赖受攻击时间比例；概率性DoS下建立几乎必然与依概率收敛，攻击成功概率进入收敛率。发现零输入策略会使与dither同步的攻击在平均动态中产生O(1/a)偏差，使平衡点偏离真实最优。

Conclusion: 在保持型架构下，日益严重的DoS攻击主要减慢优化过程而非破坏稳定性（只要通信未被永久阻断）。数值仿真验证了理论保证及dither同步攻击导致的失效机制。

Abstract: Extremum seeking control (ESC) relies on deliberately injected excitation to extract optimization information from measured outputs, making its networked implementation particularly vulnerable to denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. This paper develops a resilient discrete-time ESC architecture for cyber-physical systems subject to DoS attacks. By holding the most recently successfully transmitted signals during DoS intervals, the proposed mechanism yields averaged error dynamics with an exponentially contracting mode under successful communication and a neutral mode under attack. For deterministic DoS attacks, practical exponential convergence to the extremum is established under an average bound on the attack duration, with an explicit convergence rate depending on the fraction of time under attack. For probabilistic DoS attacks, almost-sure and in-probability convergence properties are established via stochastic averaging, with the attack success probability explicitly entering the convergence rate. A key finding is that a seemingly natural zero-input strategy can fundamentally compromise ESC: attacks synchronized with the dither generate an $\mathcal{O}(1/a)$ bias in the averaged dynamics, where $a$ is the dither amplitude, and can displace the equilibrium from the true optimizer. Thus, under the proposed hold-based architecture, increasingly severe DoS attacks primarily slow the optimization process rather than destroy its stability, provided that communication is not permanently blocked. Numerical simulations illustrate the theoretical guarantees and the failure mechanism induced by dither-synchronized attacks.

</details>


### [341] [Lower Bounds for Nonconvex-Concave Minimax Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14233)
*Qilong Wu,Zhihao Gu,Junchi Yang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究光滑非凸-凹极小极大优化的一阶oracle复杂度下界，证明确定性与随机zero-respecting算法的下界，并与已有上界匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刻画光滑非凸-凹极小极大优化中一阶算法的复杂度极限，填补确定性与随机设置下下界分析的空白。

Method: 针对联合L-光滑、关于y凹、且初值间隔满足Δ_Φ约束的目标，采用Moreau包络梯度的范数衡量稳定性，对zero-respecting一阶算法（确定性及带界方差随机oracle）进行下界分析。

Result: 确定性算法需Ω(L²D_YΔ_Φε⁻³)次oracle评估；随机算法需Ω(L³D_Y²Δ_Φε⁻⁶)次。以初始原始-对偶间隙G_0替代Δ_Φ时同样成立。确定性下界与上界至多差对数因子，随机下界精确匹配。

Conclusion: 所证下界与已有上界匹配，说明现有算法在复杂度阶数上已最优（确定性至多差对数因子），确立了该类问题的复杂度极限。

Abstract: We study lower bounds on the first-order oracle complexity of smooth nonconvex-concave minimax optimization. We consider objectives $f$ that are jointly $L$-smooth in the primal and dual variables $(x,y)$, concave in $y$, and whose primal value function $Φ(x) := \max_{y\in\mathcal Y} f(x,y)$ satisfies the initial-gap condition $Φ(0)-\inf_{x\in\mathcal X}Φ(x)\le Δ_Φ$, with a bounded dual domain satisfying $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal Y)\le D_{\mathcal Y}$. We measure stationarity by the norm of the gradient of the Moreau envelope of $Φ+ι_{\mathcal X}$ with parameter $1/(2L)$. We prove that any deterministic zero-respecting first-order algorithm requires $Ω\left(L^2D_{\mathcal Y}Δ_Φε^{-3}\right)$ oracle evaluations to find an $ε$-stationary point. Under an unbiased stochastic first-order oracle with bounded variance, any stochastic zero-respecting algorithm requires $Ω\left(L^3D_{\mathcal Y}^2Δ_Φε^{-6}\right)$ oracle evaluations. The same lower bounds hold when $Δ_Φ$ is replaced by the initial primal-dual gap $\mathcal G_0$. These deterministic and stochastic lower bounds match the corresponding upper bounds of [14] and [29], respectively, up to a logarithmic factor in the deterministic setting.

</details>


### [342] [Optimal Deterministic First-Order Oracle Complexity for Nonconvex-Concave Minimax Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14235)
*Siyu Pan,Taoli Zheng,Jiajin Li*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究光滑非凸-凹极小极大优化的确定性一阶 oracle 复杂度，证明下界 Ω(ℓ²D_Y Δ/ε³)，并提出 Tracked-FOAM 算法达到匹配上界，去掉了对数因子，确立了该区域内的最优复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非凸-凹极小极大优化的一阶复杂度下界尚不明确，且已有上界存在对数因子，未达到参数最优。

Method: 理论分析确定性一阶算法的下界；提出 Tracked-FOAM 一阶方法，结合 tracking 技术求解 ε-优化稳定点。

Result: 证明任意确定性一阶算法在最坏情况下需 Ω(ℓ²D_Y Δ/ε³) 次 oracle 查询（当 ε ≲ min{ℓD_Y, √(ℓΔ)}）；Tracked-FOAM 达到匹配上界并去除对数因子。

Conclusion: 在该参数区域内实现了对所有问题参数的最优依赖，建立了光滑非凸-凹极小极大优化的紧复杂度界。

Abstract: We study the deterministic first-order oracle complexity of smooth nonconvex-concave minimax optimization over a bounded convex dual domain. Let $\ell$ denote the joint smoothness constant, $D_{\mathcal{Y}}$ the diameter of the dual domain, and $Δ$ the initial gap. We prove that every deterministic first-order algorithm requires $Ω(\ell^2D_{\mathcal{Y}}Δ/ε^3)$ oracle queries in the worst case to find an $ε$-optimization-stationary point whenever $ε\lesssim\min\{\ell D_{\mathcal{Y}},\sqrt{\ellΔ}\}$. We then develop Tracked-FOAM, a first-order method that attains a matching upper bound, removing the logarithmic factor from previous upper bounds. Together, these results establish the optimal dependence on all problem parameters in the stated regime.

</details>


### [343] [A hybrid crossover kangaroo escape optimization framework for engineering optimization and UAV path planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14249)
*Han-Bin Liu,Huayi Wei*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出基于混合交叉机制的优化框架，结合Levy长跳与横纵交叉策略，并借助FEALPy多后端实现跨平台高效计算，在CEC2022及工程问题中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂工程优化问题具有多峰、高维、非线性约束等特性，对计算的高效性和可靠性提出挑战，需要增强种群交互并提升搜索效率的方法。

Method: 框架集成两种互补机制：Levy长跳交叉策略用于全局探索，横纵交叉策略用于信息交换与局部精化；并基于FEALPy构建统一多后端计算框架，在NumPy与PyTorch的CPU/GPU上一致运行。

Result: 在IEEE CEC2022基准测试上通过Wilcoxon秩和与Friedman统计检验，性能与代表性元启发式算法相当或更优；在约束工程设计问题及UAV路径规划（建模为约束优化问题）中展现良好效果与可扩展性。

Conclusion: 该混合交叉优化框架提升了收敛性与鲁棒性，具备良好的可移植性、可复现性和计算效率，适用于复杂工程优化场景。

Abstract: Complex engineering optimization problems are often characterized by multimodality, high dimensionality, and nonlinear constraints, posing significant challenges for efficient and reliable computation. To address these challenges, this paper develops a hybrid crossover-based optimization framework that enhances population interaction and improves search efficiency. The proposed framework integrates two complementary mechanisms, namely a Levy long jump crossover strategy for global exploration and a horizontal-vertical crossover strategy for effective information exchange and local refinement, thereby improving convergence behavior and robustness. To support scalable computation, the method is implemented within a unified multi-backend computational framework based on FEALPy, enabling consistent and efficient execution across heterogeneous platforms, including NumPy and PyTorch on both CPU and GPU. This design enhances portability, reproducibility, and computational efficiency in large-scale optimization tasks. Extensive experiments on the IEEE CEC2022 benchmark suite demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive or superior performance compared with several representative metaheuristic algorithms, as validated by Wilcoxon rank-sum and Friedman statistical tests. In addition, the method shows strong performance on constrained engineering design problems. Finally, the proposed framework is applied to UAV path planning, formulated as a constrained optimization problem, demonstrating its effectiveness and scalability in complex engineering scenarios.

</details>


### [344] [Periodic fixed-points and their algebraic characteristics in discrete-time Lur'e feedback systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14336)
*Kang Tong,Christian Grussler,Michelle S. Chong*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究离散时间Lur'e反馈系统中非平凡周期不动点的存在性问题，基于线性子系统传递函数构造的循环矩阵建立代数框架，给出与周期P无关的统一存在条件和幅值界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散时间Lur'e反馈系统中非零周期不动点的存在性判定缺乏统一、与周期无关的代数条件，本文旨在建立这样的框架并刻画其幅值范围。

Method: 利用线性子系统传递函数构造循环矩阵（无论稳定或不稳定），建立代数框架；由循环矩阵最大/最小正奇异值定义两向量构成的扇形界；在无记忆非线性反馈假设下，将该扇形界与非线性反馈函数的连续延拓求交来判定非平凡P周期不动点的存在性，并推導幅值上下界。

Result: 非平凡P周期不动点存在的必要条件是：非线性反馈函数连续延拓与扇形界的交集除原点外至少含一点。该条件对所有周期P统一成立；对有界反馈函数给出可容许周期不动点幅值上界；对具有无源反馈函数的继电反馈系统给出幅值的上下界。

Conclusion: 提出了一种基于循环矩阵的代数框架，统一刻画离散Lur'e系统中非平凡周期不动点的存在性，并给出幅值界限，对继电反馈系统特别有效。

Abstract: We study the problem of identifying nontrivial, i.e., nonzero, periodic fixed-points in discrete-time Lur'e feedback systems. Using the circulant matrix constructed from the transfer function of the linear subsystem, whether stable or unstable, we introduce an algebraic framework that allows us to determine when such fixed-points exist. This framework yields a sector bound defined by two vectors, whose slopes correspond to the maximum and minimum positive singular values of the circulant matrix. Assuming that the nonlinear feedback function is memoryless, we show that a necessary condition for the existence of nontrivial $P$-periodic fixed-points is that the intersection of the continuous completion of the nonlinear feedback function with that sector bound contains at least one point other than the origin. Our characterization provides a unified condition valid for all periods $P$, and further enables us to derive upper bounds on the amplitudes of admissible periodic fixed-points with bounded feedback functions. In particular, for relay feedback systems with passive feedback functions, we derive both upper and lower bounds for the amplitudes of such periodic fixed-points.

</details>


### [345] [Convex Pursuit-Evasion Games for Spacecraft Proximity Operations on Circular and Elliptical Orbits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14337)
*Omer Burak Iskender*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对非合作航天器追逃博弈，指出凸-凹鞍点框架在带努力正则的终端距离博弈中失效（支付对双方控制均凸，无纯开环鞍点）。转而用支撑函数从双方终端可达集导出两个精确单边保证：目标可保证一定间隔的逃逸证书与追方可强制错失距离的安全策略，二者无需理性假设即可夹逼交战结果。投影外推梯度法约25ms给出策略对并用最佳响应间隙在线认证。扩展到椭圆轨道（Yamanaka-Ankersen）、仅测角导航误差、禁飞区、多追方与闭环博弈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非合作航天器检查/服务本质是双人博弈：目标可施加推力破坏追方计划。Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs可达性可精确求解但代价随状态维数指数增长；学习类控制器可扩展却无任何保证。常用出路是凸优化并建模为凸-凹鞍点问题，但在终端距离轨道博弈中，带努力正则时支付对双方控制均为凸，纯开环鞍点未必存在，该框架失效，故需新的精确保证方法。

Method: 用支撑函数从双方终端可达集读出两个精确的单边保证：逃逸证书（证明目标能保持有保证的standoff距离）与安全策略（界定追方能强制的错失距离）。二者共同夹逼交战结果且不假设博弈方理性。采用投影外推梯度法（projected extragradient）求策略对，并用最佳响应间隙（best-response gaps）对所得策略对在线认证。构造通过Yamanaka-Ankersen动力学原样推广到椭圆参考轨道。

Result: 在超过两百次扰动试验中，逃逸证书无错误地区分捕获与逃逸。投影外推梯度法约25ms给出策略对并可就地认证。椭圆参考轨道下轨道相位使错失距离变化近两倍，非线性Keplerian传播复现了该结果。滚动时域博弈中，追方在十次代表性交战中捕获一半。仅测角导航误差、禁飞区、多追方及闭环博弈作为扩展处理。

Conclusion: 提出的支撑函数单边保证框架可在不假设理性、不依赖凸-凹鞍点的前提下，为终端距离轨道追逃博弈给出精确的逃逸与安全双侧夹逼，并配合快速可认证的投影外推梯度策略对；方法可经Yamanaka-Ankersen动力学推广至椭圆轨道，并兼容仅测角导航误差、禁飞区、多追方与闭环博弈等实际扩展。

Abstract: Inspecting or servicing a non-cooperative spacecraft is a two-player game: the target can thrust to defeat the inspector's plan. Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs reachability answers such games exactly but its cost grows exponentially with state dimension, while learning-based controllers scale yet certify nothing. Convex formulations are the usual escape, typically cast as convex-concave saddle-point problems. That framing fails in the terminal-distance orbital game: with effort regularization, the payoff is convex in both controls, so no pure open-loop saddle point need exist. In its place we derive two exact one-sided guarantees read from the players' terminal reachable sets via support functions: an escape certificate proving the target can hold a guaranteed standoff, and a security strategy bounding the miss distance the inspector can force. Together they bracket the engagement without assuming player rationality, and over two hundred perturbed trials the escape certificate separated capture from escape without error. A projected extragradient method supplies a strategy pair in about 25 ms, certified in place by best-response gaps. The construction carries unchanged to elliptical reference orbits via Yamanaka-Ankersen dynamics, where the orbital phase moves miss distance by nearly a factor of two, reproduced by nonlinear Keplerian propagation. Under receding-horizon play the inspector captures in half of ten representative engagements. Angles-only navigation error, keep-out zones, multiple pursuers, and closed-loop play are treated as extensions.

</details>


### [346] [Spectral-Residual Continuous Greedy for Tensor Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14346)
*Hao Li,Jie Xu,Zheng Xie*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出谱残差连续贪心(alg)用于帧势张量采样,保持状态相关分数分配再舍入,兼顾避免过早承诺与减少梯度评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多域张量采样中,Kronecker结构可避免完整高维感知矩阵,但设计困难:顺序离散方法会过早锁定跨模预算,标准连续贪心虽避免此问题却需大量状态相关梯度评估。

Method: alg在舍入前维护状态相关分数分配;利用模间Gram矩阵提供安全梯度区间进行方向认证,用Shapley值优先处理未解析梯度查询;确定性舍入后接路径引导交换(PGX),仅接受严格降低FP的交换。

Result: 建立有限步近似保证,当方向认证精确且有限步残差趋于零时逼近经典1-1/e因子;实验显示更少精确梯度评估与更好FP设计,跨模预算难确定时增益更明显;在所有测试噪声水平下NMSE低于Greedy-FP,但重建增益小于FP增益。

Conclusion: alg实现了更高效的帧势张量采样设计,在预算分配困难场景优势显著,并带来一定重建性能提升。

Abstract: Sampling a multidomain tensor from limited measurements is fundamental in structured linear inverse problems. Kronecker-structured sampling avoids the full high-dimensional sensing matrix, but design remains difficult: sequential discrete methods can commit the cross-mode budget too early, whereas standard continuous greedy avoids such early commitment at the cost of repeated state-dependent gradient evaluations. We propose spectral-residual continuous greedy (\alg) for frame-potential (FP) tensor sampling. \alg maintains a state-dependent fractional allocation before rounding. Mode-wise Gram matrices provide safe gradient intervals for direction certification, while Shapley values prioritize unresolved gradient queries. Deterministic rounding is followed by path-guided exchange (PGX), which accepts only exact FP-decreasing swaps. We establish a finite-step approximation guarantee that approaches the classical $1-1/e$ factor as direction certification becomes exact and finite-step residual error vanishes. Experiments show fewer exact gradient evaluations and better FP designs, with clearer gains on instances where the cross-mode budget allocation is difficult to determine. \alg also achieves lower average normalized mean-squared error (NMSE) than Greedy-FP at all tested noise levels, although the reconstruction gain is smaller than the FP gain.

</details>


### [347] [A Filippov theorem for Volterra sweeping processes with one-sided Lipschitz perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14456)
*Abderrahim Jourani,Diana Narváez,Emilio Vilches*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文为带外部多值扰动的Volterra型积分-微分sweeping process（移动集一致prox-regular且Hausdorff-Lipschitz，扰动单边Lipschitz）证明了Filippov型稳定性定理，给出两轨迹距离的显式估计，并应用于可及集与渔业模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Filippov定理刻画约束微分包含解对扰动的稳定性，但Volterra型积分-微分sweeping process在带记忆的约束系统中缺乏相应稳定性结果；同时实际模型（如具生态记忆的渔业模型）中扰动往往仅单边Lipschitz而非Hausdorff-Lipschitz，经典框架不适用。

Method: 将受约束动力学归约为无约束微分包含；借助可测选择论证；建立并使用一个增强型Grönwall不等式；在可分Hilbert空间中处理一致prox-regular且Hausdorff-Lipschitz移动集与单边Lipschitz多值扰动。

Result: 证明Filippov型稳定性定理：给定受扰动（状态项+外部可积项）系统的绝对连续解，存在原系统解，且两轨迹距离可由问题数据显式估计；仅有外部扰动时估计更精确，并退化为Filippov经典定理的初始条件Lipschitz依赖；导出可及集对初始集的Hausdorff-Lipschitz依赖及扰动影响的单边估计。

Conclusion: 该结果将Filippov稳定性推广至Volterra型sweeping process，并适用于经典框架无法处理的单边Lipschitz扰动；在具生态记忆的分布式渔业模型中得到仅由生物数据决定的稳定性常数。

Abstract: We prove a Filippov-type stability theorem for integro-differential sweeping processes of Volterra type with an outer multivalued perturbation, in a separable Hilbert space, under the assumptions that the moving sets are uniformly prox-regular and Lipschitz continuous with respect to the Hausdorff distance and that the perturbation is one-sided Lipschitz. Given an absolutely continuous solution of the system perturbed both in the state argument of the multivalued term and by an outer integrable term, we show the existence of a solution of the original Volterra sweeping process and estimate the distance between the two trajectories explicitly in terms of the data of the problem. The estimate becomes sharper when only the outer perturbation is present, and it recovers the Lipschitz dependence on the initial condition of Filippov's classical theorem. The proof combines a reduction of the constrained dynamics to an unconstrained differential inclusion, measurable selection arguments, and an enhanced version of Grönwall's inequality established in this work. As an application, we obtain the Lipschitz dependence of the attainable set on the initial set with respect to the Hausdorff distance, together with a one-sided estimate quantifying the effect of the perturbations. We also work out a spatially distributed fishery model with ecological memory whose harvesting rule, triggered by the aggregate biomass, is one-sided Lipschitz but is not Lipschitz continuous with respect to the Hausdorff distance, so that the classical framework does not apply. For this model, our estimates produce a stability constant governed only by the biological data.

</details>


### [348] [Three-Phase Unbalance Mitigation via DSO-FRA Coordination: A GNB-Based Chance-Constrained Model Considering PV Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14461)
*Qun Zhou,Jiale Guo,Jing Huang,Minrui Leng,Xueshan Liu,Chenjia Gu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出基于广义纳什谈判(GNB)的机会约束协调运行模型,激励灵活资源聚合商参与配电网三相不平衡治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵活资源聚合商(EVA、LA)具备缓解三相不平衡的潜力,但如何有效激励其主动参与是关键挑战。

Method: 构建DSO与FRAs的GNB协作框架,FRAs提供灵活性、DSO给予经济激励;按贡献定制议价权;引入场景化机会约束处理PV不确定性;采用分布式近端分解算法(PDA),并将协调模型分解为社会福利最大化与支付议价子问题,用改进双线性Benders分解求解前者。

Result: 数值结果验证了所提方法在治理不平衡、保证公平利润分配及增强不确定性鲁棒性方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 该GNB机会约束协调模型能有效激励FRAs参与不平衡治理,实现公平分配并提升鲁棒性。

Abstract: Although flexible resource aggregators (FRAs), represented by electric vehicle aggregators (EVAs) and load aggregators (LAs), possess inherent flexibility to mitigate three-phase unbalance, the key challenge lies in how to effectively incentivize them to actively participate in unbalance mitigation. To address this, this paper proposes a generalized Nash bargaining (GNB)-based chance-constrained coordinated operation model for the distribution system operator (DSO) and FRAs. In this framework, the DSO and FRAs cooperate to mitigate three-phase unbalance, where FRAs provide flexibility to reduce the DSO's unbalance mitigation costs, and the DSO offers economic incentives to FRAs in return. Bargaining power is tailored according to each participant's contribution to unbalance mitigation to ensure fair profit allocation. Moreover, a scenario-based chance-constrained formulation is integrated to handle photovoltaic (PV) output uncertainties. To solve the model, a distributed proximal decomposition algorithm (PDA) is introduced for the independent model, while the coordinated model is decomposed into a social welfare maximization subproblem and a payment bargaining subproblem, with an improved bilinear Benders decomposition algorithm developed to solve the former. Numerical results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method in mitigating unbalance, ensuring fair profit distribution, and enhancing robustness against uncertainties.

</details>


### [349] [Distributed Fast Fixed-Point Algorithms for Composite Monotone Inclusions over Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14953)
*Nghia Nguyen-Trung,Ion Necoara,Quoc Tran-Dinh*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出两种去中心化快速定点算法 ND-DFFP 与 NI-DFFP，用于求解网络中的单调包含问题，实现 O(1/k) 收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有该类问题的分布式算法多为非加速方法，且在原始空间中的精确收敛速率尚不明确。

Method: 将 Nesterov 型加速与原始-对偶技术结合，在两种设定下分别设计 ND-DFFP（同构网络相关步长）与 NI-DFFP（通过三算子包含重构解耦网络拓扑，支持异构网络无关步长）。

Result: 在适当假设下，一致性误差达到 O(1/k)，受限间隙函数与前向-后向分裂残差平方也达到 O(1/k)；在网络平均迭代或其有效域投影处评估。数值实验（分布式双线性矩阵博弈与虚拟电厂问题）显示优于近期去中心化基线。

Conclusion: 所提算法能有效加速求解单调包含问题，具备理论收敛保证与实证计算效率优势。

Abstract: This paper aims to develop new and efficient distributed algorithms for solving a class of monotone inclusions, $0 \in \sum_{i=1}^n (G_ix + T_ix)$, over a connected network of $n$ agents, where the single-valued operator $G_i$ and the possibly multivalued operator $T_i$ remain private to agent $i$. Existing distributed algorithms for this problem class are primarily non-accelerated, and their exact convergence rates in the original primal space are largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose two Decentralized Fast Fixed-Point-based algorithms, \texttt{ND-DFFP} and \texttt{NI-DFFP}, which integrate Nesterov-type acceleration with primal-dual techniques under two prominent settings: (i) \textit{Lipschitz continuity of $G_i$ and maximal monotonicity of $G_i+T_i$}; and (ii) \textit{co-coercivity of $G_i$ and maximal monotonicity of $T_i$}. While \texttt{ND-DFFP} utilizes a homogeneous network-dependent stepsize, \texttt{NI-DFFP} reformulates the problem into a three-operator inclusion to decouple the network topology, enabling heterogeneous network-independent stepsizes. Under appropriate assumptions, we establish an $\mathcal{O}(1/k)$ convergence rate for the consensus error and an $\mathcal{O}(1/k)$ rate for both the restricted gap function and the squared forward-backward splitting residual, with the latter two metrics evaluated at the network-average iterate or its projection onto the effective domain. Finally, numerical experiments on distributed bilinear matrix games and a virtual power plant problem demonstrate the competitive performance and computational efficiency of our methods over recent decentralized baselines in the literature.

</details>


### [350] [SCMO: Stochastic Control for Optimization over Probability Measures on Infinite-Dimensional Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14548)
*Hang Cheung,Jinniao Qiu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出SCMO，一种无梯度粒子方法，用于在可分Hilbert空间上优化可能非凸非光滑的概率测度泛函，支持非Dirac最优解。通过熵正则随机控制与Cole-Hopf变换，将最优反馈表示为Gibbs加权终端位移。分析了匹配与非匹配协方差下的收敛性和误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在概率测度上对非凸、非光滑泛函进行仅目标优化的难题，且最优解可能本质上是非Dirac的，传统方法难以处理。

Method: 从熵正则随机控制导出SCMO：经有限粒子和Galerkin近似，用Cole-Hopf变换将最优反馈表示为Gibbs加权终端位移；通过采样上下文云、逐个替换粒子、评分经验测度并指数重加权来近似反馈。使用候选提议与粒子更新分离协方差（匹配/非匹配）。

Result: 匹配情形下建立无PDE定性收敛及分离粒子、Galerkin投影、熵正则误差的投影优先定量界；非匹配协方差多上下文实现证明有限候选一致性，并显示曲率相关的符号效应可降低误差上界。实验在函数空间、轨迹律和接触丰富操作任务上验证其处理非光滑非凸目标、逃离次优局部盆并恢复多模态非Dirac结构。

Conclusion: SCMO是一种有效的无梯度粒子优化方法，能处理非凸非光滑概率测度泛函并恢复非Dirac最优结构，理论与实验均得到验证。

Abstract: We study objective-only optimization of possibly nonconvex and nonsmooth functionals over probability measures on a separable Hilbert space, allowing the optimizer to be intrinsically non-Dirac. We introduce SCMO (Stochastic Control Measure Optimizer), a gradient-free particle method derived from entropy regularized stochastic control. After finite-particle and Galerkin approximations, a Cole--Hopf transform represents the optimal feedback as a Gibbs-weighted terminal displacement. SCMO approximates this feedback by sampling context clouds, replacing one particle at a time with candidate draws, scoring the resulting empirical measures, and applying exponential reweighting.
  SCMO uses separate covariances for candidate proposals and particle updates, termed matched when equal and nonmatched otherwise; our analysis covers both settings. In the matched case, we establish PDE-free qualitative convergence and a projection-first quantitative bound separating particle, Galerkin-projection, and entropy-regularization errors. For the practical multi-context implementation with nonmatched covariance, we prove finite-candidate consistency and show that the signed, curvature-dependent effect of nonmatched covariance can reduce the resulting upper bound on the approximation error. Finally, experiments on function-space, trajectory-law, and contact-rich manipulation problems show that SCMO handles nonsmooth and nonconvex objectives, escapes suboptimal local basins, and recovers prescribed multimodal, non-Dirac law structure.
  Code for reproducing our experimental results is available at https://github.com/HenryCHEUNG7373/SCMO.

</details>


### [351] [A proximal linearized NEP method for composite optimization with conic and manifold constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14564)
*Hao He,Ruyu Liu,Shaohua Pan*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究带锥约束与流形约束的DC复合优化问题，提出基于距离罚函数的非精确近端线性化精确罚算法，建立O(ε^{-2})最坏复杂度及ADMM实现下的oracle复杂度，并在数值实验中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DC复合优化常同时出现锥约束与流形约束（如正交流形、非负锥、二阶锥），现有方法难以高效处理这类混合约束。

Method: 提出基于距离罚函数的非精确近端线性化精确罚算法：在流形切空间上求罚函数近端线性化的近似极小点，采用可验证的非精确性准则，并自适应更新近端与罚参数；子问题用semi-proximal ADMM求解。

Result: 在迭代序列与罚参数有界假设下，找到ε-稳定点的最坏复杂度为O(ε^{-2})；ADMM求解时，若距离函数与第一DC分量分片线性二次，oracle复杂度为O(ε^{-2}log ε^{-1})，加速变体为O(ε^{-4})；若势函数满足KL性质，则迭代序列收敛到稳定点。

Conclusion: 数值实验表明该方法在正交流形、非负锥和二阶锥约束的复合优化问题上有效。

Abstract: This paper studies DC composite optimization problems with simultaneous conic and manifold constraints. We propose an inexact proximal linearized exact penalty algorithm based on a distance-based penalty function for the conic constraint. The algorithm successively computes approximate minimizers of proximal linearizations of the penalty function over the tangent spaces of the manifold under a readily verifiable inexactness criterion, with adaptive updates of the proximal and penalty parameters. Under the boundedness assumption on the sequences of iterates and penalty parameters, we establish an $O(ε^{-2})$ worst-case complexity bound for finding an $ε$-stationary point. Moreover, when semi-proximal ADMM is employed to solve the subproblems, the resulting oracle complexity is $O(ε^{-2}\logε^{-1})$ provided that the distance function and the first DC component are piecewise linear-quadratic, while an accelerated variant achieves an $O(ε^{-4})$ oracle complexity. If, in addition, the associated potential function satisfies the KL property, the whole sequence of iterates converges to a stationary point. Extensive numerical experiments on composite optimization problems with orthogonal manifold, nonnegative cone, and second-order cone (SOC) constraints demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

</details>


### [352] [Exponential Turnpike in Optimal Boundary Control of Multi-Dimensional First-Order Hyperbolic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14601)
*Haitian Yang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文为一类多维一阶线性双曲系统的最优边界控制建立了指数型turnpike性质，允许控制与观测算子无界、代价函数非二次，核心假设为内部与边界耗散条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有turnpike结果多针对二次代价或有界算子，难以覆盖控制/观测算子无界且代价非二次的边界控制问题。

Method: 在内部与边界耗散条件下，证明输入-状态与输入-输出映射的算子范数与时间跨度T无关；结合正、伴随方程的加权能量估计、输入-输出对偶与强凸性进行证明。

Result: 建立了指数型turnpike性质；并应用于含闸门控制的二维Saint-Venant方程线性化模型，数值展示了turnpike行为。

Conclusion: 耗散条件带来的关于T一致的有界性是关键，使无界算子与非二次代价下的指数turnpike成立。

Abstract: We establish an exponential turnpike property for optimal boundary control of multi-dimensional first-order linear hyperbolic systems in which both the control and observation operators are unbounded and the cost functions may be nonquadratic. The main assumptions are internal and boundary dissipation conditions. These conditions ensure that the associated input-to-state and input-to-output maps are bounded, with operator norms independent of the time horizon T. This uniform boundedness is essential to the proof, which combines weighted energy estimates for the forward and adjoint equations, input-output duality, and strong convexity. Finally, we apply the result to the linearized two-dimensional Saint-Venant equations with sluice-gate control and illustrate the turnpike behavior numerically.

</details>


### [353] [On the Homogenization of Norm and Time Optimal Controls for Parabolic Equations with Oscillating Coefficients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14622)
*Jon Asier Bárcena-Petisco,Marius Tucsnak*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究带快速振荡周期扩散系数的一维热方程，证明范数最优与时间最优控制关于振荡尺度的均匀可观测性/零可控性估计，并给出控制收敛到均质化极限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 周期快速振荡扩散系数下的热方程控制问题中，控制估计通常依赖于振荡尺度，需要建立关于该尺度一致的估计以研究最优控制的均质化行为。

Method: 先推导与振荡尺度一致（均匀）的终态可观测性和零可控性估计；结合周期均质化与抛物系统最优控制的抽象理论。

Result: 证明范数最优值与控制在空间/时间逐点约束下收敛到均质化对应量，并由此推出最优时间与时间最优控制的收敛；控制在有界函数空间弱星收敛，延拓到公共时间区间后在任意有限指数Lebesgue空间强收敛。

Conclusion: 建立了振荡扩散热方程最优控制的均质化理论，表明范数最优与时间最优控制及其最优时间均收敛到均质化极限。

Abstract: We study homogenization of norm-optimal and time-optimal controls for a one-dimensional heat equation with rapidly oscillating periodic diffusion coefficients. The controls act on a fixed subinterval and are subject to pointwise constraints in space and time.
  We first derive final-state observability and null-controllability estimates that are uniform with respect to the oscillation scale. Combining these estimates with periodic homogenization and an abstract theory of optimal controls for parabolic systems, we prove convergence of the norm-optimal values and controls to their homogenized counterparts. We then deduce convergence of the optimal times and time-optimal controls. The controls converge weakly-star in the space of essentially bounded functions and strongly in every Lebesgue space with finite exponent, after extension to a common time interval when necessary.

</details>


### [354] [Convergence of the Sinkhorn Riemannian metric for finitely supported measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14651)
*Gilles Mordant,Liane Xu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明了在有限支撑测度的水平扰动情形下,Sinkhorn Riemannian 度量随正则化参数 ε→0 的收敛性,并进一步得到其高阶导数的收敛,从而保证关联的 Riemann 曲率张量与 Christoffel 符号收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sinkhorn 散度是熵正则化最优传输的去偏版本,其对应的 Sinkhorn Riemannian 度量刻画了该散度的局部行为。虽然已知当 ε→0 时 Sinkhorn 散度逼近平方 Wasserstein-2 距离,但 Sinkhorn Riemannian 度量在该极限下的行为仍基本未知。现有唯一论证仅针对带密度测度且仍属形式计算,亟需严格证明。

Method: 针对有限支撑测度并施加水平扰动,本文通过严格的数学分析证明 Sinkhorn Riemannian 度量在 ε→0 时的收敛性。所用技术可进一步推广用于证明该度量的高阶导数收敛,从而导出相关 Riemann 曲率张量与 Christoffel 符号的收敛。同时与绝对连续(带密度)情形进行对比,指出该研究途径在带密度测度情形下失效之处。

Result: 在有限支撑测度水平扰动假设下,严格证明了 Sinkhorn Riemannian 度量当 ε→0 时收敛;并证明其高阶导数收敛,保证 Riemann 曲率张量与 Christoffel 符号的收敛。同时揭示了方法在带密度测度情形下的局限性。

Conclusion: 本文填补了 Sinkhorn Riemannian 度量在 ε→0 极限行为上的理论空白,首次给出有限支撑测度情形下的严格收敛证明,并拓展至曲率层面的收敛;同时指出向带密度测度推广的障碍,为后续研究指明方向。

Abstract: The Sinkhorn Riemannian metric characterizes the local behavior of the Sinkhorn divergence, a debiased version of entropy-regularized optimal transport. Although the Sinkhorn divergence is known to approximate the squared Wasserstein-2 distance as the regularization parameter $\varepsilon$ goes to $0$, the behavior of the Sinkhorn Riemannian metric as $\varepsilon\to 0$ remains largely open. To the best of our knowledge, the only existing argument is for measures with a density and is still a formal computation. In this work, we prove the convergence of the Sinkhorn Riemannian metric as $\varepsilon\to 0$ in the case of finitely supported measures undergoing horizontal perturbations. Under our assumptions, our techniques additionally allow us to prove the convergence of higher order derivatives of the Sinkhorn Riemannian metric, thereby ensuring the convergence of the associated Riemann curvature tensor and Christoffel symbols as $\varepsilon\to 0$. We also compare with the absolutely continuous setting and show where our approach fails for measures with a density.

</details>


### [355] [Rank-Dependent Error Bounds and Near-Optimality in Quantum Control via Hierarchical Tucker Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14686)
*Nahid Binandeh Dehaghani,Rafal Wisniewski,Julian Berberich,A. Pedro Aguiar*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出基于固定秩层次Tucker(HT)代理的有限时域量子最优控制认证框架，给出误差指数衰减、近最优性及对数秩-性能关系等理论保证，并在XXZ自旋链上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子最优控制在高维希尔伯特空间中计算代价高，需要可认证的降维代理模型，以在保证精度的同时降低表示与计算复杂度。

Method: 采用固定秩Hierarchical Tucker (HT)张量网络作为代理表示；在均匀、秩相关的HT截断精度条件下，推导轨迹、代价与价值函数的误差界，构建后验代价证书，并分析不精确代理优化与控制收敛性。

Result: 在截断精度条件下，轨迹/代价/价值函数误差指数衰减，代理生成控制近最优；得到对数秩-性能关系、基于实际截断扰动的后验代价证书；控制XXZ自旋链数值实验与截断条件一致，展示HT秩、表示规模、代理精度与控制性能之间的权衡。

Conclusion: HT代理可为有限时域量子最优控制提供可认证的效率-精度权衡，理论与数值结果支持其作为高维量子系统控制的可控降维工具。
