Abstract: We develop a certified finite-horizon quantum optimal-control framework based on fixed-rank Hierarchical Tucker (HT) surrogates. Under a uniform rank-dependent HT truncation-accuracy condition, we establish exponentially decaying trajectory, cost, and value-function errors and near-optimality of surrogate-generated controls. We further derive a logarithmic rank--performance relation, an a posteriori cost certificate from realized truncation perturbations, and guarantees for inexact surrogate optimization and control convergence under additional regularity conditions. Numerical experiments on controlled XXZ spin chains provide finite-sample evidence consistent with the truncation condition and illustrate the trade-off between HT rank, representation size, surrogate accuracy, and control performance.

</details>


### [356] [Verifying performance, stability, and feasibility of inexact non-linear model predictive controllers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14920)
*Rajiv Sambharya,Sribalaji C. Anand,George Pappas*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出一种验证框架，用于数值分析约束非线性离散时间下非精确MPC控制器的次优性、稳定性与可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非精确MPC（如KKT点输入、线性化求解凸QP）难以从构造上保证性能，需要对给定控制器本身进行验证而非修改控制器。

Method: 将验证问题建模为优化问题：在给定初始状态集内搜索最坏初始状态，并结合与非精确控制器一致的输入，以最大化选定的性能指标；据此对单次MPC问题的最坏次优间隙、多步闭环次优间隙、闭环稳定性与可行性进行认证。

Result: 数值示例表明该框架能精确量化上述两类非精确控制器的次优性，并可测试其稳定性与可行性。

Conclusion: 该框架无需修改控制器即可为其提供性能与稳定性/可行性的认证，适用于约束非线性离散时间系统中的非精确MPC。

Abstract: We introduce a verification framework to numerically analyze inexact model predictive controllers (MPCs) in the constrained non-linear discrete-time setting. Rather than modifying the controller so that guarantees hold by construction, we treat the controller as given. In particular, we focus on two types of inexact controllers: (a) one whose input is extracted from a primal-dual point satisfying the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions of the non-convex MPC problem, and (b) one whose input is obtained by linearizing the dynamics and solving a convex quadratic program. The main idea of our verification framework is to formulate an optimization problem that searches over the worst-case initial state within a given set and control inputs consistent with the inexact controller to maximize a carefully-chosen performance metric. Using this framework, we show how to certify (i) the worst-case suboptimality gap of a single MPC problem, (ii) the worst-case closed-loop suboptimality gap over a given number of dynamical system iterations, (iii) closed-loop stability, and (iv) feasibility of the closed-loop system. Through numerical examples, we showcase the ability of our framework to precisely quantify both types of suboptimality, and to test the stability and feasibility of the inexact controllers.

</details>


### [357] [Integer Maximization over $\ell_p$ Balls: Hardness and Exact Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15114)
*Cinar Ari,Robert Hildebrand*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究 $\ell_p$ 球上整数点线性最大化问题 $\BallIPp{p}$：对固定整数 $p\ge2$ 证明判定 NP-complete；重点分析欧氏情形，给出两类伪多项式精确算法，并通过与最近向量问题（CVP）的相互归约刻画复杂性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最大化线性函数在origin-centered $\ell_p$ 球整数点上（\BallIPp{p}）的复杂度尚不明确，作者希望确定其判定复杂度，并刻画欧氏情形下难度如何随数值参数与维度变化。

Method: 1) 对每个固定整数 $p\ge2$ 证明判定 NP-complete；2) 欧氏情形给出两种互补伪多项式精确算法：一种专门化已知 radius-budget 动态规划（非线性背包框架也适用于每个固定有限整数 $p$），另一种基于候选目标值的动态规划（对半径编码大小多项式、对成本系数幅度伪多项式）；3) 将固定目标值可行性表述为 CVP，获得运行时间依赖该格覆盖半径的精确算法；4) 将环境维度 $d$ 中秩 $k$ 的欧氏 CVP 归约到维度 $d+k\le2d$ 的欧氏 \BallIP{} 判定，迁移 ETH 下界；5) 研究基于接近连续优化器的维度依赖方法，并给出可扩展到椭球的 fixed-level 构造。

Result: 对每个固定整数 $p\ge2$，$\ell_p$ 球上的判定问题是 NP-complete；欧氏情形存在两类伪多项式精确算法；通过 CVP 得到覆盖半径相关的精确算法；得到 CVP 到 \BallIP{} 的维度保持归约（$d+k\le2d$）并迁移 ETH 复杂度下界；维度依赖方法及 fixed-level 构造可扩展到椭球。

Conclusion: \BallIPp{p} 在固定 $p$ 下是 NP-complete，其欧氏情形复杂性可由数值参数、维度及与 CVP 的联系刻画，相关结果可推广到椭球。

Abstract: We study the problem of maximizing a linear function over the integer points of an origin-centered $\ell_p$ ball, which we call \BallIPp{p}. For every fixed integer $p\ge2$, we prove that the decision problem over an $\ell_p$-ball is NP-complete.
  We then focus on the Euclidean case and study how the difficulty of the problem depends on the numerical parameters of the instance. We give two complementary pseudo-polynomial exact algorithms. The first specializes a known radius-budget dynamic program; the same nonlinear-knapsack framework also applies to every fixed finite integer $p$. We then develop a complementary dynamic program over candidate objective values for the Euclidean case. The latter is polynomial in the encoding size of the radius and pseudo-polynomial in the magnitude of the cost coefficients.
  For a fixed objective value, feasibility can be formulated as a closest vector problem (CVP) instance. This connection gives an exact algorithm whose running time depends on the covering radius of that lattice. Conversely, we show that a rank-$k$ Euclidean closest-vector instance in ambient dimension $d$ reduces to the decision version of a Euclidean \BallIP{} instance in dimension $d+k\le2d$, transferring known bounds under the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH). Finally, we study dimension-dependent approaches based on proximity to the continuous optimizer and describe the fixed-level constructions that extend to ellipsoids.

</details>


### [358] [Improving the Last-Iterate Guarantees of Anytime Algorithms for Stochastic Monotone Variational Inequalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15257)
*Jun-Hyun Kim,Ahmet Alacaoglu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文分析带Halpern锚定的随机算法，求解约束凸-凹问题和单调变分不等式，证明其最后迭代收敛率达到O(t^{-1/4})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对单调博弈中带噪声反馈的场景，需要单环、单次采样的随机算法，且已有方法对受限间隙函数的收敛率仅为O(t^{-1/5})，收敛较慢。

Method: 采用带Halpern锚定的随机单环、单次调用算法，每次迭代仅使用梯度算子的一个无偏样本，适用于约束凸-凹问题与单调变分不等式。

Result: 证明了梯度映射范数和受限间隙的任意时间最后迭代收敛率均为O(t^{-1/4})，优于已知最优的O(t^{-1/5})。结果覆盖可行集可能无界的约束问题以及无有界方差的结构化随机oracle。

Conclusion: 该算法在更一般的条件下实现了更快的收敛率，扩展了随机单调变分不等式求解的理论保证。

Abstract: We analyze a stochastic algorithm with Halpern anchoring for constrained convex-concave problems and monotone variational inequalities. This algorithm is single-loop and single-call since it uses one unbiased sample of the gradient operator at every iteration to be applicable to monotone games with noisy feedback. With $t$ denoting the iteration counter, we prove the anytime last-iterate convergence rate of $O(t^{-1/4})$ for both gradient-mapping norm and restricted gap, improving the best-known rate $O(t^{-1/5})$ that was obtained for the restricted gap function. Our rates cover constrained problems with a potentially unbounded feasible set as well as a structured class of stochastic oracles without a bounded variance.

</details>


### [359] [Directionally Fine Families of Cones: Construction Principles, Approximation, and Separation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15337)
*Fernando García-Castaño,Miguel Ángel Melguizo-Padial*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文引入"方向精细锥族"这一局部几何性质，证明它可统一实现有限分离与逼近，并研究Bishop-Phelps锥与横向强制性两类实现及其在优化中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在赋范空间中，锥的有限分离与有限逼近通常需要较强的凸性或不依赖于方向的几何条件，且不同问题的构造机制彼此分散。作者希望找到一种统一的、不依赖锥凸性的局部几何机制来同时处理有限分离与定量逼近。

Method: 提出"方向精细锥族"概念，即在空间每个方向周围可选取任意窄锥。基于此框架证明方向紧集与闭锥的有限分离、局部紧锥的有限外逼近（对方向集与有界截面有定量Hausdorff控制），并构造max型正齐次分离子。随后给出两类实现：(1) Bishop-Phelps锥，其方向精细性等价于单位球面上每点为球的下凹点，即性质(G)，在Banach空间中对应严格凸+Kadec性质；(2) 引入横向强制性作为一般轴向构造，在任意赋范空间无需几何假设即可产生方向精细族，包含一致轴向偏差与范数归一化轴向锥。

Result: 方向精细性成为有限分离与逼近的共同机制，且不需要被分离锥的凸性；Bishop-Phelps锥情形下方向精细性被完整刻画为性质(G)（Banach空间中为严格凸+Kadec）；横向强制性在任意赋范空间中构造出方向精细族；由Bishop-Phelps锥的显式结构得到局部紧锥上优化的惩罚与恢复结果及定量逼近和收敛估计。

Conclusion: 方向精细锥族为有限分离、有限逼近与正齐次分离提供了一个统一框架，并揭示了经典Bishop-Phelps锥的几何本质，同时通过横向强制性推广至一般赋范空间，最终在局部紧锥优化中获得定量惩罚与恢复结论。

Abstract: We introduce the notion of a directionally fine family of cones, a local geometric property expressing the possibility of selecting arbitrarily narrow cones around every direction of a normed space. We show that this local property provides a common mechanism for finite separation and approximation. In particular, directionally compact sets can be separated from closed cones by finitely many members of the family, while locally compact cones admit finite outer approximations with quantitative Hausdorff control on their sets of directions and on bounded sections. These finite constructions lead naturally to max-type positively homogeneous separators and do not require convexity of the cones to be separated.
  We then study two complementary realizations of the framework. For the classical family of Bishop--Phelps cones, directional fineness is characterized by the requirement that every point of the unit sphere be a denting point of the unit ball, equivalently, by property~$(G)$; in Banach spaces this amounts to rotundity together with the Kadec property. On the other hand, we introduce transversal coercivity as a general axial construction principle. It yields directionally fine families in arbitrary normed spaces, without geometric assumptions on the norm, and includes uniform axial deviation and norm-normalized axial cones as canonical models. Finally, the explicit structure of the former yields penalization and recovery results for optimization over locally compact cones, together with quantitative approximation and convergence estimates.

</details>


### [360] [Eventual convexity for separable chance constraints with skewed generalized hyperbolic random variables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15403)
*Heng Zhang,Abdel Lisser*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究具有偏斜广义双曲（GH）随机变量的机会约束，证明其密度的 α-递减性质，并给出可分离联合机会约束的精确凸重构，实现可行集的渐近凸性与可计算性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机会约束在不确定性优化中应用广泛，但通用分布下可行集通常非凸，难以求解；本文希望为偏斜广义双曲（GH）分布这一灵活且能刻画偏斜厚尾的分布族建立凸性理论。

Method: 证明 GH 分布的密度是 α-递减的，据此对具有 GH 分布的可分离联合机会约束推导精确的凸重构；并通过数值计算 α-递减阈值参数。

Result: 给出 GH 分布密度 α-递减的理论证明，得到精确凸重构形式，数值验证了 α-递减阈值参数，并展示了可行集的渐近凸性以及求解相应优化问题的可计算性。

Conclusion: GH 分布的机会约束在一定条件下可转化为凸问题，使可行集具有渐近凸性且优化问题可高效求解，为不确定性优化提供了新的理论与计算工具。

Abstract: Chance constraints are widely used in optimization under uncertainty. This paper aims to show the eventual convexity (EV) of chance constraints with skewed generalized hyperbolic (GH) random variables. We prove that the densities of GH distributions are $α$-decreasing, and obtain exact convex reformulations for separable jointly chance constraints with GH distributions. We provide numerical results to compute the $α$-decreasing threshold parameters and show the EV of the feasible set together with the computational tractability to solve the associated optimization problems.

</details>


### [361] [Optimal Sensitivity of the general Wheatstone Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15491)
*Michael Fischer*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文推导了惠斯通电桥在有限电源与检流计电阻下电压不平衡灵敏度的最优配置解析解，并与等臂配置进行基准对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 惠斯通电桥不平衡电压灵敏度优化是电路设计的重要目标，但考虑有限源电阻与检流计电阻时，最优桥臂配置复杂，缺乏解析解。

Method: 推导有限电源与检流计电阻条件下最优桥臂配置的新型解析表达式，并将其与传统等臂配置进行对比基准测试。

Result: 获得了最优配置的解析表示，并表明其相较传统等臂配置（在灵敏度上）具有优势。

Conclusion: 为有限源/检流计电阻下惠斯通电桥灵敏度优化提供了可解析的最优设计依据。

Abstract: Optimizing the sensitivity of the unbalance voltage in Wheatstone bridges with respect to bridge parameter changes remains a fundamental objective in circuit design and instrumentation. When accounting for finite source and detector resistances, determining the optimal bridge configuration becomes increasingly complex, and a analytical representation of the optimal solution has not yet been established. This paper derives a novel analytical representation of the optimal configuration for finite source and detector resistances. Furthermore, the proposed optimal solution is benchmarked against the conventional equal-arm configuration.

</details>


### [362] [Joint Design of Time-of-Use Schedules and Price Levels: a Bilevel Model with Client Participation and Load Flexibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15496)
*Abdellah Bulaich Mehamdi,Wim van Ackooij,Luce Brotcorne,Stéphane Gaubert,Quentin Jacquet*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究利润最大化电力零售商对灵活用户的分时电价（ToU）联合设计问题，将其建模为双层规划，提出两种等价的单层重构与求解算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零售商需设计分时电价（时段划分与价格）以最大化利润，而灵活用户可能拒绝报价转向外部选项，需要刻画用户参与与消费响应行为。

Method: 构建双层规划：下层用户在各点上下界与固定日总能耗约束下重塑用电，并同时选择带二次正则项的参与度；证明用户最优响应可在对数线性时间计算；提出两种单层重构——闭式连续形式用随机梯度上升（对时段起点和时长连续重参数化）求解，以及混合整数非线性规划用专用求解器求解。

Result: 随机梯度上升方案几乎必然收敛到Clarke临界点且可扩展。法国零售电力市场案例（5000户模拟家庭）：梯度法与商业混合整数求解器在点式问题上利润最优性相差0.3%以内，且在100个代表性用户上快2至8倍。将无约束点式价格限制为可行ToU方案，两时段电价利润损失约1.3%-13.8%，三时段约0.6%-6.6%。

Conclusion: 所提随机梯度法可扩展且接近最优，能高效求解分时电价设计问题，并量化了将无约束价格约束为ToU结构带来的利润损失。

Abstract: We study the joint design of a time-of-use (ToU) tariff (the partition of the day into pricing blocks and the price level attached to each block) by a profit-maximizing electricity retailer facing flexible clients who may refuse the offer in favour of an outside option. The problem is modeled as a bilevel program in which each client, at the lower level, reshapes its consumption under pointwise bounds and a fixed daily energy total, and simultaneously chooses a participation level penalized by a quadratic regularizer. We prove the client's best response is computable in loglinear time. We derive two equivalent single-level reformulations: a closed-form continuous one tackled via stochastic gradient ascent (using a continuous reparametrization of block start times and durations) and a mixed-integer nonlinear program solved via dedicated solvers. The stochastic ascent scheme provides Clarke-critical accumulation points almost surely, in a scalable way. On a case study from the French retail electricity market with $5000$ simulated households, the gradient method matches a commercial mixed-integer solver on the pointwise problem to within $0.3\%$ of the optimal profit while running two to eight times faster on $100$ representative clients. Restricting unconstrained pointwise prices to admissible ToU schedules yields an estimated profit loss of $1.3\%$- $13.8\%$ for two-period tariffs and $0.6\%$-$6.6\%$ for three-period tariffs on the instances considered.

</details>


### [363] [Deterministically Optimal Robust Exact Differentiators of Arbitrary Order](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15564)
*Richard Seeber,Hernan Haimovich*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文在确定性框架下研究带噪信号求导的根本极限，首次给出任意阶因果微分器的理论下界，并构造出达到最优误差且兼具精确性与强鲁棒性的微分器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在有界高阶导数与有界测量噪声下估计函数导数，需明确因果微分器的理论极限（最低最坏情况误差）以及精确性、鲁棒性等期望性质，此前缺乏对任意阶数的统一结论。

Method: 在确定性设定下建立任意阶微分的理论根本极限，给出可达最低误差界的微分器的形式化定义与完整刻画，并通过新颖构造证明确定性最优微分器的存在性。

Result: 首次确立任意阶因果微分器的最低可达最坏情况求导误差及精确性、鲁棒性的理论极限；构造出的最优微分器具有从一开始就精确的特性以及极强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 确定性最优微分器确实存在，且在精确微分器类中具有最优误差界，同时表现出从起始即精确并伴有极强鲁棒性的性质。

Abstract: Estimation of the derivatives of a function with bounded high-order derivative in the presence of bounded measurement noise is considered, in a deterministic setting. Theoretical fundamental limitations of causal differentiators in terms of the lowest achievable worst-case differentiation error and desired properties such as exactness---the zero-error estimation of derivatives in the absence of noise---and robustness---the small sensitivity of the estimate under small perturbations---are established for the first time for arbitrary differentiation order. Differentiators that achieve these theoretically lowest bounds on their differentiation error are formally defined, fully characterized, and their properties are studied. In particular, deterministically optimal differentiators---those featuring optimal differentiation error bounds among the class of exact differentiators---are shown to exist by means of a novel construction exhibiting, in addition to exactness from the beginning, a very strong form of robustness.

</details>


### [364] [Classical Solutions for a Finite-Horizon Exit-Time Problem with Degenerate Diffusion Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15581)
*Lihua Bai,Linyu Miao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究一类一维仿射扩散在有限时间退出控制下、控制同时作用于漂移与波动率的问题。作者避开粘性解框架，证明值函数为内部C^{1,2}经典解且严格凸，构造局部Lipschitz最优反馈，刻画退化集为曲线并给出退出概率的精确平方对数渐近。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 允许控制波动率会带来瞬时波动率被抵消的可能，使HJB方程非一致抛物；更棘手的是退化位置不由模型系数预先给定，而依赖未知值函数与最优反馈，因此标准粘性解方法难以直接刻画正则性。

Method: 在适当结构假设下，而非采用粘性解表述，对该HJB方程作经典解分析：证明内部C^{1,2}正则与状态变量严格凸性，构造局部Lipschitz最优反馈，并将退化集显式识别为一条曲线。

Result: 证明值函数在整个状态域内部为C^{1,2}经典解且关于状态严格凸；构造出局部Lipschitz最优反馈；显式识别退化集为曲线，并证明该曲线上闭环漂移等于其状态坐标的时间导数；建立退出前的不可达性与不变性；得到逼近概率的精确平方对数渐近。

Conclusion: 在退化位置内生依赖值函数的非一致抛物HJB问题中，经典解与反馈方法仍可给出强正则性、闭环结构与精确退出概率渐近，为处理此类波动率可控的奇异控制问题提供了不依赖粘性解的路径。

Abstract: We study finite-horizon exit-time control of a one-dimensional affine diffusion, with an unbounded control acting on both drift and volatility. Since an admissible control can cancel the instantaneous volatility, the associated HJB equation is not uniformly parabolic. Moreover, the location of the degeneracy is not prescribed by the model coefficients but depends on the unknown value function and optimal feedback. Rather than relying on a viscosity-solution formulation, we work under suitable structural assumptions and prove that the value function is a $C^{1,2}$ classical solution throughout the interior of the state domain and is strictly convex in the state variable. Moreover, we construct a locally Lipschitz optimal feedback, explicitly identify the degenerate set as a curve, and show that the closed-loop drift on this curve equals the time derivative of its state coordinate. Finally, we prove invariance and inaccessibility before exit and derive exact squared-logarithmic asymptotics for approach probabilities.

</details>


### [365] [Projection-Free Multi-level Algorithms for Stochastic Constrained Compositional Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15679)
*Wei Jiang,Sifan Yang,Wenhao Yang,Yibo Wang,Yuanyu Wan,Zechao Li,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究随机约束多层级复合优化的免投影算法，基于线性最小化预言机提出方差缩减与动量方法，在非凸、凸、强凸及有限和设定下建立复杂度保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标函数是多层光滑函数的嵌套复合，且约束集为闭凸集；对约束集投影计算代价高，因此需要免投影方法避免投影操作。

Method: 基于线性最小化预言机的免投影方法；非凸情形提出方差缩减算法并用Frank-Wolfe间隙与梯度映射准则分析；进一步提出基于动量的方法以适应更弱光滑性假设；采用分阶段设计得到无参变体；并扩展到凸、强凸及有限和问题。

Result: 在Frank-Wolfe间隙与梯度映射准则下建立复杂度保证；动量方法在更弱光滑性下收敛；无参变体保持相同复杂度；凸与强凸速率匹配单层免投影方法；有限和问题下给出非凸、凸、强凸的复杂度；多任务数值实验验证有效性。

Conclusion: 所提免投影算法为随机约束多层级复合优化提供了系统的复杂度理论，并覆盖多种凸性与有限和设定，实验证明其有效性。

Abstract: This paper studies projection-free algorithms for stochastic constrained multi-level compositional optimization. In this context, the objective function is a nested composition of several smooth functions, and the decision set is closed and convex. Since projection onto the constraint set can be computationally expensive, we develop projection-free methods that rely on linear minimization oracles. For non-convex objectives, we propose variance-reduced projection-free algorithms and establish complexity guarantees under both the Frank-Wolfe gap and the gradient mapping criteria. We also develop momentum-based methods that achieve convergence guarantees under weaker smoothness assumptions. Additionally, by using a stage-wise design, we derive a parameter-free variant that preserves the same complexities for the Frank-Wolfe gap. Such a design can be further used to develop algorithms for convex and strongly convex functions whose rates match those of single-level projection-free counterparts. Finally, we consider finite-sum problems and derive complexities for non-convex, convex, and strongly convex objectives. Numerical experiments across multiple tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [366] [A Generalized Stability Theorem for Interconnections of Dissipative Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15765)
*Michaela Repasova,Henk J. van Waarde*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文用行为方法将耗散性理论推广到一般动态供给率，证明了一个统一互联LTI系统稳定性定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小增益和被动性等经典稳定性结果基于静态供给率，难以统一处理更一般的动态耗散概念，需要一个更普适的稳定性框架。

Method: 采用行为方法，用二次微分形式(QDF)表示存储函数和供给率，构造由存储函数之和加耦合QDF组成的Lyapunov函数，给出两个耗散LTI行为互联的稳定性条件。

Result: 建立了统一稳定性定理，可退化为有限L2增益、被动性等静态供给率结果，以及delta耗散性等动态供给率结果。

Conclusion: 通过加入耦合QDF，可获得比仅用存储函数之和的现有方法更丰富的Lyapunov函数类，从而统一并推广互联系统的稳定性分析。

Abstract: Dissipativity theory enables the stability analysis of complex, interconnected systems through the physical properties of their components. Celebrated examples of such stability results include the small gain and passivity theorems. In this paper, we prove a unifying stability theorem for dissipative linear time-invariant (LTI) systems. We use the behavioral approach to express storage functions and supply rates in terms of quadratic differential forms (QDFs). Our main result establishes conditions for the stability of an interconnection of two LTI behaviors that are both dissipative with respect to general, dynamic supply rates. As special cases, we recover existing results for static supply rates, such as those capturing finite $L_2$-gain and passivity, as well as dynamic ones capturing, for example, delta dissipativity. The key idea of the paper is to construct a Lyapunov function as a sum of storage functions and a coupling QDF, thereby allowing for a richer class of Lyapunov functions than existing works dealing with just sums of storage functions.

</details>


### [367] [Revisiting Proximal Bundle Methods: Improved Rates under H{ö}lder Smoothness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15806)
*Feng-Yi Liao,Yang Zheng*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文将经典近端束方法(PBM)中的零步循环解耦为独立的内层子程序ProxBundle，分析其在一般束模型条件下自动适应Hölder光滑性，并由此获得经典PBM在Hölder光滑下的更紧复杂度界，以及一种基于绝对模型误差测试的新变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典PBM的分析将零步(null step)与下降测试(descent test)耦合在一起，导致束更新如何近似近端子问题这一机制被掩盖，难以得到清晰的复杂度理解。作者希望分离这两者角色，实现模块化分析。

Method: 针对复合目标F=f+h，将每个零步循环视为内层束子程序ProxBundle，在一般束模型条件下独立于任何停止准则进行分析，证明其自动适应Hölder光滑性；再将该内层分析与下降步分析结合，得到经典PBM的复杂度界。同时提出绝对模型误差测试，得到新的PBM变体。

Result: 对固定近端参数，经典PBM总体复杂度为O(ε^{-(3-ν)/(1+ν)})（ν∈[0,1)）和O(ε^{-1})（ν=1）；若近端参数与ε成正比，速率提升至O(ε^{-2/(1+ν)})（ν∈[0,1)）。这是首个针对ν∈(0,1)的经典下降测试的保证。新变体在固定近端参数下同样达到O(ε^{-2/(1+ν)})。

Conclusion: 该分析成功分离了下降步与零步的作用，为不同测试下的PBM提供了模块化理解，并给出了Hölder光滑下的更优复杂度保证。

Abstract: Proximal bundle methods (PBMs) are classical algorithms for nonsmooth convex optimization. Existing analyses of the classical PBM couple the null steps with the descent test. This coupling obscures how the bundle updates approximate the proximal subproblem. In this work, we consider composite objectives $F=f+h$ and view each null-step cycle as an inner bundle subroutine, called $\mathtt{ProxBundle}$. We analyze $\mathtt{ProxBundle}$ independently of any stopping criterion under general bundle model conditions and show that it automatically adapts to H{ö}lder smoothness. Combining this inner-loop analysis with the descent-step analysis yields sharper complexity bounds for the classical PBM. For any fixed proximal parameter, its overall complexity is $\mathcal O\big(ε^{-\frac{3-ν}{1+ν}}\big)$ for $ν\in[0,1)$ and $\mathcal O(ε^{-1})$ for $ν=1$, where $ν$ is the H{ö}lder smoothness exponent. Choosing the proximal parameter proportional to $ε$ improves the rate to $\mathcal O\big(ε^{-\frac{2}{1+ν}}\big)$ for $ν\in [0,1)$. These are the first guarantees under Hölder smoothness with $ν\in(0,1)$ for the classical descent test. We further introduce an absolute model-error test. The resulting PBM variant admits a clean inexact proximal-point analysis, and for any fixed proximal parameter, achieves the same complexity $\mathcal O\big(ε^{-\frac{2}{1+ν}}\big)$. Overall, our analysis separates the roles of the descent and null steps and gives a modular understanding of PBMs across different~tests.

</details>


### [368] [An Adaptive Linesearch-free Method for Monotone Variational Inequalities under Local Lipschitz Continuity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15936)
*Hongjia Ou,Andreas Themelis,Puya Latafat*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究求解极大单调算子与单调Lipschitz算子之和包含问题的FRB分裂法，在极大单调算子为凸函数次微分时给出反射系数的紧容许范围（>1/2），并提出无需线搜索的自适应变体，用局部Lipschitz估计闭式确定步长与反射系数，基于新Lyapunov函数证明收敛并给出非渐近速率与步长下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB分裂法每步需一次resolvent与一次Lipschitz算子计算，但经典分析通常固定反射系数为1并要求全局Lipschitz常数，这在局部Lipschitz或无全局常数场景下受限。作者希望放宽反射系数范围并实现无需全局Lipschitz信息的自适应步长。

Method: 针对次微分情形识别反射系数的紧容许区间（足够小步长下所有>1/2的值）；提出无线搜索自适应FRB，步长与反射系数逐次变化，步长由简单局部Lipschitz估计闭式算出，保持每步计算开销不变；分析使用结合到解距离、相邻迭代差与gap型项的新Lyapunov函数，各项无需单调下降，其加权组合在步长条件下下降。

Result: 证明了两类方法的收敛性，给出非渐近收敛速率以及所生成步长的显式下界；在极小极大问题、均衡模型和正则化回归上的数值实验验证了自适应方法的有效性。

Conclusion: FRB的反射系数可放宽至>1/2的紧范围，自适应变体在无需全局Lipschitz常数与线搜索下保持迭代成本并获得收敛保证，适用于多种实际优化模型。

Abstract: The forward-reflected-backward (FRB) splitting solves inclusion problems involving the sum of a maximally monotone operator and a monotone Lipschitz continuous operator. Each iteration performs one resolvent step and one evaluation of the Lipschitz operator, plus a reflection term with coefficient one that reuses the previous operator value. We consider the setting where the maximally monotone operator is the subdifferential of a proper, lower semicontinuous, convex function. We identify the tight admissible range of constant reflection coefficients, namely all values larger than one half for a sufficiently small stepsize. We then propose a linesearch-free adaptive variant of FRB for locally Lipschitz continuous operators, in which both the stepsize and the reflection coefficient change across iterations. The stepsize is computed in closed form from a simple local Lipschitz estimate, without requiring the existence or knowledge of a global Lipschitz constant, while maintaining the iteration cost of FRB. The analysis of both methods relies on a new Lyapunov function that combines the distance to a solution, successive differences of iterates, and a gap-type term. The individual terms need not decrease along the iterates, but the stepsize conditions ensure that their weighted combination does. Moreover, alongside nonasymptotic rates, we derive explicit lower bounds on the generated stepsizes, and showcase the effectiveness of the adaptive method through numerical experiments on minimax problems, equilibrium models, and regularized regression.

</details>

### [369] [Event-Time Order-Flow Memory, Operational-Time Impact, and Subordinated Market Observables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13715)
*Christopher Angstmann,Tim Gebbie*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 该文将两个市场微观结构规律（交易符号长记忆与元订单冲击平方根律）分别归因于事件时间与操作时间，并统一到同一订单簿框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有两大经验规律分别定义在不同时钟上，直接混合可能导致机制误读；本文旨在区分事件时间与操作时间，而非提出新经验定律。

Method: 从离散时间随机游走的买卖报价反应—扩散订单簿出发，引入独立事件时钟；识别事件时间失衡缩减，推导局部线性区域的操作时间前沿与冲击方程，再将符号与冲击观测量从属到日历时间。

Result: 事件时间符号持续性、操作时间平方根冲击及日历时间反常效应被证明为同一订单簿表示的相容结果；分数/回火时钟效应来自事件到日历的投影。

Conclusion: 提出一个紧凑的时钟感知框架，统一解释符号长记忆与平方根冲击律。

Abstract: We consider two canonical market-microstructure regularities: the long-memory of trade signs and the square-root law of meta-order impact. The point is not to propose new empirical laws, but to separate the clocks on which existing laws are defined. The sign-memory law is an event-time statement about the ordering and fragmentation of hidden orders. The square-root impact law is an operational-time statement about front motion in a locally linear latent order book. Starting from a discrete-time random-walk bid/ask reaction--diffusion order book with a separate event clock, we identify an event-time imbalance reduction, derive the operational-time front and impact equations in the locally linear regime, and then subordinate both sign and impact observables to calendar time. Fractional or tempered clock effects enter through this event-to-calendar projection, not through a different operational-time impact mechanism. This gives a compact clock-aware framework in which event-time sign persistence, operational-time square-root impact, and anomalous calendar-time effects appear as distinct but compatible consequences of a common order-book representation.

</details>


### [370] [Gate Design and Stage-Dependent Incentives in Retail Proprietary-Trading Evaluations: Why Passing Is Not Standalone Evidence of Skill, and Why the Product Fails to Pay Under Measured Trading Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14859)
*Nicholas Hall*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 零售自营交易公司出售"两阶段产品"（付费评估+注资账户），本文分析其合约几何结构如何在不同阶段制造不同激励，使"通过评估"成为糟糕的技能信号，并揭示其负期望值与卖方利润来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该行业普遍公布通过率却极少公布出金率，且通过评估被当作交易技能的证明。作者希望揭示合约结构本身（而非交易者技能）如何在评估与注资阶段产生相反激励，解释为何通过率无法反映真实能力，并分析卖方如何通过设计获利。

Method: 建立合约几何模型，分析日内追踪回撤（end-of-day trailing）下的门槛博弈；用零技能对照测算仓位管理单独产生的通过概率；在简化合约模型下推导卖方边际与"感知/实际门槛概率差"的关系；在实测策略空间内计算多配置的期望值，并对比1:1.5盈亏比与无漂移胜率。

Result: 仅靠仓位管理、零技能即可使通过概率接近0.40（实测队列通过率为0.168）；联合门槛下，评估奖励快速且集中的节奏，而注资账户以九倍力度惩罚之。通过率随技能上升，但真实优势与激进加仓的作用几乎等同，故通过率混淆二者。卖方边际受"感知与实际门槛概率之差"约束（类似于价格分量遮蔽）。行业内通过率公布频率远高于出金率。实测策略空间内无任何配置能在观察到的漂移下达到盈亏平衡；1:1.5净成本下盈亏平衡胜率约在40.5%–41.5%，而漂移为零时为40.0%。被公司禁止的delta中性策略在观察到的出金上限下约期望值中性。

Conclusion: 合约几何结构是卖方利润的核心来源：可渗透的营销评估加严苛的出金门槛，制造负期望值并使通过率成为失真的技能信号。所有账户层面结果均以零技能对照为基准，表明该产品设计系统性地不利于交易者。

Abstract: Retail proprietary-trading firms sell a two-stage product: a paid evaluation that must reach a profit target before breaching a trailing drawdown, then a funded account that must survive a minimum window and a consistency rule before a payout. We show the geometry of this contract creates incentives that differ by stage and make passing a poor standalone signal of skill. Under end-of-day trailing the evaluation rewards a fast, lumpy cadence while the funded account punishes it, by a factor of nine in the joint gate. The evaluation is defeatable at zero skill: position sizing alone yields a pass probability near 0.40, against a measured cohort rate of 0.168. Pass probability rises with skill, but a real edge and aggressive sizing move it by nearly the same amount, so a pass rate confounds the two. Under a simplified contract model the seller's margin is bounded by the gap between perceived and actual gate probabilities, the probability analogue of shrouding a price component; the observed design, a permeable marketed evaluation and a hard payout gate, is consistent with that. Across the sector, pass rates are published far more often than payout rates. The same geometry produces negative expected value: within the measured strategy universe, no configuration at observed drifts clears break-even on any account sourced. Break-even lies between a 40.5% and 41.5% win rate at 1:1.5 net of costs, against a driftless 40.0%. The delta-neutral construction firms prohibit is approximately expected-value neutral at the observed payout ceiling. Every account-level result is reported against a zero-edge control.

</details>


### [371] [Resolution Is Not Settlement, Part I: Oracle Adjudication and Semantic Governance on Polymarket](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15368)
*Maksym Nechepurenko*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文将 Polymarket 预测市场的结算过程重构为事件溯源式多状态生命周期，以 Oracle 请求"代际"为裁决单位，在 Polygon 特定区块冻结人口上精确提取 50.4 万条生命周期事件，揭示请求年龄不等于语义解析年龄。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统预测市场研究把结算压缩为"终局结果+单一时间戳"，但杠杆事件合约涉及规则版本化、请求创建、提案、争议、重置、Oracle 终局性与适配器终局性等彼此不同的状态，且观测精度与资产负债表后果各异，因此需要更细粒度的状态重构。

Method: 以 Oracle 请求代际为裁决单位，在 Polygon 第 79,721,080 区块冻结人口（185,550 个已初始化适配器-问题实例、350,703 条解码适配器日志）；用请求者过滤精确提取 Oracle 生命周期事件；以不可变链上身份与已部署请求语义做精确链接，未完成历史做右删失处理；并通过稳定 ID 元数据做外部链接。

Result: 提取到 504,332 条 Oracle 生命周期事件（184,148 请求创建、159,447 提案、1,604 争议、159,133 结算）；账目闭合为 182,671 个至少一次请求的问题加 1,477 个后继代际。请求到首次提案中位时间在旧路径为 182 秒，新路径为 176,388–744,151 秒，重置后代际提案中位 300–2,909 秒。元数据链接匹配 104,032/185,550（56.07%），81,518 未匹配，无歧义精确匹配。

Conclusion: 结果建立了 Oracle 裁决、语义治理与适配器终局性的事件溯源账户，明确了"请求年龄≠语义解析年龄"这一区别；外部来源发布与合同可判定性时钟尚未全人口测量，不被机制时间戳替代。配套的 Part II 将重构条件代币支付记录与实际赎回，保持裁决、协议结算与持有人实现之间的边界。

Abstract: Prediction-market resolution is often reduced to a terminal outcome and one timestamp. That representation is inadequate for leveraged event claims because rule versioning, request creation, proposal, dispute, reset, Oracle finality, and adapter terminality are distinct states with different observation precision and balance-sheet consequences. We reconstruct those states for Polymarket using Oracle request generations as the unit of adjudication.
  The population is frozen at Polygon block 79,721,080 and contains 185,550 initialized adapter-question instances and 350,703 decoded adapter logs. Exact requester-filtered extraction yields 504,332 decoded Oracle lifecycle events: 184,148 request creations, 159,447 proposals, 1,604 disputes, and 159,133 settlements. The accounting closes as 182,671 questions with at least one request plus 1,477 successor generations. Immutable chain identity and deployed request semantics provide exact linkage; unfinished histories remain right-censored.
  Request age is not semantic resolution age. Median request-to-first-proposal time is 182 seconds on the legacy route but 176,388-744,151 seconds on modern routes; post-reset successor proposals arrive within 300-2,909 seconds at the median. This descriptive contrast does not establish causal efficiency. Exact stable-ID metadata linkage recovers 104,032 of 185,550 questions (56.07%), leaves 81,518 unmatched, and produces no ambiguous exact match. External-source publication and contractual-decidability clocks remain unmeasured population-wide and are not replaced by mechanism timestamps.
  The results establish an event-sourced account of Oracle adjudication, semantic governance, and adapter terminality. Companion Part II reconstructs Conditional Tokens payout recording and observed redemption, preserving the boundary between adjudication, protocol settlement, and holder realization.

</details>


### [372] [Resolution Is Not Settlement, Part II: Protocol Finality and Observed Redemption on Polymarket](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15373)
*Maksym Nechepurenko*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 提出基于事件溯源框架刻画 Polymarket 条件从准备到协议最终性及持有人兑现的完整流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Oracle 结果不等于协议支付，可赎回头寸不等于账户抵押品，赎回事件也不能完整度量经济权益，需建立事件溯源框架加以区分。

Method: 基于固定 ABI 的三类 CTF 事件族（ConditionPreparation、ConditionResolution、PayoutRedemption），区分合约级获取域与冻结的 Polymarket 适配器问题队列，构建 108,638 个精确链接条件的桥接。

Result: 99,283 条件有协议解决事件；其中 92,158 有任意金额赎回、91,817 有正支付赎回，Kaplan-Meier 中位数分别为 182 与 200 秒；支付分类含 53,847 个 (0,1)、45,024 个 (1,0)、410 个五五分等；跨合约排序中 823 个区间限定、48 个多候选、91,638 个无兼容终代、16,129 个右删失。

Conclusion: Oracle 最终性不能识别协议最终性，协议最终性不能识别持有人兑现，仅凭赎回事件无法确定已兑现权益比例，需独立且余额一致的权益分母。

Abstract: An Oracle result is not yet a protocol payout, a redeemable position is not yet collateral in a holder's account, and a redemption event is not a complete measure of economic entitlement. This companion paper develops an event-sourced framework for Polymarket conditions from preparation through protocol finality and observed holder realization.
  The empirical design uses three Conditional Tokens Framework event families derived from a pinned contract application binary interface (ABI): ConditionPreparation, ConditionResolution, and PayoutRedemption. It separates the contract-wide acquisition universe from the frozen Polymarket adapter-question cohort. The exact bridge contains 108,638 linked conditions. Of these, 99,283 have an observed protocol-resolution event by the fixed snapshot at Polygon block 90,114,204 (2026-07-12T17:11:41Z).
  Among resolved exact-linked conditions, 92,158 have an observed redemption of any amount and 91,817 have an observed positive-payout redemption; condition-specific Kaplan-Meier medians from first protocol resolution are 182 and 200 seconds respectively. The exact-linked payout taxonomy contains 53,847 canonical (0,1) vectors, 45,024 canonical (1,0) vectors, 410 fifty-fifty vectors, two other valid vectors, and 9,355 conditions with no observed resolution. Cross-contract Oracle-adapter-protocol ordering is reported conservatively: 823 conditions have an interval-qualified terminal generation, 48 have multiple candidate generations, 91,638 have no compatible terminal generation in the frozen evidence, and 16,129 are right-censored or otherwise unevaluable.
  The formal results show that Oracle finality does not identify protocol finality, protocol finality does not identify holder realization, and redemption events alone do not identify the fraction of entitlement redeemed without an independent balance-consistent entitlement denominator.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [373] [BudgetBench: A Budget-Tiered Protocol and Pilot Harness for Memory Strategy Evaluation in Local Large Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13149)
*Aditya Karnam Gururaj Rao,Arjun Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BudgetBench，将每次调用的输入token预算作为自变量来评估记忆策略，提供可复用测量协议与工具，并通过多个试点研究揭示预算合规失败和非单调质量曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地LLM代理的活跃上下文是稀缺资源：记忆容量、预填延迟、缓存增长和服务目标都限制每次调用可承受的输入token数，但现有评估缺乏以预算为自变量的系统测量方法。

Method: BudgetBench协议与参考工具：固定模型、任务、采样器与解码，扫描2K/4K/8K/16K/32K预算，记录质量、预算利用率、延迟和预算违规率；提供可替换MemoryStrategy合约、显式预算执行、确定性/版本化评分器、提示审计元数据及可复现工件。

Result: 试点研究（本地qwen2.5:1.5b 89项、托管Qwen3 30B-A3B 50项LongBench复现、500项LongMemEval oracle研究）暴露预算合规失败、非单调质量曲线及单预算评估掩盖的操作点；预算受限与全上下文方向仍不明确，本地近零差异、托管点估计偏全上下文。

Conclusion: 核心贡献是可复用的协议、工具和失败报告规范，用于扩展固定预算记忆策略评估；早期试点的tokenizer近似会低估部分提示，其违规行仅为诊断而非结论性结果。

Abstract: For local large language model agents, active context is a scarce resource: memory capacity, prefill latency, cache growth, and service objectives all constrain how many input tokens each call can afford. We present BudgetBench, an active-budget protocol and reference harness that treats the per-call input-token budget as the independent variable when comparing memory strategies. Holding the model, task, sampler, and decoding fixed, it sweeps budgets over 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, and 32K tokens and records quality, budget utilization, latency, and, as a first-class outcome, budget-violation rates. The core contribution is this reusable measurement surface: a swappable MemoryStrategy contract, explicit budget enforcement, deterministic or versioned graders, prompt-audit metadata, and reproducibility artifacts, released at https://github.com/aviskaar/budgetbench.
  We substantiate the protocol with pilot studies rather than final rankings. Across a local qwen2.5:1.5b pilot (89 items each on SWE-bench Verified and LongBench v2), a hosted 50-item Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench replication with exact tokenization, and a 500-item LongMemEval oracle study scored by the official GPT-4o evaluator, the harness exposes budget-compliance failures, non-monotonic quality curves, and operating points that single-budget evaluation hides. The budgeted-versus-full-context direction remains unresolved: the local slice is near-null and the hosted replication favors full context in point estimate. We report results transparently, including that the early pilot's tokenizer approximation undercounts some served-model prompts, so its violation rows are tokenizer-approximation diagnostics, not claim-bearing results; all timings are operational diagnostics. The reusable contribution is the protocol, harness, and failure-reporting discipline needed to scale fixed-budget memory-strategy evaluation.

</details>


### [374] [A derivative-fidelity failure mode in physics-informed neural networks: strengthened benchmark evidence from function-value training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13171)
*Koji Koyamada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将"导数保真度"定义为PINNs的一种失效模式：函数值拟合准确并不代表自动微分得到的导数可靠。通过一维基准测试（sin(x)、exp(x)）发现，视觉上准确函数逼近可伴随显著更大的二阶导数误差，尤其在高曲率边界区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINNs依赖自动微分施加微分方程残差，但函数值的良好吻合并不必然意味着导数准确。作者希望揭示这一潜在失效模式，并建立区分"值精度"与"物理残差可靠性"的诊断方法。

Method: 在一维基准上用多层感知机仅对函数值（sin(x)、exp(x)）进行训练，随后单独通过自动微分求二阶导数并评估误差。通过训练点密度、激活函数、端点密集评估以及L2与最大误差诊断等额外实验强化假设。

Result: 结果表明，函数逼近在视觉上准确的同时，二阶导数误差可能显著更大，尤其在高曲率边界区域附近。

Conclusion: 该实验提供了一套诊断协议，用于区分函数值精度与物理残差可靠性，提醒使用PINNs时需单独验证导数保真度。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) use automatic differentiation to impose differential-equation residuals, but good agreement in function values does not necessarily imply accurate derivatives. This paper formulates derivative fidelity as a failure mode of PINNs and tests it with one-dimensional benchmarks. Multilayer perceptrons are trained only on function values for sin(x) and exp(x), while second derivatives obtained by automatic differentiation are evaluated separately. The hypothesis is strengthened by additional tests over training-point density, activation functions, endpoint-dense evaluation, and both L2 and maximum-error diagnostics. The results show that visually accurate function approximation can coexist with substantially larger second-derivative errors, especially near high-curvature boundary regions. The experiment provides a diagnostic protocol for distinguishing value accuracy from physics-residual reliability.

</details>


### [375] [WaVeFuse: Regime-Adaptive Equity Index Forecasting via Channel-Wise Wavelet Denoising and Vertical Attention Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14733)
*Aashish Bohra,Vivek Vijay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WaVeFuse：双分支混合深度学习框架，通过小波去噪、因果通道CWT、CNN-BiLSTM+Transformer及垂直注意力融合(VAF)，实现股指regime鲁棒预测，R²=0.81-0.96，方向准确率70.5-78.3%，Sharpe 3.69。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合深度学习股指预测受限于三大问题：OHLCV噪声传播至技术指标(TI)、多尺度分解忽略通道差异而混淆频率特征、静态多分支融合无法适应市场regime切换。

Method: 统一双分支架构：Symlet-4小波去噪(level 2, MAD软阈值)抑制噪声；7个低滞后TI经因果通道CWT(Morlet, 32尺度)编码为尺度空间矩阵；CNN-BiLSTM捕捉时序动态，双层Transformer(heads=4, dk∈{16,32})建模尺度间谱依赖；2-token softmax门控VAF动态重加权两分支。

Result: 在KOSPI、DAX、NYSE Composite、Russell 2000(2010-2023)的WFV下，R²=0.81-0.96，方向准确率70.5-78.3%；12组配置MAE优于7个SOTA模型8.9-20.2%；DM统计量4.62-10.38(p<0.001)。10bp成本回测下四市场平均Sharpe 3.69，COVID崩盘最大回撤仅7.5%。参数量152k(0.68MB)，GPU推理<1.3ms。

Conclusion: WaVeFuse为计算高效、regime鲁棒的股指预测框架，适用于研究与决策支持部署。

Abstract: Hybrid Deep Learning for equity index forecasting is limited by three problems: propagation of OHLCV noise into derived technical indicators (TIs), channel-indiscriminate multi-scale decomposition that conflates heterogeneous frequency signatures, and static multi-branch fusion that cannot adapt to market regime shifts. WaVeFuse addresses these limitations through a unified dual-branch architecture. Symlet-4 wavelet denoising (level 2, MAD soft threshold) suppresses microstructure noise in OHLCV. Seven low-lag TIs computed from denoised prices are encoded by a causal channel-wise continuous wavelet transform (Morlet, 32 scales) into a per-timestep scale-space matrix. A CNN-BiLSTM branch captures temporal dynamics, while a dual-layer Transformer (heads=4, dk in {16, 32}) models inter-scale spectral dependencies, and their representations are integrated by a 2-token softmax gate Vertical Attention Fusion (VAF) that dynamically reweights branches as market regimes shift. Evaluated under walk-forward validation (WFV) on KOSPI, DAX, NYSE Composite, and Russell 2000 (2010-2023), WaVeFuse achieves R2 = 0.81-0.96 and directional accuracy 70.5-78.3%. It outperforms seven state-of-the-art models by 8.9-20.2% MAE across twelve dataset-period configurations. Diebold-Mariano statistics (4.62-10.38, p<0.001) confirm superiority over a well-tuned XGBoost benchmark across four indices. Ablation verifies component-wise contributions. Under realistic backtesting with 10 basis point transaction costs, WaVeFuse's directional strategy achieves a mean Sharpe ratio of 3.69 across four markets and limits maximum drawdown to 7.5% during the COVID-19 crash. With 152k parameters (0.68MB) and sub-1.3ms GPU inference, WaVeFuse delivers a computationally efficient, regime-robust framework suitable for research and decision-support deployment.

</details>


### [376] [Land Art as a Big-Data Climate Sensor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13182)
*Alev Cinbarci,Sean Kalaycioglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 分析1984–2025年间1,744幅Spiral Jetty卫星影像的多维复杂度特征，发现粗尺度排列熵与均值强度强烈追踪湖面高程，ResNet50第三主成分构成"AI气候轴"（与累积CO2相关0.86），且图像复杂度领先湖面变化约三年，将"艺术作为温度计"修正为"艺术作为水文状态先行指标"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Robert Smithson的《螺旋防波堤》随大盐湖水位在淹没与露出间反复交替，为研究艺术作品与气候/水文动态提供了独特对象；同时需检验早期基于小样本的"香农熵与全球温度正相关"论断是否成立。

Method: 共配准1984–2025年逐月逐年的1,744幅Landsat 4-9与Sentinel-2影像；构建14维复杂度签名（香农熵、多尺度排列熵、分形维数、空隙度、灰度共生纹理、强度统计、ImageNet预训练ResNet50特征）；并与NASA GISTEMP、USGS NWIS、Open-Meteo、Global Carbon Budget的42年月度气候水文面板进行对比，采用bootstrap、STL分解、偏相关与滞后分析。

Result: 香农熵为弱代理，不支持早期正相关论断；粗尺度排列熵与均值强度与湖面高程强相关（Spearman 0.85–0.88，置信区间不含零）；ResNet50嵌入第三主成分无监督地表现为"AI气候轴"（与累积CO2相关0.86，与湖面高程相关-0.83）；图像复杂度领先湖面约三年（滞后+3时Pearson r=0.58，CI 0.40–0.73）；STL显示1984–2015上升、此后急剧下降的非单调趋势；控制月份与传感器的偏相关证实结果稳健。

Conclusion: 研究将"艺术作为温度计"的隐喻修正为"艺术作为水文状态先行指标"，并公开数据集、特征流程与分析代码作为基准。

Abstract: Robert Smithson's 1970 land artwork Spiral Jetty, located in the north arm of Utah's Great Salt Lake, has alternated between submergence and exposure during severe lake decline. We analyze 1,744 co-registered Landsat 4-9 and Sentinel-2 image chips spanning every year and calendar month from 1984 to 2025. A 14-feature complexity signature combines Shannon entropy, multiscale permutation entropy, fractal dimension, lacunarity, gray-level co-occurrence texture, intensity statistics, and ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 features. These measurements are compared with a 42-year monthly climate and hydrology panel from NASA GISTEMP, USGS NWIS, Open-Meteo, and the Global Carbon Budget. Bootstrap analysis shows that Shannon entropy is a weak proxy and does not support an earlier small-sample claim of positive correlation with global temperature. By contrast, coarse-scale permutation entropy and mean intensity track lake elevation strongly, with Spearman correlations of 0.85 to 0.88 and 95 percent confidence intervals excluding zero. The third principal component of the ResNet50 embeddings emerges without supervision as an AI climate axis, correlating 0.86 with cumulative CO2 and -0.83 with lake elevation. Image complexity leads lake stage by about three years, with Pearson r = 0.58 at lag +3 and a 95 percent confidence interval of 0.40 to 0.73. STL decomposition reveals a non-monotonic trend that rises from 1984 to 2015 and declines sharply thereafter as the lake approaches record-low elevations. Partial correlations controlling for month and sensor confirm robustness to seasonal and sensor effects. These results refine the art-as-thermometer metaphor into an art-as-leading-indicator-of-hydrological-state interpretation. The dataset, feature pipeline, and analysis code are released as a public benchmark.

</details>


### [377] [LLMs or Naive Bayes? Old Gems or New Ways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13185)
*Mohammad Firas Sada,Dmitry Mishin,John Graham,Seungmin Kim,Mahidhar Tatineni,Frank Würthwein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过基准测试证明：在文本分类任务中，一旦有标注数据，经典 Naive Bayes 在准确率上可比肩甚至超越大语言模型，且吞吐量和能效高出数个数量级，仍是资源受限 HPC 场景下的最优选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对大语言模型流行背景下"经典方法如 Naive Bayes 是否应被淘汰"的疑问，作者希望实证检验 NB 与 LLM 在文本分类中的真实取舍。

Method: 将 Complement Naive Bayes 与零样本/少样本 LLM 进行基准对比，覆盖四个模型家族、27B 到 1T 参数（37倍规模跨度）的模型；在多个文本分类任务上比较准确率、吞吐量与能耗；并做 GPU/CPU 吞吐量分析及决策边界实验。

Result: LLM 仅在零数据场景占优（Amazon Polarity 98.0% vs 88.2%），但该优势易受数据污染影响；在低污染情感任务上 NB 反而胜出（81.7% vs 73.0%）。有标注数据时（AG News），NB 达 89.1%，与零样本 27B LLM（89.0%）无统计差异，优于 397B 前沿模型（84.8%），且 CPU 吞吐达数千样本/秒。小 LLM 批量推理比 NB CPU 推理慢 40-486 倍，能耗约为 NB 的百分之一量级。

Conclusion: 对于有标注数据的文本分类任务，NB 仍是资源受限 HPC 从业者的最优选择；决策线依任务而异（主题分类约 N~10^4 标签达到 LLM 平价，零数据情感任务则始终偏向 LLM）。作者还提供 Kubernetes Helm 算子，利用可配置阈值和可验证 Prometheus 指标自动完成模型选择。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) prompt a recurring question in research computing: should classical methods like Naive Bayes (NB) be retired? We benchmark Complement Naive Bayes against zero-shot and few-shot LLMs spanning four model families and a 37x range in scale (27B to a 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts) across text classification tasks. LLMs dominate only in zero-data regimes (98.0% vs 88.2% on Amazon Polarity sentiment), and even that win is contamination-prone: on a low-contamination sentiment task NB beats the zero-shot LLM (81.7% vs 73.0%). However, once labeled data is available (e.g., AG News), NB reaches 89.1% accuracy, statistically indistinguishable from the zero-shot 27B LLM (89.0%) and better than the 397B frontier model (84.8%), at thousands of samples/sec on a commodity CPU. Fine-tuned DistilBERT reaches 90.6% but at far lower throughput than NB at batch size 1 (Table 2). Our measured GPU throughput analysis shows small-LLM batched inference is 40-486x slower than NB CPU inference (the multiplier depends strongly on the host CPU), exposing a structural gap bounded by memory bandwidth, with roughly two orders of magnitude lower energy per sample. For resource-constrained HPC practitioners performing text classification with labeled data, NB remains the optimal choice. We show the decision line is task-dependent (NB reaches LLM parity around $N \sim 10^4$ labels for topic classification, while zero-data sentiment favors the LLM at all N tested) and provide a Kubernetes Helm operator that automates model selection using configurable thresholds and verifiable Prometheus metrics.

</details>


### [378] [An Efficient and Modular Framework for Targeted Harm Mitigation in LLMS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13624)
*Roberto Campbell,Momin Abbass,Muneeza Azmat,Michal Ulewicz,Raya Horesh,Kristjan Greenewald,Rogério Abreu de Paula,Nathalie Baracaldo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出模块化纠错框架，用Activated LoRA(aLoRA)适配器与上下文感知路由机制，在生成过程中低延迟地纠正LLM的有害输出，兼顾对齐与任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽具零样本学习能力，但仍易产生偏见、毒性等有害输出，与人类偏好不一致。现有对齐方法成本高且与模型紧耦合，缺乏灵活性与可扩展性。

Method: 模块化纠错框架：为预训练LLM增加Activated LoRA(aLoRA)适配器和上下文感知路由。专家适配器可在序列中途激活且不破坏KV缓存，实现低延迟定向纠正；每个专家针对特定危害（如偏见、毒性）训练；学习型路由器根据模型中间输出动态选择专家。

Result: 在标准安全基准上提升了对齐水平，同时保持任务性能，提供轻量高效的可控部署路径。

Conclusion: 该模块化方案为更安全、更可控的LLM部署提供了轻量高效的途径。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful zero-shot learners but remain prone to misalignment with human preferences, often producing biased, toxic, or otherwise harmful outputs. Existing alignment methods, while effective, are costly and tightly coupled to the model, limiting flexibility and scalability. We propose a modular correction framework that augments pretrained LLMs with Activated LoRA (aLoRA) adapters and a context-aware routing mechanism to eliminate harms from misaligned model responses. Our approach enables expert adapters to activate mid-sequence without invalidating the KV cache, allowing low-latency, targeted correction during generation. Each expert is trained to detect and mitigate specific harms, such as bias or toxicity. A learned router dynamically selects appropriate experts based on the models intermediate outputs. We demonstrate that our system improves alignment on standard safety benchmarks while preserving task performance, offering a lightweight and efficient path toward safer and more controllable LLM deployments.

</details>


### [379] [Early Prediction of Satellite Collision Probability Using a Hybrid TCN-Transformer Model for a CDM-Based Conjunction Analysis Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13191)
*Rabia Tüylek Tok,Burak Yağlıoğlu,Enes Dağ,Emre Onur Kahya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于学习的框架，利用历史CDM序列早期预测同一交会事件的碰撞概率（PoC）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO卫星与碎片激增导致近距离交会事件频发，给运营商带来负担；电推进卫星低推力机动时间约束更严。当前CDM中非线性不确定性传播和PoC对协方差演化敏感，使连续CDM解读困难。

Method: 先用无迹变换（UT）传播与反向传播评估碰撞风险对CDM参数的敏感性，并用PCA识别与PoC变化最相关的特征；据此选取原始CDM参数并构造反映相对运动、交会几何和协方差不确定性的派生指标。基于序列增强数据训练混合TCN-Transformer模型学习碰撞风险的时间演化。

Result: 敏感性分析与PCA结果支持了所选CDM参数及派生指标的合理性；在TÜBİTAK UZAY接收分析的CDM数据上验证，展示了该方法对LEO卫星交会更早、更一致的风险评估潜力。

Conclusion: 该学习框架可实现卫星交会风险的早期预测，提升LEO交会操作风险评估的时效性与一致性。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of operational satellites and orbital debris has increased the frequency of close approach events in low Earth orbit (LEO), creating a higher operational burden for satellite operators. This problem is especially critical for satellites using electric propulsion, where low-thrust maneuver capability imposes additional time constraints on collision avoidance planning. In current practice, Conjunction Data Messages (CDMs) provide relative state, covariance, miss distance, time of closest approach, and probability of collision (PoC) information for conjunction assessment. However, the nonlinear propagation of orbital uncertainties and the sensitivity of PoC to covariance evolution make the interpretation of sequential CDMs challenging. This study proposes a learning-based framework for early prediction of satellite conjunction risk by estimating the PoC expected in the subsequent CDM update of the same close approach event. In the proposed methodology, an Unscented Transform-based propagation and backpropagation framework is first used to evaluate the sensitivity of the collision risk metric to CDM parameters. In addition, Principal Component Analysis is applied to the numerical CDM parameters to identify the features most relevant to PoC variation. The results obtained from the sensitivity analysis and PCA are then used to justify the selected raw CDM parameters and to construct derived metrics representing relative motion, encounter geometry, and covariance-related uncertainty. Using the resulting sequential enriched conjunction dataset, a hybrid Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)-Transformer model is trained to learn the temporal evolution of conjunction risk. The framework is applied to CDMs received and analyzed within TÜBİTAK UZAY, demonstrating its potential for earlier and more consistent operational risk evaluation for LEO satellite conjunctions.

</details>


### [380] [Evaluating LLM-Generated Rules for Heart Disease Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13192)
*Feisal Alaswad,Batoul Aljaddouh,Maher Alrahhal,Wafaa Al Nassan,Talal Bonn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究对比传统机器学习模型与LLM生成规则系统在心脏病预测上的表现，发现传统ML模型预测性能更优，但LLM规则在可解释性方面有优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索LLM生成规则系统在医疗预测任务中能否替代传统机器学习模型，并权衡预测性能与可解释性。

Method: 使用UCI心脏病数据集，评估Logistic Regression、KNN、SVM、Naive Bayes、Decision Tree、Random Forest等分类器，以及GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4.6生成的规则系统，采用准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数进行评价。

Result: 传统ML模型整体优于LLM规则系统。Random Forest最佳，准确率90.2%、精确率0.829、召回率1.0、F1分数0.906；Naive Bayes次之，准确率88.5%、F1分数0.881。LLM规则中Claude Sonnet 4.6达80.3%准确率（F1: 0.833），GPT-4o为70.5%（F1: 0.690）。

Conclusion: 医疗AI系统存在预测性能与可解释性的权衡，LLM生成的IF-THEN规则虽性能较低，但能提升临床决策的透明度。代码已公开于GitHub。

Abstract: This study compares traditional machine learning models and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated rule-based systems for heart disease prediction using the UCI Heart Disease dataset. Several classifiers, including Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, were evaluated alongside rule-based systems generated using GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. Experimental results show that traditional machine learning models consistently outperform LLM-generated rule-based systems in predictive performance. Random Forest achieved the best overall performance with 90.2% accuracy, a precision of 0.829, perfect recall of 1.0, and an F1-score of 0.906. Naive Bayes followed closely with 88.5% accuracy and an F1-score of 0.881. In contrast, the LLM-generated rule models achieved lower performance, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 reaching 80.3% accuracy (F1-score: 0.833) and GPT-4o obtaining 70.5% accuracy (F1-score: 0.690). Despite the performance gap, the LLM-generated rules provide interpretable IF-THEN diagnostic logic that enhances explainability and transparency in clinical decision-making. These findings highlight the trade-off between predictive performance and interpretability in medical artificial intelligence systems. The complete implementation of all experiments, including machine learning models and LLM-derived rule classifiers, is publicly available in the GitHub repository at https://github.com/FeisalAlaswad/LLM-Rule-ML-Heart-Disease-Prediction .

</details>


### [381] [Diagnosing Faults in Reinforcement Learning Simulators and World Models with Canonical Polynomial Invariants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13194)
*Tesfay Zemuy Gebrekidan,Hadush Hailu Gebrerufael*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验"尊重物理结构的模型预测更好"这一前提，用Acrobot上的精确多项式不变量（Gröbner基）做实验。发现精确性对预测几乎无益，但在诊断（定位被违反的约束、归因故障参数）方面极有价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量文献假设将物理结构嵌入学习动力学能提升预测性能，但这一前提缺乏严格检验。作者希望验证"尊重底层物理=预测更好"是否成立，并探索精确不变量的其他价值。

Method: 利用轨迹中恢复、规范化为Q上约化Gröbner基的精确多项式不变量。在Acrobot上测试一致性正则化器与塑形势的影响。提出两种程序：筛选（识别被违反的物理约束）和归因（恢复故障不变量并识别责任物理参数）。引入normal-form deflation和quotient-space recovery支撑。

Result: 预测方面：精确性收益甚微——正则化降低代数残差但不改预测保真度；来自100%质量误差系统的塑形势与正确势加速学习效果相当。诊断方面：十五个注入故障中筛选全部定位且无误报（观测空间基线无一能定位）；归因在7个参数故障中全部恢复责任参数。配对差异检验检测所有故障。参考生成器扰动1e-4保留14-15/15定位，而理想相等判定仅能区分1e-12扰动。在11个RL环境350个发布对中未发现模拟器动力学变化。

Conclusion: 精确不变量的价值在诊断而非预测。筛选不严格要求精确性，但代数比较需要精确性。诊断方法揭示的是基准实现本身的性质而非动力学变化。

Abstract: A large literature builds physical structure into learned dynamics on the premise that models respecting the underlying physics predict better. We test that premise using exact polynomial invariants recovered from trajectories and canonicalised as reduced Gröbner bases over $\mathbb{Q}$. On Acrobot, exactness provides little benefit for prediction: a consistency regulariser reduces algebraic residual while leaving rollout fidelity essentially unchanged, and a shaping potential recovered from a system with a 100% mass error accelerates learning as effectively as the correct potential. Exact canonical invariants instead prove valuable for diagnosis. We develop two procedures: screening, which identifies the violated physical constraint, and attribution, which recovers the faulty invariant and identifies the responsible physical parameter. To enable this, we introduce normal-form deflation and quotient-space recovery. Across fifteen injected faults, screening localises every broken constraint with no false alarms, whereas observation-space baselines do not localise any; attribution recovers the responsible parameter on all seven parameter faults. Paired difference tests detect all faults, showing that the advantage is localisation rather than detection. Perturbing reference generators by $10^{-4}$ preserves 14--15/15 localisations, showing that screening does not require exactness, whereas ideal-equality decisions distinguish perturbations of only $10^{-12}$, showing that exactness is required for algebraic comparison. Applied to 350 release pairs across eleven RL environments, the diagnostic finds no evidence of changed simulator dynamics, instead revealing properties of the benchmark implementations themselves.

</details>


### [382] [Machine Unlearning for Speech Question Answering in Large Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13195)
*Zhe Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究 LALMs 在语音问答场景下的机器遗忘，评估多种遗忘策略，可在降低隐私泄露达 80% 的同时保持核心能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）在语音理解与问答上表现强劲，但因大规模训练数据继承了隐私风险，可能无意记忆敏感信息。相比文本 LLM 或 ASR，语音问答中声学感知与事实知识紧密耦合，遗忘更具挑战。

Method: 提出并评估多种遗忘策略：梯度上升（gradient ascent）、任务算术（task arithmetic），以及基于对齐的微调方法（强制安全拒答响应），以去除隐私知识并保留核心能力。

Result: 在语音问答数据集上的大量实验表明，这些遗忘方法可将隐私泄露率降低最高 80%，同时在非隐私语音问答及通用语音理解基准上性能近乎不变。

Conclusion: 机器遗忘可在 LALMs 语音问答中有效缓解隐私泄露，且基本不损害模型的核心语音理解与问答能力。

Abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in speech understanding and question answering (QA), but they also inherit privacy risks from large-scale training data, including the unintended memorization of sensitive information. In this work, we study machine unlearning for speech QA in LALMs, a setting that is more challenging than prior work on text-based Large Language Models (LLMs) or Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) due to the tight coupling between acoustic perception and factual knowledge. We present and evaluate multiple unlearning strategies, including gradient ascent, task arithmetic, and alignment-based fine-tuning methods that enforce safe refusal responses, to remove private knowledge while still preserving performance on core capabilities. Through extensive experiments on speech QA datasets, we show that these unlearning methods can reduce the privacy leakage rate by up to 80% while maintaining near-neutral performance on non-private speech QA and general speech understanding benchmarks.

</details>


### [383] [Algorithmic Information Dynamics of Learning: A Certified, Differentiable Complexity Controller for Grokking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13197)
*Luan Ozelim,Hector Zenil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用可微的认证算法复杂度估计器 K_CDM_sF 将算法信息动力学引入学习动力学，把复杂度变量变成能主动干预 grokking 的控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AID 通过扰动系统并测量算法复杂度变化来研究系统，但其常用估计器 BDIM 是分段常数的，只能做有限差分，无法作为可微的控制器参与学习动力学。grokking 中复杂度序参量已知，却未被用来实际驱动训练。

Method: 采用认证且可微的 K_CDM_sF 估计器；施加瞬态 loss kick；用复杂度 gate 控制发射/释放；进行消融（复杂度 gate vs 训练 loss gate、认证先验 vs 均匀先验、∇K 归因 vs 随机支撑）；直接扰动 Occam 场并测响应。

Result: 估计器作为控制器可加速 grokking；Occam 边界有限尺寸趋势 f_c ~ ln p/p 符合 coupon-collector；复杂度 gate 比 loss gate 少 27% 干预即可拯救失败种子；只有 map complexity 标记转变完成；均匀先验与 ∇K 归因可替代；Occam 场呈类成核响应、无线性区，不支持涨落-耗散代理；有限场响应在转变附近增长数个量级；bang-bang 脉冲可迁移到稀疏奇偶和 transformer，而持续权重空间损失失败。

Conclusion: 算法估计器的独特贡献在于时序（何时发射、何时释放），而非归因。

Abstract: Algorithmic Information Dynamics (AID) studies systems by perturbing them and measuring changes in algorithmic complexity, but its usual estimator, the Block Decomposition Method, is piecewise constant, restricting the calculus to finite differences. We use $K^{\mathrm{CDM}}_{\mathrm{s}F}$, a certified, differentiable estimator, to bring the calculus into learning dynamics: grokking, where a complexity order parameter is known but has not been made to act. A\empts a transient loss kick, the estimator becomes a controller that accelerates grokking in Levin's description-length--versus-time sense, within a data-dependent Occam boundary whose finite-size trend, $f_c\sim\ln p/p$, is consistent with a coupon-collector interpretation. Ablations show that a complexity gate matches a train-loss gate in rescuing failing seeds with $27\%$ less intervention; among the tested signals, only map complexity marks the transition's completion; the certified prior and the per-parameter $\nabla K$ attribution are both fungible (a uniform-prior sensor makes bit-identical gate decisions, and random supports match $\nabla K$-selected ones above a sparsity threshold); and direct field perturbation shows a nucleation-like response to the Occam field (no linear regime is resolved over the probed amplitudes, so these measurements do not justify a fluctuation--dissipation surrogate), with a finite-field response growing by orders of magnitude toward the transition. These measurements account for the empirically tuned staircase: bang--bang pulses, stall-fired and released on yield, whose iteration plausibly builds the response it exploits. The kick transfers to sparse parity and to a transformer; a sustained weight-space loss fails. The algorithmic estimator's distinct contribution is timing (when to fire and when to release), not attribution.

</details>


### [384] [SPICE: Simple Polysemantic Feature Interpretation via Clustering-based Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13198)
*Sehyun Lee,Dahee Kwon,Damin Lee,Jaesik Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPICE：一种通用的多义特征解释框架，自动确定每个神经元的概念簇数量，首次系统比较CNN与Transformer中的多义性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络可解释性中的多义性（一个神经元被多个不相关概念激活）阻碍了功能理解。现有方法依赖特定架构和人工启发式（如固定簇数K），缺乏通用性和可扩展性，尤其不适用于现代Transformer模型。

Method: 提出SPICE框架，避免架构相关的传播规则，自动确定每个神经元的概念簇数量，无需预设K，可扩展到大型模型。

Result: 实现首次跨CNN和Transformer的多义性系统比较，并全面研究多义性如何产生、随深度和架构变化，以及通过不同计算路径形成。

Conclusion: SPICE为深度视觉架构的多义性分析提供了通用、可扩展的解决方案，推动对神经网络内部表征的理解。

Abstract: One of the pivotal recent challenges in neural network interpretability is polysemanticity, where a single neuron is activated by multiple, often unrelated concepts, hindering clear functional understanding. Although prior work has explored this phenomenon, existing approaches remain architecture-specific and depend on manual heuristics such as a fixed number of concept clusters ($K$), limiting their generality and scalability--especially for modern Transformer-based models. To address these limitations, we introduce SPICE (\textbf{S}imple \textbf{P}olysemantic Feature \textbf{I}nterpretation via \textbf{C}lustering-based \textbf{E}xplanation), a generalizable framework for analyzing polysemanticity in deep vision architectures. SPICE avoids architecture-dependent propagation rules, enabling the first systematic comparison of polysemanticity across both CNNs and Transformers, and automatically determines the number of concept clusters per neuron, eliminating reliance on a preset $K$ and supporting scalable analysis for large models. Using SPICE, we conduct a comprehensive investigation into how polysemanticity emerges, varies across depth and architecture, and forms through distinct computational pathways.

</details>


### [385] [Discovering and Preserving Category Correlation Knowledge via Adaptive Reciprocal Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13199)
*Dawen Jiang,Zhishu Shen,Zeyu Liu,Tiehua Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AR-KD方法，通过对教师输出分布进行互适应重塑，缩小师生容量差距，提升知识蒸馏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 师生模型间存在显著容量差距，现有静态单向蒸馏范式忽视学生学习的动态性，且对困难样本缺乏针对性指导，导致迁移效率低。

Method: AR-KD对教师进行互适应，将教师的类相关矩阵与学生关系表征对齐，重塑教师预测结构以适配学生容量，缓解过度自信教师导致的类间暗知识崩塌，提供更丰富兼容的监督信号。

Result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k上优于SOTA基线；同构与异构设置下学生精度最高提升7.13%，平均比vanilla KD高1.42%-4.15%，与其他先进方法结合可进一步提升。

Conclusion: AR-KD通过教师输出的互适应重构，有效提升知识迁移效率，具有良好通用性与可组合性。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation aims to improve the performance of lightweight student models by transferring knowledge from larger and more powerful teacher models. However, a substantial size gap between teacher and student models often impedes effective knowledge transfer. Most existing approaches adopt a static, one-way teacher-to-student distillation paradigm, which overlooks the dynamic nature of student learning and fails to provide targeted guidance on hard samples. In this paper, we propose adaptive reciprocal knowledge distillation (AR-KD), a novel method that improves knowledge transfer by simplifying the teacher's output distribution. Specifically, AR-KD performs reciprocal adaptation on the teacher by matching its class correlation matrix to the student's relational representation, which reshapes the teacher's prediction structure to better suit the student's capacity. This relational alignment mitigates the collapse of inter-class dark knowledge caused by overconfident teachers, enabling the student to learn from richer and more compatible supervisory signals. We evaluate AR-KD on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k classification datasets, where it outperforms state-of-the-art knowledge distillation baselines. Specifically, AR-KD improves student performance across homogeneous and heterogeneous setups: up to 7.13% accuracy gain for students, 1.42% to 4.15% higher than vanilla KD on average, and further improvements when integrated with other advanced methods. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ARKD/.

</details>


### [386] [Criticality in Dissimilar Decomposition and Undersampling of Random Datasets with Anomalies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13201)
*Ghurumuruhan Ganesan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究AI生成数据作为"链接"异常点时对随机数据集分解与欠采样性质的影响，揭示最小强相异分解规模的相变现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来LLM训练数据将包含大量由当前LLM生成的AI文本/图像数据，需要理解这种AI生成数据如何影响批次分解，进而影响新LLM的性能。

Method: 将AI生成数据视为与主数据点"链接"的异常点，利用冗余图（redundancy graphs）和迭代技术，分析随机数据集的分解与欠采样性质。

Result: 得到最小强相异（SD）分解规模的界；证明存在相变现象——异常数少时最小规模由主数据点决定，超过阈值后由异常点主导；并建立随机欠采样数据集强相似性的规模临界性结果。

Conclusion: 通过对类别数据集的实例分析验证了理论结果，为理解AI生成数据混合训练场景下的数据分解提供了理论框架。

Abstract: Training datasets for upcoming LLMs would include a significant amount of AI text/image data generated from current LLMs. In such a scenario, it is important to understand how this affects batch decompositions and thereby, the performance of the resultant new LLM. In this paper, we consider AI generated data as anomalies ``linked" to main data points and study decomposition and undersampling properties of the overall random dataset. We use redundancy graphs and iteration techniques to obtain bounds for the minimum size of a strongly dissimilar (SD) decomposition and demonstrate a phase transition phenomena, wherein the minimum size is essentially determined by the \emph{main} data points when the number of anomalies is small and is ``taken" over by the anomalies above a certain threshold. We also establish a size criticality result for the strong similarity of a randomly undersampled dataset and illustrate our results with examples involving categorical datasets, whose overall space size is much larger than the size of the dataset.

</details>


### [387] [Do Tabular Foundation Models Still Need Feature Engineering?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13202)
*Yifan WU,Pinjun Dong,Jiran Tao,Binyan Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究了特征工程对表格基础模型（TFM）是否仍然重要。结果表明：特征工程收益集中在早期模型世代，对最强模型几乎无效；但提供相关数据集的上下文信息仍能提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征工程一直是表格机器学习的核心，而表格基础模型（TFM）通过预训练和上下文学习被广泛应用。其兴起引出一个自然问题：随着模型能力增强，人工特征构建是否仍有价值？

Method: 在两大TFM家族的多个版本上进行受控研究，在TabArena基准数据集上测试多种现有特征工程技术，并补充进行上下文信息（来自相关数据集）的实验。

Result: 特征工程增益集中在早期模型世代，对最强模型趋于可忽略；而加入来自相关数据集的上下文信息仍能提升性能。

Conclusion: 更强的TFM对显式构造的输入表征依赖减弱，性能提升来源发生转变：重新表征现有输入的效果下降，而提供额外任务相关上下文仍有益。

Abstract: Feature engineering has long been a cornerstone of tabular machine learning. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained on a wide range of tabular datasets and applied via in-context learning. Their rise raises a natural question: does manual feature construction still matter as these models become more capable? To answer this, we perform a controlled study across several versions of two major TFM families, testing a wide range of existing feature engineering techniques on benchmark datasets from TabArena. We find a consistent pattern: feature engineering gains are concentrated in earlier model generations and become negligible for the strongest models. These results suggest that stronger TFMs depend less on explicitly engineered input representations. In a complementary experiment, however, adding in-context information from related datasets still improves performance. Our findings indicate a shift in the source of performance gains for stronger TFMs: re-representing existing inputs becomes less effective, while providing additional task-relevant context remains beneficial.

</details>


### [388] [Scalable partial information decomposition for symptom networks via supervised embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13203)
*Cillian Hourican,Eric Dignum,Rick Quax,Debraj Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可扩展的 embedding-based PID (ePID)，将非焦点症状压缩为低基数嵌入以计算两源 PID，从而在症状网络中标定冗余与协同信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统症状网络的成对关系只以标量边权表示，无法区分两个症状对第三个症状的信息是重叠的、还是仅在组合中出现的，而标准 PID 在多个源上计算不可行。

Method: ePID 将所有非焦点症状压缩为低基数离散嵌入，再做可处理的两源 PID，为每个有序源-目标对输出 source-unique、remainder-unique、冗余和协同分量；在合成贝叶斯网络及 83 个真实数据集上以五种 PID 度量基准测试 13 种嵌入，最优为监督式 ACIB。

Result: ACIB 嵌入在多数情况下最准确恢复参考分解，压缩四个以上症状时各 PID 度量的原子均非负，协同恢复 r=0.92；PHQ-9 网络中冗余与 remainder-unique 主导，协同仅 6-9%，无协同主导的有向边；而 28 项 IRI 中 45% 的源对为协同主导。

Conclusion: ePID 分离重叠信息与交互依赖信息，为症状网络方法提供可扩展、与模型无关的补充，用以区分观察相关中的冗余与协同贡献。

Abstract: Pairwise relationships among mental-health symptoms are routinely summarised asscalar edge weights, which cannot express whether two symptoms carry overlapping information about a third or information that appears only in combination. Partial information decomposition (PID) addresses this gap but is computationally intractable beyond a few sources.
  We introduce embedding-based PID (ePID), a scalable pipeline that compresses all nonfocal symptoms into a low-cardinality discrete embedding and computes a tractable two-source PID, yielding source-unique, remainder-unique, redundant, and synergistic components for each ordered source-target pair. We benchmarked 13 candidate embeddings on synthetic Bayesian networks calibrated to PHQ-9 and on 83 real-world datasets across five PID measures.
  A supervised Agglomerative Conditional Information Bottleneck (ACIB) embedding recovered the reference decomposition most accurately of the 13 embeddings tested, and did so for every PID measure yielding non-negative atoms once four or more symptoms were compressed (synergy recovery r = 0.92). The two instruments then diverged sharply. In PHQ-9 networks (UK Biobank,N = 154,291; Xinxiang student sample, N = 24,292) the surrounding symptom context carried most pairwise dependence through redundant and remainder-unique channels; synergy contributed 6 to 9%, and no directed edge was synergy-dominated in either cohort. In the 28-item Interpersonal Reactivity Index, 45% of source pairs were. The identical pipeline, applied without parameter changes, therefore returned opposite profiles for the two instruments, each consistent with how that instrument was constructed.
  By separating overlapping from interaction-dependent information, ePID provides a scalable, model-agnostic complement to standard symptom-network methodology to distinguish redundant and synergistic contributions to observed correlations.

</details>


### [389] [GradRepair-ODE: Certified Gradient Repair for Neural ODE Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13204)
*Ziqian Bi,Xin Liang Chia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GradRepair-ODE 可靠性框架，在优化器步中检查、修复或拒绝 ODE 梯度，为数值可疑的梯度附加证据，避免应用不可靠更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经 ODE 在训练循环内使用数值求解器，求解器既决定前向轨迹又影响回传梯度，二者耦合带来可靠性问题：在步长过松、刚性动力学、混沌敏感或事件不连续等情形下，可微 ODE 流程可能返回数值方向可疑的有限梯度，威胁科学机器学习和连续时间生成建模（如扩散概率流 ODE、流匹配）。

Method: GradRepair-ODE 在优化器步处对梯度进行检查与处理：计算多个梯度候选，用方向有限差分检验和求解器诊断进行比对，诊断可能的数值失效模式，通过路径切换或更严格重算修复所选梯度，并拒绝无法认证下降方向的步。

Result: 在六个合成 ODE 系统上，方法对低风险系统保持不变；将 Robertson 与 Lorenz 梯度修复至与严格参考的余弦相似度 1.000；将不安全接受步从 37 降至 0；对事件不连续案例选择拒绝而非施加未经认证的更新。

Conclusion: 论文主张改变训练契约：ODE 梯度应在到达优化器时附带数值证据，从而提升科学机器学习与连续时间生成建模中 ODE 训练的可靠性。

Abstract: Neural ordinary differential equations use numerical solvers inside the training loop. The solver determines the forward trajectory and also affects the gradient passed to the optimizer. That coupling creates a reliability problem for scientific machine learning and continuous-time generative modeling, including diffusion probability-flow ordinary differential equations and flow-matching models. Under loose step sizes, stiff dynamics, chaotic sensitivity, or event discontinuities, a differentiable ODE pipeline can return a finite gradient whose direction is numerically suspect. We introduce GradRepair-ODE, a reliability framework for checking, repairing, and rejecting ODE gradients at the optimizer step. The method computes several gradient candidates, compares them with directional finite-difference checks and solver diagnostics, diagnoses likely numerical failure modes, repairs selected gradients through path switching or stricter recomputation, and rejects steps whose descent direction cannot be certified. In six synthetic ODE systems, GradRepair-ODE leaves low-risk systems unchanged, repairs Robertson and Lorenz gradients to cosine similarity 1.000 against a strict reference, reduces unsafe accepted steps from 37 to 0, and rejects an event-discontinuous case instead of applying an uncertified update. The paper argues for a simple change in the training contract: an ODE gradient should reach the optimizer with numerical evidence attached.

</details>


### [390] [Task-Aware Federated Fine-Tuning for MoE-based Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13395)
*Tingqi Wang,Hongyu Ke,Haoxin Wang,Rafal Angryk,Zhipeng Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedTAR，一种面向MoE大模型的任务感知联邦微调方法，通过路由输出关联任务偏好，实现簇内/簇间聚合以保持专家特化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构通过稀疏激活提升容量并降低开销，适合资源受限的分布式环境。但MoE大模型的联邦微调在客户端数据异构时面临挑战：不同客户端的任务偏好不同，直接聚合本地更新会削弱专家特化，并在共享专家上引入冲突的更新方向。

Method: FedTAR通过路由输出建立本地更新与任务偏好的关联：对路由特征和本地更新分别做SVD，提取低维任务坐标和更新方向；基于任务坐标，在任务偏好相似的客户端间进行簇内聚合，在不同任务组间进行簇间聚合；再通过学到的任务-更新映射重建聚合更新，使最终更新与任务特定优化方向对齐。

Result: 在四种基准任务、不同non-IID设置下评估，FedTAR持续优于强联邦微调基线，达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: FedTAR能保持专家特化并缓解异构客户端间的破坏性干扰，是有效的MoE大模型联邦微调方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a widely adopted architecture for Large Language Models (LLMs), as it improves model capacity while limiting computational overhead through sparse expert activation. This property makes MoE-based LLMs particularly attractive for resource-constrained distributed environments. However, federated fine-tuning of MoE-based LLMs remains challenging under heterogeneous client data. Since clients often correspond to different task preferences, directly aggregating their local updates may weaken expert specialization and introduce conflicting update directions on shared experts. To address these challenges, we propose FedTAR, a task-aware federated fine-tuning method for MoE-based LLMs. FedTAR establishes the association between local updates and task preference via routing outputs. Specifically, we apply Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to both routing features and local updates to extract low-dimensional task coordinates and update directions. Based on the task coordinates, FedTAR performs intra-cluster aggregation among clients with similar task preferences and inter-cluster aggregation across different task groups. The aggregated update is then reconstructed through the learned task-to-update mapping, ensuring that the final update remains aligned with task-specific optimization directions. In this way, FedTAR preserves expert specialization and mitigates destructive interference among heterogeneous clients. We evaluate FedTAR on four benchmark tasks under different non-IID settings. Experimental results demonstrate that FedTAR consistently outperforms strong federated fine-tuning baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [391] [Specification Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13415)
*Atticus Cull,Justin McCarthy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究让语言模型充当"规格预言机"，比较将学到的事实存入外部文本笔记与写入模型权重两种方式。结果显示权重式预言机能更好利用事实结构，但存储开销大得多。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规格说明面临基本权衡：省略细节会导致关键问题无法回答，逐条记录全部细节又使规格变得庞大冗长。作者希望探究语言模型能否作为紧凑、动态的规格预言机，通过学习目标事实直接回答问题。

Method: 在4类各含596条事实的世界、两种Qwen2.5模型规模上，比较两种存储学习事实的方式：外部文本笔记，以及修改模型权重（适配器）。跨存储容量积分评估准确率。

Result: 权重式预言机从结构中获益显著更多：7B模型下，结构化世界比非结构化世界的积分准确率高18.5个百分点，而笔记式仅为1.1个百分点。代价是存储成本高：最小适配器约175 KiB，而笔记预算最多16 KiB。

Conclusion: 改编权重能更成功利用潜在结构，而外部笔记需要明显更少的对象专属存储。两种方式在紧凑性与结构利用间各有权衡。

Abstract: Specifications face a basic tradeoff: leave details out, and important questions go unanswered; record every detail separately, and the specification becomes large and prolix. We investigate whether a language model can serve as a compact, living specification oracle by learning facts about a target and answering questions about it directly. We compare two ways of storing the learned facts: external text notes and changes to the model's weights. Across four families of 596-fact worlds and two Qwen2.5 model sizes, weight-only oracles benefited substantially more from structure: with the 7B model, their accuracy integrated across storage capacities was 18.5 percentage points higher on structured than unstructured worlds, compared with 1.1 points for note-sheet oracles. This advantage came at a substantial storage cost, with the smallest adapter requiring approximately 175 KiB compared with a maximum note budget of 16 KiB. Adapted weights therefore exploited latent structure more successfully, while external notes required substantially less object-specific storage.

</details>


### [392] [ReCAST: Reward Credit Assignment across Timesteps for Online Diffusion Reinforcement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13425)
*Yihang Chen,Yuanhao Ban,Kuei-Chun Kao,Cho-Jui Hsieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReCAST方法，在扩散模型多奖励微调中按时间步对每个奖励进行信用分配，通过Rényi可区分性增益分配权重，在SD3.5-Medium上提升了泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型多奖励训练需区分用户偏好与奖励信息量：偏好决定各奖励贡献多少，信息量决定其反馈在去噪何时有用。有些奖励在全局结构出现时即可评估，有些需样本接近干净时才有效，需同时解决这两个问题。
