While DRL has shown promise, existing GNN-based approaches often struggle to efficiently model high-order topological dependencies and suffer from loose coupling between task and resource states, leading to myopic scheduling decisions. To address these limitations, we propose HiGFRL, a Hierarchical Graph Fusion-Driven Reinforcement Learning framework. HiGFRL constructs a novel three-level state representation comprising a Static Hypergraph, a Dynamic Global Graph, and a Local Bipartite Graph to explicitly model the interplay between task dependencies and real-time cluster dynamics. Specifically, we design a fusion-driven dual-network architecture to optimize RL decision-making, where a Context Fusion Allocator integrates local bipartite matching features with fused global context to execute precise task-to-node allocation, and a Global State Evaluator leverages the global dynamic graph representation to accurately estimate expected long-term cumulative reward. Furthermore, we incorporate a topology-prior-guided hybrid reward mechanism that distills static topological priors into the learning process to accelerate convergence. Extensive experiments using real-world Alibaba cluster traces demonstrate that HiGFRL significantly outperforms heuristics and DRL baselines. Specifically, in challenging large-scale high-load scenarios, HiGFRL reduces the Makespan by up to 32.55%, and optimizes the average task flow time and average task wait time by 13.58% and 13.79%, respectively. Experimental results confirm that HiGFRL not only significantly improves cluster throughput but also ensures superior QoS by substantially reducing queuing delays. Code Release:https://github.com/igeng/HiGFRL.

</details>


### [501] [LiftGCN: Efficient Energy-Preserving Graph Learning via Joukowski Spectral Lifting for Finite Element Stress Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14977)
*Chen Zeng,Qiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LiftGCN：基于Joukowski谱提升的高效谱稳定图网络，用于有限元应力预测，改善高梯度应力集中重建并降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有限元应力场存在强局部非光滑性，孔洞、缺口和加载区附近产生尖锐空间梯度与高频图分量。传统消息传递本质平滑，会衰减高频信息；现有单位传播方法虽保留谱幅值，但依赖矩阵函数与高阶近似，传播复杂度达O(Ked)。

Method: 提出LiftGCN：利用Joukowski关系将归一化图算子的实谱映射到单位圆，并以简单二阶递推实现谱变换，避免矩阵指数、特征分解和高阶多项式截断。线性Joukowski骨干具有单位模特征根，在正定度量下保持能量，防止图频分量随深度指数衰减；每层仅需一次稀疏邻域聚合，传播复杂度O(ed)，并辅以轻量局部非线性残差增强表达。

Result: 有限元应力预测实验中，LiftGCN在总体精度上具竞争力，同时更好重建应力集中与局部高梯度结构，且计算成本显著降低。

Conclusion: LiftGCN通过Joukowski谱提升实现高效且谱稳定的图网络，在保持精度的同时有效缓解高频衰减问题，适用于有限元应力场预测。代码已开源。

Abstract: Finite element stress fields often exhibit strong local non-smoothness, where stress concentrations near holes, notches, and loading regions induce sharp spatial gradients and high-frequency graph components. Although graph neural networks naturally operate on irregular finite element meshes, conventional message passing is inherently smoothing and progressively attenuates such high-frequency information. Unitary propagation alleviates this problem by preserving spectral magnitudes, but typically relies on matrix functions and high-order approximations with $O(Ked)$ propagation complexity. We propose LiftGCN, an efficient spectrally stable graph network based on Joukowski spectral lifting. LiftGCN maps the real spectrum of a normalized graph operator onto the unit circle through the Joukowski relation and realizes the resulting spectral transformation as a simple second-order recurrence, avoiding matrix exponentials, eigendecomposition, and high-order polynomial truncation. We show that the linear Joukowski backbone has unit-modulus characteristic roots and admits an energy-preserving structure under a positive-definite metric, preventing exponential attenuation of graph-frequency components with depth. Each layer requires only one sparse neighborhood aggregation, yielding $O(ed)$ propagation complexity, while lightweight local nonlinear residuals provide expressive feature transformations. Experiments on finite element stress prediction demonstrate that LiftGCN achieves competitive overall accuracy while improving reconstruction of stress concentrations and local high-gradient structures with substantially reduced computational cost. Our code is available at https://github.com/ChenZeng001/LiftGCN.

</details>


### [502] [HGTO: A Unified Graph-Based Physics-Informed Formulation for Structural Topology Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15001)
*Kangzheng Liu,Uday Kumar Punna,Leixin Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HGTO 提出统一的图神经网络拓扑优化框架，将密度参数化在单元图上、结构状态在节点-单元超图上求解，通过有限元关联结构耦合材料场与平衡状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经密度参数化与双场物理信息方法多以坐标场表示密度和位移，未充分利用有限元网格固有的离散关联关系，效率与通用性受限。

Method: 将密度参数化于网格导出的单元图，结构状态在节点-单元超图上确定；有限元运动学、数值积分、本构及力组装均作为可微计算中的显式操作，材料场与平衡状态经共同有限元关联结构耦合。

Result: 柔度与传统密度优化相当，计算成本显著低于代表性基于坐标的双场神经方法；同一框架可处理高分辨率与不规则网格、三维结构、有限变形及弹塑性响应。

Conclusion: 将完全神经拓扑优化从坐标空间扩展至有限元图空间，为多样化、可扩展的拓扑优化提供统一且高效的公式。

Abstract: Density-based topology optimization is typically structured as a nested sequence of material updates, structural analyses, and sensitivity assessments. While neural density parameterization and dual-field physics-informed approaches provide data-free alternatives, most existing methods represent density and displacement as coordinate fields and make limited use of the discrete relationships inherent in the finite element mesh. The present study introduces HGTO, a unified graph-based formulation that extends complete neural topology optimization from coordinate space to finite-element graph space. Element densities are parameterized on the element graph derived from the mesh, and the structural state is determined on the corresponding node--element hypergraph. Finite element kinematics, numerical quadrature, constitutive response, and force assembly remain explicitly defined operations within the differentiable computation. The material field and equilibrium state are therefore coupled through a common finite-element incidence structure. Numerical studies show compliance comparable to conventional density-based optimization at substantially lower computational cost than a representative coordinate-based dual-field neural method. The same coupled formulation accommodates high-resolution and irregular meshes, three-dimensional structures, finite deformation, and elastoplastic response.

</details>


### [503] [Pick Your Poison: Learning to Select Poison Sets for Stronger LLM Backdoor Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15029)
*Aashiq Muhamed,Mona T. Diab,Virginia Smith,Andrew Ilyas,Matthew Jagielski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有后门投毒评测固定毒样本数量并随机采样，严重低估最坏情况脆弱性（攻击成功率3%~80%波动）。作者将毒集选择形式化为带预算的集合优化问题，提出SAILS方法学习集合评分器并审计少量候选，平均提升30个百分点，且可迁移扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后门投毒攻击评测通常固定毒样本数量，并从候选池中随机采样。作者发现这种做法的缺陷：在模型、干净数据和毒样本数量都固定的情况下，仅因毒集选择不同，攻击成功率就会从3%波动到80%，因此随机采样会严重低估最坏情况的脆弱性。

Method: 将毒集选择形式化为"预算受限的oracle查询集合优化"问题，并提出SAILS（Set-level Audit-Informed Iterative Learned Selection）：先用数百次微调-评估运行训练一个集合评分器，再用它对数百万候选集合排序，最后只对少量候选短名单进行真实审计。

Result: 在三个LLaMA-3-8B后门设置中，SAILS相比最强的影响力基线方法，在留出集上平均提升攻击成功率30个百分点；能够从小规模微调迁移到全规模微调；并可扩展到代码生成、智能体（agentic）和纯API（API-only）后门场景。

Conclusion: 随机选择毒样本会显著低估后门脆弱性，毒集选择应被视为集合优化问题。SAILS能高效地在巨大候选空间中搜索高危害毒集，揭示更严峻的最坏情况风险，并可跨规模与任务场景泛化。

Abstract: Backdoor poisoning attacks add poisoned examples to otherwise-clean finetuning data, pairing a trigger with a target behavior that the model learns to produce when the trigger appears. Existing evaluations typically fix the number of poisoned examples and sample them at random from a candidate pool. We show that this can severely underestimate worst-case vulnerability: across three LLaMA-3-8B backdoor settings, holding the model, clean data, and poison count fixed, attack success ranges from 3% to 80% depending only on which poison set is chosen.
  We formalize poison selection as oracle-budgeted set optimization and introduce SAILS (Set-level Audit-Informed Iterative Learned Selection), which learns a set scorer from a few hundred finetune-and-evaluate runs, ranks millions of candidate sets, and audits only a small shortlist. SAILS improves held-out attack success by 30 percentage points on average over the strongest influence baselines, transfers from small-scale to full-scale finetuning, and extends to code-generation, agentic, and API-only backdoors.

</details>


### [504] [MoARa: Module-Aware Rank Allocation and Structure-Preserving Decomposition for Low-Rank LLM Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15037)
*Keunyoung Kim,Nojun Kwak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MoARa 通过模块感知的投影秩分配与分块幅度-方向分解，显著加速低秩梯度投影的 LLM 预训练收敛，减少步数与墙钟时间且内存开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低秩梯度投影虽降低了 LLM 预训练的优化器状态内存，但达到目标质量所需的步数与墙钟时间仍有改进空间。作者将其归因于现有方法的两个设计缺陷：投影秩预算在所有 Transformer 模块上均匀分配（未考虑各模块投影敏感度差异），以及对原始梯度整体投影会同时衰减其幅度与方向。

Method: 提出 MoARa，包含两部分：一是基于静态 profiling 的模块感知投影秩分配；二是分块（block-wise）的幅度-方向分解，默认块大小设在注意力头维度附近。该方法与 GaLore 等低秩方法结合使用。

Result: 在 Llama、Qwen、DeepSeek 五种架构（300M–7B）上评测：GaLore+MoARa 在 Llama 2 7B 上以少 37% 步数和少 34% 墙钟时间达到标准 GaLore 的最终困惑度，峰值预留内存开销仅 0.2%。六种低秩方法中，仅模块感知秩分配就一致带来步数下降；在兼容主机上双组件设计可达 41.7% 步数减少与 37.1% 墙钟时间减少。

Conclusion: MoARa 通过模块感知秩分配与幅度-方向分解有效加速低秩梯度投影预训练，在多种架构和规模上实现一致的步数与时间节省，且内存开销可忽略。

Abstract: Low-rank gradient projection reduces the optimizer-state memory cost of large language model (LLM) pretraining, but the steps and wall-clock time needed to reach a target quality remain a meaningful axis for improvement. We attribute this to two design choices in existing methods: the projection-rank budget is allocated uniformly across Transformer modules with heterogeneous projection sensitivity, and projecting a raw gradient attenuates its magnitude and direction jointly. We propose MoARa, which combines a static profiling-based module-aware projection-rank allocation with a block-wise magnitude-direction decomposition; the default block size is set in the neighborhood of the attention head dimension. Across five Transformer architectures spanning Llama, Qwen, and DeepSeek at 300M to 7B scales, GaLore with MoARa reaches standard GaLore's final perplexity in 37% fewer steps and 34% less wall-clock time on Llama 2 7B, with only 0.2% peak reserved memory overhead under standard graph compilation. Across the six low-rank pretraining methods we evaluate, module-aware rank allocation alone delivers directionally consistent step reductions on all six. On compatible hosts, the two-component design reaches up to 41.7% step reduction and 37.1% wall-clock reduction.

</details>


### [505] [Ensemble Complexity in Photovoltaic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15049)
*Sun Ze,Zhou Liguo,Xu Yuqing,Yu Lei,Jiang Mingming*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过匹配对比与消融，系统评估异质集成中各组件的贡献与代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成虽能提升光伏预测，但部分组件贡献有限甚至增加计算开销，需明确其真实效果。

Method: 基于固定异质预测器库，使用GEFCom2014及三个公开数据集（PVDAQ、OPSD、Ausgrid），按时间划分、三个随机种子进行小时级实验；在ERA5回溯辅助下比较静态融合与匹配的boosting，并进行天气门控与成员移除消融；另设15分钟案例分析，用树模型替换一个神经网络成员。

Result: 静态融合相比boosting降低缩放MAE达1.11%（PVDAQ）、4.41%（OPSD）、1.63%（Ausgrid），多重比较校正后仅OPSD显著；天气门控无一致增益；成员移除显示组级依赖与个体冗余并存；15分钟案例归一化误差降1.72%但推理更慢。

Conclusion: 应进行组件级评估，并明确天气可用性与测试集复用的限制。

Abstract: An ensemble can improve photovoltaic forecasts while adding components that contribute little or increase computation. We assess these effects through matched comparisons and ablations of a fixed heterogeneous predictor bank. Hourly experiments use GEFCom2014 and three additional public datasets, with chronological partitions and three seeds. Under retrospective ERA5 assistance, static fusion reduces scaled mean absolute error against matched boosting by 1.11%, 4.41%, and 1.63% on PVDAQ, OPSD, and Ausgrid; only OPSD remains supported after multiple-comparison correction. Weather gating offers no consistent incremental benefit. Exploratory member removals show group-level dependence alongside individual redundancy. A separate, previously inspected fifteen-minute case replaces one neural member with a tree predictor: normalized error falls by 1.72%, but measured inference is slower. These findings support component-wise evaluation with explicit limits on weather availability and test-set reuse.

</details>


### [506] [Not All Prompts Are Equal: Exploration-Guided Prompt Scaffolding for Multimodal Reinforcement Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15051)
*Yuanhao Yue,Qianli Ma,Chengyu Wang,Haoting Wang,Lei Shen,Jun Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出探索引导的提示脚手架框架，用EPS自适应调整训练提示分布，提升MLLM的RL后训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线RL中训练提示的信息量差异大：部分已饱和、部分过难，但标准训练给它们相同采样预算，浪费资源且学习信号差。

Method: 基于KL正则化策略改进理论提出Exploration Potential Score (EPS)，用on-policy rollout统计直接计算提示效用；对低效用提示不丢弃，而由教师模型生成保留原任务意图的脚手架改写，把教师监督重新定义为训练数据精炼；与GRPO结合。

Result: 在Geo3K和MMK12上稳定优于基线，域内相对提升最高9.7%；MathVision提升11.5%，MMMU-Pro提升11.1%。

Conclusion: 动态调整提示分布并将教师模型用于数据精炼，能有效提升多模态大模型RL后训练的域内与OOD表现。

Abstract: Training prompts in online reinforcement learning (RL) differ substantially in how informative they are for the current policy: some are already saturated while others are too difficult to yield reliable learning signals, yet both receive equal rollout budget under standard training. We propose an exploration-guided prompt scaffolding framework that adapts the training prompt distribution dynamically throughout RL post-training of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Central to our approach is the $\textit{Exploration Potential Score} (EPS)$, a lightweight rollout-based proxy for prompt utility derived from KL-regularized policy improvement theory, computable directly from on-policy rollout statistics without additional overhead. Rather than discarding low-utility prompts, we use a teacher model to generate scaffolded rewrites that preserve the original task intent while making subsequent training more informative, reframing teacher supervision as training-data refinement rather than output imitation. Integrated with GRPO on Geo3K and MMK12, our method consistently outperforms the baseline on both in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks, achieving up to 9.7\% relative improvement in-domain and gains of 11.5\% on MathVision and 11.1\% on MMMU-Pro.

</details>


### [507] [What Does an LLM Learn from Reinforcement Learning? A Mechanistic Interpretability Perspective with Fixed-SAE Track](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15064)
*Lingheng Du,Yiming Tang,Xufeng Duan,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Fixed-SAE Track 框架，通过共享 SAE 追踪 RL 训练前后 LLM 内部表征变化，发现 RL 主要增强已有特征（如格式标记），而非创造新特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对 RL 如何改变 LLM 的解释多停留在行为层面，缺乏对表征层面的理解：RL 能否创造全新特征、增强或抑制哪些已有特征尚不清楚；而现有 SAE 无法直接用于跨训练过程追踪变化。

Method: 提出 Fixed-SAE Track：对每个层在基础模型与所有 RL checkpoint 的汇总激活上训练一个共享 SAE，固定所有特征方向，通过可解释 SAE latent 的激活来严格定义表征漂移，包括检测新出现的特征；并在多数据集、多 RL 算法上验证，另设计特征已知的合成基准测试 RL 能否植入全新特征。

Result: RL 引起的漂移较小、渐进、概念特定且集中于后层，主要提升少量"阶梯 token"（如步骤分隔符、答案定界符等格式脚手架）的采样率，而非重塑问题内容；将这些特征引导学生模型可获得约 80% 的 RL 性能增益。

Conclusion: RL 主要激发模型已有的能力（类似 steering），而非创造新特征；Fixed-SAE Track 为追踪表征变化提供了有原则的方法，并为理解 RL 如何改变 LLM 内部表征提供了证据。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely utilized in large language model training to improve targeted capabilities, yet how RL reshapes a model remains poorly understood. Prior attempts to explain how RL works largely offer behavioral perspectives, leaving open what RL gives a model at the representation level: can RL create genuinely novel features, and which existing features does it enhance or suppress? Recent developments in mechanistic interpretability suggest sparse autoencoders (SAEs) as a promising lens to decompose internal activations into human-interpretable features; however, they cannot be directly applied to tracking change across training. In this work, we introduce Fixed-SAE Track, a framework that trains one shared SAE per considered layer on activations pooled across the base model and all RL checkpoints, holding every feature direction fixed so that representation shifts are rigorously defined through the activations of interpretable SAE latents, including the detection of emerging novel features. Validated across multiple datasets and RL algorithms, we find that RL-induced drift is small, gradual, concept specific, and concentrated in late layers, mainly enhancing the sampling rates of a small set of ladder tokens, formatting scaffolding such as step breaks and answer delimiters, rather than reshaping problem content. Steering these features into the base model recovers around 80% of RL's performance gain, suggesting that RL primarily elicits capabilities the model already possesses, much as steering does. We further design a synthetic benchmark with features known by construction to test whether RL can instill genuinely novel features. We believe Fixed-SAE Track provides a principled approach to tracking representation shifts and offers representational evidence for understanding how reinforcement learning changes the inner representation of LLMs.

</details>


### [508] [Sensory Precision Inference for Multimodal Arbitration under Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15065)
*Tin Mišić,Takato Horii*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多模态感知推理模型，通过迭代自由能最小化联合更新潜在信念和模态特异性感觉精度，研究动态精度推断在多模态冲突下的生成式仲裁作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体面对的多感官数据常被噪声、缺失或模态间不一致所破坏，需要在竞争性感觉假设间自适应仲裁。主动推理虽提供不确定性引导的推理框架，但动态推断的感觉精度在多模态冲突下的生成式仲裁作用仍研究不足。

Method: 构建多模态感知推理模型，潜在信念与模态特异性感觉精度通过迭代自由能最小化联合更新；感觉精度动态既反映感觉不确定性，又主动塑造冲突时的潜在信念演化。引入对感觉精度的学习先验，诱导类别相关的结构化精度模式，影响跨模态推理动态。使用合成多模态MNIST数据集（视觉、听觉、触觉）在受控噪声与模态不一致下评估。

Result: 动态精度推断在损坏感觉证据下提升重建鲁棒性，支持从减少的感觉证据中进行连贯潜在推断，并实现冲突模态间的稳定仲裁。学习到的精度先验产生可解释的精度结构，塑造推理动态和跨模态潜在结构。

Conclusion: 感觉精度推断是不确定性下自适应多模态信念形成的机制性控制过程，精度动态是实现鲁棒且可解释多感官整合的计算机制。

Abstract: Autonomous agents operating on multisensory data cannot assume that all sensory modalities remain consistently informative. In real environments, sensory streams are frequently corrupted by noise, missing data, or inter-modal incongruence, requiring adaptive arbitration between competing sensory hypotheses. While active inference provides a principled framework for uncertainty-guided inference, the role of dynamically inferred sensory precision in generative multimodal arbitration under sensory conflict remains comparatively underexplored. We propose a multimodal perceptual inference model in which latent beliefs and modality-specific sensory precisions are jointly updated through iterative free-energy minimization. In our proposed model, sensory precision dynamics not only reflect sensory uncertainty but actively shape the evolution of latent beliefs during multimodal conflict. In addition, we introduce a learned prior over sensory precisions that induces structured, class-dependent precision patterns and influences cross-modal inference dynamics. We evaluate the model using a synthetic multimodal MNIST dataset combining visual, auditory, and tactile representations of digit classes under controlled sensory noise and inter-modal incongruence. Results show that dynamic precision inference improves reconstruction robustness under corrupted sensory evidence, supports coherent latent inference from reduced sensory evidence, and enables stable arbitration between conflicting modalities. Furthermore, learned precision priors generate interpretable precision structures that shape inference dynamics and cross-modal latent structure. These findings support sensory precision inference as a mechanistic control process for adaptive multimodal belief formation under uncertainty, highlighting precision dynamics as a computational mechanism for robust and interpretable multisensory integration.

</details>


### [509] [Branched Optimal Transport Amortization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15072)
*Semyon Semenov,Viktor Kovalchuk,Meir Roketlishvili,Albert Baichorov,Fakhri Karray,Martin Takac,Arip Asadulaev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可扩展的分支流匹配算法，在高维空间中求解分支最优传输问题，学习具有分支结构的高维生成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然界的树状结构（河流、血管等）体现"规模经济"的高效性，但分支最优传输（BOT）在大规模深度生成模型领域研究不足。标准连续时间生成模型（如流匹配）无法捕捉真实数据中固有的层次与分支模式，缺乏让流合并或共享路径以降低总传输成本的机制。

Method: 受BOT"规模经济"原理启发，将Benamou-Brenier连续时间最优传输公式推广，构建分支生成流。概率质量可沿公共路径聚集后再分支至不同目标。模型由神经网络参数化，学习复杂的分支生成过程，并具可扩展性以处理高维问题。

Result: 在生物学与图像生成等高维挑战性任务上验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作将分支最优传输引入大规模深度生成建模，提出的分支流匹配算法能有效学习高维分支生成过程，弥补了现有连续时间生成模型在分支结构建模上的空白。

Abstract: Methods of Branched Optimal Transport (BOT) mimic the economy and efficiency of natural tree-like structures, such as those found in rivers and biological systems. These methods are widely applicable for designing efficient networks in society, from river basins and blood vessels to mail and gas distribution systems. However, they remain understudied in the context of designing deep generative models, particularly at a large scale. Standard continuous-time generative models, such as the flow matching approach, fail to capture the inherent hierarchical and branching patterns present in real-world data. Current models provide no mechanism for flows to merge or share pathways to minimize total transport cost. Inspired by the "economy of scale" principle in BOT, we introduce a novel, scalable branched flow-matching algorithm designed to solve the branched optimal transport problem in high dimensions. Our method adapts the Benamou-Brenier continuous-time optimal transport formulation to learn branched generative flows. These flows allow probability mass to aggregate along common pathways before branching out to diverse targets. Parametrized by neural networks, our method effectively learns complex branched generative processes. We demonstrate its effectiveness on challenging high-dimensional tasks in biology and image generation.

</details>


### [510] [Ensemble-Conditioned Molecular Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15077)
*Ross Irwin,Alessandro Tibo,Jon Paul Janet,Simon Olsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将分子设计重定义为对构象系综的模式与性质进行优化，提出系综条件引导框架，可同时以多种条件调制3D分子生成模型，并在双靶点结合剂与活性态选择性激动剂设计中验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分子设计假设分子采用单一生物活性构象，但实际上分子处于构象分布中，决定候选分子是否可行的许多性质取决于整个分布而非单一构象。因此需要新的设计范式来同时优化构象系综的模式与整体性质。

Method: 提出系综条件引导（ensemble-conditioned guidance），在推理时自适应组合各条件产生的向量场，条件可被追求或规避、跨模态混合、任意数量组合。引入自适应对称学习以组合不同参考系的条件，并扩展生成框架支持可变尺寸生成。采用基于3D分子生成模型的方法。

Result: 在多模式条件与系综性质优化的新基准上进行了评估；应用于双靶点结合剂设计和活性态选择性激动剂设计两个实际药物发现任务，两者中额外的状态条件相比单状态条件均改善了目标结果。

Conclusion: 该工作将分子设计从单一构象范式拓展为构象系综优化，统一的生成框架能以单模型完成多种设计任务，并证明状态条件对实际药物设计任务具有增益。

Abstract: Molecular design is typically approached as a problem of finding molecules which can adopt a single bioactive conformation. In reality, molecules occupy a distribution over conformations, and many of the properties which determine whether a candidate is viable depend on that distribution rather than on any single conformer. We reframe molecular design as an optimisation of both the modes and properties of molecules' conformational ensembles, where modes can be represented as shapes, pharmacophore profiles or protein pockets, and properties are aggregate scalars computed over the whole distribution. To realise this we introduce ensemble-conditioned guidance, a framework which conditions 3D molecular generative models on both axes simultaneously. Mode conditions are composed adaptively at inference by combining the vector fields produced under each condition. Conditions may be targeted or avoided, mixed across modalities and combined in arbitrary numbers, allowing a wide range of design tasks to be expressed with a single trained model. We introduce adaptive symmetry learning to allow conditions from different reference frames to be composed, and extend our generative framework to enable flexible-size generation. We evaluate on new benchmarks for multi-mode conditioning and ensemble property optimisation, and apply the framework to two practical drug discovery tasks, dual-target binder design and active-state-selective agonist design, where in both cases conditioning on the additional state improves the desired outcome over single-state conditioning.

</details>


### [511] [$\mathbb{SL}(n)$ Representation Learning: An Intrinsic Mixed-Curvature Space with Higher Curvature Capacities and Deeper Order-Aware Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15083)
*Xingrun Li,Yusuke Mukuta,Xin Yang,Yinyu Ye,Tatsuya Harada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SL(n)表示空间，用极简约束det(A)=1结合左不变Schatten-p Finsler结构，实现统一空间中同时具备点wise混合曲率、曲率耦合与有序组合能力，并在图基准上全面超越现有流形基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合曲率表示学习依赖乘积流形，需手动指定不同曲率空间的组合方式，且将曲率贡献分离到各因子上，难以自然地耦合曲率并刻画有序结构。

Method: 提出由det(A)=1简单约束定义的SL(n)空间，赋予左不变Schatten-p Finsler结构；利用其非交换群结构实现内在的顺序敏感性，借助非幂零Lie代数支持任意深度的嵌套Lie括号，从而进行深层有序组合。

Result: SL(n)在多个图基准上一致优于广泛的表示流形基线：KEGG上平均失真较最强基线降低44.3%，HumanCyc降低40.5%，OGBL-PPA的Hits@20提升42.8%；Flickr30k-Order实验进一步支持其捕捉高阶有序依赖的能力。

Conclusion: 一个看似简单的结构约束即可产生出乎意料的丰富几何、容量与组合能力，为统一表示空间中的混合曲率建模提供了新路径。

Abstract: Mixed-curvature representation learning seeks to capture rich geometric structures that cannot be adequately modeled by a single curvature regime. Existing approaches largely rely on product manifolds, which require manually specifying how different curvature spaces are combined and separate their curvature contributions across factors. We introduce the $\mathbb{SL}(n)$ space, a representation geometry defined by the simple $\det(A)=1$ constraint and a left invariant Schatten-$p$ Finsler structure. Despite this minimal construction, $\mathbb{SL}(n)$ exhibits pointwise negative, zero, and positive flag curvature around a common flagpole, while its mixed-curvature and curvature-coupling capacities are asymptotically maximal relative to the intrinsic geometric upper bound. Beyond geometry, its noncommutative group structure provides inherent order sensitivity, and its non-nilpotent Lie algebra admits nonzero nested Lie brackets at arbitrary depth, enabling deep order-aware composition. Empirically, $\mathbb{SL}(n)$ consistently outperforms a broad range of representation manifold baselines across graph benchmarks at different scales. It reduces average distortion over the strongest baselines by $44.3\%$ on KEGG and $40.5\%$ on HumanCyc, and improves Hits@20 by $42.8\%$ on OGBL-PPA. Experiments on Flickr30k-Order further support its ability to capture higher order dependencies from ordered composition. Together, these results show how a seemingly simple structural constraint can yield unexpectedly rich geometry, capacity, and composition within a unified representation space.

</details>


### [512] [Beyond Numerical Time Series: A Unified Benchmark for Multimodal Forecasting with Heterogeneous Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15087)
*Peng Chen,Zhihao Zhuang,Hongzhou Chen,Junhao Huang,Aiping Yang,Mengsen Wu,Yiding Liu,Xilin Dai,Zewei Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MUSE-Bench，一个统一的多模态时间序列预测基准，涵盖八领域十四数据集和六类上下文，系统评测统计、专用、基础、多模态及LLM等预测范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序预测基准以数值为中心，对影响真实动态的上下文信息支持有限；多模态基准则数据与上下文覆盖不足、评测碎片化、过度依赖聚合评估。

Method: 构建MUSE-Bench，包含八领域十四个数据集与六类上下文（元数据、事件、节假日、新闻、图像、数值协变量），在统一非重叠预测窗口、共同目标观测和一致的点预测与概率指标下评测多样预测范式。

Result: 数值时序基础模型总体排名领先；多模态基础模型Aurora落后领先数值TSFM但优于所有专用模型；消融显示外部上下文提升四个上下文感知模型，而错误或时间错位上下文降低性能；通用LLM直接预测表现差，LLM引导的精炼无一致提升。

Conclusion: MUSE-Bench实现了对预测模型如何利用上下文的系统评估，为未来多模态预测研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Most time series forecasting benchmarks remain numerical-centric and provide limited support for evaluating contextual information that shapes real-world temporal dynamics. Existing multimodal benchmarks also suffer from limited data and context coverage, fragmented evaluation settings, and overreliance on aggregate evaluation. In this paper, we propose \textbf{MUSE-Bench}, a unified benchmark for multimodal time series forecasting with heterogeneous context. It comprises fourteen datasets across eight domains and six types of context: metadata, events, holidays, news, images, and numerical covariates. We evaluate diverse forecasting paradigms, including statistical, data-specific, foundation, multimodal, and general-purpose LLM forecasting methods under shared non-overlapping forecast windows, common target observations, and consistent point and probabilistic metrics. Extensive experiments yield three main findings. First, numerical time series foundation models dominate the overall ranking, while Aurora, the evaluated multimodal foundation model, trails the leading numerical TSFMs but outperforms all evaluated data-specific models. Second, ablations show that external context improves the four evaluated context-aware models, whereas incorrect or temporally misaligned context degrades performance. Third, general-purpose LLMs perform poorly as direct forecasters, and LLM-guided refinement does not yield consistent improvements. MUSE-Bench enables systematic evaluation of how forecasting models utilize context and provides a foundation for future multimodal forecasting research.

</details>


### [513] [Refinement-based Flow Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15123)
*Bumgeun Park,Hyukjun Yang,Donghwan Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RFPO通过交替进行Q引导的样本精炼与自目标流匹配，在无需从隐式目标分布直接采样的情况下训练在线RL流策略，能捕获多模态动作分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于流的策略表达力强，但传统流匹配需要从目标分布采样；当动作分布仅由Q函数隐式定义时，直接采样通常不可行。

Method: 先用当前流策略从高斯噪声生成动作，经有限步随机精炼将其推向Q函数诱导的能量分布；再将精炼动作与其初始噪声配对作为固定目标进行流匹配训练，反复迭代将Q引导注入策略。

Result: 在6个连续控制任务上几乎全部达到或超越标准高斯策略基线；在6个几何形态多样的二维合成目标分布上成功捕获复杂多模态结构且无模式崩溃。作者还给出了分布动态的理论分析。

Conclusion: RFPO无需直接采样即可实现Q引导的流策略优化，兼具多模态表达能力，理论与实验均得到验证。

Abstract: Flow-based policies offer an expressive representation for online reinforcement learning, but conventional flow matching requires samples drawn from the distribution to be modeled. This poses a challenge when the desired action distribution is defined only implicitly by a Q-function, since directly sampling actions from the resulting distribution is generally intractable. We propose Refinement-Based Flow Policy Optimization (RFPO), a novel framework for training a flow policy in online reinforcement learning by alternating between Q-guided sample refinement and self-target flow matching. RFPO first generates actions from Gaussian noise using the current flow policy and then uses a finite-step stochastic refinement procedure to move them toward an energy-based distribution induced by the Q-function. Each refined action is then paired with its corresponding initial noise sample and used as a fixed target for flow-matching training. By repeatedly refining its own outputs and learning from the resulting targets, RFPO incorporates Q-guidance into the policy without requiring direct samples from the target distribution, while retaining the capacity to represent multiple action modes. We further provide a theoretical analysis of the distributional dynamics induced by RFPO. Across six continuous-control tasks, RFPO matches or outperforms a standard Gaussian-policy baseline on almost every task. Experiments on six synthetic two-dimensional target distributions with diverse geometries demonstrate that RFPO captures complex multimodal structure without mode collapse.

</details>


### [514] [Omni-Streaming Thinking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15128)
*Enjun Du,Siyi Liu,Ziyu Zheng,Jingyu Li,Yiwen Guo,Yongqi Zhang,Difan Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OST框架解决流式全模态模型的"过早跨模态承诺"问题，通过结构化输出、独立证据存储与验证-反驳机制提升性能，并构建OST-DiagBench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式全模态模型需在观察到的视频块与同步音频中决定回答什么、何时回答。视觉线索常在语音或声音事件完成前就支持某种解释；若该解释作为事实进入记忆，后续推理会持续传递它，即使音频随后与之矛盾。作者称此为"过早跨模态承诺"失败。

Method: 提出Omni-Streaming Thinking (OST)，生成结构化输出：当前观察到的证据、对未来证据的预测、以及基于证据的主张。每个主张初始标记为pending并关联未来验证区间。音视频证据分开存储，在验证区间结束时用指定模态的证据核验主张。检测到矛盾证据时，反驳过程降低该主张及依赖状态的影响，并用新证据引导状态更新。答案门控决定关键主张是否满足回答条件。基于冻结的Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct骨干并轻量适配。

Result: 在五个流式与音视频基准上，比最强开源基线平均相对提升超过10%。引入OST-DiagBench，固定视频、编辑音频以测试一致、缺失、矛盾、共存和字幕-语音冲突。OST达到d-prime=2.95，开源基线最高仅1.38，同时减少视觉诱发的听觉幻觉。

Conclusion: OST有效缓解过早跨模态承诺，提升流式全模态推理性能并减少跨模态幻觉，为流式全模态模型提供可验证的证据-主张管理机制。

Abstract: Streaming omni-modal models must decide what and when to answer from the video chunks and synchronized audio observed so far. Visual cues often support an interpretation before an utterance or sound event is complete. If that interpretation enters memory as a fact, later reasoning can keep relaying it even after audio contradicts it. We call this failure premature cross-modal commitment. We propose Omni-Streaming Thinking (OST), which generates structured outputs that include evidence observed so far, forecasts of future evidence, and claims based on this evidence. Each claim is initially marked as pending and linked to a future verification interval. Audio and visual evidence are stored separately, and OST checks a claim against the evidence from the specified modality at the end of the verification interval. When contradictory evidence is detected, a refutation process reduces the influence of the claim and its dependent states, and then guides a state update using the new evidence. An answer gate decides whether the answer-critical claims meet the conditions for giving a response. Using a frozen Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct backbone with lightweight adaptation, OST outperforms the strongest open baselines on five streaming and audio-visual benchmarks by more than 10% relative on average. We also introduce OST-DiagBench, which holds video fixed and edits audio to test agreement, absence, contradiction, coexistence, and subtitle-speech conflict. OST reaches d-prime = 2.95, compared with at most 1.38 for open baselines, while reducing vision-induced auditory hallucinations.

</details>


### [515] [Multi-source Transfer Learning of Time Series with a Shapelet-based Distance Measure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15148)
*Jiseok Lee,Brian Kenji Iwana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练的Shapelet Matching源选择方法，并用多源预训练降低负迁移风险，在128个UCR数据集上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列分类中迁移学习依赖源数据集选择，而传统可迁移性评估方法需对每个候选源完整预训练模型，计算成本高昂。

Method: 先从目标与候选源数据集中提取判别性shapelet，通过比较shapelet集合量化数据集相似度（免训练）；再依据相似度分数选取多个源数据集，合并为多源数据集进行预训练，最后在目标任务上微调。

Result: 在UCR Archive的128个数据集上，用时间CNN和Transformer架构评估。多源预训练平均降低了负迁移风险；Shapelet Matching在CNN骨干上取得最强性能，在patch-based Transformer上保持竞争力，且无需为每个候选源单独预训练模型。

Conclusion: Shapelet Matching是一种高效、免训练的源选择方法，多源预训练能有效缓解负迁移，在保证性能的同时显著节省计算成本。

Abstract: Transfer learning is an effective technique for addressing data scarcity in deep learning for time series classification, but its success depends on the selection of source datasets. Conventional transferability estimation methods are often computationally expensive, as they require fully pre-training a model on each potential source dataset to assess its suitability. This paper introduces a novel, training-free source selection method named Shapelet Matching. Our approach first identifies discriminative shapelets from the target and potential source datasets. Then, Shapelet Matching quantifies dataset similarity by comparing the extracted sets of shapelets. To mitigate the risk of negative transfer from selecting an unsuitable single source, we introduce a multi-source transfer learning method. We select several source datasets based on their shapelet-based similarity scores, combine them into a single multi-source dataset, and use this aggregated dataset for pre-training. The model is then fine-tuned on the target task. We evaluated our method on 128 datasets from the UCR Archive using both temporal CNN and Transformer architectures. The empirical results demonstrate that our multi-source pre-training reduces the risk of negative transfer on average. Shapelet Matching achieves the strongest performance for the CNN backbone and remains competitive for patch-based Transformer architectures, while avoiding the cost of pre-training a separate model for every candidate source.

</details>


### [516] [Nearly Minimax-Optimal Regret for Linear Contextual Bandits with Arbitrary Adaptive Action Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15170)
*Tianyuan Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究任意动作菜单的随机线性上下文bandit，建立上下界匹配的遗憾界，在$2\le K\le d$时达到$\widetilde O(K^{1/4}\sqrt{dT})$，在$K\ge d$时改进标准$d\sqrt T$率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典$ \widetilde O(\sqrt{dKT})$ 界对菜单大小 $K$ 的依赖并非最优，尤其当动作菜单可依赖参数和历史时，需重新刻画 $K$ 的最优多项式依赖。

Method: 针对动作菜单任意且可依赖固定参数与交互历史的随机线性上下文bandit，建立匹配的上界与下界（相差对数因子），分析不同 $K$ 与 $d$ 关系下的最优遗憾依赖。

Result: $2\le K\le d$ 且 $T\ge d^2$ 时，上下界均为 $\widetilde O(K^{1/4}\sqrt{dT})$，比先前 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dKT})$ 改进 $K^{1/4}$；$K\ge d$ 时上界 $\widetilde O_{d,T}(\sqrt{dT}\min\{\sqrt d,(d\log K)^{1/4}\})$，下界为 $\Omega(\sqrt{dT}\min\{\sqrt d,(d\log K/\log(2d))^{1/4}\})$，多项式大 $K$ 时达 $d^{3/4}\sqrt T$，改进 $d^{1/4}$。

Conclusion: 该工作给出任意动作菜单随机线性上下文bandit的最优遗憾刻画：小菜单时对 $K$ 的依赖最优，大菜单时显著改进标准 $d\sqrt T$ 率，并在 $\log K$ 达 $d$ 阶时平滑恢复 $d\sqrt T$。

Abstract: We study stochastic linear contextual bandits with arbitrary action menus that may depend on the fixed parameter and the interaction history. We establish matching upper and lower bounds, up to logarithmic factors. Let $d$ be the dimension, $K$ be the menu size, and $T$ the time horizon. For $2\le K\le d$, we prove an upper bound $\widetilde O(K^{1/4}\sqrt{dT})$. When $T\ge d^2$, we further prove a lower bound $Ω(K^{1/4}\sqrt{dT})$. Thus, for $T\ge d^2$ and $2\le K\le d$, the upper and lower bounds match up to logarithmic factors, and the polynomial dependence on $K$ is optimal. Compared with the previous $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dKT})$ bound, our upper bound improves the dependence on $K$ by a factor of $K^{1/4}$.
  For $K\ge d$, we prove an upper bound $\widetilde O_{d,T}\left(\sqrt{dT}\min\{\sqrt d,(d\log K)^{1/4}\}\right)$ and a lower bound $Ω\left(\sqrt{dT}\min\left\{\sqrt d,\left(\frac{d\log K}{\log(2d)}\right)^{1/4}\right\}\right)$. Here, $\widetilde O_{d,T}$ omits logarithmic factors only in $d$ and $T$. In particular, for polynomially large $K\ge d$, the upper and lower bounds both scale as $d^{3/4}\sqrt T$ up to logarithmic factors, improving the standard $\widetilde O(d\sqrt T)$ rate by a factor of $d^{1/4}$. As $K$ grows further, the regret smoothly recovers the $d\sqrt T$ scale once $\log K$ reaches order $d$.

</details>


### [517] [Temporal Self-Distillation: Faster Inference in Discrete Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15177)
*Shijian Xu,Andrea Miele,Metod Jazbec,Volker Roth,Eric Nalisnick,Ilija Bogunovic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Temporal Self-Distillation (TSD)，一种on-policy方法，通过让dLLM早期时间步的预测分布蒸馏后期最终提交步的分布，实现更激进的并行解码以加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型(dLLMs)能并行生成多个token实现快速推理，但并行解码过于激进时性能严重下降。

Method: TSD蒸馏模型在较早时间步的去噪分布，向token最终确定时间步的分布对齐，促使早期预测更好预测最终输出。教师信号来自模型自身，无需离线教师生成，可无缝适用于基座和后续训练策略。

Result: 在数学、规划和代码的七个基准上，TSD显著将速度-质量前沿推向低计算区间，加速效果可与离线蒸馏媲美。

Conclusion: TSD提供了一种简单、单阶段的dLLM加速方法，避免了复杂的两阶段流程。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) promise fast inference by generating multiple tokens in parallel, but suffer severe performance degradation when parallel decoding is pushed too aggressively. We introduce Temporal Self-Distillation (TSD), a simple on-policy method that trains dLLMs for fast inference by distilling predictions across time. Specifically, TSD distills the model's denoising distribution at earlier timesteps toward its distribution at the final timestep at which a token is committed. This encourages earlier predictions to better anticipate the model's eventual output, enabling much more aggressive parallel decoding. Because its teacher signal comes from the model itself, TSD requires no offline teacher generation and applies seamlessly to both base and post-trained policies. Across seven benchmarks in mathematics, planning, and code, TSD substantially shifts the speed--quality frontier toward the low-compute regime. TSD thus provides a simple, single-stage approach to accelerating dLLMs, achieving speedups competitive with offline distillation while avoiding a complex two-stage pipeline.

</details>


### [518] [Rethinking Correctness for Uncertainty Estimation in Clinical Prediction with Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15180)
*Mingcheng Zhu,Jinning Liang,Tingting Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出双轴框架评估临床预测中"正确性判据"的质量，发现判据选择会显著影响不确定性估计(UE)的结论，呼吁在比较UE方法前先验证判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在临床预测中日益普及，识别不可靠预测对安全部署至关重要；UE可检测此类预测，但其评估依赖"正确性判据"，若该判据与人类判断不符，会导致关于模型可靠性的结论产生误导。

Method: 提出双轴框架，从"与人类判断的一致性"和"对人类参照UE性能的保真度"两个维度评估判据；在3个临床预测任务、3个模型上评估8种判据，使用450条经两位评审标注的预测，并在4种UE方法、23254条预测上测试。

Result: 规范精确匹配(EM)人类一致性最高、UE扭曲最低；BERT匹配(BEM)与LLM-judge一致性也较强。判据选择使错误检测AUROC变化最高达0.146，甚至逆转UE方法排名；LLM-judge会选择性接受无效/不确定输出（30个已识别错误中接受了16个）。

Conclusion: 正确性评估是临床UE评估的组成部分，在比较UE方法前应对其进行验证。

Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly explored for clinical prediction from electronic health records and medical images, where identifying unreliable predictions is important for safe deployment. Uncertainty estimation (UE) enables detecting such predictions, but its evaluation depends on a correctness criterion that determines whether each model output is correct. If this criterion disagrees with human judgement or distorts downstream UE performance, conclusions about model reliability can be misleading. We introduce a two-axis framework that evaluates correctness criteria by their agreement with human judgements and fidelity to human-referenced UE performance. We assess eight criteria across three clinical prediction tasks and three models using 450 predictions annotated by two reviewers. Across the audited tasks, canonical exact matching (EM) achieved the highest observed human agreement and lowest UE distortion, while the BERT-based matching (BEM) and LLM-judge also showed strong human agreement. Across four UE methods and 23,254 clinical predictions, criterion choice changed error-detection AUROC by up to 0.146 and reversed the relative ranking of UE methods. The LLM-judge also selectively accepted invalid or uncertain outputs, accepting 16 of 30 such human-identified errors. These results demonstrate that correctness assessment is an integral component of clinical UE evaluation and should be validated before UE methods are compared.

</details>


### [519] [Convergence rates for generative drifting flows: fixed-scale obstructions and multihead acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15193)
*Arthur Stéphanovitch,Eddie Aamari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了drift模型在理想条件下的收敛问题，指出固定分辨率是导致收敛缓慢的关键瓶颈，并提出多头部方法恢复指数级收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Drift模型能单步生成样本，有望实现更快的生成式AI。论文关注在引入有限数据或优化效应之前，其内部drift过程在理想条件下能否快速收敛到目标分布。

Method: 分析drift过程的收敛速度与空间尺度处理方式的关系；发现单一固定分辨率会使目标分布的细尺度特征几乎不可见，导致收敛极慢；进而提出多头部方法，在连续的分辨率范围内组合尺度归一化信息。

Result: 证明多头部方法在标准参考分布附近能恢复指数级收敛速度。

Conclusion: 固定分辨率是drift模型的关键瓶颈，多头部尺度归一化方法为构建更快的单步生成模型提供了简单途径。

Abstract: Drifting models offer a promising route to faster generative AI: they perform gradual transport during training, while generating new samples in a single step. This paper asks whether the underlying drifting process can converge rapidly to a target distribution under ideal conditions, before finite-data or optimization effects are introduced. We show that its convergence rate depends critically on how it handles spatial scale. With a single fixed resolution, fine-scale features of the target can become nearly invisible, leading to extremely slow convergence. We introduce a multihead approach that combines scale-normalized information across a continuum of resolutions. We prove that this multihead approach restores exponential convergence near standard reference distributions. These results identify fixed resolution as a key bottleneck and provide a simple route to faster one-step generative models.

</details>


### [520] [ProtoGuide: Prototype-Driven Guidance for Class-Conditional Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15239)
*Salvatore Romano,Marco Grassia,Pietro Liò,Giuseppe Mangioni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ProtoGuide 是一种后验、与骨干无关的离散图扩散引导框架，通过将去噪器输出松弛为可微软邻接并用冻结的孪生 GNN 打分注入梯度，实现无需重训的条件生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准类条件机制在训练时把类别信号嵌入去噪器，导致条件机制与模型耦合；连续域中分类器引导可避免耦合，但离散图扩散采样离散边状态，梯度无法通过采样图传播。

Method: 在每个反向步，将去噪器逐边输出松弛为可微软邻接，用冻结的孪生 GNN 嵌入，并与目标类原型及其最近竞争者打分；所得逐边梯度经余弦调度阻尼后注入去噪器输出。所有组件保持冻结，换原型即可重定向引导。

Result: 在五类真实网络和 EDGE、DiGress 两种骨干上，宏分类准确率从 50.7% 提升到 73.5%，从 73.6% 提升到 83.8%，优于 DiGress 内置条件训练。无引导模型最弱处增益最大，但各类别不均衡；多数设置下图覆盖率仍高，分布效应因类而异。Best-of-N 需大量过采样才能匹配精度，但牺牲图多样性；独立初始化分类器、方向性测试和少样本分析支持目标导向引导及对极小支持集的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: ProtoGuide 提供了一种与骨干无关、后验可重定向的离散图扩散条件生成方案，在提升类别可控性的同时保持较高覆盖率，且对少样本支持集鲁棒。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models are a prominent family for graph generation, but standard class-conditional mechanisms embed the class signal in the denoiser during training, tying the conditioning mechanism to the trained model. Classifier guidance avoids this coupling in continuous domains by steering a frozen model with a classifier's gradient, but discrete graph diffusion samples discrete edge states, so gradients cannot propagate through the sampled graph. We introduce ProtoGuide, a post-hoc, backbone-agnostic framework that recovers an analogous mechanism. At each reverse step the denoiser's per-edge output is relaxed into a differentiable soft adjacency, embedded by a frozen Siamese graph neural network, and scored against a target-class prototype and its nearest competitor; the resulting per-edge gradient, damped by a cosine schedule, is injected back into the denoiser output. All components stay frozen, so guidance is retargeted by supplying a different prototype. On five classes of real-world networks and two architecturally different backbones, EDGE and DiGress, ProtoGuide raises macro classification accuracy from 50.7% to 73.5% and from 73.6% to 83.8%, and outperforms DiGress's built-in conditional training under our configuration. Gains are largest where the unguided models are weakest, and are not uniform across classes. Per-graph coverage remains high in most settings, while distributional effects are class-dependent. A Best-of-N selection baseline matches this accuracy given enough oversampling, but at a substantial cost in graph diversity. An independently initialized classifier, a directionality test, and a few-shot analysis support target-directed steering and robustness to very small support sets.

</details>


### [521] [BioDCASE: Active Learning for Bioacoustics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15255)
*Ben McEwen,Rupa Kurinchi-Vendhan,Shiqi Zhang,Lukas Rauch,Marek Herde,Sara Beery*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出2026 Active Learning for Bioacoustics BioDCASE挑战赛，系统评估生物声学监测中的主动学习采样方法，最优方法AULC比随机采样高26.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生态监测（尤其被动声学监测）数据量大但标注成本高，主动学习可筛选样本，但现有方法因模型、预算、指标、数据集不统一而难以公平比较。

Method: 组织BioDCASE 2026挑战赛，在四个陆地与海洋数据子集上，对来自7支团队的10种采样方法进行统一评估。

Result: 最优方法AULC平均比随机采样高26.4%；子集间差异显著（HSN提升67.1%，ATBFL仅8%）；多信号融合的提交排名靠前；多样性选择优于纯不确定性采样；从多样性转向不确定性并减少批次内冗余有助训练；大批量采集在标注后期可能更有益。

Conclusion: 该挑战赛为生物声学主动学习提供了系统基准，表明多信号融合、多样性优先及冗余控制是有效策略。

Abstract: Ecological monitoring increasingly relies on machine learning models, whose performance depends on the quality and quantity of labelled data. However, obtaining these labels is costly, particularly in passive acoustic monitoring, where vast amounts of data are collected but only a small proportion can feasibly be annotated. Active learning addresses this bottleneck by prioritizing which samples should be labelled. However, progress is difficult to measure, because published methods are evaluated under different models, budgets, evaluation metrics and datasets. To address this challenge, we present the 2026 Active Learning for Bioacoustics BioDCASE challenge: a systematic evaluation of sampling methods designed to identify effective AL strategies. Participant methods were evaluated across four subsets composed of terrestrial and marine data. Across ten proposed sampling methods from seven teams, the top-ranked method achieved an area under the learning curve 26.4 % higher than random sampling at the same annotation budget, averaged over four data subsets. Significant variation in performance was observed across subsets, with the top-performing submission achieving a 67.1 % gain for the HSN subset over random sampling and a gain of 8 % for the ATBFL subset. Top-ranking submissions combined multiple acquisition signals, and diversity-based selection outperformed pure uncertainty sampling. Furthermore, there is evidence that transitioning from diversity-based to uncertainty-based selection and explicitly reducing redundancy within acquisition batches improve model training. There is also initial evidence that larger acquisition batch sizes may be increasingly beneficial later in the labelling process.

</details>


### [522] [Learning CNF Formulas from Uniform Random Solutions: Near-Tight Sample Complexity for Valiant's Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15268)
*Weiming Feng,Yixiao Yu,Yiyao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视Valiant学习CNF公式的算法，在局部引理条件下分析其样本复杂度，证明了匹配下界并改进了样本复杂度界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Valiant提出学习CNF公式的经典算法，但其样本复杂度在局部引理条件下的最优性尚未完全明确，需要重新审视并确定紧确界。

Method: 对固定t≥1，在k≳(1+1/t)log d条件下，证明Valiant算法以总变差误差ε达到样本复杂度Õ(n^{⌈t⌉}/ε)，并构造匹配下界。

Result: 对t&gt;1证明Valiant算法的匹配下界；在t=1（涵盖0&lt;t&lt;1）时，通过信息论下界Ω̃(n/ε)证明Valiant算法样本复杂度达到最优（至多对数因子）。

Conclusion: Valiant算法在局部引理条件下的样本复杂度在t&gt;1时紧确，在t=1时接近最优，完善了该算法样本复杂度的理论刻画。

Abstract: We revisit Valiant's algorithm (Commun. ACM'84) for learning $n$-variable CNF formulas with clause size $k$ and variable degree $d$ from i.i.d. uniform random solutions in the local lemma regime. For fixed $t\geq1$, under $k\gtrsim(1+1/t)\log d$, Valiant's algorithm achieves total variation error $\varepsilon$ with $\widetilde{O}(n^{\lceil t \rceil}/\varepsilon)$ sample complexity. For $t>1$, we prove a matching lower bound for Valiant's algorithm. At $t=1$ (covering $0<t<1$), we show Valiant's algorithm has optimal sample complexity up to logarithmic factors by an information-theoretic lower bound $\widetildeΩ(n/\varepsilon)$.

</details>


### [523] [Draining Fictitious Knots: Restoring Distance-Awareness Guarantees for High-Dimensional Spline Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15274)
*Masoud Ataei,Mohammad Javad Khojasteh,Vikas Dhiman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对DAREK在高维下因"虚构结点"（fictitious knots）而违反距离感知的问题，提出"排流不确定性机制"（drainage），通过构造从虚构结点向最近真实结点单调递减的不确定性路径，恢复距离感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN结合样条激活在可解释函数逼近上有前景。DAREK为其提供高效的自底向上不确定性量化（距离感知误差界），但在高维场景下，由于其按分量分解的表述，组合输入空间中会出现不对应真实训练数据的"虚构结点"，诱导不确定性估计器在远离真实观测处报告低不确定性，破坏距离感知保证。

Method: 精确识别并刻画该失效模式的几何结构；提出drainage不确定性机制，从任意虚构结点区域向最近真实结点构造单调递减的不确定性路径，作为实用的启发式修正，在高维下恢复理论距离感知。

Result: 在2D合成基准与100维人脸数据集上，drainage将采样距离感知（SDA）从85%提升至98-99%，以更低计算成本达到高斯过程水平。

Conclusion: drainage方法有效缓解虚构结点失效模式，恢复高维下的距离感知，兼具理论合理性与实用效率。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) with spline activations have recently shown promise for interpretable function approximation. Distance-Aware Error for Kolmogorov Networks (DAREK) introduces a computationally efficient bottom-up approach to uncertainty quantification by equipping KANs with distance-aware error bounds; yet, in high-dimensional settings, the theoretical guarantees can be weakened by the emergence of fictitious knots. Inspired by the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem, DAREK adopts a componentwise formulation in which each input dimension is treated separately; as a result, induced knot locations may appear in the combined input space without corresponding to actual training data. These fictitious knots mislead the DAREK uncertainty estimator into reporting low uncertainty far from any real observation, violating the distance-awareness guarantee. We identify this failure mode precisely, characterize its geometric structure, and propose a drainage uncertainty mechanism that restores distance-awareness by constructing a monotonically decreasing uncertainty path from any fictitious knot region toward the nearest real knot. The proposed drainage method provides a practical heuristic correction that mitigates the fictitious-knot failure mode while restoring theoretical distance-awareness in high-dimensional settings. Experiments on a 2D synthetic benchmark and a 100-dimensional face dataset show that drainage raises sampled distance-awareness (SDA) from 85% to 98-99%, matching Gaussian processes at lower computational cost.

</details>


### [524] [Impute-EM: Native Mixed-State Diffusion Models for Heterogeneous Data Imputation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15284)
*Sergei Kholkin,Kirill Sokolov,Dmitry Baranchuk,Evgeny Burnaev,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Impute-EM，一种 EM 风格框架，交替用当前模型填补缺失值并在完整数据上重训原生混合状态扩散模型，避免 one-hot 松弛，在混合类型表格填补的分布保真度上取得最佳表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构数据中数值、类别、二元变量共存，缺失值普遍存在。现有扩散填补方法多用连续替代（如 one-hot 松弛）处理离散变量，导致模型状态空间与数据真实混合离散-连续结构不匹配。

Method: Impute-EM：EM 风格迭代框架，交替执行“用当前模型填补缺失项”和“在补全数据上重拟合扩散骨干”。用原生混合状态扩散骨干实例化，结合高斯分量与掩码类别分量，不做 one-hot 松弛。理论上刻画精确设定下的更新过程。

Result: 理论证明：观测到的掩码索引边缘分布在极限下与目标一致，同时明确说明从不完整观测中一般无法识别完整数据分布。实验上在混合类型表格填补的分布保真度上最优，下游建模受益；文本填补作为原生离散骨干的受控验证。

Conclusion: 原生建模离散变量并配合 EM 迭代可提升异构数据缺失填补的分布保真度，但需认识到完整数据分布从缺失观测中的不可识别性。

Abstract: Missing values are ubiquitous in heterogeneous data mining, where numerical, categorical, and binary variables often coexist. Many imputation methods, especially diffusion-based ones, treat discrete variables through continuous surrogates such as one-hot relaxations rather than modeling them natively. This creates a mismatch between the model state space and the mixed discrete and continuous structure of the data. We propose Impute-EM, an Expectation Maximization style framework that alternates between imputing missing entries with the current model and refitting a diffusion backbone on completed data. We instantiate Impute-EM with native mixed-state diffusion backbones for heterogeneous data, combining Gaussian and masked categorical components without one-hot relaxations. In exact settings, we characterize the update and show that the observed mask-indexed marginals match the targets at the limit, while making explicit that the full data distribution is generally non-identifiable from incomplete observations alone. Empirically, Impute-EM delivers the best distributional fidelity on mixed-type tabular imputation, on which downstream modeling relies, with text imputation serving as a controlled validation of the native discrete backbone.

</details>


### [525] [Generalization Can Emerge in Tabular Foundation Models From a Single Table](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.09665)
*Junwei Ma,Nour Shaheen,Alex Labach,Amine Mhedhbi,Frank Hutter,Anthony L. Caterini,Valentin Thomas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战"表格基础模型需大规模预训练"的普遍观点，发现仅在单张真实表格上做自监督预训练即可实现跨域强迁移，并指出任务数量与质量是关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前表格上下文学习模型（如TabPFN、TabDPT）普遍认为泛化需依赖大规模合成语料或大量真实数据预训练，成本高昂，作者质疑这一观点是否必要。

Method: 在单张真实表格上进行简单自监督预训练，并在大量异构数据集上系统性地预训练与评估，分析数据中哪些方面对跨域泛化最重要。

Result: 仅用单张表格预训练即可在异构基准上取得出人意料的强迁移效果；数据集可构建的任务数量与质量是决定下游性能的关键。

Conclusion: 泛化并不必然依赖大数据，少量数据即可；任务的数量和质量是表格基础模型跨域泛化的核心因素，为更高效的预训练范式提供依据。

Abstract: Deep tabular modelling increasingly relies on in-context learning where, during inference, a model receives a set of $(x,y)$ pairs as context and predicts labels for new inputs without weight updates. We challenge the prevailing view that broad generalization here requires pre-training on large synthetic corpora (e.g., TabPFN priors) or a large collection of real data (e.g., TabDPT training datasets), discovering that a relatively small amount of data suffices for generalization. We find that simple self-supervised pre-training on just a \emph{single} real table can produce surprisingly strong transfer across heterogeneous benchmarks. By systematically pre-training and evaluating on many diverse datasets, we analyze what aspects of the data are most important for building a Tabular Foundation Model (TFM) generalizing across domains. We then connect this to the pre-training procedure shared by most TFMs and show that the number and quality of \emph{tasks} one can construct from a dataset is key to downstream performance.

</details>


### [526] [Admissable: Training Reinforcement Learning Agents against Adversarial Missingness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15297)
*Paul Stahlhofen,Luca Hermes,Tim Kochs,Markus Vieth,Barbara Hammer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出对抗性特征缺失（adversarial feature missingness）的强化学习场景，形式化定义该问题，并开发对抗训练算法以提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为使强化学习算法适用于真实世界，需在不利条件下保证安全。其中一种挑战是对抗性特征缺失：对手遮挡观测特征以尽可能降低性能。

Method: 形式化定义强化学习中的对抗性缺失，将其与 ℓ∞ 范数有界对抗扰动及缺失数据学习进行对比；开发对抗训练算法。

Result: 在三个 MuJoCo 基准环境上验证，该方法相比使用随机均匀缺失的基线，在所有三个任务上均取得更好的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 对抗训练能有效提升强化学习对对抗性特征缺失的鲁棒性。

Abstract: In order to make Reinforcement Learning algorithms applicable in real world scenarios, safety must be ensured even under adverse operating conditions. In this work, we consider the challenge of adversarial feature missingness: a scenario in which an adversary occludes features from the agent's observation in order to reduce performance as much as possible. We formally define adversarial missingness for Reinforcement Learning and compare it to the related concepts of $\ell_\infty$-norm bounded adversarial perturbations and learning with missing data. We develop an adversarial training algorithm and show its effectiveness in increasing robustness against adversarial missingness on three MuJoCo benchmark environments. Compared to a baseline trained with random uniform missingness, our method achieves better robustness on all three tasks.

</details>


### [527] [When Correlations Mislead: Confounder-Aware Multi-View Urban Region Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15305)
*Sean Bin Yang,Ying Sun,Zongyi Xu,Tung Kieu,Jilin Hu,Bin Yang,Kristian Torp,Hua Lu,Torben Bach Pedersen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CURE：一种混淆感知的多视图城市区域表示学习框架，通过分离共享潜在混淆成分并减少其影响，提升跨视图融合的稳定性与预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多视图方法通过增强视图间交互来改进区域嵌入，但忽视了视图特有的区域结构，且会传播由共享潜在因子引发的相关性，导致下游预测稳定性下降。

Method: CURE首先为每个视图利用其区域图结构进行编码，估计一个共享潜在成分，并在跨视图交互前削减其投影影响；随后采用分层图感知融合模块，结合局部与全局区域上下文聚合残差视图表示。

Result: 在三个真实城市上的实验表明，CURE提升了预测性能，在视图缺失和含噪情况下保持鲁棒，并通过共享成分分离与上下文相关的视图加权实现可靠的跨视图整合。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模并去除共享混淆成分，CURE为多视图城市区域表示学习提供了更稳定、鲁棒且可解释的融合方案。

Abstract: Urban region representation learning commonly combines heterogeneous data sources, such as mobility flows, points of interest, and land-use information, to support tasks including mobility analysis, public safety forecasting, and service demand estimation. Existing multi-view methods typically improve region embeddings by strengthening interactions across views. However, such methods often overlook view-specific regional structures and may propagate correlations induced by shared latent factors, which can reduce the stability of downstream predictions. To overcome this major limitation, we propose CURE, a confounder-aware framework for multi-view urban region representation learning. CURE first encodes each view with its regional graph structure, estimates a shared latent component, and then reduces its projected influence before cross-view interaction. A hierarchical graph-aware fusion module subsequently aggregates the residual view representations using local and global regional contexts Experiments on three real-world cities show that CURE improves predictive performance, remains robust under missing and noisy input views, and provides reliable cross-view integration through shared component separation and context-dependent view weighting.

</details>


### [528] [The Universe of Universes: Benefit Yield Functions, Implosion Thresholds, and Infrastructure-Aware Optimization in Multi-LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15314)
*Danielle Franklin,Vasu Raj Jain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出UoU框架，将主流LLM生态视为结构化检索语料，建立组合式AR与ML架构实现跨模型RAG，并形式化"收益产出函数"BYF及集成崩塌阈值θ*。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM集成与混合智能体系统只把模型当作响应者并聚合输出，未研究性能随集成规模N的变化；基准研究仅证实单模型性能饱和，模型崩溃文献只讨论迭代训练退化，二者都未形式化集成层面的崩塌阈值，也未建模生态系统级知识遗传漂移，或将AI制造速度作为θ*的协变量。

Method: 提出Universe of Universes (UoU)框架：把整个主流LLM生态系统视为结构化检索语料，采用组合式自动推理(AR)与机器学习(ML)架构进行跨模型检索增强生成；形式化定义收益产出函数BYF（每增加一个模型带来的边际性能增益），并识别崩塌阈值θ*（BYF过零、总体性能开始下降的集成规模），同时建模生态系统级Epistemic Hereditary Drift (EHD)。

Result: 识别出崩塌阈值θ*，即BYF由正转负、集成性能开始退化的临界规模；将AI制造速度确立为θ*的协变量，并将EHD推广到生态系统层面。

Conclusion: 该框架对国防部多模型AI采办政策及AI系统测试科学具有直接意义。

Abstract: We introduce the Universe of Universes (UoU) framework, which treats the full ecosystem of major large language models (LLMs) as a structured retrieval corpus and proposes a compositional Automated Reasoning (AR) and Machine Learning (ML) architecture for cross-model retrieval-augmented generation. The central contribution is the formal characterization of the Benefit Yield Function (BYF), the marginal performance gain per additional model added to an ensemble, and the identification of the implosion threshold θ*: the ensemble size at which BYF crosses zero and aggregate performance begins to degrade. Existing LLM ensemble and mixture-of-agents systems treat models as responders and aggregate outputs, but do not study performance as a function of ensemble size N across the full model universe. Benchmark research confirms performance plateaus at the individual model level; model collapse literature establishes that iterative training on AI-generated outputs degrades individual model distributions. Neither body of work formalizes the ensemble-level implosion threshold, models Epistemic Hereditary Drift (EHD) at the ecosystem level, or treats AI manufacturing velocity as a co-variable of θ*. The framework has direct implications for DoD multi-model AI acquisition policy and the emerging science of testing AI-enabled systems.

</details>


### [529] [Robust and Efficient Communication for Multi-Agent Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15361)
*Rafael Pina,Varuna De Silva,Corentin Artaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MARC框架，基于条件互信息原理与注意力机制对消息进行正则化，在通信瓶颈和有损信道下显著优于现有MARL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习中，通信是分布式智能的核心，但如何保证生成的消息既具信息量又能鲁棒应对物理约束仍是难题；现实中的自主机器人网络和去中心化系统常面临通信瓶颈与有损信道。

Method: MARC受条件互信息的信息论原理启发，采用基于注意力的架构，并引入独特的消息正则化机制，最小化对未来系统状态的不确定性，从而诱导学习高代表性的通信协议。评估在严格的通信瓶颈与有损信道下进行。

Result: 在复杂协作任务中，MARC显著优于当前最先进方法；深度分析消息特性表明，即使在显著数据压缩下，MARC仍能保持高性能。

Conclusion: MARC为在资源受限环境中部署智能体提供了可扩展的路径，兼顾消息信息量与物理通信约束下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Effective communication is a cornerstone of distributed intelligence in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), yet ensuring that generated messages are both informative and robust to physical constraints remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Regularized Communication (MARC), a novel framework inspired by information-theoretic principles of conditional mutual information. MARC employs an attention-based architecture coupled with a unique message regularization mechanism designed to minimize uncertainty regarding future system states, thereby inducing the learning of highly representative communication protocols. Crucially, we evaluate MARC under stringent communication bottlenecks and lossy channels, simulating the real-world constraints of autonomous robotic networks and decentralized systems. Our results demonstrate that MARC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in complex cooperative domains. Furthermore, we provide a deep analysis of message characteristics, proving that MARC maintains high operational performance even under significant data compression, offering a scalable path for deploying intelligent agents in resource-constrained environments.

</details>


### [530] [Representing Clinical Conditions on Vital Signs from Healthy Individuals using Latent Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15379)
*Rafael Pina,Varuna De Silva,Mindula Illeperuma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于条件变分自编码器的深度生成模型，将健康个体的生命体征数据重塑为特定临床病症的模式，以解决医疗场景下缺乏代表性训练数据的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习在医疗等复杂信号处理中很关键，但模型训练需要丰富数据集，常无法获取有代表性的数据集。

Method: 基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的深度生成模型，用公开ICU数据集训练，再用健康个体生命体征数据评估；并提出一种距离度量来衡量生成样本与目标临床标签的对齐程度。

Result: 模型不仅能学习ICU数据的潜在动态，还能将健康个体数据重塑为与特定临床病症生命体征一致；相比基线方法，生成样本更符合目标临床标签。

Conclusion: 该生成模型可用于增强/重塑健康个体生命体征数据以模拟临床病症，缓解数据稀缺问题，且所提距离度量验证了其优于基线的标签对齐能力。

Abstract: Machine learning can be crucial to help scale complex signal processing applications in scenarios such as healthcare. However, these machine learning models need rich datasets to be trained and there are often cases where it is not possible to access representative datasets. In this paper, we propose a deep generative model based on conditional variational autoencoders with the objective of augmenting the vital signs of healthy individuals in a way that mimics the patterns of a certain clinical condition. More specifically, we use a publicly available ICU (Intensive Care Unit) dataset to train our model and then evaluate it using the vital data that we have collected from healthy individuals. Our results demonstrate that the proposed model can not only learn the underlying dynamics of the ICU data but, more importantly, can reshape our collected data from healthy individuals in a way that is aligned with the vital signs of a certain clinical condition. We propose a distance metric that shows how our model can generate samples that are more aligned with the intended clinical labels when compared to the tested baselines.

</details>


### [531] [CodeTS: Verifiable Text-to-Time Series Generation via Executable Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15393)
*Xudong Yuan,Shunyu Liu,Tongya Zheng,Huiping Zhuang,Mingli Song,Kaixuan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CodeTS框架，将Text-to-TS生成重构为Text-to-Code-to-TS过程，用可执行代码作为中间接口，结合对齐三元组监督初始化和多阶段执行奖励的RLVR，实现可验证的零样本文本到时间序列生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Text-to-TS方法缺乏从文本描述中推导生成逻辑的显式机制来指导时间序列合成，导致生成过程不可控、不可验证。

Method: 将Text-to-TS重构为Text-to-Code-to-TS：先把文本时间描述映射到显式代码空间，由可执行代码规定文本需求如何塑造目标时间模式，再通过代码执行获得时间序列。不含真实代码标注时，利用结构化时间属性构建对齐的Text-Code-TS三元组进行监督初始化；进一步设计多阶段基于执行的奖励，验证格式有效性、代码可执行性和时间序列质量，使真实Text-TS对能为RLVR提供训练信号。

Result: 在8个基准、覆盖短/中/长生成长度的实验表明，CodeTS提供强零样本方案，优于基于LLM的基线，平均结果超过在目标数据集上训练的监督生成基线。

Conclusion: 以代码作为中间生成接口并配合可验证奖励，能有效桥接文本与时间序列生成，CodeTS在零样本条件下即达到优于监督基线的效果。

Abstract: Text-to-Time Series Generation (Text-to-TS) provides a promising paradigm for synthesizing time series from natural language, enabling scenario-specific generation when real observations are scarce or costly to acquire. However, existing methods typically lack an explicit mechanism for deriving generation logic from textual descriptions to guide time series synthesis. In this paper, we propose CodeTS, a verifiable framework that uses code as an intermediate generation interface, reformulating Text-to-TS generation as a Text-to-Code-to-TS process. CodeTS first maps textual temporal descriptions into an explicit code space, where executable code specifies how textual requirements shape target temporal patterns, and then obtains the time series through code execution. To learn this code generation process reliably without real code annotations, CodeTS constructs aligned Text-Code-TS triplets from structured temporal attributes for supervised initialization. More importantly, we further design multi-stage execution-based rewards that verify format validity, code executability, and time series quality, enabling real Text-TS pairs to provide training signals for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks across short, medium, and long generation lengths demonstrate that CodeTS provides a strong zero-shot solution for Text-to-TS generation, outperforming LLM-based baselines and achieving better averaged results than supervised generative baselines trained on the target datasets.

</details>


### [532] [Single-condition neural solvers encode transferable response spaces for parametric differential equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15432)
*Wenbo Cao,Weiwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出线性化子空间迁移（LST）与主动迁移建模（ATM），利用单条件训练神经求解器的输出雅可比作为可复用响应空间，实现跨条件PDE解迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PDE算子学习需跨条件数据或昂贵物理约束训练，构建全局模型；论文寻求利用单条件模型的局部信息实现跨条件解，降低数据与训练成本。

Method: LST利用在单一条件下训练的神经解模型的输出雅可比定义响应空间，通过在该空间坐标上最小化目标PDE系统残差来恢复目标解；ATM以迁移后残差作为覆盖指标，选择性从额外单条件模型获取响应空间以增强表示能力。

Result: 在六个系统上，单条件响应空间支持跨条件迁移；空间增加提升精度。相比物理信息算子基线，ATM降低误差与离线构建成本，代表性案例有数量级精度提升，目标适配时间从毫秒到秒级。

Conclusion: 结果确立了神经求解器可作为可复用的局部参数模型，为跨条件PDE求解提供高效、低成本的新范式。

Abstract: Operator learning for parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) typically builds global models over prescribed domains, requiring cross-condition data or costly physics-constrained training. Here we show that the output Jacobian of a neural solution model trained at one condition defines a reusable response space for cross-condition solution variations. We introduce Linearized Subspace Transfer (LST) to exploit this space and recover target solutions by minimizing the target PDE-system residual over response-space coordinates. Because any single response space has finite coverage, Active Transfer Modeling (ATM) uses post-transfer residuals as coverage indicators to selectively acquire response spaces from additional single-condition models. Across six systems, single-condition response spaces supported cross-condition transfer, with enrichment improving accuracy when added spaces expanded representation capacity. Relative to evaluated physics-informed operator baselines, ATM reduced error and offline construction cost, with orders-of-magnitude accuracy gains in representative cases and millisecond-to-second target adaptation. These results establish neural solvers as reusable local parametric models.

</details>


### [533] [On the role of the tokenizer in ECG transformer models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15433)
*Jiawei Li,Fabio Bonassi,Johan Sundström,Thomas B. Schön,Antônio H. Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较了8种ECG分词策略在4种Transformer骨干上的表现，发现与ECG形态对齐的分词（Median-beat、HeartLang）在性能和内存效率上均优于逐点/分块分词。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分词决定了ECG Transformer接收的生理内容及注意力作用序列，但其对性能的影响尚未被系统研究。作者希望在不增加骨干容量的前提下，通过合理设计分词来同时提升预测性能与内存效率。

Method: 在CPSC2018九标签分类任务上，比较8种分词策略，跨Transformer、Informer、Reformer、FEDformer四种骨干；控制输入投影和主干容量以隔离分词构造的影响；并将两种生理感知表示进行池化。

Result: Median-beat与HeartLang分词在四个骨干上平均macro-AUC为0.893和0.889，而逐点和分块分词仅为0.822和0.824；池化两种生理感知表示带来8.2%的相对提升；平均序列长度从1250降至158，峰值训练内存从5.21GB降至0.27GB。

Conclusion: 将分词与ECG形态对齐，可在不增加骨干容量的情况下同时提升预测性能与内存效率。代码已开源。

Abstract: Tokenization determines both the physiological content presented to an ECG Transformer and the sequence over which attention operates. We compare eight tokenization strategies across Transformer, Informer, Reformer, and FEDformer on the nine-label CPSC2018 classification task. The input projection and principal backbone capacity are controlled to isolate the effect of token construction. Median-beat and HeartLang tokenization achieve mean macro-AUCs of 0.893 and 0.889 across the four backbones, compared with 0.822 and 0.824 for point-wise and patch-wise tokenization. Pooling the two physiology-aware representations yields an 8.2% relative improvement in macro-AUC. They also reduce mean sequence length from 1,250 to 158 tokens and mean peak training memory from 5.21 to 0.27 GB. The results show that aligning tokens with ECG morphology can improve both predictive performance and memory efficiency without increasing backbone capacity. The source code is available on https://github.com/LeeJarvis996/ecg_tokenizer.

</details>


### [534] [GSLAD: Prototype-Regularized Graph Structure Learning for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15483)
*Zepeng Zhang,Fuad Khuri,Keivan Faghih Niresi,Olga Fink*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GSLAD，一种原型正则化的图结构学习框架，利用结构偏差进行无监督多变量时间序列异常检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业故障可能先改变变量间的结构模式，而单变量轨迹仍接近正常，导致异常信号微弱，传统基于预测/重构/表示差异的方法难以捕捉。

Method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段用预测监督优化条件感知图学习器和图预测器；将推断的正常图聚类为多个结构原型（代表正常工况），并以边级变异性刻画结构不确定性；第二阶段用对原型的偏差正则化图学习器。推理时结合不确定性归一化的结构偏差与预测偏差进行异常打分。

Result: 在四个工业基准上取得强整体性能，并验证了结构偏差对异常检测与诊断的有效性。

Conclusion: GSLAD 表明结构偏差是有效的异常信号，原型正则化有助于学习稳定且工况特定的结构模式。

Abstract: Unsupervised multivariate time series anomaly detection methods typically identify anomalies through forecasting, reconstruction, or representation discrepancies. However, industrial faults may first alter inter-variable structural patterns while individual trajectories remain close to normal, resulting in weak anomaly signals. In this paper, we propose GSLAD, a prototype-regularized graph structure learning framework that uses structural deviations for anomaly scoring. GSLAD adopts a two-phase training strategy. First, a condition-aware graph learner and a graph-based forecaster are optimized with predictive supervision. The inferred normal graphs are then clustered into multiple structural prototypes representing different normal operating regimes, with edge-wise variability characterizing structural uncertainty. Deviations from these prototypes regularize the graph learner in the second phase, encouraging stable and regime-specific structural patterns. During inference, uncertainty-normalized structural deviation is combined with predictive deviation for anomaly scoring. Experiments on four industrial benchmarks demonstrate strong overall performance of GSLAD and confirm the effectiveness of structural deviation for anomaly detection and diagnosis.

</details>


### [535] [Data-driven Prediction of Satellite-observed Avalanche Activity from Snowpack Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15485)
*Jakob Grahn,Filippo Maria Bianchi,Bert Kruyt,Karsten Müller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用5天SNOWPACK模拟输出通过transformer预测次日Sentinel-1 SAR探测的雪崩活动指数，区域尺度相关性较好但网格尺度较弱，尚不能确立业务化预报能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大范围山区雪崩预报依赖雪盖状况与近期雪崩活动信息，但野外观测稀疏，难以覆盖广大山区，因此探索能否利用数值模拟预测卫星探测的雪崩活动。

Method: 收集挪威及瑞典部分地区5个冬季的Sentinel-1雪崩探测数据，配合20×20 km网格、不同高程与预设坡角的数值天气预报驱动SNOWPACK模拟；用transformer以5天SNOWPACK输出预测次日SAR-AAI（该指数按碎屑大小加权、将探测分散到可能发生日期并按模拟运动区域归一化）；4个冬季训练，1个冬季验证。

Result: 在完整6天时段平均后，区域平均预测与参考SAR-AAI相关系数r=0.803；模型能捕捉时空总体变化，但预测更平滑且低估最强活动；20 km网格尺度一致性较弱（r=0.549）。

Conclusion: 仅单次训练且未在完全未见的冬季上评估，卫星观测本身存在漏检、误检和时间不确定，故结果不足以证明业务化预报能力，但表明区域SNOWPACK模拟包含卫星观测雪崩活动总体变化的信息。

Abstract: Avalanche forecasting requires knowledge of snowpack conditions and recent avalanche activity, but field observations are sparse across large mountain regions. We explore whether SNOWPACK simulations can predict avalanche activity mapped by synthetic aperture radar (SAR). We compiled five winters of Sentinel-1 avalanche detections across Norway and parts of Sweden, alongside SNOWPACK simulations forced by numerical weather predictions on a 20 x 20 km grid at different elevations and predefined slope angles. A transformer used five days of SNOWPACK outputs to predict the following day's SAR-detected Avalanche Activity Index (SAR-AAI). This index weights larger debris more heavily, spreads detections across possible occurrence dates and normalises by modelled runout area. The model was trained on four winters and evaluated on one validation winter. Regional mean predicted and reference SAR-AAI correlated at r = 0.803 after averaging over complete six-day periods. The model followed broad changes in time and space but produced smoother predictions and underestimated the strongest activity. Agreement at the 20 km cell scale was weaker (r = 0.549) after the same averaging. These results come from a single training run without evaluation on an untouched winter. Satellite observations also contain missed and false detections and uncertain timing. The results therefore do not establish operational forecast skill, but suggest that regional SNOWPACK simulations contain information about broad variations in satellite-observed avalanche activity.

</details>


### [536] [Rotation-Based Subspace Tracking for Robust Kernel PCA on Streaming Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15488)
*Kris Lokere,John Fossaceca*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于旋转更新的在线鲁棒核PCA方法，通过在再生核希尔伯特空间中将子空间估计旋转至新样本方向，实现对动态非线性子空间的快速追踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际数据存在数据漂移、流式到达、非线性结构和异常值，传统PCA与现有在线鲁棒核PCA难以持续追踪变化（梯度下降在初始对齐后失效），需要新的更新机制。

Method: 提出旋转式子空间更新机制，在RKHS中每次将子空间估计旋转朝向新到来的特征向量，而非仅依赖梯度下降；给出两种互补的旋转策略，并用鲁棒影响函数调节旋转幅度以抑制异常值影响。

Result: 在具有已知真实子空间的合成流式数据上实验，逐样本旋转比纯梯度下降收敛更快，能有效动态追踪非线性子空间。

Conclusion: 旋转更新为流式数据中动态追踪非线性子空间提供了一种有效机制，并可通过鲁棒影响函数增强抗异常值能力。

Abstract: Machine learning models process large amounts of data, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a widely used technique to reduce the dimensionality of the data and extract useful features. In practice, datasets often change over time (data drift) and/or arrive one sample at a time (streaming data), making it infeasible to process the entire dataset at once in batch mode. Real-world data also often contains nonlinear patterns, which traditional PCA cannot extract. Kernel PCA addresses this by implicitly mapping samples into a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). Raw data also often contains outliers, which can have an outsized effect on the estimated subspace unless the algorithm is made robust. However, existing online robust kernel PCA algorithms are designed to converge to a subspace that is assumed to be fixed, and gradient-descent-based updates lose their effectiveness at tracking further changes once this initial alignment is achieved. This paper introduces a rotation-based update mechanism, which updates the subspace estimate by rotating it toward each new incoming feature vector in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space, rather than relying on gradient descent alone. We present two complementary rotation strategies, and show that the extent of rotation can be moderated by a robust influence function to mitigate the effect of outliers. Through experiments on synthetic streaming data with a known ground-truth subspace, we show that per-sample rotations converge faster than gradient descent alone, demonstrating an effective mechanism for dynamically tracking a nonlinear subspace in streaming data.

</details>


### [537] [Same path, different: a mechanistic comparison of looped and stacked transformer encoders on 12-lead ECG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15498)
*Pawel Olszowiec,Michal Byra,Grzegorz Gruszczynski,Grzegorz Stefanski,Alberto Presta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以 bViT 为例，系统对比循环（权重复用）与堆叠 Transformer 架构在表征、几何和动力学上的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 因参数高效而被广泛采用，但循环与堆叠架构在表征能力和动力学上的确切差异尚未被刻画清楚。

Method: 在 PTB-XL 的 12 导联 ECG 分类任务上，用相同训练协议训练 bViT（单一权重绑定块重复 L 次）与标准 ViT，并通过几何相似性等指标进行对比分析。

Result: bViT 参数减少 8.9 倍却达到与 ViT 相当的精度；两者构建的潜在表征几何相似且遵循相同的典型顺序，但动力学不同：bViT 步长更小、对患者间差异更敏感、远离数据流形时近乎中性；ViT 则出现表征维度坍塌和分布外特征扩张。

Conclusion: 循环与堆叠架构可产生相当的表征，但动力学行为存在本质差异，揭示了二者在泛化与分布外行为上的不同特性。

Abstract: Recurrent Transformers reusing their weights rather than stacking $L$ distinct layers are becoming widely adopted due to their parameter efficiency [1,2,3]. However, the exact representational and dynamical differences between looped and stacked architectures remain uncharacterized. This paper presents a controlled study on the example of bViT model [1] applying one weight-tied block $L$ times. We train two models: bViT and standard ViT [4] on 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) classification tasks from the PTB-XL dataset under identical training protocols. Despite an $8.9\times$ parameter reduction, bViT achieves accuracy parity with ViT. Geometric similarity metrics demonstrate that both architectures construct comparable latent representations in an equivalent canonical order. Crucially, their dynamics differ: bViT exhibits smaller step sizes and inter-patient sensitivity, as well as near-neutral behavior away from the data manifold, whereas ViT exhibits collapsing dimensionality of representations and out-of-distribution feature expansion.

</details>


### [538] [End-to-End Verifiable and Robust Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15521)
*Doryan Lesaignoux,Enrique Mármol Campos,Gabriele Spini,José L. Hernández-Ramos,Stephan Krenn*

Main category: cs.LG
