TL;DR: 本文提出一种可验证联邦学习协议，通过密码学承诺与零知识证明，使鲁棒聚合流程（基于余弦相似度的离群剔除及选择集聚合）可公开审计，且不泄露单个客户端更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习依赖聚合器且参与者与基础设施未必可信，需同时满足两个需求：对投毒/拜占庭更新的鲁棒性，以及聚合器的可验证性（客户端或第三方在不获知单个更新的前提下审计聚合结果）。现有工作多将二者分离处理，对鲁棒、剔除离群点的聚合缺乏高效的公开可验证方案。

Method: 将密码学承诺与非交互零知识证明结合，构建可公开审计的鲁棒聚合流水线，证明内容涵盖两部分：(i) 基于余弦相似度的离群点剔除；(ii) 对所选集合的聚合，且验证者无法获知各客户端的单独更新。

Result: 在代表性投毒攻击下保持高精度，评估配置中平均精度损失低于4%；验证开销实用，在研究规模下证明生成与验证可在数分钟内完成。

Conclusion: 鲁棒离群剔除与公开可验证性可在联邦学习场景中共同实现。

Abstract: Federated learning enables multiple parties to train a shared model without centralizing raw data with the help of an aggregator, but introduces integrity risks once participants or infrastructure are not fully trustworthy. Two requirements are particularly important: robustness to poisoned or Byzantine client updates, and verifiability of the aggregator so that clients or third parties can audit the reported aggregation without learning individual updates. Existing work has largely treated these goals separately, and efficient public verifiability for robust, outlier-excluding aggregation remains limited. We present a verifiable federated learning protocol that makes a robust aggregation pipeline publicly auditable. Our design combines cryptographic commitments with non-interactive zero-knowledge proofs to certify both (i) cosine-similarity-based outlier exclusion and (ii) aggregation over the selected set, without revealing individual client updates to verifiers. In experiments under representative poisoning attacks, our method maintains high accuracy, with an average accuracy loss below 4\% across the evaluated configurations, while keeping verification overhead practical: proof artifacts can be generated and verified within minutes at the scale studied. In summary, our results show that robust outlier exclusion and public verifiability can be jointly achieved in a federated learning setting.

</details>


### [539] [Beyond Noise: Understanding and Overcoming Temperature Effects in Analog DNN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15527)
*Niklas Summ,Xiao Wang,Hendrik Borras,Bernhard Klein,Holger Fröning*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过实验研究温度对模拟计算硬件非理想性的影响，并比较多种缓解策略的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟计算能效高，适合在移动和嵌入式设备上部署机器学习任务，但其易受噪声和物理器件非理想性影响，且这些效应随环境因素（如温度）变化，会显著降低推理精度。

Method: 在代表性模拟硬件上进行实验研究：先刻画随机性与系统性非理想性在不同工作温度下的行为，再比较基于仿真和基于硬件的缓解策略。

Result: 温度引起的性能退化主要由系统性非理想性驱动，而非单纯的随机噪声；噪声感知训练提升了鲁棒性，硬件在环训练和温度感知校准在变化热条件下保持精度效果最佳。

Conclusion: 系统性非理想性是温度致退化主因，硬件在环训练与温度感知校准是应对温度波动的强有效策略。

Abstract: The energy efficiency of analog computing makes it one of the most promising candidates for deploying resource-intensive machine learning workloads on constrained platforms such as mobile and embedded devices. However, analog accelerators are inherently susceptible to noise and non-idealities arising from physical component variations, whose behavior is further sensitive to environmental factors. These effects can significantly degrade inference accuracy. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive experimental study on a representative example of analog hardware to investigate the impact of temperature. We first characterize the behavior of stochastic and systematic non-idealities across a range of operating temperatures. Following this, we compare a set of simulation-based and hardware-based mitigation strategies aimed at improving robustness against temperature-induced performance degradation. Our results suggest that temperature-induced degradation is driven primarily by systematic non-idealities rather than stochastic noise alone. Noise-aware training improves robustness, while hardware-in-the-loop training and temperature-aware calibration provide the strongest accuracy retention across varying thermal conditions.

</details>


### [540] [The Misery of Mechanistic Interpretability: A Formal Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15533)
*Tobias Ladner,Matthias Althoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示可解释替代网络(IRN)的忠实性对微小输入扰动敏感，并提出首个基于可达性分析的形式化验证框架，证明对抗场景下忠实性差距的上界，并通过验证感知训练收紧该界限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械可解释性成为理解黑盒前沿语言模型的主流方法，IRN通过稀疏神经元暴露可解释特征，但其忠实性通常仅在干净数据上经验评估，缺乏对对抗场景的形式化保证。

Method: 作者首先在五种开放权重模型家族上实验证明语义微小扰动会翻转主导IRN特征与人类可理解解释；随后提出首个IRN忠实性形式化验证框架，利用可达性分析认证对抗场景下忠实性差距的可靠上界；最后采用验证感知训练收紧认证界限。

Result: 在GPT-2 small、Gemma 2 2B、Gemma 3 1B、Llama 3.2 1B、R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B上发现轻微扰动即翻转主导特征；验证感知训练显著收紧认证界限，恢复安全审计可用的特征级解释。

Conclusion: 该工作首次为大型语言模型的机械可解释性提供形式化保证，使IRN解释在对抗场景下对安全审计可行动。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has become the dominant lens for understanding frontier language models, as their inner workings are complex and inherently black boxes. To gain insights into these models, interpretable replacement networks (IRNs) are trained at all layers, exposing interpretable features through sparsely activated neurons. However, the faithfulness of an IRN is usually evaluated only empirically on clean data, and we show that even semantically minor input perturbations flip the dominant IRN features-and thus the human-understandable interpretation-across five open-weight model families (GPT-2 small, Gemma 2 2B, Gemma 3 1B, Llama 3.2 1B, R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B). We propose the first formal verification framework for the faithfulness of an IRN, where reachability analysis certifies a sound upper bound of the faithfulness gap in adversarial scenarios. Moreover, we show that verification-aware training of IRNs substantially tightens this certified bound, restoring a feature-level interpretation that safety auditors can act on. Together, these results give, to the best of our knowledge, the first formal guarantees for mechanistic interpretability of large language models.

</details>


### [541] [Specifying Reward Functions for RL Without Environment Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15544)
*Stephane Hatgis-Kessell,W. Bradley Knox,Emma Brunskill*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 EARS，无需环境交互即可从偏好中学习奖励函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于偏好的 RLHF 需反复训练策略、采样真实轨迹并获取反馈，在交互代价高或不安全的场景中不实用。

Method: 用结构化 LLM 流程从任务描述和观测空间构建少量表达性奖励特征，在特征空间中策略性采样想象轨迹，并从想象轨迹对的偏好中学习特征权重。

Result: 在疫情封锁、糖尿病胰岛素管理、高速自动驾驶三个长时域任务上，使用真实或 LLM 偏好标签时，EARS 学到的奖励函数比直接提示 LLM 生成奖励函数更贴合真实奖励或 LLM 上下文。

Conclusion: 基于偏好的奖励指定在无环境采样下仍有效，适用于采集真实轨迹昂贵或不可行的场景。

Abstract: Enabling human stakeholders to specify reward functions that lead to their desired outcomes is a key challenge in deploying reinforcement learning agents. Preference-based methods such as online RLHF can reduce the burden of manual reward design, but they require repeatedly training policies, sampling trajectories from the real world, and eliciting feedback, making them impractical in settings where environment interaction is computationally expensive or unsafe. We introduce Experience-Free Autonomous Reward Specification (EARS), a method for learning reward functions from preferences without environment interaction. Our approach uses a structured LLM-mediated process to construct a small set of expressive reward features from a task description and the environment observation space, then strategically samples imagined trajectories in this feature space and learns feature weights from preferences over the imagined trajectory pairs. We evaluate on three long-horizon domains: pandemic lockdown regulation design, insulin administration for diabetes patients, and autonomous vehicle control on a highway. We compare EARS to baselines that also enable reward specification without environment interaction--namely, methods that directly prompt an LLM to generate a reward function. When learning from either ground-truth preference labels or preferences labeled by a LLM, EARS designs reward functions that are more aligned with the ground truth reward function that produced the preferences or LLM context than these baselines. These results suggest that preference-based reward specification remains effective without environment sampling, enabling practical reward design in settings where collecting real trajectories is costly or infeasible.

</details>


### [542] [The Token Before the Value Is the Key: How Hybrid Architectures Organize Induction Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15545)
*Ke Cheng,Xin Xu,Yixiao Chen,Lei Xin,Jianbo Zhao,Fanhu Zeng,Yue Liu,Jun Zhang,Jie Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究混合语言模型中"携带(Carrying)—匹配(Matching)—复制"三类归纳计算的层级分配与形成机制：Carrying集中在高效层，Matching集中在global接收层，且Matching的组织依赖于Carrying的学习方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合语言模型能提升能力与效率，但架构互补性如何转化为可学习的计算尚不清楚。作者关注位置敏感(content-based/position-sensitive)的归纳任务——Carrying(携带前驱信息)、Matching(按内容匹配源)、Copying(复制值)——在异构层间如何分配。

Method: 提出layer-type-agnostic的配对比对探针(paired probes)，在统一block-update接口下追踪Carrying与Matching；通过lag-one masking、移除卷积、降低早期学习率等干预改变前驱支持；用源键恢复与固定值选择追踪接收层对源信息的依赖；并变化局部窗口与induction富集训练文本。

Result: 在recurrent-global与local-global混合架构中，Carrying集中于高效层，Matching集中于global接收层；局部贡献集中于lag one(历史值前一个token)。上述干预可使Carrying与Matching在阶段间迁移，并影响自然文本recall(效果依赖配置与目标)。变化窗口与训练文本会改变二者的早期形成时序。

Conclusion: 探针与干预将解释焦点前移：Matching的组织方式取决于Carrying如何被学习。值前的lag-one token成为连接混合架构、电路形成与recall的具象纽带。

Abstract: Hybrid language models can improve capability as well as efficiency, raising the question of how architectural complementarity becomes learned computation. We examine the established induction roles of Carrying predecessor information, Matching a source by content, and Copying its value. How are these position-sensitive and content-based computations allocated across heterogeneous layers? We introduce layer-type-agnostic paired probes that track Carrying and Matching through a common block-update interface. In recurrent--global and local--global hybrids, Carrying concentrates in efficient layers and Matching in global receivers. The measured local contribution concentrates on lag one: the token immediately before the historical value. Changing predecessor support through lag-one masking, convolution removal, or early learning-rate reduction can relocate Carrying and Matching between stages. Source-key restoration and fixed-value selection trace the receiver's dependence on the prepared source. These interventions also change natural-text recall, with outcomes depending on configuration and target. Varying local windows and induction-enriched training text changes the early development of functional Carrying and Matching, connecting architectural priors and training evidence to formation timing. Together, the probes and interventions shift the explanatory focus upstream: the organization of Matching follows how Carrying is learned. The token before the value provides a concrete link between a hybrid's architecture, circuit development, and recall. Code is available in https://github.com/ckpassenger/bind-match-copy/tree/main.

</details>


### [543] [Bayesian Optimisation Using Product-of-Experts Gaussian Process Models with Uncertainty Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15555)
*Yean Hoon Ong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BO-pro-c，一种使用乘积专家高斯过程（GP-pro-c）作为代理模型的贝叶斯优化算法，解决单全局GP模型计算复杂度高的问题，并在多种BO设置下验证其性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化通常依赖单一全局高斯过程作为代理模型，但其训练复杂度随数据点数量呈立方增长，限制了在大规模优化问题中的适用性。GP-pro-c虽能通过组合多个局部专家缓解该问题，但它在BO中的应用尚未被充分研究。

Method: 提出 BO-pro-c 算法，采用 GP-pro-c（带不确定性校准的乘积专家高斯过程）作为代理模型，并在多样化的贝叶斯优化设置中评估其性能。

Result: 实验表明 BO-pro-c 保持了有竞争力的优化性能，相比基于单一全局GP模型的BO算法，简单遗憾降低0.9%，计算开销降低39.4%。

Conclusion: BO-pro-c 是一种有效的贝叶斯优化方法，在保持竞争性能的同时显著降低计算开销，适合大规模优化问题。

Abstract: Bayesian optimisation (BO) typically relies on a single global Gaussian process (GP) model as its surrogate model. However, GP regression has cubic computational complexity in the number of training data points, limiting its applicability to large-scale optimisation problems. The product-of-experts Gaussian process model with uncertainty calibration (GP-pro-c) mitigates this limitation by combining multiple local GP experts, enabling improved uncertainty quantification, reduced computational cost, and preservation of global correlations. Despite these desirable properties, the use of GP-pro-c in BO has not been thoroughly studied. This paper introduces BO-pro-c, a Bayesian optimisation algorithm that uses GP-pro-c as its surrogate model, and evaluate its performance across a diverse range of BO settings. Experimental results suggest that BO-pro-c maintains competitive optimisation performance while achieving a 0.9% reduction in simple regret and a 39.4% reduction in computational overhead relative to a BO algorithm based on a single global GP model.

</details>


### [544] [Multi-View Molecular Representation Learning with Hierarchical Graphs and Contextualized Fingerprints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15611)
*Gwang-Hyeon Yun,Jong-Hoon Park,Bing Hu,Helen Chen,Anita Layton,Young-Rae Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HiFi-Mol 是一个多视角分子预训练框架，分别预训练分层图编码器与上下文化指纹编码器，在下游整合两视角特征，在 MoleculeNet 八项分类任务上平均 ROC-AUC 提升 2.77%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子预训练方法多依赖单一视角：图方法建模原子-键拓扑但缺乏片段级监督，指纹描述符编码化学模式却通常仅作固定辅助特征，导致在有限标注数据和结构新颖化合物上泛化受限。

Method: 提出 HiFi-Mol，先分别预训练两个分支再下游整合。图分支采用片段感知掩码与多分辨率监督以捕获子结构感知表示；指纹分支对来自七类指纹家族的活跃条目进行分词，并用掩码语言建模学习上下文化嵌入。微调时融合投影后的多分辨率图特征与指纹嵌入进行预测。

Result: 在 MoleculeNet 的 scaffold split 下，八项分类任务平均 ROC-AUC 相对最佳基线提升 2.77%，三项回归任务保持有竞争力表现。进一步分析表明片段感知掩码提升了图表征质量，分类结果显示图与指纹变体的优势具有数据集依赖性，证实两视角提供互补预测信号。

Conclusion: 图与指纹两视角具有互补性，分开预训练后整合可有效提升分子性质预测，尤其有利于片段级监督与上下文化指纹表征。

Abstract: Molecular property prediction requires representations that generalize from limited labeled data to structurally novel compounds. Existing molecular pretraining methods often rely on a single view: graph-based approaches model atom-bond topology but provide limited fragment-level supervision, whereas fingerprint descriptors encode chemical patterns but are typically used as fixed auxiliary features. We propose HiFi-Mol, a multi-view framework that separately pretrains a hierarchical graph encoder and a contextualized fingerprint encoder before downstream integration. The graph branch uses fragment-aware masking with multi-resolution supervision to capture substructure-aware representations, while the fingerprint branch tokenizes active entries from seven fingerprint families and applies masked language modeling to learn contextualized embeddings. During fine-tuning, HiFi-Mol combines projected multi-resolution graph features with fingerprint embeddings for downstream prediction. Evaluated on MoleculeNet benchmarks under the scaffold split, HiFi-Mol achieves a 2.77% improvement in average ROC-AUC over the best baseline across eight classification tasks while maintaining competitive performance on three regression tasks. Further analyses reveal that fragment-aware masking improves graph representation quality, and classification results demonstrate dataset-dependent strengths of the individual graph and fingerprint variants, confirming that the two views provide complementary predictive signals.

</details>


### [545] [Where to Compute and How to Interact: Operator-Readable Adaptation with Gauge-Aware Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15620)
*Zixuan Shen,Quanxu Wan,Bingchuan Wang,Zhi Wang,Biao Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"operator readability"原则与GA-AMNO框架，将自适应网格算子中的"在哪算"（物理信息自适应分配）与"如何交互"（几何条件低秩Gauge传输）解耦并可检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应网格神经算子主要关注"在哪里计算"（采样与计算分配），而忽视节点重定位后"信息如何交互"。网格自适应改变局部采样尺度、邻域结构与几何上下文，使不同节点上的表示不可直接比较，直接聚合会混淆物理变化与离散化引起的表示变化。且分配与交互被同一输出目标联合优化，仅凭最终误差难以区分二者作用。

Method: 提出operator readability原则，要求自适应算子能解释并检验计算分配于特定位置的原因及非均匀离散下表示如何交互。基于此提出GA-AMNO：（1）物理信息自适应分配决定"在哪算"；（2）几何条件低秩Gauge传输将源特征映射到目标表示上下文后再聚合，决定"如何交互"。给出表示一致聚合的充分条件，并分析拓扑保持网格形变下的近似传输误差与连续性。

Result: 在五个PDE基准上取得更优预测精度；通过受控干预与几何失配分析验证了分配与交互各自的作用，并表明Gauge传输在强几何失配下提升了跨离散表示的兼容性。

Conclusion: 将自适应网格神经算子的分配与交互显式解耦，使mesh-to-solver信息交换可检验、可干预，提升精度与跨离散表示兼容性。

Abstract: Adaptive meshes enable neural operators for partial differential equations (PDEs) to allocate spatial samples and computation according to local physical structures. Existing approaches, however, mainly address where to compute, with less attention to how information should interact after node relocation. Mesh adaptation changes local sampling scales, neighborhood structures, and geometric contexts, so representations formed at different nodes may not be directly comparable. Direct aggregation can therefore entangle physical variation with discretization-induced representation variation. Because allocation and interaction are jointly optimized through the same output objective, their individual roles are also difficult to distinguish from final errors alone. We introduce operator readability, requiring an adaptive operator to account for and test why computation is allocated to particular locations and how representations interact under the resulting nonuniform discretization. Based on this principle, we propose the Gauge-Aware Adaptive Mesh Neural Operator (GA-AMNO). Physics-informed adaptive allocation answers where to compute, while geometry-conditioned low-rank Gauge transport maps source features into target representation contexts before aggregation, answering how to interact. This makes mesh-to-solver information exchange inspectable and intervenable. We establish sufficient conditions for representation-consistent aggregation and analyze approximate transport errors and continuity under topology-preserving mesh deformations. Experiments on five PDE benchmarks demonstrate improved predictive accuracy, while controlled interventions and geometric-mismatch analyses verify the roles of allocation and interaction and show that Gauge transport improves cross-discretization representation compatibility under strong geometric mismatch.

</details>


### [546] [FedLTLib: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Federated Long-Tail Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15625)
*Changkun Lin,Junxiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 FedLTLib，一个面向联邦长尾学习（FL-LT）的标准评测基准，统一实验配置以支持公平可复现的对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动设备数据存在"双重异质性"（全局类别不平衡与局部统计偏斜叠加），导致尾类性能严重下降，而现有 FL-LT 研究实验配置不一致、对比不公平，缺乏标准评测。

Method: 构建 FedLTLib 基准平台，采用标准化评测框架，集成反映移动数据特征的多样基准数据集，并实现 13 种先进 FL 算法（4 种传统 FL + 9 种 FL-LT）。

Result: 提供统一的实验协议，使研究者能够在一致的配置下对算法的鲁棒性与泛化能力进行公平、可复现的评估。

Conclusion: FedLTLib 标准化 FL-LT 评测，有助于推动移动计算生态中鲁棒智能的部署。

Abstract: Driven by the escalating demand for privacy-preserving computing, Federated Learning (FL) has witnessed remarkable progress, becoming a cornerstone technology for bridging distributed data silos in mobile edge networks. However, in real-world mobile computing environments, data is generated by heterogeneous mobile devices with varying user behaviors, leading to a significant Long-Tail Distribution. Unlike idealized balanced datasets, data in the wild manifests an acute imbalance where a minority of head classes dominate the sample space while a vast number of tail classes, often representing rare but critical edge-case events, are extremely scarce. This data heterogeneity, which we formally characterize as "Double Heterogeneity", referring to the superposition of global class imbalance and local statistical skew, precipitates severe performance deterioration on tail classes, thereby spurring the vital research direction of Federated Long-Tail Learning (FL-LT). To standardize evaluation and accelerate research in this field, we introduce FedLTLib, a comprehensive benchmark tailored for FL-LT. Addressing the critical issues of inconsistent experimental configurations and unfair comparisons in prior work, FedLTLib establishes a standardized evaluation framework. The platform not only incorporates diverse benchmark datasets reflecting mobile data characteristics but also implements 13 state-of-the-art FL algorithms (4 traditional FL algorithms and 9 FL-LT algorithms). By leveraging FedLTLib, researchers can perform fair and reproducible evaluations of algorithm robustness and generalization capabilities under a unified experimental protocol, ultimately advancing the deployment of robust intelligence in mobile computing ecosystems.

</details>


### [547] [Principal-timestep Restricted Init via Sparse Matrix-decomposition in Flow-matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15643)
*Jiayang Gu,Zheng Fang,Lichaun Xiang,Fanghui Liu,Xu Cai,Hongkai Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对LoRA在流匹配扩散模型微调中效果不佳的问题，提出Prism-LoRA框架，通过主时间步选择与主通道过滤改进梯度对齐，加速收敛并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA结合谱初始化在自回归语言模型上能加速收敛并提升性能，但在扩散模型微调中收益甚微甚至为负。作者认为原因在于LoRA的低秩参数化与流匹配目标固有的高秩梯度之间存在根本性错配：随机时间步采样导致梯度方向在训练步间高度异质，使低秩约束下的更新方向错位。

Method: 提出Prism-LoRA（Principal-timestep Restricted Init via Sparse Matrix-decomposition），包含两个组件：(i)主时间步选择，将初始化梯度限制在一小部分主导时间步上，以抑制有效梯度秩；(ii)主通道过滤，去除任务无关通道，使单步谱初始化梯度更好地对齐长程优化轨迹。

Result: 在主体驱动生成、可控生成和去模糊等多个扩散微调基准上，方法持续提升收敛速度与最终性能，优于基线LoRA和其他谱初始化方法，且更早达到收敛。

Conclusion: 通过改进梯度对齐，Prism-LoRA有效解决了谱初始化LoRA在扩散微调中的失效问题，兼顾更快收敛与更优性能，具有较好的通用性。

Abstract: Flow-matching diffusion models have recently emerged as a strong paradigm for high-fidelity visual generation. However, their prohibitively high fine-tuning cost limits scalability to downstream tasks. While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) combined with spectral initialization has demonstrated accelerated convergence and improved performance in autoregressive language models by better aligning gradient directions, we find that it fails to deliver similar gains in diffusion fine-tuning, often yielding marginal or even negative improvements over vanilla LoRA.We attribute this discrepancy to a fundamental mismatch between LoRA's low-rank parameterization and the intrinsically high-rank gradients induced by the flow-matching objective. In particular, stochastic timestep sampling introduces directionally heterogeneous gradient signals across training steps, leading to misaligned updates under low-rank constraints.To address this issue, we propose Prism-LoRA,a Principal-timestep Restricted Init via Sparse Matrix-decomposition framework that improves gradient alignment during fine-tuning. Our method consists of two key components: (i) principal timestep selection, which restricts initialization gradients to a subset of dominant timesteps to suppress effective gradient rank, and (ii) principal channel filtering, which removes task-irrelevant channels, enabling the one-step spectral initialization gradient to better align with the long-horizon optimization trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves both convergence speed and final performance across multiple diffusion fine-tuning benchmarks, including subject-driven generation, controllable generation, and deblurring, achieving not only performance improvement but also earlier stages of convergence over baseline LoRA and other spectral-init methods.

</details>


### [548] [Backward SDEs-based Diffusion for Physics-Constrained Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15702)
*Zihao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出终端条件反转（TCI）方法，用BSDE为Score-SDE先验构造原则性的逆映射，保证终端的测量/物理一致性，并在稀疏视角CT重建中优于免训练基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练score-based扩散模型提供强无条件先验，但在逆问题中强制测量/物理一致性常依赖启发式引导、间歇投影或任务特定条件训练，推理结束时可行性缺乏保证。

Method: 给定冻结的Score-SDE先验和任务定义的终端可行性规范，构造一个后向随机微分方程（BSDE），其适应解定义了从终端要求到选定噪声水平下先验状态的有原则逆映射；在标准正则条件下证明适应解的存在唯一性，构造性保证终端一致性；并开发实用神经BSDE求解器，在不修改score定义系数的前提下组合任意预训练扩散先验与域约束，产生锚定先验状态以支持邻域采样。

Result: 玩具数据集实验验证了稳定的终端条件反转和分布一致的邻域采样；稀疏视角CT重建案例中，重建质量优于代表性免训练基线，同时在规定终端规范下满足严格的测量可行性。

Conclusion: 该框架为Score-SDE逆问题提供了有理论保障的终端一致性机制，兼顾先验复用与域约束，并能进行不确定性刻画。

Abstract: Pretrained score-based diffusion models provide strong unconditional priors, yet enforcing measurement or physics consistency in inverse problems is often handled by heuristic guidance, intermittent projections, or task-specific conditional training, with limited guarantees of feasibility at the end of inference. We propose terminal-conditioned inversion for score-based SDE priors. Given a frozen Score-SDE prior and a task-defined terminal feasibility specification, we construct an associated backward stochastic differential equation whose adapted solution defines a principled inverse map from the terminal requirement to a prior state at a chosen noise level. Under standard regularity conditions, we establish existence and uniqueness of the adapted solution and obtain terminal consistency by construction. We further develop a practical neural BSDE solver that composes arbitrary pretrained diffusion priors with domain constraints without modifying the score-defined coefficients, producing an anchored prior state that enables neighborhood sampling for uncertainty characterization. Experiments on toy datasets validate stable terminal-conditioned inversion and distributionally consistent neighborhood sampling. As a real-world case study, we apply the framework to sparse-view CT reconstruction and achieve improved reconstruction quality over representative training-free baselines while satisfying strict measurement feasibility under the prescribed terminal specification. Project is available in: \href{https://laplacelab.github.io/BSDEDiffusion/}{https://laplace.center/icmlbsdeI/}

</details>


### [549] [Knowledge-Enriched Structured EHR Features for 30-Day Hospital Readmission Prediction on MIMIC-IV](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15713)
*Mohamad Najafi,Hongyun Fu,Mathias Brochhausen,Jian Wu,Yaohang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种知识增强的结构化EHR特征表示，在不用临床笔记的情况下预测30天再入院，性能与现有方法相当但计算成本更低且可解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于预训练语言模型处理出院小结的方法虽性能强，但依赖临床笔记、计算成本高、表示缺乏可解释性。

Method: 将结构化EHR数据与四类医学知识源结合：疾病本体映射、手术分类、药物成分词表、器官系统检验聚合；每个特征维度对应一个具名临床概念，形成稀疏可解释的患者表示；在MIMIC-IV v2.2队列上用六种分类器评估。

Result: 20折交叉验证下最佳配置AUROC为0.743，与先前仅用结构化数据或结合临床笔记的方法相当，且计算成本显著更低。可解释性分析显示人口学、器官系统检验、药物成分特征和一级本体疾病类别主导预测，更深层级贡献可忽略。

Conclusion: 知识增强的结构化特征可作为临床笔记嵌入的竞争性且高效的替代方案用于30天再入院预测。

Abstract: Recent approaches to 30-day hospital readmission prediction rely on pre-trained language models applied to discharge summaries. Although these methods achieve strong performance, they depend on the availability of clinical notes, incur substantial computational costs, and yield representations that lack interpretability. We propose a knowledge-enriched feature representation that augments structured Electronic Health Record (EHR) data with four medical knowledge sources: disease ontology mapping, procedure classification, drug ingredient vocabulary, and organ system laboratory aggregation, without using clinical notes. Each feature dimension corresponds to a named clinical concept, yielding a sparse and interpretable patient representation. The approach is evaluated with six classifiers on a MIMIC-IV v2.2 cohort. Under 20-fold cross-validation, the best configuration achieves an AUROC of 0.743. This performance is comparable to that of previously reported methods on this dataset, including both those using only structured data and those incorporating clinical notes, while requiring considerably less computational cost. Interpretability analysis shows that demographics, organ system labs, drug ingredient features, and first-level ontology disease categories drive prediction, while deeper hierarchy levels contribute negligibly. These findings indicate that knowledge-enriched structured features offer a competitive and efficient alternative to embeddings from clinical notes for 30-day readmission prediction.

</details>


### [550] [The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15982)
*Ruishuo Chen,Xun Wang,Yu Chen,Zhuoran Li,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Gavel提出用冻结LLM自身的中间层状态进行技能路由，仅训练两个线性映射，无需在上下文中加载技能文本，在多个基准上超越需大量外部参数的检索与渐进披露方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体的技能选择至关重要。现有部署方案（预加载全部技能元数据）分散注意力且限制库规模；检索管线则把选择移出智能体能力范围。作者希望利用冻结智能体LLM自身前向传播中已存在的路由信号。

Method: Gavel分两步：Glance将任务与各技能的中间层状态经两个线性映射（唯一训练参数）投影，对全库与安装时一次前向构建的紧凑技能库打分；Verdict恢复候选技能的前向传播，读取模型自身似然与yes/no判断，与glance以专家乘积方式融合。仅训练一次即可零样本迁移。

Result: 在三个公开基准及新基准SkillTraj（372条模拟轨迹）上零样本迁移。Qwen3-32B上超越需额外1.2B–16B参数的渐进披露和检索重排管线，书面任务提升最高13.4分，技能需求中途出现时提升最高21.9分。路由准确率随骨干模型增强而提升；在bash-agent中，32B模型在Skill-Use上触发正确技能的频率高于Codex中的更大前沿模型。

Conclusion: 冻结LLM的前向传播已隐含技能路由信号，两个线性映射即可读出，无需技能文本。Gavel在效率与准确率上均优于依赖外部参数的方法，且随骨干模型性能提升而受益。

Abstract: Skills extend an LLM agent beyond its parametric knowledge, and the gain they promise rests on picking the right one. Deployed harnesses route by preloading every skill's metadata into the context, which disperses the agent's attention and caps the library size. Retrieval pipelines move the selection out of the context, but also out of the agent's capability. We show that the frozen agent LLM already carries the routing signal in its own forward passes, and that two linear maps suffice to read it out with no skill text in the context. Gavel (Glance And Verdict from a frozen LLM) reads it in two steps. A glance projects the task's and each skill's mid-layer states through the two maps, the only parameters trained, and scores the full library against compact per-skill banks that one forward pass builds at installation. A verdict then resumes the shortlisted skills' forward passes and reads the model's own likelihood and yes/no judgment, fused with the glance as a product of experts. Trained once, Gavel transfers zero-shot to three public benchmarks and SkillTraj, our new benchmark of 372 simulated agent trajectories. On Qwen3-32B it outperforms progressive disclosure and retrieve-and-rerank pipelines that add 1.2B to 16B external parameters, by up to 13.4 points on written tasks and up to 21.9 when the need for a skill arises mid-rollout. Routing accuracy improves as the backbone does, and in a bash-agent harness the same 32B triggers the correct skill on Skill-Use more often than far larger frontier models running in Codex.

</details>


### [551] [Assembling the CREW: A Collaborative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Automated Related Work Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15721)
*Hai-Dang Dang,Bao-Yen Pham,Bao Nguyen,Tran Thi Huong,Huynh Thi Thanh Binh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CREW框架，用协作强化学习（IPPO）让LLM智能体动态协调生成相关工作，质量提升且降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动相关工作生成可大幅减少人力，但现有多智能体LLM方法依赖预定义工作流，智能体各司其职，协调僵化、静态，难以自适应地综合复杂科学文献。

Method: CREW框架，让LLM智能体绕过启发式流水线，通过自主选择动作（Retrieve、Disseminate、Compose、Critique）实现动态协调，策略由独立近端策略优化（IPPO）进行优化。

Result: 在标准RWG基准上大量实验表明，相比强基线质量大幅提升，同时显著降低token开销。

Conclusion: 通过协作多智能体强化学习实现自适应协调，可有效改进相关工作生成并兼顾成本效率。

Abstract: Automatic Related Work Generation (RWG) significantly reduces the human time and effort required to author the Related Work Section (RWS) of a research paper. However, prior methods leveraging multi-agent Large Language Models (LLMs) typically rely on a predefined workflow, where each agent is responsible for a specific step in the entire process. This rigid, static inter-agent coordination limits the adaptive collaboration required to synthesize complex scientific literature. To address this limitation, we propose CREW (Collaborative Reinforcement Learning for Related Work Generation), a novel framework where LLM agents bypass heuristic pipelines to dynamically coordinate by autonomously selecting actions, such as Retrieve, Disseminate, Compose, and Critique, driven by a policy optimized via Independent Proximal Policy Optimization (IPPO). Extensive experiments on a standard RWG benchmark demonstrate that our approach yields substantial quality improvements over strong existing baselines, while significantly reducing token costs. Code is available at https://github.com/YenPBao/CREW-Collaborative-MARL.git

</details>


### [552] [A Language-Guided Multimodal Foundation Model for Zero-Shot and Multi-Task Brain Signal Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15740)
*Mingzhi Chen,Yiyu Gui,Guibo Luo,Yuchao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出METIS，一个通过统一语言-信号对齐框架构建的脑信号多模态基础模型，实现零样本与多任务脑信号分析，并在大规模评测中显著超越现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脑信号分析方法存在局限：端到端模型需任务特定重训练且泛化差；预训练模型语义浅、依赖大量微调；通用多模态基础模型因表征错位和缺乏领域知识难以解读脑信号。

Method: 提出METIS多模态基础模型，通过统一的语言-信号对齐框架，在迄今最大且最多样的脑信号语料上预训练，涵盖20个数据集、超11000名受试者、逾70000小时记录。

Result: 在12个数据集的零样本评测中，平均准确率超领先通用模型20.9%以上；无需微调即匹配或超越有监督任务专用模型；少样本AUROC优势超16.0%，跨数据集迁移优势15.9%。

Conclusion: 该工作为通用脑信号分析建立新范式，为下一代神经技术铺路。

Abstract: Brain signal analysis is essential for both neuroscience research and clinical diagnostics, yet current approaches face critical limitations. End-to-end models require task-specific retraining and exhibit limited generalization, while pre-trained models lack semantic depth and still depend on extensive fine-tuning. Meanwhile, general-purpose multimodal foundation models, though powerful in other domains, struggle to interpret brain signals due to representational misalignment and lack of domain knowledge. This study introduces a multimodal foundation model for zero-shot and multi-task brain signal analysis (METIS) through a unified language-signal alignment framework. METIS is pretrained on the largest and most diverse brain-signal corpus to date, comprising over 70,000 h of recordings from more than 11,000 subjects across 20 datasets. In a comprehensive zero-shot evaluation across 12 datasets, METIS outperformed the leading generalist model by over 20.9% in average accuracy. Remarkably, without any fine-tuning, METIS's performance matches or exceeds that of supervised, task-specific models. Furthermore, METIS demonstrates exceptional data efficiency and strong generalization, achieving an average AUROC advantage of over 16.0% in few-shot settings and 15.9% in cross-dataset transfer. This work establishes a new paradigm for general-purpose brain signal analysis, paving the way for next-generation neurotechnology.

</details>


### [553] [Sylvas: Synergistic Learning Value based Device Scheduling in Federated Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15763)
*Yuxuan Sun,Yuxuan Bai,Tan Chen,Sheng Zhou,Zhisheng Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Sylvas：面向联邦持续学习（FCL）的协同学习价值设备调度框架，从分布价值与标签价值两方面评估设备数据学习价值，在资源约束下调度高价值设备以支持及时模型更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物联网应用（智能交通、工业监控、无人系统）需要FCL使全局模型持续适应分布式非平稳数据流。时空数据分布动态变化与标签稀缺下，如何量化各边缘设备对全局学习的贡献并在资源约束下调度最有价值设备，是核心挑战。

Method: Sylvas从两个角度评估分布式数据的学习价值：分布价值（从时空分布角度刻画设备数据对全局模型学习的贡献）与标签价值（刻画伪标签数据的数量与可靠性权衡）。将二者整合为协同学习价值度量，据此在满足通信与计算资源约束下调度高价值设备。

Result: 案例研究表明，Sylvas在时空分布动态变化下能支持及时的模型适应，并有效利用无标签数据。

Conclusion: Sylvas为无线边缘FCL提供了一种基于协同学习价值的设备调度方案，兼顾分布与标签价值，在资源受限下提升模型更新的时效性与对无标签数据的利用效率。

Abstract: Federated continual learning (FCL) enables shared global models to continuously adapt to distributed and non-stationary data streams, making it important for Internet of Things applications such as intelligent transportation, industrial monitoring, and unmanned systems. Under spatio-temporal data distribution dynamics and label scarcity, a key challenge is how to quantify the contribution of each edge device to global learning performance and schedule the most valuable devices under resource constraints for timely model updating. This article presents Sylvas, a synergistic learning value based device scheduling framework for FCL at the wireless edge. Sylvas evaluates the learning value of distributed data from two perspectives: distributional value, which characterizes the contribution of device data to global model learning from a spatio-temporal distribution perspective, and label value, which captures the quantity and reliability tradeoff of pseudo-labeled data. By integrating these factors into a synergistic learning value metric, Sylvas schedules devices with high learning value while satisfying communication and computation resource constraints. Case studies demonstrate that Sylvas supports timely model adaptation under spatio-temporal distribution dynamics and effectively exploits unlabeled data.

</details>


### [554] [Transfer Learning for Socioeconomic Estimation in Forced-Displacement Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15773)
*Steven Ndung'u,Adel Daoud,Ismael Yacoubou Djima,Hai-Anh H. Dang,Patrick Michael Brock*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将基于DHS预训练的多模态时空视觉Transformer迁移至南苏丹、喀麦隆和赞比亚的被迫流离失所情境，利用卫星协变量估算社会经济指数，营地网格内解释度达66%（MAE 4.37），非营地41%（MAE 5.41），为家庭调查间歇期提供时空补充。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 包容性家庭调查虽强化了被迫流离失所人群的社会经济证据，但资源密集、周期长；在脆弱、冲突和暴力情境下两轮调查之间状况可能快速变化，亟需更频繁、空间细粒度的补充证据以指导行动优先级。地球观测与机器学习可提供可扩展的时空社会经济信息，但面向一般人群的工具尚未在流离失所情境中系统适配与评估。

Method: 将在36个非洲国家、约120万家庭DHS数据上预训练的多模态时空视觉Transformer，适配至南苏丹、喀麦隆和赞比亚的流离失所与收容社区情境；使用UNHCR FDS和RMS数据导出的社会经济指数开发并评估适配后模型。

Result: 卫星衍生的地理空间协变量在营地相交网格中可解释高达66%的社会经济结果变异（MAE 4.37指数点），在非营地相交区域为41%（MAE 5.41）。

Conclusion: 该框架通过定期更新的模型化社会经济估计填补关键时空数据空白，与周期性家庭调查互补，支持调查间歇期的洞察、及时的人道主义优先级排序与实地核查。

Abstract: Progress in inclusive household surveys has strengthened socioeconomic evidence for forcibly displaced populations, providing indispensable benchmarks on living conditions and welfare. However, these surveys remain resource-intensive and periodic, while conditions can change between rounds, particularly in settings affected by fragility, conflict, and violence. More frequently updated, spatially granular complementary evidence is therefore needed to identify where socioeconomic conditions may be changing between survey rounds and to inform operational prioritization. Earth observation and machine learning offer a scalable source of spatially explicit socioeconomic information. However, tools developed for general populations have not been systematically adapted and evaluated in forced displacement settings, where living conditions, settlement patterns, and displacement impacts may differ substantially. We address this gap by adapting a multimodal spatiotemporal vision transformer, pretrained on Demographic and Health Survey data from approximately 1.2 million households across 36 African countries, to forced displacement and host community settings in South Sudan, Cameroon, and Zambia. We develop and evaluate the updated, adapted model using socioeconomic indices derived from UNHCR FDS and RMS data. Our results show that satellite-derived geospatial covariates explain up to 66% of the variation in socioeconomic outcomes in camp-intersecting grids, with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 4.37 index points, and 41% in non-camp-intersecting areas, with an MAE of 5.41. The framework complements and adds value to periodic household surveys by filling critical spatial and temporal data gaps with regularly updated, model-based socioeconomic estimates. These estimates sustain insight between survey rounds and support timely humanitarian prioritization and field verification.

</details>


### [555] [MoveBench: A Benchmark for Global-Scale Wildlife Movement Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15780)
*Justin Kay,Shir Bar,Ellen O. Aikens,Martin Becker,Francesca Cagnacci,Juliet Cohen,Scott W. Forrest,Jessica Kendall-Bar,Madeleine Lucas,Macon Overcast,Meredith S. Palmer,Will Rogers,Nicholas J. Russo,Christian Rutz,Larissa T. Beumer,Michael Brown,Ying-Chi Chan,Sarah C. Davidson,Diego Ellis Soto,Anne G. Hertel,Roland Kays,Benjamin Koger,Guram Mikaberidze,Thomas Mueller,Ruth Oliver,Thorsten Papenbrock,Robert Patchett,Jared A. Stabach,Dane Taylor,Scott W. Yanco,Sara Beery*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MoveBench：首个大规模概率性野生动物移动预测基准，含260万GPS点、800+个体、110物种、127国及16亿环境栅格瓦片（160协变量）。提出概率评估协议，发现现有方法对未来时间点泛化优于未见个体、深度学习方法未必优于简单基线、环境协变量选择显著影响性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野生动物轨迹预测对生态与保护至关重要，但相比人类和车辆轨迹，其空间无约束、高度随机且受环境条件影响，现有基准和方法不足。

Method: 构建MoveBench大规模基准数据集，并设计概率评估协议以克服点预测指标对随机现象的局限；在多个时空尺度上系统评测四类方法。

Result: (1) 现有方法对未来时间点泛化好于对未见个体；(2) 深度学习方法并不稳定优于简单基线；(3) 环境协变量选择显著影响性能。

Conclusion: MoveBench支持移动预测方法的标准化评估，为该生态重要任务的方法进展提供基础。

Abstract: Understanding and predicting wildlife movement is critical for ecology and conservation. While trajectory forecasting has advanced for human and vehicle movement, wildlife trajectories present distinct challenges: they are unconstrained in space, highly stochastic, and influenced by environmental conditions. We introduce MoveBench, the first large-scale benchmark for probabilistic wildlife movement forecasting, containing 2.6M GPS locations from 800+ individuals across 110 species in 127 countries, paired with 1.6B environmental raster tiles capturing 160 covariates known or hypothesized to influence movement. We propose a probabilistic evaluation protocol for movement trajectory forecasts, addressing limitations of point-prediction metrics for inherently stochastic phenomena. Through comprehensive empirical evaluation of four method families across multiple temporal and spatial scales, we reveal that: (1) existing predictive methods generalize better to future timepoints than to unseen individuals, (2) deep learning approaches do not consistently outperform simpler baselines, and (3) environmental covariate selection significantly impacts performance. MoveBench enables standardized evaluation of movement forecasting methods and provides a foundation for methodological advances on this ecologically important task.

</details>


### [556] [Per-Matrix Optimality Is Not Enough: Three-Level Optimization for Low-Rank LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15838)
*Huicheng Zhang,Xiyao Feng,Ze-Tong Li,Chengkai Zhu,Xiao Shi,Xiwei Pan,Jinguo Liu,Ge Bai,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出三级压缩优化链(L1白化SVD、L2块级联合优化、L3端到端微调)，仅用256条校准序列将LLaMA-7B在60%压缩下WikiText-2困惑度从42.1降至11.4，并揭示离线计算-数据权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逐矩阵SVD截断在白化Frobenius范数下虽为Eckart-Young最优，但独立压缩各矩阵的误差会通过块的非线性前向传播累积放大，因此需要扩大优化范围来缓解复合误差。

Method: 受量子多体方法中分层变分优化启发，构建三级链：L1为白化SVD逐矩阵截断，L2为Transformer块级联合优化，L3为端到端语言建模损失精调；全程仅用256条校准序列，无需指令或恢复数据。

Result: LLaMA-7B在60%压缩下WikiText-2困惑度依次为42.1→19.1→11.4；跳过L2会使PTB困惑度恶化24点且端到端训练无法弥补；增益在20-80%压缩率、五种13B以内架构、分布内与分布外基准上均成立，但跨架构用各自配置、压缩率扫描未统一协议。

Conclusion: 该三级链有效提升困惑度与压缩保真度，块级阶段起正则化作用；校准数据增多时L2可跳过，存在离线计算-数据权衡。作者仅主张困惑度与压缩保真度改善，下游任务精度仍显著低于稠密模型。

Abstract: Per-matrix singular value decomposition (SVD) truncation is Eckart-Young optimal in the whitened Frobenius norm, but errors from independently compressed matrices compound through the block's nonlinear forward pass. Inspired in part by hierarchical variational optimization in quantum many-body methods, we introduce a three-level chain that widens optimization scope from individual matrices to Transformer blocks to the full model: whitened SVD~(L1), block-level joint optimization~(L2), and end-to-end language-modeling loss refinement~(L3), all from 256 calibration sequences, with no instruction or recovery data. On LLaMA-7B at 60% compression, the chain reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 42.1 to 19.1 to 11.4. The block-level stage acts as a regularizer: skipping it worsens Penn Treebank (PTB) perplexity by 24 points, a gap that additional end-to-end training did not close in our experiments. Perplexity gains hold across 20-80% compression, five architectures up to 13B parameters, and both in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks, though the cross-architecture rows use architecture-specific configurations and the ratio sweep was not run under one common protocol. With more calibration data, skipping the block-level stage becomes competitive, revealing an offline compute--data trade-off. We therefore claim improvements only in perplexity and compression fidelity; downstream accuracy remains well below the dense model.

</details>


### [557] [Task-Directed Residual AddUNet:Perfect-Reconstruction Routing for Full-Rate Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15857)
*Vikram R. Lakkavalli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立AddUNet的完美重构(PR)解释及其全速率实现，提出残差全速率PR架构用于任务导向表示学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将加性U-Net的survivor-skip结构与临界采样多速率PR滤波器组等价，从而解耦表示设计与重构设计。

Method: 证明约束加性U-Net等价于临界采样多速率PR滤波器组；提出全速率PR公式，去除互补子带限制；提出残差全速率PR架构，对任意形状兼容的线性/非线性路由算子保证精确重构，无需可逆性、匹配合成滤波器组、重构损失或学习解码器。

Result: 实验验证单通道线性可分离因子的精确路由达到机器精度；TIMIT上测试PER从28.60±2.09%降至25.76±0.41%（识别器与训练协议固定）；说话人探测显示结构守恒不必然带来任务特定不变性。

Conclusion: 守恒是结构性的，学习专注于任务导向路由；保留了路由信息且实现精确重构，全速率PR框架统一了AddUNet与恒等捷径ResNet。

Abstract: This paper establishes a perfect-reconstruction (PR) interpretation of AddUNet and its full-rate realization, and introduces a Residual Full-Rate PR architecture for task-directed representation learning. The survivor--skip structure of a constrained additive U-Net is shown to be exactly equivalent to a critically sampled multirate PR filter bank. The full-rate formulation removes the complementary-subband restrictions of the critically sampled system while preserving PR. A Residual Full-Rate PR architecture is then proposed to progressively route task-irrelevant, nuisance, or redundant structure away from the task-facing survivor while retaining the routed information explicitly. Exact reconstruction is guaranteed for arbitrary shape-compatible linear or nonlinear routing operators, without requiring invertibility, a matched synthesis bank, reconstruction loss, or learned decoder. The resulting architecture decouples representation design from reconstruction design: conservation is structural, while learning is devoted to task-directed routing. The same formulation identifies an identity-shortcut ResNet with its residual output retained as a full-rate PR system. Experiments verify exact single-channel routing of linearly separable factors to machine precision. On TIMIT, the proposed front-end improves test PER from $28.60\pm2.09\%$ to $25.76\pm0.41\%$ with the recognizer and training protocol held fixed, while maintaining exact reconstruction. Speaker probing further shows that structural conservation does not itself imply task-specific invariance.

</details>


### [558] [LLM-Based Schema-Aware Split Learning for Privacy-Preserving Mental Distress Prediction Across Heterogeneous Surveys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15871)
*Md Khalid Syfullah,Alvi Ataur Khalil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种模式感知的拆分学习（SL）框架，利用LLM作为共享语义编码器来统一异构心理健康调查模式，在保护隐私的同时实现高效协作预测建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理健康困扰日益普遍，各机构收集大量调查数据，但隐私约束和调查设计（问题、量表、格式）差异阻碍了数据的直接整合与协作分析。

Method: 采用LLM（LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct）作为共享语义编码器，将每条调查记录序列化为自然语言描述以统一异构模式；LLM通过LoRA微调并跨客户端-服务器拆分，客户端仅保留原始数据并运行轻量前端，资源密集的主干部署在服务器端。

Result: 仅用2,000训练样本即达到平均ANLS 0.708；在九个设置中有八个超越联邦学习；将每客户端计算量降低三个数量级；并可泛化到未见数据集。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了准确、隐私保护且资源高效的协作学习，可从异构心理健康调查数据中有效建模。

Abstract: Rising societal and lifestyle complexity has been linked to a growing prevalence of mental distress worldwide. Educational institutions, workplaces, clinics, etc. collect large volumes of mental health survey data to understand and reduce this burden. Collaborative analysis of such data could yield effective generalizable predictive models. Privacy constraints and varied survey designs (i.e., different questions, scales, and formats) hinder direct integration. We propose a schema-aware split learning (SL) framework that preserves privacy, using a large language model (LLM) as a shared semantic encoder to harmonize heterogeneous survey schemas across institutions. We serialize each survey record into a natural-language description, unifying disparate survey schemas into a common format. The LLM is fine-tuned for mental distress assessment via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and partitioned across client and server. Clients retain the raw survey responses locally and run only a lightweight front-end, so original records never leave the institution that collected them. The resource-intensive backbone runs on the server, minimizing client-side computation. Using LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct, the framework attains an average ANLS of 0.708 with only 2,000 training samples, surpasses federated learning (FL) in eight of nine settings, and cuts per-client computation by three orders of magnitude, while generalizing to unseen datasets. Overall, it enables accurate, privacy-preserving, and resource-efficient collaborative learning from heterogeneous mental health survey data.

</details>


### [559] [Learning Multimodal One-step Flow Policy via Value-weighted Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15883)
*Jaehun Shon,Jinha Choi,Jongwook Jeon,Jongmin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OptiFlow提出一种基于最优传输的一步流策略学习框架，联合训练值感知参考流策略与一步策略，通过状态级熵最优传输耦合动作样本，实现分布内高价值多模态行为的有效利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习仅从固定数据集学习策略，数据常含多模态动作分布。流策略能自然表示多模态行为，但学习高效一步流策略困难：标准值引导易导致模式坍塌，或在分布外区域利用高估偏差。

Method: 将一步流策略学习构建为结构化样本分配问题。联合训练值感知参考流策略与高效一步策略，通过状态级熵最优传输耦合二者动作样本；每个状态下，评论家估计值定义蒸馏目标动作的优先级，动作距离代价保证几何兼容配对；避免直接最大化评论家。

Result: 实验表明OptiFlow能有效捕捉最优多模态行为，在多种离线RL基准上取得强劲性能。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 传输引导的方法通过将一步策略锚定到高价值、数据集支持的模式，实现分布内利用，规避分布外发散风险，为一步流策略学习提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn a policy solely from fixed datasets, which often contain multimodal action distributions. Flow policies can naturally represent such multimodal behaviors, but learning an efficient one-step flow policy remains challenging: standard value guidance often leads to mode collapse or exploits overestimation bias in out-of-distribution regions. To address this, we introduce One-step Flow policy via Optimal Transport (OptiFlow), a framework for one-step flow policy learning as a structured sample-allocation problem. OptiFlow jointly trains a value-aware reference flow policy and an efficient one-step policy, coupling their action samples through state-wise entropic optimal transport. For each state, critic-estimated values define the priority of distillation target actions, while the action-distance cost ensures geometrically compatible pairings. By avoiding direct critic maximization, our transport-guided approach enables in-distribution exploitation by anchoring the one-step policy to high-value, dataset-supported modes without the risk of out-of-distribution divergence. Experimental results demonstrate that OptiFlow effectively captures optimal multimodal behaviors and achieves strong performance across diverse offline RL benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Yonsei-DILLab/OptiFlow.

</details>


### [560] [Privacy-enhanced federated learning via asynchronous aggregation and local differential perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15885)
*Zhen Zhong,Shini Yang,Liesheng Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种隐私增强联邦学习框架，融合DDP、轻量级同态加密与本地差分隐私，并采用带版本控制的异步聚合策略，在隐私保护与模型性能间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决分布式数据环境下安全协同训练问题，兼顾隐私保护与模型性能。

Method: 融合动态差分隐私（DDP）、轻量级同态加密（HE）与本地差分隐私（LDP）；采用异步聚合策略并引入版本控制以支持异步分布式训练。

Result: 在CIFAR-10与Purchase-100上，即使隐私约束严格（ε=0.1）仍保持高分类精度（最高82.6%），通信开销较FedAvg降低21.3%。

Conclusion: 该框架有效平衡隐私保护与模型性能，为大规模分布式协同计算提供可扩展的技术基础。

Abstract: This study proposes a privacy-enhanced federated learning framework to address secure collaborative training in distributed data environments. The framework integrates Dynamic Differential Privacy (DDP), lightweight Homomorphic Encryption (HE), and Local Differential Privacy (LDP) mechanisms to ensure data privacy protection during model training. Additionally, the framework employs an asynchronous aggregation strategy with version control to support distributed training in asynchronous environments. Experimental validation on the CIFAR-10 and Purchase-100 benchmark datasets demonstrates that the method maintains high classification accuracy (up to 82.6%) even under stringent privacy constraints (ε = 0.1), while reducing communication overhead by 21.3% compared to FedAvg. Experimental results demonstrate that this framework effectively balances privacy protection and model performance in distributed machine learning scenarios, providing a scalable technical foundation for large-scale distributed collaborative computing.

</details>


### [561] [Discrete Beckmann Transport Models for One-Step Language Modeling and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15903)
*Sophia Tang,Shiyi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DBTM提出一种基于时间无关流的离散Beckmann传输模型，其自主动传输映射可在单步内将任意点送达单纯形顶点的固定点，无需教师蒸馏即可实现少步生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散与流模型是有前景的自回归替代方案，但将多步采样压缩到少步通常需蒸馏预训练教师模型，这限制了学生模型质量上限，并带来昂贵的两阶段训练流程。

Method: 构建时间无关流，其自主动传输映射可将任意点到单纯形顶点固定点单步送达。该固定点性质由守恒方程刻画，其残差可直接从数据最小化，无需教师流与时间条件。部分训练映射对应有限时间截断流，生成即迭代单映射至不动点；并扩展为部分上下文插值，额外评估作为精炼步。

Result: 在语言建模与推理任务上，DBTM实现单步与少步生成，在质量与准确率上优于离散扩散及连续流基线。

Conclusion: DBTM通过时间无关流的固定点构造，绕开教师蒸馏与两阶段训练，实现高效少步生成并提升性能。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion and flow models are a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, but compressing many-step sampling into fewer steps typically requires distilling a pretrained teacher model. This caps the student at the teacher's quality and requires a costly two-stage training pipeline. We introduce Discrete Beckmann Transport Models (DBTM), built on a time-independent flow whose autonomous transport map provably carries any point in the ambient space to a fixed point on the vertices of the simplex in a single step. We show that this fixed-point property is characterized by a conservation equation whose residual can be minimized directly from data, removing the requirement for a teacher flow and time conditioning. Under this construction, a partially trained map corresponds to the flow truncated at finite time, so generation reduces to iterating one map until it reaches a fixed point. We further extend the map to a partial-context interpolant where additional function evaluations act as refinement steps rather than ODE integration steps. On language modeling and reasoning tasks, DBTM enables one- and few-step generation that improves quality and accuracy over discrete diffusion and continuous flow baselines.

</details>


### [562] [Privacy-Aligned Personalized Federated Learning with Compact Adaptation and Variable-Length Gaussian Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15950)
*Yilin Xu,Chun Hei Michael Shiu,Chih Wei Ling,Linqi Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对个性化联邦学习中记录级差分隐私的结构性错配问题，提出一次性释放私有客户端上下文、将重复自适应限制在固定系数空间的方法，并结合可变长量化实现高斯机制，降低通信开销同时保持隐私与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记录级差分隐私在个性化联邦学习中存在结构性错配：客户端特有的变化是低维的，但训练过程却反复释放高维更新，导致隐私与通信代价过高。

Method: 一次性释放私有客户端上下文，将重复自适应限制在固定系数空间；利用因子化生成器诱导自适应优化几何以重塑噪声更新；通过受控消融发现径向演化保留了大部分私有训练收益；并直接用可变长量化实现系数更新的高斯机制，使量化误差本身充当隐私扰动。

Result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，该方法在各隐私预算和客户端异质性下匹配或优于全模型私有自适应；在CIFAR-10、ε=16时，受保护上行通信降低2.67倍，且未来客户端精度相当。

Conclusion: 通过低维系数空间释放私有上下文、结合量化即扰动策略，可有效对齐隐私与个性化自适应需求，兼顾隐私、通信效率和模型精度。

Abstract: Record-level differential privacy exposes a structural misalignment in personalized federated learning when client-specific variation is low-dimensional while training repeatedly releases high-dimensional updates. In this paper, we address this misalignment by releasing a private client context once and confining repeated adaptation to a fixed coefficient space. Beyond dimensionality reduction, the factorized generator induces an adaptive optimization geometry that reshapes noisy updates, and controlled ablations show that most of its private-training gain is retained by radial evolution. To further reduce the communication cost, we realize the Gaussian mechanism for coefficient updates directly through variable-length quantization with finite expected code length, so that the quantization error itself serves as the required privacy perturbation rather than extra distortion. Across MNIST and CIFAR-10, our design matches or outperforms full-model private adaptation across privacy budgets and client heterogeneity, while reducing protected uplink by a factor of 2.67 at \(\varepsilon=16\) on CIFAR-10 with comparable future-client accuracy.

</details>


### [563] [A Chosen Future Can Still Be Rewritten: Causal Writability in Video Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15980)
*Xingyun Wang,Haomin Zheng,Man Yuan,Leqian Yang,Ziming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"因果可写性"(causal writability)：视频模型生成物理错误运动时，正确运动信息仍保留在模型内部，可通过低维编辑恢复，且存在深度"闭合"边界标记承诺点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究视频模型物理错误运动的成因：是没学到正确运动，还是学到了却未使用。作者主张是后者。

Method: 训练红色物体慢速、蓝色物体快速振荡的视频；测试红色物体快速运动（冲突情形）。用由简单物理变量预测的低维编辑注入正确运动，并测试不同网络深度处编辑的效果，揭示强度固定的深度边界（闭合），及更强下游写入与增益过冲现象。并在1.3B预训练视频模型上复现。

Result: 冲突情形下模型虽生成慢动作，但低维编辑能恢复正确快动作；固定强度下存在陡峭深度边界（边界前可改、边界后不可改）；运动信号仍留存，更强下游写入可恢复物理运动，增益过大则过冲；早期因果可写性可预测后续训练能纠正哪些错误（可写深度更多的错误更易被纠正）。

Conclusion: 因果可写性及其陡峭闭合在1.3B预训练视频模型中复现，表明该现象跨模型规模和训练范式具有通用性；模型并非未学到正确运动，而是未能使用。

Abstract: When a video model generates physically incorrect motion, did it fail to learn the correct motion, or did it learn it but fail to use it? We show the latter: the correct motion remains available inside the model and can still be made to control the generated video. We train on videos where red masses oscillate slowly and blue masses oscillate quickly, then test a red mass with fast observed motion. Even when the model generates slow motion in this conflicting case, a low-dimensional edit predicted from simple physical variables restores the correct fast motion. We call this ability causal writability. At fixed strength, we find a sharp depth boundary: the same edit changes the video before the boundary but not after it. This closure marks commitment for that write. The motion signal nevertheless remains, and a stronger downstream write can restore physical motion, while excessive gain overshoots. Early causal writability predicts which errors training later corrects: those errors are writable at more network depths than errors that persist. We reproduce both causal writability and its sharp closure in a pretrained 1.3B video model, supporting generality across model scale and training regime.

</details>

### [564] [Gaussian Normalized Coordinates and Risk-Neutral CDF Deformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14212)
*Jian Sun*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文提出用归一化隐含波动率坐标揭示无套利结构，并聚焦于赋予该坐标直接概率解释的核心量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在行权价空间中，无套利结构不够透明；归一化隐含波动率坐标能更清晰地呈现该结构，但缺乏直接的物理解释。

Method: 围绕一个单一量构建归一化隐含波动率坐标，使其具有直接的概率解释。

Result: 该量将隐含波动率坐标与概率意义直接联系起来，从而揭示无套利结构。

Conclusion: 通过概率解释的归一化坐标，可更透明地表征无套利约束。

Abstract: Normalized implied-volatility coordinates reveal no-arbitrage structure that is less transparent in strike space. This paper centers on a single quantity that gives those coordinates a direct probabilistic interpretation.

</details>


### [565] [The skew Brownian motion should not be used as a risk-neutral returns process: a well-posed skew-normal alternative](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15306)
*Lorenzo Torricelli,Michele Bufalo*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文指出基于偏斜布朗运动（SBM）的期权定价文献存在诸多错误与误解，尤其是普遍误认该模型为Itô-McKean SBM，且忽视其可套利的结论。作者重新表述SBM看涨期权公式，识别出具有偏斜正态边缘的正确Markovian SDE，并给出隐含波动率曲面的渐近分析及一个新的正态/偏斜正态随机占优性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于SBM的风险中性金融估值模型近二十年来日益流行，但其发展史充满错误与误解：主流金融模型被误认为基于Itô-McKean SBM（实则不然），且关于带局部时间的收益模型（如SBM）可套利的重要结论被广泛忽视。作者希望澄清该领域的混淆与误解。

Method: 逐一揭示现有SBM期权定价文献中的错误；重新表述SBM看涨期权定价公式；识别具有偏斜正态边缘分布的正确的Markovian SDE并证明其强适定性；利用闭式解对隐含波动率曲面进行渐近分析。

Result: 证明即使SBM收益模型存在套利，其期权定价公式本身并不产生套利；给出正确的具有偏斜正态边缘的Markovian SDE并证明强适定性；提供隐含波动率曲面的渐近分析；并得到一个具有独立意义的新颖正态/偏斜正态随机占优性质。

Conclusion: SBM期权定价文献中的错误与误解需被澄清；尽管SBM收益模型可套利，其期权定价公式仍可正确使用；通过正确的Markovian SDE与偏斜正态边缘分布，可将SBM的偏斜正态边缘潜力正当地用于风险中性估值。

Abstract: Return models for risk-neutral financial valuation based on skew Brownian motions (SBMs) have been introduced about twenty years ago, and have recently enjoying growing popularity. Unfortunately, the story behind their development is one of mistakes and erroneous interpretations, beginning from the foundational misrepresentations that the prevalent financial model is based on the Itô-McKean SBM -- which, in fact, it is not. Besides, and more seriously, the clarification of \cite{rossello2012arbitrage} that price models with a local time in their returns, such as the SBM, are arbitrageable
  has been, by and large, ignored.
  In this paper, we try to clear the field from the confusions and misconceptions lurking in the standing option pricing literature on SBM, by exposing all the errors we could trace in the treatment so far.
  Recognizing however the potential of the SBM skew-normal marginals for risk-neutral valuation, as a positive contribution, we reformulate the putative SBM call pricing formula and show that, even if the SBM return model admits arbitrage, its option pricing formula does not. The correct Markovian SDE with skew-normal marginals is then identified, its strong well-posedness shown, and by exploiting the availability of closed formulae, an asymptotic analysis of the implied volatility surface is offered. En route to our conclusions, we obtain a novel normal/skew-normal stochastic dominance property of independent interest.

</details>


<div id='eess.SY'></div>

# eess.SY [[Back]](#toc)

### [566] [From Winding-Fault Geometry to Reliability: Estimation and Prognosis of Stator Inter-Turn Faults](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13448)
*Bambang L. Widjiantoro,Syahrul Munir,Katherin Indriawati,Moh Kamalul Wafi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个从物理建模到在线诊断、退化预测与可靠性评估的统一框架，用于感应电机定子匝间短路故障，采用增广状态粒子滤波联合估计机电状态与故障严重度，并以四种预测模型连接阈值穿越RUL、可靠性评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 定子匝间短路是感应电机常见故障，其严重度与空间方位影响输出特征；现有方法多局限于单一环节（建模、诊断或预测），缺少从物理故障模型到在线估计、退化预测与可靠性评估的一体化衔接。

Method: 建立几何故障模型，证明输出特征对故障严重度呈仿射关系并具基本空间周期性；利用该结构，用增广状态粒子滤波同时估计非线性机电状态与未知故障严重度并给出后验不确定性；随后用线性趋势、Holt指数平滑、贝叶斯退化、粒子预测四种模型外推退化，并接入阈值穿越RUL、首次穿越可靠性、退化相关危险率可靠性及Weibull寿命基准。

Result: 数值结果表明：可准确在线估计故障并重构输出；刻画了退化模式与预测时域对预测效果的影响；可靠性与阈值穿越预测具有一致性；由空间周期性导致的不同故障方位下估计精度相当。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了从基于物理的匝间故障建模到在线诊断、退化预测与可靠性评估的统一连接，兼顾确定性与概率性健康评估。

Abstract: This paper develops an integrated framework for estimation, prognosis, and reliability assessment of stator inter-turn faults in induction motors. The fault is characterized by its severity, defined as the fraction of short-circuited turns, and its spatial orientation. A geometric fault model shows that the resulting output signature is affine in the fault severity and exhibits a fundamental spatial periodicity. Exploiting this structure, an augmented-state particle filter jointly estimates the nonlinear electromechanical state and the unknown fault severity while quantifying posterior uncertainty. The estimated degradation is then propagated using four prognostic models: linear trend, Holt exponential smoothing, Bayesian degradation, and particle-based forecasting. Their predictions are connected to threshold-crossing remaining useful life (RUL), first-passage reliability, degradation-dependent hazard reliability, and a Weibull lifetime benchmark, thereby providing both deterministic and probabilistic health assessments. Numerical results demonstrate accurate online fault estimation and output reconstruction, characterize the effects of degradation pattern and prediction horizon on prognosis, and show consistent reliability and threshold-crossing predictions. Moreover, estimation accuracy remains comparable across the distinct fault orientations induced by the spatial periodicity. The resulting framework provides a unified connection from physics-based inter-turn fault modeling to online diagnosis, degradation prognosis, and reliability assessment.

</details>


### [567] [Storage-Based Strategic Manipulation of Constraint-Binding Patterns in Power Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15755)
*Mehdi Davoudi,Minghao Mou,Junjie Qin*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究垄断型储能聚合商(ESA)在日前电力市场中的策略性参与，将其与系统运营商的交互建模为Stackelberg博弈，并通过约束绑定模式分解求解均衡，揭示FTR对福利的负面影响并提出限制机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 储能聚合商协调分布式储能并可能持有金融输电权(FTRs)，其策略性投标可能扭曲市场结果。已有研究已知无FTR时策略性储能能弱改善社会福利，但FTR的引入是否会破坏这一福利保证尚不明确，需要新的建模与均衡分析框架。

Method: 将ESA与系统运营商的交互表述为Stackelberg博弈：运营商通过网络约束、多周期经济调度清算市场，决定发电/负荷计划、节点电价、能量市场支付与FTR收益；采用市场出清问题的"约束绑定模式分解"刻画均衡，并据此分析ESA通过诱导或规避特定约束绑定模式来提升利润的策略。

Result: 理论证明：某些FTR头寸会强化ESA诱导特定约束模式的动机，使社会福利降至无储能水平以下，推翻无FTR情形下的弱福利改善保证。针对此，提出两种系统运营商机制以限制ESA的不当行为及其对市场结果和福利的负面影响。三节点算例验证理论，IEEE测试系统验证方法的可扩展性。

Conclusion: FTR的存在可能使策略性储能的福利效应从改善转为恶化；通过约束绑定模式视角可有效计算均衡并识别不利行为；所提运营商机制可缓解这些负面影响，且方法在标准测试系统上具备可扩展性。

Abstract: This paper studies the strategic market participation of a monopolistic energy
  storage aggregator (ESA) in a day-ahead electricity market. The ESA coordinates
  geographically distributed storage units, submits a coordinated bid for its
  portfolio, and may hold financial transmission rights (FTRs). The system
  operator clears the market through a network-constrained, multi-period economic
  dispatch, determining generation and load schedules, nodal prices,
  energy-market payments, and FTR payoffs. We formulate the ESA--system-operator
  interaction as a Stackelberg game and characterize its equilibrium through a
  constraint-binding-pattern decomposition of the market-clearing problem.
  Beyond enabling equilibrium computation, the framework reveals how the ESA can
  increase its profit by strategically inducing or avoiding particular
  constraint-binding patterns. It also establishes a novel welfare result: although strategic storage without
  FTRs is known to weakly improve social welfare relative to the no-storage case,
  certain FTR positions can overturn this guarantee by strengthening the ESA's
  incentive to induce particular patterns, causing social welfare to fall below
  the no-storage level. Motivated
  by these findings, we develop two system-operator mechanisms for limiting
  undesirable ESA behavior and its adverse effects on market outcomes and social
  welfare. Finally, a three-bus study illustrates the theoretical findings, while IEEE test systems
  demonstrate the scalability of the proposed method.

</details>


### [568] [Active Filter Design for Buffering Datacenter-Scale Power Fluctuations from Training AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13490)
*Dillon Jensen,Grant Wilkins,Obi Nnorom,Hugo Budd,Phil Levis,Juan Rivas*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种机架级储能供电架构，通过自动检测负载变化并用机架储能补偿，使电网侧功率爬升率保持在预设范围内，从而缓解大模型训练同步负载对电网硬件的冲击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型训练需数千处理器并行，负载功率爬升速度远超电网硬件补偿能力，传统供电架构难以应对。

Method: 设计并实验验证一种新型供电架构：自动检测负载功率变化，利用机架内储能进行缓冲，为电网响应争取时间，且无需修改系统软件；原型额定10 kW、400 VDC、物料成本$3,500。

Result: 原型成功为训练负载供电，并将电网侧功率爬升率限制在预设范围内；硬件缓冲可靠，兼容任意训练负载。

Conclusion: 该架构以硬件方式解决训练负载功率波动问题，无需软件改动，具备通用性与成本可行性。

Abstract: Training large AI models requires thousands of processors working in parallel. This synchronized load poses a challenge for traditional power delivery architectures, because IT power ramps much faster than grid hardware can compensate.
  This paper presents a hardware solution to this problem, introducing a novel power delivery architecture which automatically detects changes in load power and compensates using on-rack energy storage, giving time for the grid to respond to the varying load. The architecture is validated experimentally, powering a training load while limiting the grid-side power ramp rate such that it stays within pre-specified range. The prototype presented is rated to deliver up to 10 kW of buffered power in a 400 VDC system, with a bill of materials cost of $3,500 USD. The system design is described in detail. A key advantage of this architecture versus other approaches is that it reliably buffers power fluctuations without requiring any changes to system software, making it compatible with any training workload.

</details>


### [569] [A Duality Reformulation of the Companion-Matrix Lyapunov Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13522)
*Augusto Ferrante*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究连续时间Lyapunov方程解的正半定性与逐元素非负性的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨Lyapunov方程解的正半定性与逐元素非负性之间的等价关系，并验证关于Hurwitz伴生矩阵的猜想。

Method: 利用解算子的伴随性证明等价关系，结合可控性Gramian归一化与实增殖矩阵伴随多项式系数的成对正性定理。

Result: 证明两性质对所有实Hurwitz伴生矩阵均成立，解决了之前仅在实谱假设下成立的猜想。

Conclusion: 建立了正半定性与非负性的等价，并给出协方差与能量解释，联系耗散实现与阻尼二阶系统。

Abstract: We study the relation between positive semidefiniteness and entrywise nonnegativity for solutions of continuous-time Lyapunov equations. For a real Hurwitz matrix $A$, we show that the solution of $AP+PA^\top=-Q$ is positive semidefinite for every symmetric entrywise nonnegative $Q$ if and only if the solution of $A^\top X+XA=-R$ is entrywise nonnegative for every positive semidefinite $R$. This equivalence follows from the adjointness of the two solution operators and extends to all real unmixed matrices. We then prove that both properties hold for every real Hurwitz companion matrix, settling a conjecture previously established under the additional assumption of a real spectrum. The proof combines a controllability-Gramian normalization with a pairwise positivity theorem for the coefficients of the adjugate polynomial of a real accretive matrix. The latter is obtained from a coefficient-sign property of bivariate polynomials, an auxiliary determinant that does not vanish on the product of two open right half-planes, and a rank-one perturbation argument. Covariance and energy interpretations connect these results with dissipative realizations, damped second-order systems, and comparisons between input Gramians.

</details>


### [570] [Predicted-Flow Control Barrier Functions for Non-Control-Affine Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13591)
*Amirsaeid Safari,Jesse B. Hoagg*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出改进的预测流控制屏障函数（P-CBF），解决了原有方法仅适用于控制仿射系统且预测视界可能缩短或消失的局限，实现了固定视界内的安全认证与性能优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CBF仅在时间上逐点施加约束，不考虑未来状态演化，导致控制短视（myopic）。P-CBF虽能在整个预测视界内认证安全性，但现有工作仅适用于控制仿射系统，且预测视界可能缩短甚至消失。

Method: 引入规划控制（planning control），可在参数化规划与备用控制之间平滑过渡，并用时间平移参数决定是否需要过渡；通过一个保证可行的凸优化（控制限为凸多面体时退化为QP）求解控制规划与时间平移参数的演化；实际执行控制由瞬时规划控制与时间平移确定。

Result: 在密集障碍环境中自动驾驶汽车导航的仿真中，与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）进行对比验证。

Conclusion: 该方法同时解决了固定预测视界内的安全认证与性能优化问题，克服了先前P-CBF的适用性与视界退化限制。

Abstract: Control barrier functions (CBFs) enforce safety through conditions imposed pointwise in time without consideration of state evolution over a future horizon. Thus, CBF-based controls are typically myopic. Predicted-flow CBFs (P-CBFs) generalize CBFs from a function of the current state to a functional of the predicted flow under a parametrized control. P-CBFs can certify safety over the entire prediction horizon while simultaneously allowing for performance optimization over the horizon. However, prior work with P-CBFs only applies to control-affine systems, and suffers from a limitation where the prediction horizon can shrink or even vanish. This article addresses both of these shortcomings by introducing a planning control that smoothly transitions from a parametric plan to a backup control (if needed) and a time-shift parameter that determines if transition is needed. The evolution of the control-plan and time-shift parameters is determined from a single guaranteed-feasible convex optimization, which reduces to a quadratic program (QP) if the control limits are a convex polyhedron. The real-time executed control is determined from the instantaneous planning control and time shift. This method simultaneously addresses safety certification and performance optimization over the fixed prediction horizon. The approach is compared to nonlinear model predictive control in simulation of an autonomous car navigating a dense obstacle environment.

</details>


### [571] [Underwater Barrier Sensing Under a Network False-Alarm Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13662)
*Hesam Mosalli,Stephane Blouin,Amir G. Aghdam*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究联合传感器布点与检测器工作点分配以守卫区域。为高斯信号超额模型给出负对数漏检风险的凹性充要条件，据此设计凹max-min分配、线性割与独立证书，深水案例中警报预算重分配使图设计目标提升14.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 守卫区域需在共享误报预算下优化传感器布点与检测阈值；负对数漏检风险是否凹以及连续场屏障强度能否独立验证尚不明确。

Method: 针对平方律检测器的高斯信号超额模型，推导传感器误报概率下负对数漏检风险凹性的充要条件；构造凹max-min分配及其鞍点；用透视重构生成混合整数问题的线性割；并给出与图搜索无关的连续屏障强度下界证书。

Result: 固定部署下的凹max-min分配鞍点使单位警报的边际屏障增益与最坏情况占用测度相等；深水基准Munk剖面案例中，固定传感器数与警报负载下重分配预算使图设计目标提升14.9%；证书在插值连续场上建立屏障要求，而单独图值无法做到。

Conclusion: 该框架为共享误报预算下的联合布点与工作点分配提供可解结构与验证手段，并在深水案例中证明预算重分配与连续场证书的实用价值。

Abstract: We study joint sensor placement and detector operating-point allocation for guarding a region against an adversarial crossing. Each sensor may adjust its detection threshold, while all sensors draw on a shared network-level false-alarm budget. For a Gaussian signal-excess model of a square-law detector, we give a necessary and sufficient condition for the negative-log miss hazard to be concave in a sensor's false-alarm probability. At fixed deployment, this yields a concave max-min allocation whose saddle point equalizes marginal barrier gain per unit alarm against a worst-case occupation measure. A perspective reformulation supplies linear cuts for the mixed-integer joint problem, and a separate certificate lower-bounds the continuum barrier strength independently of the graph used for path search. On a deep-water case study based on the canonical Munk profile, reallocating a fixed alarm budget raises the graph design objective by 14.9% at unchanged sensor count and alarm load, and the certificate establishes the barrier requirement on the interpolated continuum field, which the graph value alone cannot.

</details>


### [572] [Data-Driven Spiking Control for Distributed $\varepsilon$-Nash Equilibrium Seeking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13663)
*Linqi Wang,Wei Xiao,Yuzhou Wei,Bin Xin,Keyou You,Gang Wang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文研究如何用脉冲（spiking）控制实现直接由数据合成的反馈律，同时保持博弈论性能保证：在网络博弈中实现分布式ε-Nash均衡（NE）寻求，通过鲁棒LMI从含噪输入-状态数据直接计算稳定模拟反馈增益，并给出两种脉冲实现，证明前向完备性、无Zeno性及伪梯度的最终界，从而保证有限暂态后输出构成ε-NE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性动力学智能体模型未知且受外源扰动，需在不辨识系统的情况下直接从数据合成控制，并将连续的博弈反馈律转化为仅用固定权重脉冲神经元的实现，同时保留ε-Nash均衡的性能保证。

Method: 将博弈伪梯度视为被调节误差，用局部内模处理已知外系统信号；通过鲁棒线性矩阵不等式从含噪局部输入-状态数据直接计算稳定模拟反馈增益，无需辨识智能体动力学。开发两种脉冲实现：一种使用非交互的漏积分-发放单元，另一种允许神经元单元间的复位耦合；引入连续辅助坐标，将脉冲闭环暴露为受有界实现误差驱动的稳定模拟系统。

Result: 该表示给出前向完备性、无Zeno性及伪梯度的最终界（对连接架构有显式事件处理条件）；该界意味着有限暂态后，智能体输出对任意高于有限阈值的ε构成ε-NE。航天器编队重构示例展示了数据驱动合成、两种脉冲实现及其实际均衡行为。

Conclusion: 直接从数据合成的模拟反馈增益可由固定权重脉冲控制实现，并保留分布式ε-Nash均衡的博弈论性能保证，在含未知模型与扰动的网络博弈中有效，且经航天器编队重构示例验证。

Abstract: This paper studies how a feedback law synthesized directly from data can be realized by spiking control while retaining a game-theoretic performance guarantee. We consider distributed $\varepsilon$-Nash equilibrium (NE) seeking in network games played by linear dynamical agents with unknown models and exogenous disturbances. The pseudo-gradient of the game is treated as a regulated error, and local internal models account for signals generated by known exosystems. Robust linear matrix inequalities are then used to compute stabilizing analogue feedback gains directly from noisy local input-state data, without identifying the agent dynamics. To implement these gains using only fixed-weight spikes, we develop two spiking realizations. The first realization uses non-interacting leaky integrate-and-fire units, while the second permits reset coupling among the neuronal units. In both cases, a continuous auxiliary coordinate exposes the impulsive closed loop as the stable analogue system driven by a bounded implementation error. This representation yields forward completeness, Zeno-freeness, and an ultimate bound on the pseudo-gradient, subject to explicit event-processing conditions for the connected architecture. The bound implies that, after a finite transient, the agents' outputs constitute an $\varepsilon$-NE for every $\varepsilon$ above a finite threshold. A spacecraft formation reconfiguration example illustrates the data-driven synthesis, the two spiking realizations, and their practical equilibrium behavior.

</details>


### [573] [Low-Ripple Modulation Strategy for a Photovoltaic-Based Triple-Port Hydrogen Production System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13746)
*Shiqi Zhang,Ziang Jiao,Jiaxin Su,Ning Wang,Zheng Li,Xiaoqiang Guo,Changchun Hua*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对可再生能源制氢中三有源桥隔离DC-DC变换器，提出一种内、外移相角协同优化的低纹波调制策略，以抑制制氢端口电流纹波。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电解制氢的制氢端口电流纹波会影响电解槽效率和制氢速率，现有研究对电流纹波优化效果有限且难以实现动态优化，导致动态工况下纹波抑制不足。

Method: 建立精确数学模型，推导最小电流纹波条件下的最优移相角组合；采用带自适应参数策略的改进差分进化算法，实现动态工况下的全局优化。

Result: 仿真与实验结果表明，所提策略能有效抑制电流纹波，为波动性可再生能源制氢提供高效可靠方案。

Conclusion: 所提出的内外移相角协同优化低纹波调制策略可有效抑制制氢端口电流纹波，适用于可再生能源波动场景。

Abstract: Among various production methods, hydrogen generation via electrolysis powered by renewable energy plays a key role in achieving large-scale green hydrogen production. The triple active bridge isolated DC-DC conversion system exhibits significant application potential in hydrogen production due to its advantages, such as high energy density, wide step-down ratio, and high reliability. However, the output current ripple at the hydrogen production port critically affects the efficiency of the electrolyzer and the hydrogen production rate. Existing studies have limited optimization effects on current ripple and struggle to achieve dynamic optimization, leading to constrained ripple suppression under dynamic operating conditions. To address this issue, this paper proposes a low-ripple modulation strategy based on coordinated optimization of inner and outer phase-shift angles for multi-port power conversion systems in renewable energy hydrogen production. By establishing an accurate mathematical model, the optimal phase-shift angle combination under minimal current ripple conditions is derived. An improved differential evolution algorithm with adaptive parameter strategy is employed to achieve global optimization under dynamic conditions. Simulation and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed strategy effectively suppresses current ripple, providing an efficient and reliable solution for hydrogen production from fluctuating renewable energy sources.

</details>


### [574] [From Benchmark to Deployment: Shift-Robust Fabric Recognition for Industrial Textile Onboarding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13774)
*Haochen Li,Chenwei Wang,Felicity S. C. Tang,Misbah Iqbal,Carman K. M. Lee,Elif Ozden Yenigun*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文重新审视织物结构自动识别任务，指出精度虚高源于数据泄漏，真正瓶颈是采集源偏移，并提出中心纹理配方与成本感知的人机路由方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纺织品采购中，来样织物结构（平纹、斜纹、缎纹）仍靠手工分类，成为瓶颈；而现有基准精度看似已解决该问题，却在实际部署中难以维持，因此需揭示精度背后的真实困难。

Method: 在FabricFlow基准上做三项工作：进行重复样本审计并重建无泄漏划分；采用架构无关的中心纹理配方缓解采集源偏移；设计基于分类学严重性成本的置信门控路由策略，将高置信样本自动分类，仅将不确定少数交由人工处理。

Result: 无泄漏标准训练在档案独有留出集上Top-1为58.0%、校准误差0.158；中心纹理配方提升13.5个Top-1点并恢复校准；同时报告了层级分类、OCR融合和零样本视觉语言模型均无帮助的负结果。

Conclusion: 研究给出一套具体、校准良好且成本感知的可部署织物入库配方，强调诚实报告负结果与真实数据划分的重要性。

Abstract: Automatically recognising a fabric's construction (jersey, twill, satin) is a bottleneck in textile sourcing, where incoming swatches are still typed by hand. Benchmark accuracy suggests the problem is solved, yet rarely survives deployment. On the \numClasses{}-class FabricFlow benchmark we expose three gaps that headline accuracy hides. First, a duplication audit reveals train/test leakage that inflates accuracy; we rebuild leakage-free splits that report the true difficulty. Second, on the clean data the binding failure is acquisition-source shift between catalogues, not the peripheral shortcuts one might fear: on an archive-exclusive hold-out, standard training holds 58.0\% Top-1 at a calibration error of 0.158, while a simple, architecture-agnostic central-texture recipe adds 13.5 Top-1 points and restores calibration. Third, because confusing one fabric family for another is costlier than a within-family slip, we optimise a taxonomic-severity cost: a confidence-gated routing policy auto-types confident swatches and refers only the uncertain minority to a human, sharply cutting onboarding cost. Throughout we report honest negatives: hierarchical classification, OCR fusion and zero-shot vision--language models all fail to help, yielding a concrete, calibrated, cost-aware recipe for deployable textile onboarding.

</details>


### [575] [Optimal Threshold Type Policies for Partially Observable Restless Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13886)
*Anu Krishna,Rahul Meshram,Kesav Ram Kaza*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究有限状态部分可观测的restless多臂老虎机，受资源受限野生动物监测启发。核心贡献是对多维信念状态最优策略的结构刻画：证明激活优势关于信念单调的充分条件，从而最优策略具有阈值结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源受限野生动物监测中，每个地点的潜在状态独立演化，每步只能监测有限地点。主动监测可揭示当前状态，被动运行无观测，形成崩塌式老虎机信念动态。多维信念状态的最优策略结构此前缺乏刻画。
