Method: 建立部分可观测restless多臂老虎机（PO-RMAB）模型。通过模型相关的Lipschitz常数来界定值函数的变化幅度，从而给出激活优势关于信念状态单调的充分条件；进一步将结果特化到一步生灭（birth-death）动态并推导显式界。

Result: 证明了在充分条件下激活优势关于信念单调，最优策略在(M-1)维信念单纯形上呈阈值型结构；对一步生灭动态给出了显式的Lipschitz界。

Conclusion: 该工作为多维信念状态下的PO-RMAB最优策略提供了结构性刻画，阈值性质可简化策略计算，并可推广至具体动态模型（如生灭过程）。

Abstract: We study a finite-state partially observable restless multi-armed bandit (PO-RMAB) motivated by resource-constrained wildlife monitoring. The underlying condition of each location evolves independently, while only a limited number of locations can be actively monitored at each decision epoch. Activation reveals the current state, whereas passive operation provides no observation, yielding a collapsing-bandit belief dynamics. Our main contribution is a structural characterisation of optimal policies for the multidimensional belief-state problem. We establish sufficient conditions under which an activation advantage is monotone with respect to the belief state, and hence the optimal policy has the threshold type structure over the $(M-1)$-dimensional belief simplex. The key result is obtained by bounding the variation of the value function through a model-dependent Lipschitz constant. We further specialise the result to one-step birth-death dynamics and derive explicit bounds.

</details>


### [576] [Influence Enhancement in Opinion Dynamics Using Edge Modification: A Kron Reduction-Based Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13895)
*Aashi Shrinate,Aravind Seshadri,Twinkle Tripathy,Laxmidhar Behera,Lingfei Wang,Karl Henrik Johansson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文在Friedkin-Johnsen观点动力学模型下，通过边修改（模拟社交网络推荐机制）提升目标顽固智能体的影响力，提出基于拓扑的条件与高效近似优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线社交网络成为广告与倡导的主要平台，增强用户影响力具有重要价值。现有工作多未利用网络拓扑特性来提升影响力，本文试图从拓扑角度解决该问题。

Method: 在FJ模型下引入"边修改"概念（对应推荐机制）；提出基于拓扑的判定条件，识别总能提升目标顽固智能体影响力的边修改；将问题建模为离散优化以最大化影响力中心性，并给出计算高效的近似解法。

Result: 所提边修改的影响对顽固度、交互权重等参数变化保持鲁棒；近似算法能有效求解优化问题；在Erdos-Renyi随机图上的FJ动力学实验中验证了方法有效性。

Conclusion: 通过利用网络拓扑进行边修改，可在参数变化下稳健地提升目标顽固智能体的影响力，近似优化方法在实践中有效。

Abstract: With the emergence of online social networks as a primary platform for advertising and advocacy, enhancing a user's influence has become of significant interest. In this paper, we investigate this problem under the Friedkin Johnsen opinion dynamics model, wherein stubborn agents influence the opinions of other agents in the network. Unlike most of the existing works, we leverage topological properties of the network to increase the influence of a desired stubborn agent. Specifically, we introduce the notion of edge modification, which mimics the mechanism of recommendations in social networks. First, we present a topology-based condition that identifies edge modifications that always increase the influence of a desired stubborn agent. It is shown that the impact of the chosen edge modifications remains robust
  to changes in parameters such as stubbornness and the interaction weights. Thereafter, we formulate a discrete optimisation problem to identify a set of edge modifications that maximise the agent's influence centrality. We present a computationally efficient approximate solution to the optimisation problem. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on the Friedkin-Johnsen opinion dynamics over the Erdos Renyi random graph.

</details>


### [577] [Diffusion-Based Multiple-Shooting Indirect Optimal Control for Fuel-Optimal Spacecraft Trajectory Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13990)
*Saeid Tafazzol,Ehsan Taheri,Ryne Beeson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种基于扩散模型的多重打靶间接控制方法，将扩散模型的探索能力与间接法结合，用于生成燃料最优航天器轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散生成模型在机器人控制中可探索解的多样性，但缺乏最优性保证；而间接最优控制方法虽满足必要最优条件，却对初始协态估计高度敏感，导致求解Hamiltonian边值问题（HBVP）收敛域狭窄。

Method: 提出基于扩散模型的多重打靶间接控制方法，融合扩散模型的探索能力与间接法，缓解协态初值估计的敏感性并扩大HBVP的收敛域。

Result: 在燃料最优地球-火星低推力转移问题上与基于随机协态初始化的先进间接法进行基准测试，收敛鲁棒性优于该先进间接方法。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效提升燃料最优航天器轨迹求解的收敛鲁棒性，为长时域、bang-bang型轨迹的间接最优控制提供可行方案。

Abstract: Diffusion-based generative models (DMs) have found applications in control problems, and in particular robotics, where the DMs enable exploration of possible control solutions. A critical shortcoming of these applications is that they have lacked optimality guarantees. This is a problem for their potential use in fuel-optimal spacecraft trajectories that are characterized with long time-horizons and bang-bang profiles. Alternatively, indirect optimal control methods ensure explicit satisfaction of necessary conditions, but are highly sensitive to the initial costate estimation needed to solve the resulting Hamiltonian boundary-value problems (HBVPs). To alleviate this sensitivity and enlarge the convergence domain of HBVPs, advanced indirect methods have been developed that use smoothing approaches and continuation. We propose a diffusion-based multiple shooting indirect control method that combines the exploration capability of DMs with indirect method to generate fuel-optimal spacecraft trajectories. We benchmark our method against an advanced indirect method on a fuel-optimal Earth-Mars low-thrust transfer problem, showing higher convergence robustness than the advanced indirect method that is based on random costate initialization. Code and visualizations are available at https://saeidtafazzol.github.io/Diffusion_Indirect_Control/.

</details>


### [578] [Characterizing Identifiability and Generalization for Inverse Receding-Horizon Linear-Quadratic Regulator Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14053)
*Zhiyuan Jin,Jingqi Li,David Fridovich-Keil*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究滚动时域LQR中的目标函数推断问题，刻画了目标可唯一辨识的条件，并分析了对未见状态的动作预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 给定序贯的状态-动作观测（动作为新求解的有限时域LQR问题首个控制），需要理解能否从观测中辨识出LQR目标函数，以及辨识不确定性对动作预测的影响。

Method: 将每个观测动作建模为有限时域LQR的首个控制，理论分析目标唯一可辨识性及额外观测是否提供新信息；分析动作预测，在观测状态的仿射包内比较不同目标函数对应的动作，在包外推导预测误差上界；针对仅线性目标项未知的情形给出精确预测结论，并进行数值实验（含随机观测噪声）。

Result: 刻画了目标唯一可辨识的条件及额外观测无信息的情形；证明所有复现观测动作的目标在观测状态的仿射包上产生相同动作，包外给出预测误差上界；当仅线性目标项未知时在所有状态均可精确预测；数值结果显示在随机噪声下重新优化推断目标仍能准确预测未见状态动作。

Conclusion: 滚动时域LQR目标函数的可辨识性与预测行为具有明确结构性；即使存在观测噪声，基于推断目标重新优化可实现跨规划时域的准确动作预测。

Abstract: We consider the problem of objective inference in the context of receding-horizon linear-quadratic regulator (LQR). In this setting, we are given sequential state-action observations, where each observed action is the first control of a newly solved finite-horizon LQR problem. We characterize when the objective of that problem is uniquely identifiable from these observations and when additional observations provide no new information about the objective. We then analyze action prediction at unseen states and show that all objectives reproducing the observed actions yield identical actions throughout the affine hull of the observed states; outside this hull, we derive an upper bound on the prediction error. % and deriving a prediction-error bound outside this hull. Additionally, we show that, when only the linear objective terms are unknown, exact prediction holds at every state. Finally, numerical results show that, even under stochastic observation noise, re-optimizing an inferred objective enables accurate action prediction at unseen states across different planning horizons.

</details>


### [579] [Fixed-Time Resilient Integral Reinforcement Learning for Input-Constrained Unknown Nonlinear Systems Under FDI Attacks and Disturbances: A Data-Driven Admissible Warm Start](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14067)
*Tien Dat Vu,Minh Doan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种弹性学习控制器，针对存在执行器饱和、虚假数据注入攻击和外部扰动的未知非线性系统，利用有限轨迹数据学习饱和安全策略，实现学习误差与闭环状态的固定时间收敛，并保障鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未知非线性系统在实际中常受执行器限制、恶意数据注入攻击与外部扰动影响，传统学习方法难以兼顾安全性、快速收敛与对初始化的鲁棒性。

Method: 采用积分形式消除未知漂移，利用存储的信息性数据在激励消退后持续学习；通过有限维Koopman表示提升预部署数据构造稳定初始策略，其逆饱和策略映射提供数据驱动的评论家权重热启动。

Result: 控制器结构上保持输入约束，在持续攻击与扰动下保证实用的固定时间鲁棒性；双连杆机器人镇定实验验证了快速状态恢复、有界评论家学习、执行器约束可靠满足及改进的闭环性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的学习与初始化架构能在攻击和扰动下实现快速、安全且对初始化鲁棒的固定时间控制，具有实际应用潜力。

Abstract: This paper develops a resilient learning controller for unknown nonlinear systems operating under actuator limits, false-data-injection attacks, and external disturbances. The key idea is to learn a saturated secure policy directly from finite trajectory data while guaranteeing that both the learning error and the closed-loop state converge to compact neighborhoods within a uniform fixed time independent of initial conditions. An integral formulation removes the unknown drift from the implementable learning law, while stored informative data sustain learning after online excitation fades. To mitigate the closed-loop sensitivity to arbitrary critic initialization, pre-deployment data, which may also be reused from the replay stack, are lifted through a finite-dimensional Koopman representation to construct a stabilizing initial policy, whose inverse saturated-policy map provides a data-driven critic-weight warm start. The resulting controller preserves input constraints by construction and guarantees practical fixed-time robustness under persistent attacks and disturbances. The proposed learning and initialization architecture is further verified through a two-link robot stabilization example, where the results demonstrate rapid state recovery, bounded critic learning, reliable actuator-constraint satisfaction, and improved closed-loop behavior under informed critic initialization.

</details>


### [580] [Predefined-Time Integral Reinforcement Learning for Saturated Unknown Nonlinear Multi-Agent Systems Under FDI Attacks and Disturbances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14075)
*Tien Dat Vu,Minh Doan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 针对受执行器约束、外部干扰和FDI攻击的未知非线性多智能体系统，提出基于积分Bellman-Isaacs方程的critic-only强化学习框架，实现预定时间安全编队控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未知非线性多智能体系统在安全编队中面临执行器饱和、外部干扰与FDI攻击的多重挑战，且需要不依赖初始条件的预定时间收敛保证，传统固定时间方法难以直接满足。

Method: 将图耦合协调误差动态建模为局部零和微分博弈，采用非二次输入效用生成饱和兼容的安全策略；用积分Bellman-Isaacs等式消除对未知非线性漂移的显式依赖，实现有限轨迹数据的critic-only学习；设计两幂状态代价结构与deadline参数化critic更新，将总期限分配到数据信息性、critic学习、强化窗口与编队收敛各环节。

Result: 证明了critic与编队误差在独立于初始条件下的实用预定时间收敛到有界残差集，并通过构造满足安全执行器约束；仿真在FDI攻击、干扰、输入约束及不同初始条件下验证了框架有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架将最优学习与预定时间稳定统一，通过deadline分配机制优于增益决定收敛时间的固定时间方法，为受攻击和约束的未知非线性多智能体系统提供了安全预定时间编队方案。

Abstract: This paper addresses secure leader-follower formation of unknown nonlinear multi-agent systems under actuator constraints, external disturbances, and false-data-injection (FDI) attacks. The graph-coupled coordination-error dynamics are formulated as local zero-sum differential games, where a nonquadratic input utility yields saturation-compatible secure policies and actuator-channel FDI and disturbances act as adversarial inputs. To eliminate explicit dependence on the unknown nonlinear drift, an integral Bellman-Isaacs identity enables critic-only learning from finite trajectory data. A two-power state-cost structure and a deadline-parameterized critic update connect optimal learning with predefined-time stabilization. Unlike fixed-time methods whose settling-time bound is determined by preselected gains, the proposed framework assigns the overall deadline first and allocates it among data informativity, critic learning, the reinforcement window, and formation convergence. Practical predefined-time convergence of the critic and formation errors to bounded residual sets is established independently of initial conditions, while secure actuator constraints are satisfied by construction. Simulations validate the framework under FDI attacks, disturbances, input constraints, and different initial conditions.

</details>


### [581] [SafePG: Safe and Globally Optimal Reinforcement Learning with Hard Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14076)
*Vipul K. Sharma,Wesley A. Suttle,S. Sivaranjani*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种在硬安全约束下控制非线性系统的无模型策略梯度强化学习框架，具备收敛性与最优性保证，并通过四旋翼导航仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在未知环境中控制非线性动力系统时，需在探索的同时满足硬安全约束，而现有策略梯度方法难以兼顾安全性与最优性、收敛性保证。

Method: 1) 构造围绕确定性控制器的随机包装策略，实现未知环境探索并保留确定性控制结构；2) 将这些随机策略截断到硬安全约束上，定义参数化、构造即安全的控制策略类；3) 用测度论证明截断策略类下（可能非凸的）RL目标及其策略梯度良定义；4) 基于随机梯度上升开发无模型PG算法直接搜索截断策略，并利用梯度支配性建立收敛与最优性保证。

Result: 理论上证明了目标函数与梯度良定义、算法收敛且达到最优；仿真中在安全四旋翼导航问题上验证了框架有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架为带硬安全约束的非线性系统提供了一种具理论保证的无模型策略梯度RL方法，兼顾探索、安全与最优性。

Abstract: We present an optimal and convergent model-free policy gradient (PG) reinforcement learning (RL) framework for controlling nonlinear dynamical systems under hard safety constraints. We first construct a class of stochastic wrapper policies centered around a deterministic controller, thereby enabling exploration in unknown environments while preserving the underlying deterministic control structure. We then define a class of parameterized safe-by-construction control policies by truncating these stochastic policies onto hard safety constraints. We next establish, via measure-theoretic arguments, that the potentially nonconvex RL objective under the truncated policy class, as well as its policy gradients, are well-defined. We then develop a model-free PG algorithm based on stochastic gradient ascent that directly searches over these truncated policies and leverage gradient dominance to establish convergence and optimality guarantees. Finally, we validate this framework through simulations on a safe quadrotor navigation problem.

</details>


### [582] [Behavior of Nonlinear Opinion Dynamics over Large Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14086)
*Yu Xing,Anastasia Bizyaeva,Karl H. Johansson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文用graphon研究大规模网络上的非线性舆论动力学，证明graphon动力学可近似有限维系统，并借谱近似结果刻画舆论分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典舆论模型仿真中可呈现复杂舆论模式，但对此类分布的量化理解尚不充分，需要在大规模网络下对非线性舆论动力学进行理论刻画。

Method: 采用graphon表示底层网络结构，网络由graphon生成的随机图刻画；引入含交互饱和效应的非线性更新规则及对应的graphon连续极限动力学；利用随机图谱近似结果证明平衡点近似。

Result: 证明当网络规模很大时，graphon动力学可近似有限维系统；非线性模型的平衡点可由连续极限的平衡点近似，从而基于graphon结构定量刻画舆论分布；数值仿真验证了理论结果。

Conclusion: graphon框架为大规模网络上非线性舆论动力学提供了可量化的分析工具，能有效刻画舆论分布并与仿真一致。

Abstract: Opinion dynamics have been studied for decades across disciplines, with much of the theoretical literature focusing on behaviors such as consensus, polarization, and clustering. Although classic models can exhibit more complex opinion patterns in simulations, quantifying such distributions is not fully understood. To address this question, in this paper, we study the behavior of nonlinear opinion dynamics over large-scale networks using graphons, which capture the underlying network structure. In the model, agents update their opinions according to a nonlinear rule that includes saturation effects in interactions. The network is represented by random graphs generated from a graphon, and a corresponding nonlinear dynamical model is introduced over the graphon. We show that the graphon dynamics approximate the finite-dimensional system, when the network size is large. Leveraging spectral approximation results for random graphs, we further show that the equilibria of the nonlinear model can also be approximated by those of the continuum limit. This result enables a quantitative characterization of the opinion distribution based on the underlying graphon structure. The theoretical results are illustrated by numerical simulation.

</details>


### [583] [Functional Observers for Output-Feedback Safety with High-Order Control Barrier Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14104)
*Shima Sadat Mousavi,Pol Mestres,Aaron D. Ames*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究在状态不可全测时，用高阶控制障碍函数(HOCBF)为线性系统做输出反馈安全滤波，指出只需对HOCBF所需的状态泛函具备可观测/可检测性，并提出多项式协同设计框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HOCBF条件仅依赖特定状态泛函，无需全状态重构；但所需泛函由HOCBF增益决定，从而使安全设计与估计设计相互耦合，需要联合设计方法。

Method: 利用标量泛函观测器，构建多项式协同设计框架，刻画HOCBF可观测性/可检测性、观测器存在性与阶数以及收敛速率限制，并给出单侧估计误差界以实现安全输出反馈。

Result: 得到了HOCBF可观测性与可检测性条件、观测器存在性与最小阶数、收敛速率的固有限制，并在认证的单侧估计误差界下实现安全输出反馈。

Conclusion: 表明输出反馈安全滤波不必依赖全状态重构，只需功能可观测/可检测性，通过HOCBF与观测器的协同设计可保证安全实现。

Abstract: This paper studies output-feedback safety filtering for linear systems using high-order control barrier functions (HOCBFs) when the full state is unavailable. Since the HOCBF conditions depend only on specific state functionals, full-state reconstruction is unnecessary; instead, their implementation requires only functional observability or detectability of these quantities. We show that the HOCBF gains determine the required functionals and hence their observability properties, coupling safety and estimation design. We exploit this structure using scalar functional observers and develop a polynomial co-design framework that characterizes HOCBF observability and detectability, observer existence and order, and convergence-rate limitations. A certified one-sided estimation-error bound then enables safe output-feedback implementation.

</details>


### [584] [Parallel Policy-Gradient Methods for Parameter Optimization of Nonlinear Feedback Controllers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14114)
*An Nguyen,Leilei Cui*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出离散时间非线性控制仿射系统的时间并行策略梯度框架,将状态与协态rollout建模为残差最小化问题并用Gauss-Newton与并行关联扫描求解,给出与horizon T无关的局部收敛保证,并在IDA-PBC惯性轮摆例中验证性能与计算优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化反馈控制器虽有严格稳定性保证,但需人工调参以获得良好闭环性能;传统策略梯度评估依赖顺序前向状态rollout与反向协态传播,计算上难以并行,效率受限。

Method: 针对离散时间非线性控制仿射系统,推导策略梯度表达式,将策略梯度评估所需的状态与协态rollout表述为残差最小化问题,并用带并行关联扫描的Gauss-Newton迭代求解。

Result: 对全局渐近稳定且局部指数稳定的闭环系统,证明残差最小化问题满足局部Polyak-Lojasiewicz不等式,GN迭代局部二次收敛;PL常数、收敛邻域大小与二次收敛界均与rollout horizon T无关;对任意有限T,状态求解器可在至多T次迭代内从任意初值恢复精确轨迹。IDA-PBC惯性轮摆实验表明闭环性能提升且具计算优势。

Conclusion: 该时间并行策略梯度框架在保持稳定性保证的同时实现高效参数优化,具有良好的可扩展性与实用潜力。

Abstract: Structured feedback controllers provide rigorous stability guarantees, but often require manual parameter tuning to achieve good closed-loop performance. Policy-gradient methods offer a systematic approach to parameter optimization; however, conventional gradient evaluation requires sequential forward state rollout and backward costate propagation. This letter develops a time-parallel policy-gradient framework for discrete-time nonlinear control-affine systems. We derive the policy-gradient expression where the state and costate rollouts required for policy-gradient evaluation are formulated as residual-minimization problems and solved using Gauss-Newton (GN) iterations with parallel associative scans. For closed-loop systems that are globally asymptotically stable and locally exponentially stable, we show that the residual-minimization problems satisfy a local Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) inequality and that the GN iterates converge locally at a quadratic rate. Moreover, the PL constant, the size of the convergence neighborhood, and the quadratic convergence bound are independent of the rollout horizon T. We also prove that, for any finite horizon T, the state solver recovers the exact trajectory from any initialization in at most T iterations. Finally, an inertia-wheel pendulum example with interconnection and damping assignment passivity-based control (IDA-PBC) demonstrates improved closed-loop performance and the computational benefits of the proposed parallel policy-gradient framework.

</details>


### [585] [Real-Time Synthesis of Robust Controlled Invariant Sets for Monotone Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14115)
*Yasin Sonmez,Mahmoud Khaled,Majid Zamani,Murat Arcak*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出阈值函数重构，将控制不变集计算转化为独立的列方向一维二分搜索，实现高度并行且复杂度低于懒惰不动点算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全攸关系统的控制需要在线计算形式化安全证书（如控制不变集），但标准综合算法随状态维度扩展性差。尽管单调系统与下闭安全规格可用懒惰不动点算法加速，但其成员测试和冗余检查仍是主要瓶颈。

Method: 引入阈值函数重构：将d维网格上的下闭集合表示为其沿指定轴的列高度。由此把最大不动点迭代重新表述为每列独立的1维二分搜索，形成高度并行（embarrassingly parallel）的迭代方法。

Result: 计算复杂度渐近低于懒惰不动点算法；实验在3D网格上合成不变集：10^9单元<50毫秒，10^14单元<2分钟；并在安全感知模型预测控制示例中演示了在线重综合。

Conclusion: 阈值函数重构显著加速了单调系统的控制不变集在线计算，支持大规模网格与在线MPC应用。

Abstract: Safety-critical control of autonomous systems requires formal safety certificates, such as controlled invariant sets, that must be computed online as conditions change. Although standard synthesis algorithms scale poorly with state dimension, monotone dynamical systems with lower-closed safety specifications allow for accelerated computation of controlled invariant sets. In particular, lazy fixed-point algorithms exploit monotonicity and track only the antichain basis of the set. However, membership tests and redundancy checks against an evolving basis remain major bottlenecks. We introduce a threshold-function reformulation in which a lower-closed set on a d-dimensional grid is represented by its column heights along a designated axis. This reformulates the greatest-fixed-point iteration as independent one-dimensional binary searches, one per grid column, yielding an embarrassingly parallel iteration with asymptotically lower computational complexity than the lazy fixed-point algorithm. Experiments synthesize invariant sets on 3D grids with 10^9 cells in under 50 ms and 10^14 cells in under two minutes. We further demonstrate online re-synthesis in a safety-informed model predictive controller example.

</details>


### [586] [Sparse Generalized-Admittance AC Power Flow for Fast Contingency Analysis and Remedial-Action Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14132)
*Pierre Artoisenet,Noémie Verstraete*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出PFPD潮流方法的稀疏重构，将负荷/发电机表示为对角并联导纳，迭代修正节点电流以满足恒功率和调压约束；松弛节点作为固定电压边界移除。复用稀疏LU分解（含Woodbury低秩更新）处理多种初始化场景，在多个大系统上N-1和变压器分接头动作测试中相较pandapower与PowSyBl获得显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 输电系统运行中重复AC潮流计算（如N-1 contingency分析、补救动作评估）累积耗时成为大电网运营的计算瓶颈，需要更快的潮流求解方法。

Method: 提出PFPD的稀疏重构：负荷与发电机用导纳矩阵对角上的固定并联导纳表示，迭代计算修正节点电流以匹配恒功率与调压约束；松弛节点作为固定电压边界从导纳块分解中移除。迭代复用初始广义非松弛矩阵及其PQ块的稀疏LU分解，无需显式构造稠密逆矩阵。支持两种初始化：未解基态的flat-start并联启发式，以及从已解运行点出发的动作后重复计算。局部拓扑/参数变化表示为低秩导纳更新，用Woodbury恒等式求逆。可选局部网络公式为全网精化提供热启动。

Result: 在1354节点、9241节点PEGASE系统及6717节点合成Texas系统上进行N-1实验，平均每次contingency相较pandapower加速14.4–18.0倍。变压器分接头动作上，比pandapower快2.8–2.9倍，比PowSyBl OpenLoadFlow快7.2–29.9倍。

Conclusion: 该稀疏PFPD重构通过复用稀疏LU分解与低秩更新，有效解决大电网重复AC潮流计算瓶颈，在N-1分析与分接头动作评估中实现了对现有工具的大幅加速，适用于高效应急分析与补救动作评估。

Abstract: Repeated AC power-flow calculations are common tasks in transmission system operations, in particular for contingency analysis and remedial-action assessment. For large networks, their cumulative runtime can become a computational bottleneck in operational processes. This paper develops a sparse reformulation of the generalized bus-admittance power-flow method known as PFPD. Loads and generators are represented by fixed shunt admittance terms on the diagonal of the admittance matrix, while corrective nodal currents are iteratively computed to match the constant-power and regulated-voltage constraints. In contrast to the original formulation, the slack bus is treated as a fixed-voltage boundary and removed from the admittance block decomposition. The resulting iteration reuses sparse LU factorizations of the initial generalized non-slack matrix and its PQ block, without explicitly forming dense inverse matrices. The same formulation admits two initialization modes: an unsolved base case using the same flat-start shunt heuristic as in the primary PFPD method, and repeated post-action calculations initialized from a solved operating point. Localized topology and parameter changes are expressed as low-rank admittance updates and the resulting admittance matrices are inverted by means of the Woodbury identity. An optional local-network formulation can provide an warm start before full-network refinement. N-1 experiments on the 1354-bus and 9241-bus PEGASE systems and the 6717-bus synthetic Texas system yield average per-contingency speedups between 14.4 and 18.0 relative to pandapower. On transformer tap-position actions, the method is 2.8--2.9 times faster than pandapower and 7.2--29.9 times faster than PowSyBl OpenLoadFlow.

</details>


### [587] [Recursive Self-Improvement LLM Agents for Inverter Dynamic Model Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14260)
*Jie Feng,Xiaoyang Wang,Xin Chen,Yuanyuan Shi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出立场：将递归自我改进(RSI)LLM智能体用作动态逆变器模型辨识的搜索引擎，通过类型化控制模块词汇+方块图语法约束搜索空间，在GFL逆变器基准上把NRMSE从0.470降至0.0435，并复原出接近真实隐藏控制器的15模块闭环结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆变器(IBR)内部控制器多为厂商私有，电网运营商难以获知。白盒需厂商披露、黑盒牺牲可解释性，现有灰盒方法（稀疏/符号回归）难以发现反馈控制架构或融入控制工程先验，存在明显空白。

Method: (1) 将搜索空间限制为标准化控制模块的类型化词汇（PI控制器、PLL、低通滤波器等），并按方块图语法规则组合；(2) 用RSI LLM智能体在候选方块图模型上做程序搜索，以PCC处测得的频域导纳数据为引导，各候选的自由参数用非线性最小二乘拟合。实现上改造开源程序进化框架ThetaEvolve，支持上下文进化与测试时学习。

Result: 在GFL逆变器基准的概念验证中，RSI循环将朴素开环模型的NRMSE从0.470降至0.0435，并辨识出与隐藏真实GFL控制器高度相似的15模块闭环结构。

Conclusion: RSI LLM智能体结合类型化控制模块词汇与方块图语法，是逆变器动态模型辨识的有效自然搜索引擎，可在无需厂商披露的情况下获得兼具可解释性与精度的灰盒模型。

Abstract: This is a position paper. We demonstrate that recursive self-improvement (RSI) large language model (LLM) agents are a natural search engine for dynamic model identification of inverter-based resources (IBRs) whose internal controls are often proprietary and hidden from grid operators. White-box models provide physical transparency but require vendor disclosure; black-box models avoid this requirement but sacrifice interpretability; and existing grey-box approaches, including sparse and symbolic regression, are poorly suited to discovering feedback control architectures or incorporating control-engineering priors. Our position is that this gap can be alleviated by (1) restricting the search space to a typed vocabulary of standard control modules, including PI controllers, phase-locked loops (PLLs), low-pass filters, etc., composed under block-diagram grammar rules, and (2) using an RSI LLM agent to perform program search over candidate block-diagram models, guided by measured frequency-domain admittance data at the point of common coupling (PCC), while fitting the free parameters of each candidate by nonlinear least squares. We instantiate this position by adapting ThetaEvolve, an open-source program-evolution framework supporting in-context evolution and test-time learning, to inverter model discovery. In a proof-of-concept study on a grid-following (GFL) inverter benchmark, the RSI loop reduces the normalized root mean square error (NRMSE) of a naive open-loop model from 0.470 to 0.0435 and identifies a 15-module closed-loop structure that closely resembles the hidden ground-truth GFL controller.

</details>


### [588] [Probe Sets for Nonlinear Kalman Filtering: Multi-Center Gains and Covariance Recalibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14271)
*Shida Jiang,Shengyu Tao,Scott Moura*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出探针集(probe sets)改进非线性卡尔曼滤波增益计算，通过多中心局部近似最小化平均协方差，提升协方差一致性与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统非线性卡尔曼滤波仅围绕预测状态这一单一中心近似协方差，当局部近似无法代表整个不确定区域的测量几何时，会产生不准确的增益和过度自信的协方差估计。

Method: 引入探针集——由协方差缩放的少量状态集合，滤波在每个探针处重复局部近似，选择使平均协方差最小的增益；同一构造也用于协方差重校准步骤，且不依赖特定近似规则，适用于多种KF变体。对二次测量推导了在预测不确定性被低估时探针优于单中心增益的条件。

Result: 在两个系统各300组随机设置下，比较四种KF变体与多个基线：探针方法保持典型精度，同时显著降低协方差不一致性以及主导单次运行均方根误差的罕见大误差轨迹。

Conclusion: 探针集方法可通用地提升非线性KF的协方差一致性与鲁棒性，减少极端误差轨迹，代码已开源。

Abstract: Kalman filters (KFs) choose the gain as the product of the state--measurement cross-covariance and the inverse of the innovation covariance. In nonlinear systems, the predictive distribution generally changes shape, and these covariances require approximation. Conventional nonlinear KFs approximate them around a single center, the predicted state. They can produce inaccurate gains and overconfident covariance estimates when one local approximation does not represent the measurement geometry across the uncertainty region. To address this issue, we introduce probe sets, small covariance-scaled collections of states at which the filter repeats its local approximation. We then select the gain that minimizes the average covariance reported by these local approximations. The same construction is used in our previously proposed covariance recalibration step to improve covariance consistency. The construction applies to different KF variants without requiring a specific approximation rule. For quadratic measurements, we derive conditions under which probing yields lower normalized true error variance than the corresponding single-center gain when prediction uncertainty is sufficiently understated. We compare four KF variants with multiple baselines across 300 randomized setups for each of two systems. The results show that probing preserves typical accuracy while substantially reducing covariance inconsistency and the rare large-error trajectories that dominate the root mean square of per-run errors. The code is available at https://github.com/Shida-Jiang/Probe_KF.

</details>


### [589] [Grid Topology Optimization for Congestion Management Under High Renewable Penetrations and Discrete Load Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14367)
*Giacomo,Bastianel,Hakan,Ergun,Line,Roald*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种识别少量高价值母线拓扑的方法，用LPAC近似OPF并结合AC可行性校验，在IEEE 118节点上降低发电成本并支持离线开关决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可再生能源波动和电力需求增长使传统电网承压，母线拓扑优化可重分配潮流，但组合爆炸使其实时应用不切实际。

Method: 基于LPAC近似的OPF优化模型，选取IEEE 118节点系统中两对变电站（46-49、24-69），在365个聚类时段的不同风电和负荷条件下分别优化其拓扑，并进行AC可行性校验。

Result: 每对变电站识别出四种最常出现的最优拓扑；在标准、拥塞及离散负荷增长条件下评估，相比普通AC-OPF，发电总成本最多降低0.147%，并展示拓扑优化对母线托管容量的影响。

Conclusion: 该方法为系统运行人员提供实用流程，离线筛选少量最优母线拓扑用于不同风电-负荷场景，在降低成本的同时避免实时切换的计算与运行风险。

Abstract: Transmission grids are increasingly stressed by the fluctuating nature of renewable energy sources and by increasing electricity demand. Such grids were mainly built for a different generation fleet and load conditions. Grid topology optimization offers the possibility to redistribute power flows by modifying the busbar topology of substations in the grid. However, the combinatorial explosion of feasible busbar configurations makes topology optimization impractical for system operators. This paper proposes a methodology to identify a small subset of high-value busbar topologies to capture the economic benefit of topology optimization across a range of renewable-demand patterns. The optimization model is based on a LPAC approximation of the optimal power flow formulation, and AC-feasibility checks of the optimal topology applied to the IEEE 118-bus test case. In the test case, we select two distinct pairs of substations (46-49 and 24-69) and we optimize their topology separately over 365 clustered timesteps with different wind and load conditions. For each pair, we identify the four most recurrent optimal topologies and evaluate their performance under standard, and congested conditions, with and without a discrete load growth. Results show that selecting from this reduced set of topologies reduces total generation costs by up to 0.147% compared to a plain AC-OPF. In addition, we show the influence of topology optimization on the hosting capacity of selected busbars under discrete load growth. Our findings provide a practical methodology for system operators to select a subset of optimal busbar topologies to be used in their grid for different wind-load conditions, resulting in decreasing generation costs without the computational and operational risks of real-time switching decisions.

</details>


### [590] [LLaTSA: Large Language Model-Aligned General-Purpose Transient Stability Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14374)
*Chao Shen,Hongwei Zhen,Junyan Shao,Zhenghao Yang,Yifan Zhang,Mingyang Sun*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出LLaTSA，一个基于LLM对齐的通用暂态稳定分析（TSA）轨迹预测框架，解决Uni-TSA在异构系统上的局限，实现跨系统场景的准确预测与稳定判别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态轨迹预测是数据驱动TSA的重要范式，但现有预测器多为系统专用，当网络结构、发电组合或状态变量集变化时需大量重训练。Uni-TSA虽提出通用框架，但存在短观测歧义、数值轨迹与LLM嵌入不匹配、状态变量间耦合被忽略、密集骨干推理成本高等问题。

Method: LLaTSA通过结构化文本前缀引入运行工况、扰动属性和状态变量身份；将归一化时间块与TSA相关词表对齐后，用预训练稀疏解码器only的MoE骨干处理；引入状态变量耦合模块捕获故障后协同演化；采用teacher forcing与rollout训练支持迭代长时程预测。

Result: 在多个测试系统上的案例研究表明，LLaTSA能实现准确的轨迹预测、可靠的稳定判别，并在未见场景中有效适应。

Conclusion: LLaTSA通过LLM对齐与稀疏MoE设计，提升了通用轨迹TSA的跨系统适应性与预测可靠性。

Abstract: Dynamic trajectory prediction has become an important paradigm for data-driven transient stability analysis (TSA), yet most existing predictors remain system-specific and require substantial retraining when network configurations, generation mixes, or state-variable sets change. Uni-TSA introduced a general-purpose TSA framework that combines channel-independent modeling with a pretrained large language model (LLM) predictor. Nevertheless, its application to heterogeneous systems is limited by ambiguity in short observations, a mismatch between numerical trajectories and LLM embeddings, neglected coupling among state variables, and the high inference cost of dense backbones. This paper proposes LLaTSA, an LLM-aligned framework for general-purpose trajectory-based TSA. LLaTSA first incorporates operating conditions, disturbance attributes, and state-variable identity through a structured textual prefix. It then aligns normalized temporal patches with a TSA-related vocabulary before processing them with a pretrained sparse decoder-only mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbone. A state-variable coupling module captures coordinated post-fault evolution, while teacher forcing and rollout-based training support iterative long-horizon prediction. Case studies on multiple test systems demonstrate accurate trajectory prediction, reliable stability discrimination, and effective adaptation across unseen scenarios.

</details>


### [591] [Angle-Based Formation Tracking of Underactuated Planar Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14397)
*Nhat-Minh Le-Phan,Yali Fan,Thien-Minh Nguyen,Lihua Xie*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究异构平面欠驱动智能体（如USV）的基于角度的编队跟踪问题，在扰动下用领航-跟随图分别设计需/不需相对速度测量的两种控制律，仿真验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对欠驱动水面舰艇（3自由度仅2个控制输入：纵荡力与偏航力矩）这类异构平面欠驱动智能体，在存在扰动的情况下实现编队跟踪具有挑战性。

Method: 将期望编队用一组纵向偏置点（hand points）及这些点三元组间的规定角度约束来刻画；在领航者恒速运动、领航-跟随交互图下，先提出依赖相对速度测量的控制律实现渐近编队跟踪并保证内部稳定性，再提出不依赖相对速度信息的第二算法。

Result: 第一种控制律在相对速度可测时实现渐近编队跟踪并具内部稳定性；第二种算法无需相对速度信息即可将跟随者的hand points驱动至期望队形。USV数值仿真验证了两种方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提基于角度的编队跟踪方法对异构欠驱动智能体在扰动下有效，且可降低对相对速度测量的依赖。

Abstract: This paper addresses the angle-based formation tracking problem for a class of heterogeneous planar underactuated agents subject to disturbances. A representative example is a group of underactuated surface vessels (USVs) operating in the surge-sway-yaw plane, in which each vessel has three degrees of freedom but only two independent control inputs, which are surge force and yaw moment. The desired formation is characterized by a set of longitudinal offset points, referred to as hand points, together with prescribed angular constraints among triplets of these points. The formation tracking problem is studied on a leader-follower interaction graph, assuming the leader moves at constant velocity. Under the assumption that relative velocity measurements are available, the first control law achieves asymptotic formation tracking with internal stability guarantees. Moreover, a second algorithm that does not rely on relative velocity information is introduced, which successfully drives the followers' hand points to their desired configuration. Numerical simulations involving USVs are presented to validate the effectiveness of the proposed approaches.

</details>


### [592] [Computing Robustness to Sparse Diagonal Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14445)
*Christoffer Kjellson,Emma Tegling*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文证明新鲁棒性度量ν的计算等价于最大化非负矩阵乘积的谱半径，从而可迁移谱半径最大化的已有结果，并给出可用全局求解器求解的重构与算法，虽尚不可扩展，但推进了ν的可计算性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ν被提出作为结构奇异值μ的替代，以更好刻画对稀疏对角不确定性的鲁棒性，但其计算一直是未解问题。

Method: 将ν的计算等价转化为非负矩阵乘积的谱半径最大化问题；借助已有谱半径最大化结果导出改进上界及界重合条件；给出使非凸优化问题可用全局求解器求解的重构与结构性质。

Result: 得到ν的谱半径最大化等价形式、更精细的上界及界重合条件；能求解非平凡问题，并识别系统最脆弱部分；但尚未实现可扩展计算。

Conclusion: 结果虽未提供可扩展的ν计算方案，但是迈向其可计算性与可解释性的重要一步。

Abstract: A new robustness metric $ν$ was recently proposed as a substitute for the structured singular value $μ$ to better capture robustness to sparse diagonal uncertainty, but its computation has remained an open problem. In this paper, we show that computing $ν$ is equivalent to maximizing the spectral radius of a nonnegative matrix product. This equivalence allows us to transfer existing results on spectral-radius maximization to $ν$, including a refined upper bound and conditions under which the bounds coincide. We then provide reformulations and structural results that enable an algorithm to solve the nonconvex optimization problem for nontrivial problems using global solvers. This also enables identification of the most fragile parts of the system. Our results do not yet provide a scalable solution for computing $ν$, but they are an important step toward computability and interpretability.

</details>


### [593] [Collaborative Computation and Migration in Multi-UAV Networks with Semantic Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14476)
*Bin Li,Yuchen Ou,Yinqiu Liu,Abbas Jamalipour*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对语义通信使能的多无人机边缘计算系统，提出联合优化任务卸载、迁移与轨迹控制框架，并设计HAN-MATD3算法以最大化语义相似度、最小化时延与能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机资源有限且网络结构动态变化，现有方法忽视任务语义信息及无人机与移动终端间的复杂关系，导致协调性差、效率低。

Method: 提出联合优化框架，用于语义通信使能的多无人机MEC系统中的任务卸载、任务迁移与轨迹控制；采用异构图建模网络拓扑，用异构图注意力网络（HAN）提取语义特征，并将其集成到多智能体TD3（MATD3）框架中，形成HAN-MATD3算法。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据与结果，仅说明所提算法用于支持联合优化。（原文未提供量化结果）

Conclusion: HAN-MATD3可面向6G无人机辅助MEC场景实现语义相似度最大化与任务时延、系统能耗最小化的联合优化。

Abstract: Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV)-assisted Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) is a key technology for future 6G networks, providing wide coverage and flexible computing services. However, the limited resources of UAVs and the dynamic changes in the network structure make it difficult to maintain high efficiency. Existing methods often ignore the semantic information of tasks and the complex relationships among UAVs and mobile terminals, resulting in poor coordination. This paper proposes a joint optimization framework for task offloading, task migration, and trajectory control in semantic communication-enabled multi-UAV edge computing systems, aiming to maximize semantic similarity while minimizing task latency and system energy consumption. To tackle the resultant problem, we develop a Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network-based Multi-Agent Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (HAN-MATD3) algorithm. Specifically, we use a heterogeneous graph to model the network topology and apply HAN to extract important semantic features. These features are then integrated into the MATD3 framework to support joint optimization.

</details>


### [594] [Recent Advances in Resilient Multi-Energy Systems Against Climate Change](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14719)
*Grant Ruan,Zhengmao Li,Yi Wang,Ning Zhang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文综述了通过嵌套耦合框架构建韧性多能源系统的研究进展，涵盖韧性资源、评估、运行规划、定价投资及实际项目，并指出七大挑战与机遇。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化对能源系统长期可持续发展构成全球性威胁，亟需协调电力、天然气、供热、氢能、交通和水等多个能源载体与部门，挖掘跨部门灵活性以应对气候变化。

Method: 采用嵌套耦合（nested coupling）视角建立韧性多能源系统的整体框架，进行文献综述，并融合能源系统、气候科学、社会学、经济学和数据科学的跨学科分析。

Result: 系统梳理了韧性资源、韧性评估、韧性导向的运行与规划、韧性定价与投资以及实际落地实施的最新进展；相较既有研究，本文完整考察了气候变化影响（分布偏移）、韧性定价和全球项目。

Conclusion: 识别出七大主要挑战与机遇（如数据匮乏、分布式协调与隐私、高保真仿真、机器学习技术等），为研究者、产业专家和政策制定者把握该领域新兴趋势与未来机遇提供参考。

Abstract: Climate change is a global threat to the long-term sustainable development of energy systems. Recent works have explored the emerging opportunity of coordinating different energy carriers and sectors (e.g. electricity, natural gas, heating, hydrogen, transportation, and water sectors) to unlock the cross-sector flexibility against climate change. This review has established a holistic framework for resilient multi-energy systems through the lens of nested coupling. It covers the most recent progress in resilience resources, resilience evaluation, resilience-oriented operation & planning, resilience pricing & investment, and real-world implementation. This work differs from prior studies through a full investigation on climate change impacts (distribution shifts), resilience pricing, and global projects. Within this area, we advocate for a unique and interdisciplinary perspective spanning across energy systems, climate science, sociology, economics, and data science. At the end, seven major challenges and opportunities are identified, including data deficiency, distributed coordination & privacy, high-fidelity simulation, and machine learning techniques. Researchers, industrial experts, and policy makers can follow this review to capture the emerging trend and future opportunities in this growing area.

</details>


### [595] [Velocity-free Attitude Synchronization Using Vector Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14752)
*Melika Afshari,Mouaad Boughellaba,Abdelhamid Tayebi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文研究刚体网络在无角速度测量、仅依赖惯性矢量测量、且通信拓扑为无向图的条件下，实现无领导者与领导者-跟随者分布式姿态同步的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统姿态同步方案通常需要角速度信息或进行姿态重构，且容易产生unwinding问题。本文旨在去除对角速度和姿态重构的依赖，并避免unwinding，实现几乎全局渐近稳定的同步。

Method: 提出无需角速度和姿态重构的分布式控制方案，直接利用惯性矢量测量，在无向通信拓扑下分别处理无领导者（达成共同恒定姿态一致）与领导者-跟随者（同步到仅一个智能体已知的期望姿态）两种情形。

Result: 所提方案均避免unwinding，并实现期望同步集的几乎全局渐近稳定性；数值仿真验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 该方案在无需角速度和姿态重构的情况下，有效解决了无向图下刚体网络的分布式姿态同步问题，兼具理论稳定性保证与仿真验证。

Abstract: This paper addresses the velocity-free leaderless and leader--follower distributed attitude synchronization of a network of rigid body systems, with inertial vector measurements, under an undirected communication graph topology. In the leaderless case all agents achieve consensus on a common constant orientation. In the leader--follower case, all agents synchronize with a prescribed constant orientation available to only one agent. The proposed schemes require neither attitude reconstruction nor angular-velocity, avoid unwinding, and achieve almost-global asymptotic stability of the desired synchronization sets. Numerical simulations illustrate their effectiveness.

</details>


### [596] [Comparative Evaluation of MILP, MPC, and Reinforcement Learning for Commercial Battery Dispatch Under Time-of-Use Tariffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14776)
*Hafiz Majid Hussain,Wajiha Samar,Lurian Klein,Pedro Nardelli*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文基于商用光伏+储能全年真实数据，对比MILP（完美预知）、MPC（日前持续性预测）和SAC强化学习三种调度策略。MILP年降本24.6%，MPC仅用前一天数据即实现99.2%基准收益，而SAC表现劣于无储能基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BESS配合屋顶光伏在分时电价下可节省成本，但基于模型与无模型的调度策略在全年度真实商用数据上缺乏充分基准对比。

Method: 基于某商用光伏装置2023全年、分时电价下的数据，评估三种策略：(i) 完美预知的MILP（理想基准）；(ii) 基于日前持续性预测的MPC（低复杂度可部署）；(iii) 在因果信息约束下训练的SAC深度强化学习智能体。

Result: MILP相对无储能基线年降本24.6%；持续性预测MPC仅用前一天数据即达到该基准的99.2%；SAC智能体年成本反而高于无储能基线。

Conclusion: 在该数据集与电价结构下，持续性MPC在实际约束下几乎捕获了全部可实现经济收益；受限于可观测性与奖励设计等强化学习固有挑战，该RL配置未表现出竞争力。

Abstract: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) paired with rooftop photovoltaics (PVs) can deliver measurable cost savings under time-of-use (TOU) electricity tariffs; however, the relative performance of model-based and model-free dispatch strategies remains insufficiently benchmarked on full-year, real-world commercial datasets. This paper presents a full-year (2023) comparative evaluation of three BESS dispatch approaches using data from a commercial PV installation operating under a TOU tariff. The examined strategies include: (i) a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) formulation with perfect foresight, providing an oracle performance benchmark under the assumed model; (ii) a model predictive control (MPC) scheme based on a day-ahead persistence forecast, representing a low-complexity deployable approach; and (iii) a soft actor-critic (SAC) deep reinforcement learning agent trained under causal information constraints. The MILP benchmark achieves an annual cost reduction of 24.6\% relative to a no-storage baseline. The persistence-based MPC approach recovers 99.2\% of this benchmark using only prior-day data. In contrast, the evaluated SAC agent yields an annual cost higher than the no-storage baseline. This outcome is analyzed in the context of known challenges in reinforcement learning for energy systems, including limited observability and reward design. Overall, the results indicate that, for the studied dataset and tariff structure, persistence-based MPC captures nearly all achievable economic benefits under practical deployment constraints, whereas the considered RL configuration does not yield competitive performance under the same information limitations.

</details>


### [597] [Stabilization of a Heterodirectional Bradytachic (1D, 2D) PDE Pair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14941)
*Miroslav Krstic*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究一个一维边界驱动的标量双曲PDE与一个二维快速PDE耦合系统的镇定问题，通过时间尺度分离方法实现指数稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有backstepping设计适用于耦合双曲系统及其集合与连续统，但这些工作中快速子系统的第二变量不含输运或扩散项。当第二变量确实存在输运或扩散时，尚无可用设计，且单一标量输入无法对二维状态进行精确控制。

Method: 采用时间尺度分离：在准稳态极限下，二维子系统坍缩为一维降阶被控对象中的空间Volterra算子，对该降阶系统应用backstepping设计，二维子系统则作为稳定的边界层。

Result: 一个定理证明：对低于显式阈值的任意时间尺度比，系统均指数稳定，且该结果关于内部扩散系数一致成立，直至纯输运情形。

Conclusion: 所提方法在存在二维快速动力学时仍能通过单标量输入实现系统镇定，克服了精确控制不可行的问题。

Abstract: A scalar hyperbolic PDE, actuated at one boundary, is coupled with a fast PDE in two spatial dimensions: transport in the axial coordinate and in an internal coordinate, and possibly diffusion in the internal coordinate. Backstepping designs exist for coupled hyperbolic systems, for their ensembles, and for their continua, but in all of these the second variable of the fast subsystem carries no transport or diffusion; when it does, no design is available, and from a scalar input no exact control of the two-dimensional state is to be expected. The pair is stabilized here by time-scale separation: in the quasi-steady limit the two-dimensional subsystem collapses into a spatial Volterra operator inside a one-dimensional reduced plant, backstepping applies there, and the two-dimensional subsystem is left to be a stable boundary layer. One theorem establishes exponential stability of the pair for every time-scale ratio below an explicit threshold, uniformly in the internal diffusion coefficient down to the pure-transport case.

</details>


### [598] [The Heavy Chain PDE: Rapid Stabilization by Backstepping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14947)
*Miroslav Krstic*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究悬挂重链（无端载荷）的边界镇定问题，构造Volterra backstepping变换将其（退化的双曲系统）映射为带任意指定阻尼率和弹性约束的目标系统，实现位移、速度、应变指数收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重链自由端张力为零导致波速退化；在Riemann坐标下模型成为耦合奇异、自由端反射由域内产生（而非边界条件）的退化2×2双曲系统，边界镇定具有挑战性。

Method: 构造Volterra backstepping变换，将系统映射到同一链带均匀阻尼与小车处弹性约束的目标系统；通过选取自由端有界Frobenius分支求解奇异核方程以替代缺失的边界数据，四个核由全局收敛幂级数生成，变换在能量空间上有界可逆（逆变换通过反转指定衰减率获得）。

Result: 所得闭环系统位移、速度与应变的指数收敛；核方程可解且变换有界可逆，逆变换可通过反转衰减率得到。

Conclusion: 该工作将针对圆盘/球上抛物型方程发展的径向backstepping结构推广到退化双曲系统，为重链边界镇定提供了新方法。

Abstract: We consider boundary stabilization of a heavy chain hanging from a moving trolley with no tip load. Because the tension vanishes at the free end, the wave speed vanishes there; in Riemann coordinates the model becomes a degenerate $2\times2$ hyperbolic system in which the coupling is singular and the free-end reflection is generated in the domain rather than by a boundary condition. We construct a Volterra backstepping transformation that maps this system to the same chain with uniform damping of an arbitrarily prescribed rate and an elastic restraint at the trolley, yielding exponential convergence of displacement, velocity, and strain to zero. The singular kernel equations are solved by selecting their bounded Frobenius branch at the free end, which replaces the missing boundary datum, and the four kernels are generated by a globally convergent power series. The transformation is boundedly invertible on the energy space, with inverse obtained by reversing the prescribed decay rate. The result extends the radial backstepping structure developed for parabolic equations on disks and balls to a degenerate hyperbolic system.

</details>


### [599] [Topology-Aware Congestion Pricing: Demand Robust Routing using the Forman-Ricci Curvature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14980)
*Sheryl Paul,Samuel Williams,Kexin Wang,Ruolin Li,Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种拓扑感知的拥堵定价正则化方法，用Forman-Ricci曲率(FRC)构建离线结构惩罚项增强Pigouvian收费，在需求扰动下降低瓶颈流量并保持近优效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Pigouvian收费虽能实现系统最优，但依赖需求数据，在需求变化时效果下降，尤其在结构关键的瓶颈边上表现脆弱。

Method: 将Beckmann势进行拓扑感知正则化：在预计算的Pigouvian收费上叠加由Forman-Ricci曲率导出的离线结构惩罚项（FRC可刻画瓶颈结构），并理论证明均衡的存在性、正则化强度与惩罚边流量的关系及效率损失与Pigouvian收费逼近程度的关系。

Result: 在8个真实网络上进行定向与均匀需求扰动实验，瓶颈流量下降且效率接近最优；FRC的效果与边介数相当，但计算成本显著更低。

Conclusion: FRC是一种实用且鲁棒的经典拥堵定价补充手段，能在需求不确定条件下兼顾效率与瓶颈缓解。

Abstract: Congestion pricing is widely used to improve transportation network efficiency where individual decentralized route choices can lead to system-level inefficiencies. Pigouvian tolls achieve the system optimum but depend on demand and can lose effectiveness under demand shifts, particularly on structurally critical bottleneck edges. We propose a topology-aware regularization of the Beckmann potential governing the (Wardrop) equilibrium by augmenting precomputed Pigouvian tolls with an offline structural penalty derived from Forman--Ricci curvature (FRC), which captures bottleneck structures. We prove that the resulting equilibrium is well-defined, that stronger regularization reduces flow on penalized edges, and that efficiency loss depends on how closely the structural penalty approximates optimal Pigouvian tolls. Experiments on eight real-world networks under targeted and uniform demand perturbations show reduced bottleneck flow with near-optimal efficiency. FRC achieves reductions comparable to edge betweenness at substantially lower computational cost, making it a practical, robust complement to classical congestion pricing.

</details>


### [600] [Formal Synthesis of Robust Koopman-Model Predictive Control: A Case Study in AC-DC Power Conversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15197)
*Shun Hirose,Shiu Mochiyama,Yoshihiko Susuki*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种基于鲁棒Koopman模型的预测控制(RK-MPC)的形式化综合方法，面向非线性动态系统的数据驱动控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性系统在数据驱动控制下的形式化综合具有挑战性，需兼顾鲁棒性与可证明的闭环性能，并满足复杂时序逻辑规格。

Method: 将信号时序逻辑(STL)描述的规格融入优化问题，构造新的RK-MPC优化框架，并对闭环性能给出证明。

Result: 通过应用于AC-DC功率变换器的可靠设计，验证了所提RK-MPC的有效性。

Conclusion: RK-MPC为含非线性动态的系统提供了可证明性能的数据驱动形式化综合途径，适用于电力电子等高可靠性场景。

Abstract: This letter proposes a formal synthesis of Robust Koopman-Model Predictive Control (RK-MPC), a novel data-driven approach to formal synthesis of systems with nonlinear dynamics. We formulate a novel optimization problem for RK-MPC by incorporating specifications described by Signal Temporal Logic and prove its closed-loop performance. Effectiveness of the proposed RK-MPC is evaluated by applying it to the reliable design of an AC-DC power converter.

</details>


### [601] [TREDD: Robust Trend-Based Reference Evaluation for Interpretable Degradation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15249)
*Elisabeth Vogel,Ronny Porsch,Peter Langendoerfer*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: TREDD是一种可解释的退化检测方法，通过趋势偏差识别物理老化，并用数据质量与上下文检查区分计算性漂移与真实老化，在NASA锂电池数据集上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传感器监测数据中的趋势未必对应真实物理老化，噪声、离群点、不稳定初期区域及工况变化都可能产生类似模式，因此需要区分真实退化与伪趋势。

Method: TREDD结合滚动窗口平滑、基线估计、方向相关的退化指数、长期趋势提取与持续性漂移检测；并将计算性漂移检测与物理老化解释分离，加入数据质量评估、上下文检查及稳健辅助分析。

Result: 在NASA锂离子电池老化数据集上以放电循环容量为退化变量进行评估，案例研究表明TREDD能识别清晰的退化轨迹，同时对微弱、缓慢或非典型趋势赋予较低置信度。

Conclusion: 该方法支持透明且基于置信度的退化解释，而非单纯的预测性电池健康估计。

Abstract: Technical systems are increasingly monitored using sensor and operational data to detect degradation and performance deterioration at an early stage. However, observed trends in measurement data do not necessarily correspond to physical aging, since noise, outliers, unstable initial regions, or changing operating conditions may produce similar patterns. This paper proposes Trend-based Reference Evaluation for Degradation Detection (TREDD), an interpretable method for detecting degradation as a persistent, trend-based deviation from an early reference state. TREDD combines rolling-window smoothing, baseline estimation, a direction-dependent degradation index, long-term trend extraction, and persistent drift detection. In addition, the method separates computational drift detection from the interpretation of drift as plausible physical aging by incorporating data-quality assessment, context checking, and robust auxiliary analysis. The approach is evaluated on the NASA Lithium-Ion Battery Aging Dataset using discharge-cycle capacity as the degradation-relevant condition variable. The representative case study illustrates that TREDD can identify clear degradation trajectories while assigning reduced confidence to weak, gradual, or atypical trends. The method therefore supports transparent and confidence-based degradation interpretation rather than purely predictive battery health estimation.

</details>


### [602] [Communication Architecture Co-Design for Distributed Control via System Level Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15341)
*Jeonghyeon Noh,SooJean Han*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可扩展的凸框架，在系统级综合（SLS）范式内协同设计通信拓扑与分布式控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络化动态系统规模增大，分布式控制器架构设计成为关键。已有研究将RFD引入SLS，但主要关注执行器/传感器布置，忽略了通信架构对分布式控制性能的根本影响，且SLS内通信拓扑的可扩展显式协同设计仍具挑战。

Method: 在SLS框架下显式刻画由通信拓扑诱导的系统响应可行子空间，用通信邻接矩阵参数化，与物理对象拓扑分离；据此推导通信链路范数，构建通信架构协同设计的凸SLS问题；采用近端ADMM方案分解优化问题以保持大规模网络的可扩展性。

Result: 数值实验验证该框架能有效优化闭环性能与通信架构复杂度之间的权衡，并确认其可扩展性。

Conclusion: 该工作为SLS内的通信架构与分布式控制器协同设计提供了可扩展的凸框架，兼顾性能与通信复杂度。

Abstract: As networked dynamical systems grow in scale, distributed controller architecture design has become a critical issue. To address this, prior studies have incorporated the regularization for design (RFD) framework into system-level synthesis (SLS), focusing primarily on actuator and sensor placement. However, communication architectures also fundamentally impact the performance of distributed control, and scalable explicit co-design of the underlying communication topology within SLS remains challenging. This paper proposes a scalable convex framework for the co-design of communication architectures and distributed controllers within the SLS paradigm. We explicitly characterize a communication topology-induced feasible subspace of system responses, parameterized by the communication adjacency matrix and separate from the physical plant topology. By deriving a communication link norm from this characterized subspace, we formulate a convex SLS problem for communication architecture co-design. A proximal ADMM scheme is employed to appropriately decompose the optimization problem in a manner that preserves scalability to large networks. Numerical experiments validate the efficacy of the proposed framework in optimizing the trade-off between closed-loop performance and communication architecture complexity, while also confirming its scalability.

</details>


### [603] [Volt-VAr-Watt Optimization in Four-Wire Low-Voltage Networks: Exact Nonlinear Models and Smooth Approximations - Extended Version](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15370)
*Sleiman Mhanna,Frederik Geth,Lucas Quiertant,Pierluigi Mancarella*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出三种无需整数/二进制变量的非线性四线不平衡最优潮流模型，将Volt-VAr与Volt-Watt等不可微智能逆变器功能纳入优化，并在真实低压网络上验证其准确性、可靠性与可解性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式能源激增导致低压配电网过压与欠压问题频发。智能逆变器的Volt-VAr/Volt-Watt功能可在用户侧调压，但因函数不可微，难以纳入优化模型。

Method: 提出三种四线不平衡最优潮流的非线性模型，均不含二进制或整数变量：（1）用控制流将不可微函数直接编码为自定义函数（借助现代代数建模语言）；（2）与（3）引入带可调近似误差的定制光滑近似，以缓解不可微带来的数值问题，在保持精度的同时提升可靠性。在含不同屋顶光伏渗透率的真实四线不平衡低压网络上评估，包括含302台智能逆变器的539节点系统。

Result: 首次在真实四线不平衡低压网络模型上实现准确、可靠且可解的Volt-Var-Watt优化（VVWO）；并证明基于优化的非增量方法比常用的增量（准稳态）方法具有更高的可靠性。

Conclusion: 所提模型无需整数变量即可有效处理智能逆变器的不可微控制，兼顾精度与数值可靠性；基于优化的非增量方法在低压网络电压优化中优于传统增量方法。

Abstract: The proliferation of distributed energy resources is increasing the prevalence of both overvoltages and undervoltages in low-voltage (LV) distribution networks. Smart inverter functionalities, such as Volt-VAr and Volt-Watt control, can regulate voltage at the consumer level but are challenging to capture in optimization models due to their nondifferentiability. This paper proposes three nonlinear models for four-wire unbalanced optimal power flow that incorporate these nonsmooth functions without binary or integer variables. The first model encodes these nonsmooth functions directly as user-defined functions using control flow, a feat enabled by many state-of-the-art algebraic modeling languages. The second and third introduce bespoke smooth approximations with tunable approximation errors to address potential numerical issues arising from nondifferentiability, improving reliability while maintaining accuracy. All three methods are evaluated on real four-wire unbalanced LV networks with varying rooftop solar adoption levels, including a 539-bus system with 302 smart inverters. This paper is not only the first to demonstrate accurate, reliable, and tractable Volt-Var-Watt optimization (VVWO) on real four-wire unbalanced LV network models, but it also establishes that optimization-based, non-incremental methods offer superior reliability compared to commonly used incremental (quasi-steady-state) approaches.

</details>


### [604] [Safe Newton-Based Extremum Seeking for Static Maps with Delayed Output Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15537)
*Azad Ghaffari,Tiago Roux Oliveira*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出延迟安全牛顿型极值搜索（SANES）框架，在目标和安全测量均受常时延影响下，最小化未知静态映射并满足未知安全约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际系统中目标与安全测量常存在时延且映射未知，需要在无模型条件下同时保证优化收敛与安全性，现有极值搜索方法难以显式处理延迟与安全约束的耦合。

Method: 采用无模型预测器补偿延迟测量，构造牛顿型极值搜索名义输入及梯度信息；构建CLF-CBF鲁棒二次规划（QP），并加入参数更新约束以显式考虑导数估计与预测误差；从估计误差边界推导无延迟情形鲁棒裕度，延迟情形则融合估计与预测误差；通过Lyapunov分析直接证明名义牛顿型极值搜索动力学的实用稳定性，再推导鲁棒CLF/CBF条件。

Result: 建立了不依赖局部平均的收敛性保证，证明在允许参数集上实现实用收敛，并保证规定安全集的鲁棒子集前向不变；数值案例验证了在未知目标/安全映射和延迟测量下仍能实现约束优化。

Conclusion: SANES框架可有效处理未知映射、未知安全约束与常时延测量，实现安全的极值搜索优化。

Abstract: This work presents a delayed safe Newton-based extremum seeking (SANES) framework for minimizing an unknown static map subject to an unknown safety constraint. The objective and safety measurements are assumed to be affected by the same constant time delay. To compensate for delayed measurements, a model-free predictor is developed to construct the quantities required for optimization, including the nominal Newton-based extremum-seeking control input and the gradient information used to formulate control Lyapunov function (CLF) and control barrier function (CBF) conditions. Robust CLF--CBF quadratic programs (QPs), subject to parameter-update constraints, are then formulated to account explicitly for derivative-estimation and prediction errors. For the delay-free case, robustness margins are derived from bounds on the extremum-seeking estimation errors, whereas for the delayed case, the margins incorporate both estimation and prediction errors. Practical stability of the nominal Newton-based extremum-seeking dynamics is established directly through a Lyapunov analysis, thereby providing convergence guarantees over the admissible parameter set without relying exclusively on local averaging arguments. Robust CLF and CBF conditions are subsequently derived to establish practical convergence and forward invariance of a robust subset of the prescribed safe set. A numerical case study demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed SANES framework in achieving constrained optimization despite unknown objective and safety maps and delayed measurements.

</details>


### [605] [MM-LMPC: Multi-Modal Learning Model Predictive Control via Mode-Specific Terminal Design and Bandit-Based Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15623)
*Wataru Hashimoto,Kazumune Hashimoto,Masako Kishida*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出多模态LMPC（MM-LMPC），通过轨迹聚类和LCB元控制器选择各模式控制器，缓解标准LMPC对初始数据的敏感性，改进探索并降低代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准LMPC复用历史轨迹构造终端约束与终端代价，但会过度利用已有良好cost-to-go的轨迹，探索不足，难以发现更优路径模式，对初始数据敏感。

Method: 将历史轨迹聚类为运动模式；为每个模式构建专属LMPC控制器；用基于LCB的元控制器在每次迭代选择执行哪个模式控制器。模式信息通过两种设计融入终端约束与代价：硬约束设计使用各模式数据的模式专属终端约束与代价；软正则设计保留共享终端约束，并在终端代价中加入基于隶属度的惩罚项。

Result: 理论证明两种设计均保持递归可行性与闭环稳定性；硬约束设计还建立了模式级代价收敛、渐近最优模式性能及LCB下的对数累积遗憾界。多路线避障仿真显示MM-LMPC较标准LMPC探索更好、代价更低。

Conclusion: MM-LMPC有效缓解轨迹池化带来的偏差，在保留LMPC可行性与稳定性结构的同时提升探索能力与长期控制性能。

Abstract: Learning Model Predictive Control (LMPC) improves iterative control tasks by using previous executions to construct the terminal constraint and terminal cost of the MPC problem. Although effective, this reuse of past trajectories can make LMPC sensitive to the initial data. In particular, LMPC may repeatedly exploit stored trajectories with favorable cost-to-go values while insufficiently exploring alternative route patterns that could yield lower cost after further improvement. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Modal LMPC (MM-LMPC). The proposed framework clusters past trajectories into motion modes, constructs a mode-specific LMPC controller for each mode, and uses an LCB-based meta-controller to select which mode-specific controller to execute at each iteration. Mode information is incorporated into the terminal constraint and terminal cost through two designs. The hard-constrained design uses mode-specific terminal constraints and terminal costs constructed from the data associated with each mode. The soft-regularized design retains a shared terminal constraint while adding membership-based penalties to the terminal cost. These designs reduce the bias caused by pooling all trajectories into a single terminal memory while retaining the recursive feasibility and stability structure of LMPC. Our theoretical analysis shows that both designs preserve recursive feasibility and closed-loop stability. For the hard-constrained design, we further establish mode-wise cost convergence, asymptotic best-mode performance, and a logarithmic cumulative regret bound under the LCB rule. Simulations on multi-route obstacle-avoidance tasks show that MM-LMPC improves exploration and achieves lower costs than standard LMPC.

</details>


### [606] [Model-Free PID Tuning by Step-Response Inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15711)
*Daniel Pachner,Pavel Otta,Jiří Dostál,Vladimír Havlena*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出SPIN算法，用单次闭环阶跃响应构建相图并计数绕圈，从而自动整定PID增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业PID回路仍靠手动整定（步进设定值、观察响应、调整增益），过程繁琐且依赖经验，需要一种无需辨识模型、无需优化的自动化整定方法。

Method: 从单个闭环阶跃响应出发，构造控制偏差的三个相图，统计每条轨迹绕其稳定点缠绕的次数；这些计数无量纲，与步长和时钟无关，可辨别是积分、比例还是微分通道欠阻尼。用三角规则读取三个计数：对确定有问题的频带降低增益，对通过测试的频带提高增益。无需模型辨识与优化求解，迭代确定性且有界。

Result: 在典型过程对象上用单一固定步长和一套无量纲常数验证；迭代收敛到良阻尼集合边缘的循环。可从任意增益（含致稳性差的初值）开始，过程运行中即可使用，除常规设定值阶跃外无需额外激励。每次决策可见，操作员能了解算法所见。

Conclusion: SPIN将手动PID整定转化为确定性算法，适用于增益和相位随频率下降的自调节稳定过程（涵盖滞后+死时模型）及含积分作用的嵌套I⊂PI⊂PID控制器，并提供公开参考实现与交互演示。

Abstract: Industrial PID loops are still tuned by hand: step the setpoint, look at the response, change a gain. This paper turns that procedure into an algorithm, SPIN, for Step-response Phase-portrait INspection. From a single closed-loop step response we form three phase portraits of the control deviation and count how many times each trajectory winds around its settling point. The counts are dimensionless and independent of the step size and of the clock. They show which channel is under-damped: integral, proportional, or derivative. A triangular rule reads the three counts, cutting the gain of the one band whose fault is certain and raising that of every band the same test shows to be within its limit. No model is identified and no optimization is solved. The iteration is deterministic and its gains stay inside a fixed box. Because a ringing count is itself the evidence that the loop is in the regime where cutting that band's gain reduces the count, the iteration settles into a cycle at the edge of the well-damped set. It needs no excitation beyond a routine setpoint step, so it can run on a process in operation, and it may start from arbitrary gains, including destabilizing ones. SPIN assumes a stable, self-regulating process whose gain and phase both fall with frequency, which covers the lag-plus-dead-time models common in process control, and a controller from the nested family $\mathrm{I} \subset \mathrm{PI} \subset \mathrm{PID}$ with integral action present. We validate it on a battery of process-typical plants with one fixed step size and one set of dimensionless constants throughout. Every decision is visible: the operator sees what the algorithm sees. A reference implementation and an interactive demonstration are public.

</details>


### [607] [Hydrogen-Diesel Dual-Fuel Engine Operation Using Real-Time GRU-Based Nonlinear Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15819)
*Alexander Winkler,Vasu Sharma,Julian Bedei,Edward Sperling,Charles Robert Koch,David Gordon,Jakob Andert*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本研究将基于门控循环单元(GRU)深度神经网络动力学模型的非线性模型预测控制(NMPC)应用于氢-柴油双燃料(H2DF)发动机的瞬态控制，实现实时、约束感知的控制并大幅替代柴油。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 氢-柴油双燃料燃烧可降低燃烧产生的CO2排放，但在高氢能占比(HES)下表现出非线性循环间动力学特性，传统控制难以应对。

Method: 训练GRU深度神经网络动力学模型（基于99,800个发动机循环数据），预测指示平均有效压力、NOx、颗粒物(PM)和最大压升率；采用NMPC进行瞬态H2DF控制，并在单缸Cummins 4.5 L发动机上沿一条未见的4,900循环轨迹进行实验验证。

Result: 相比量产纯柴油控制，NMPC将负载跟踪平均绝对误差改善27.8%，平均PM降低61.1%，但无EGR时发动机出口NOx平均增加105.1%。平均与峰值HES分别达39.7%和55.1%；高氢设置下峰值HES达77.8%且无约束违反。对反馈噪声和模型-对象失配具有鲁棒性，在低成本嵌入式硬件上每循环执行耗时3-7 ms。

Conclusion: 基于学习动力学的NMPC可实现实用、实时、约束感知的瞬态H2DF控制，并显著替代柴油。

Abstract: Hydrogen-diesel dual-fuel (H2DF) combustion reduces combustion-out CO2 emissions but exhibits nonlinear cycle-to-cycle dynamics at high hydrogen energy shares (HES). This work evaluates nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) with a gated recurrent-unit deep neural network dynamics model for transient H2DF control. Trained on 99,800 engine cycles, the model predicts indicated mean effective pressure, nitrogen oxides (NOx), particulate matter (PM), and maximum pressure-rise rate. Single-cylinder Cummins 4.5 L experiments follow an unseen 4,900-engine-cycle trajectory. Compared with production diesel-only control, NMPC improves load-tracking mean absolute error by 27.8% and reduces mean PM by 61.1%, while mean engine-out NOx increases by 105.1% without exhaust-gas recirculation. Mean and peak HES reach 39.7% and 55.1%; a high-hydrogen setting achieves 77.8% peak HES without constraint violations. Robust to feedback noise and model-plant mismatch and executing in 3 to 7 ms per engine cycle on low-cost embedded hardware, learned-dynamics NMPC enables practical, real-time, constraint-aware transient H2DF control with substantial diesel substitution.

</details>
